translation.en: Can you manage chopsticks ?
translation.zh: 你会用筷子吗？

translation.en: Why not ? See .
translation.zh: 怎么不会？看。

translation.en: Good mastery . How do you like our Chinese food ?
translation.zh: 太厉害了。你觉得我们的中国菜怎么样？

translation.en: Oh , great ! It's delicious . You see , I am already putting on weight . There is one thing I don't like however , MSG .
translation.zh: 哦，太好了！很好吃。你看，我都已经吃胖了。但是有一样东西我不喜欢，就是味精。

translation.en: What's wrong with MSG ? It helps to bring out the taste of the food .
translation.zh: 味精怎么了？它有助于提升食物的味道。

translation.en: According to some studies it may cause cancer .
translation.zh: 一些研究显示，它可能会导致癌症。

translation.en: Oh , don't let that worry you . If that were true , China wouldn't have such a large population .
translation.zh: 哦，别担心。如果这是真的，中国就不会有这么多人了。

translation.en: I just happen to have a question for you guys . Why do the Chinese cook the vegetables ? You see what I mean is that most vitamin are destroyed when heated .
translation.zh: 我正好有个问题要问你们。为什么中国人要煮蔬菜？你知道我的意思是大多数蔬菜在加热时，维生素都会被破坏。

translation.en: I don't know exactly . It's a tradition . Maybe it's for sanitary reasons .
translation.zh: 我不太清楚。这是一个传统。也许是因为卫生原因吧。

translation.en: Mike's Mechanics . Can I help you ?
translation.zh: 迈克修车厂，我能为你做些什么吗？

translation.en: Yes , how do I get to your shop from Chilin ?
translation.zh: 是的，从麒麟到你们店怎么走？

translation.en: Go straight up Zhongshan Road and you will see our sign on your right , after you pass the museum .
translation.zh: 沿着中山路一直走，经过博物馆后，你会看到我们的标志牌在你的右手边。

translation.en: Hi Bill , it ’ s Jane .
translation.zh: 嗨，比尔，我是简。

translation.en: Jane , I ’ m on the other line , can you hang on for a second ?
translation.zh: 简，我在接另一个电话，你能稍等一下吗？

translation.en: OK , I ’ ll be right back .
translation.zh: 好的，我马上回来。

translation.en: Looks like dinner's ready .
translation.zh: 看来晚餐准备好了。

translation.en: I made my little brother cry .
translation.zh: 我让我弟弟哭了。

translation.en: Shame on you !
translation.zh: 我真为你感到羞耻！

translation.en: Can I have the check please ?
translation.zh: 请给我支票好吗？

translation.en: Is this amount correct ?
translation.zh: 这个数目正确吗？

translation.en: Yes , sir , it is .
translation.zh: 是的，先生，是的。

translation.en: Thank you , the service was good
translation.zh: 谢谢，服务很好

translation.en: Please come again .
translation.zh: 请再来。

translation.en: Did anyone call ?
translation.zh: 有人打电话来吗？

translation.en: Just Mr . White .
translation.zh: 是怀特先生。。

translation.en: What did he want ?
translation.zh: 他想做什么？

translation.en: He wouldn't say over the phone .
translation.zh: 他不肯在电话里说。

translation.en: Andrew's Hair Salon , this is Andrew .
translation.zh: 安德鲁的发廊，这是安德鲁。

translation.en: Andrew , this is Linda Chen .
translation.zh: 安德鲁，这是琳达·陈。

translation.en: Hi Linda , what can I do for you ?
translation.zh: 嗨，琳达，有什么事吗？

translation.en: I need to set up an appointment to get my hair fixed .
translation.zh: 我需要预约去修头发。

translation.en: For what day ?
translation.zh: 哪一天？

translation.en: Tuesday morning .
translation.zh: 星期二早上。

translation.en: I'm getting a tattoo tomorrow .
translation.zh: 我明天要纹身。

translation.en: Are you nuts ?
translation.zh: 你疯了吗？

translation.en: What's for lunch ?
translation.zh: 午餐吃什么？

translation.en: Pork chops .
translation.zh: 猪排。

translation.en: May we see the wine list please ?
translation.zh: 我们可以看看酒单吗？

translation.en: Sure . Our special wine today is a 1989 Chardonnay .
translation.zh: 当然。我们今天的特色葡萄酒是1989年的霞多丽。

translation.en: That sounds pretty good ! How much is it ?
translation.zh: 听起来不错！多少钱？

translation.en: It's $ 4.25 cents by the glass . The whole bottle is $ 22.5 .
translation.zh: 每杯4.25美分。整瓶22.5美元。

translation.en: I'd like a bottle please .
translation.zh: 我想要一瓶。

translation.en: I'll need to see your ID please .
translation.zh: 我需要看看你的身份证。

translation.en: Sorry about the inconvenience , you look so young . I had make sure you are over 21 years old .
translation.zh: 很抱歉给您带来不便，您看起来很年轻。我得确定你已经21岁了。

translation.en: No , can I take a message ?
translation.zh: 不，我可以留个口信吗？

translation.en: No , I'll call back later .
translation.zh: 不，我稍后再打。

translation.en: I'd like to talk to Mr . White please ?
translation.zh: 我可以和怀特先生谈谈吗？

translation.en: He stepped out of the office for a little while .
translation.zh: 他刚离开办公室一会儿。

translation.en: When is a good time to catch him ?
translation.zh: 什么时候可以找到他？

translation.en: In about twenty minutes .
translation.zh: 大约二十分钟后。

translation.en: You stepped on my foot !
translation.zh: 你踩到我的脚了！

translation.en: Sorry . I didn't mean to .
translation.zh: 对不起。我不是故意的。

translation.en: No , he is at work now .
translation.zh: 不，他现在在工作。

translation.en: May I have his office phone number please ?
translation.zh: 请问我能知道他办公室的电话号码是多少吗？

translation.en: It's your turn to go first .
translation.zh: 轮到你先走了。

translation.en: I went first last time .
translation.zh: 上次就是我先走的。

translation.en: No , Mary went first last time .
translation.zh: 不，上次是玛丽先走的。

translation.en: Oh , Okay .
translation.zh: 哦，好吧。

translation.en: I am a student in Cambridge University . I read your ad , I want to know something more about your room , please ?
translation.zh: 我是剑桥大学的学生。我看了你的广告，我想了解更多关于你房间的情况，好吗？

translation.en: It's a big bedroom with a drawing room , facing a beautiful wood .
translation.zh: 这是一间带客厅的大卧室，面对着一片美丽的树林。

translation.en: Is there a bathroom ?
translation.zh: 有浴室吗？

translation.en: No , but there is one downstairs , which my daughter used some years ago .
translation.zh: 没有，但楼下有一个，我女儿几年前用过。

translation.en: It sounds good . Could I go and see it myself ?
translation.zh: 听起来不错。我能亲自去看看吗？

translation.en: Certainly , you're welcome anytime .
translation.zh: 当然，随时欢迎你。

translation.en: See you later !
translation.zh: 那到时候见！

translation.en: ( after a while ) Good afternoon , Mrs . Smith . I called you just now .
translation.zh: （过了一会儿）下午好，史密斯夫人。我刚才和你通过电话。

translation.en: Welcome ! Come in , please !
translation.zh: 欢迎光临！请进！

translation.en: This way please . Your room is upstairs ... Here it is .
translation.zh: 请这边走。你的房间在楼上……就是这里。

translation.en: Wonderful ! A modest , comfortable room . Ah , a beautiful window , through which I can see a beautiful scene , and hear the birds singing . How nice !
translation.zh: 太好了！这是个简约舒适的房间。啊，还有一扇漂亮的窗户，透过它我可以看到美丽的景色，听到鸟儿的歌唱。多好啊！

translation.en: Yes , if you want to wash something , there is a separate lavatory room outside .
translation.zh: 是的，如果你想洗东西，外面还有一个单独的盥洗室。

translation.en: Excellent ! I like it ! When can I move in ?
translation.zh: 真棒！我喜欢！我什么时候能搬进来？

translation.en: Anytime you like .
translation.zh: 你想什么时候都行。

translation.en: Ah , Bob . Just the person I wanted to see .
translation.zh: 啊，鲍勃。正是我想见的人。

translation.en: So what is it ?
translation.zh: 那是什么？

translation.en: You gotta help me out this time , buddy .
translation.zh: 这次你得帮帮我，伙计。

translation.en: Another tough thing , I guess .
translation.zh: 另一件很难的事，我想。

translation.en: Who broke my chair ?
translation.zh: 谁把我的椅子弄坏了？

translation.en: It wasn't me .
translation.zh: 不是我。

translation.en: Man ! That car almost hit me !
translation.zh: 哇！那辆车差点撞到我！

translation.en: Yeah , that was close .
translation.zh: 是啊，好险。

translation.en: Yes , sir . Where to ?
translation.zh: 是的，先生。去哪里？

translation.en: Wangfujing , please !
translation.zh: 王府井，拜托！

translation.en: Oh , I like the music on your radio . It's nice .
translation.zh: 哦，我喜欢你收音机里的音乐。很好听。

translation.en: Thank you ! I always tune to this program when driving . So what's your favorite program ?
translation.zh: 非常感谢。我开车时总是调到这个节目。你最喜欢的节目是什么？

translation.en: I like Winner's English very mush . You know the Beijing Olympic Games is right around the corner . We should learn English Well . It's on FM 96.6 , China Business Radio . You can get it on your radio too .
translation.zh: 我非常喜欢温纳英语。你知道北京奥运会就要来了。我们应该学好英语。中国商业广播电台就在96.6频道。你也可以在收音机里听到。

translation.en: But I don't speak English at all .
translation.zh: 但我一点也不会说英语。

translation.en: That's OK . The program is especially for the beginners like us .
translation.zh: 没关系。这个节目特别适合像我们这样的初学者。

translation.en: Really ? When is it on ?
translation.zh: 真的吗？节目什么时候开始？

translation.en: It begins at 6:40 every morning , and it goes for 20 minutes .
translation.zh: 每天早上6:40开始，持续20分钟。

translation.en: Thank you so much . I'll try and catch that .
translation.zh: 非常感谢。我会好好学一学的。

translation.en: The radio has brought us lots of convenience .
translation.zh: 收音机给我们带来了许多方便。

translation.en: Yes , I can also learn about the traffic condition through it .
translation.zh: 是的，我也可以通过它了解交通状况。

translation.en: With the development of the society and technology , radio is nearly everywhere .
translation.zh: 随着社会和科技的发展，无线电几乎无处不在。

translation.en: So we should take the advantage of it .
translation.zh: 所以我们应该好好利用它。

translation.en: It's so boring .
translation.zh: 太无聊了。

translation.en: Don't you like it ?
translation.zh: 你不喜欢这个频道吗？

translation.en: I don't . Is there anything worth watching on the other channel ?
translation.zh: 不喜欢。另一个频道有什么值得看的吗？

translation.en: I think it's a basketball match on channel 5 .
translation.zh: 应该正在播第五频道的篮球赛。

translation.en: Do you mind if we switch over ?
translation.zh: 你介意我们换个频道吗？

translation.en: Well , I'd rather see a movie .
translation.zh: 嗯，我更想看电影。

translation.en: What's the movie ?
translation.zh: 什么电影？

translation.en: ' Star war ' .
translation.zh: 《星球大战》。

translation.en: It must be interesting .
translation.zh: 一定很有趣。

translation.en: Peter , enough with your computer games . Go do your homework now .
translation.zh: 彼得，你的电脑游戏玩够了。现在去做作业。

translation.en: Can't I play more ?
translation.zh: 我不能再玩一会儿吗？

translation.en: No ! Stop playing computer games !
translation.zh: 不！别玩电脑游戏了！

translation.en: Mom , I'll be finished soon .
translation.zh: 妈妈，我马上就好了。

translation.en: Peter , if you don't turn off your computer , then I won't allow you to play it again starting next week .
translation.zh: 彼得，如果你不关掉电脑，从下周开始我就不允许你再玩了。

translation.en: May I have a cookie ?
translation.zh: 我可以要一块饼干吗？

translation.en: Peter , go and tidy up your toys now .
translation.zh: 彼得，现在去整理你的玩具。

translation.en: Wait a moment , mom .
translation.zh: 等等，妈妈。

translation.en: I'm mad ! I said now ! Turn off the TV , and do it now .
translation.zh: 我疯了！我说现在！关掉电视，现在就做。

translation.en: Mom , just ten more minutes . The show is going to be over soon .
translation.zh: 妈妈，再等十分钟。演出马上就要结束了。

translation.en: Peter , if you don't do it soon , I will throw your toys in the trash can .
translation.zh: 彼得，如果你不快点做，我就把你的玩具扔进垃圾桶。

translation.en: Dad , may I have a room of my own ?
translation.zh: 爸爸，我可以有自己的房间吗？

translation.en: Oh , honey , I'm so sorry , we don't have enough space for you to have your own room .
translation.zh: 哦，亲爱的，对不起，我们没有足够的空间让你自己住。

translation.en: Dad , but I don't want to share a room with Peter . He snores every night .
translation.zh: 爸爸，但我不想和彼得同住一个房间。他每晚都打鼾。

translation.en: Honey , you can ask him to be quite . Otherwise you may punish him and tell him to stand out of the room , right ?
translation.zh: 亲爱的，你可以让他安静点。否则的话你可以惩罚他，叫他离开房间，对吗？

translation.en: Alright . Maybe it's the only way to do it .
translation.zh: 好吧。也许这是唯一的办法了。

translation.en: Mom , what are we going to make tonight ?
translation.zh: 妈妈，我们今晚要做什么？

translation.en: Curry and rice . What do you think ?
translation.zh: 咖喱饭。你怎么认为？

translation.en: That sounds nice . I can peel the potatoes first .
translation.zh: 听起来不错。我可以先剥土豆皮。

translation.en: Really ! Oh , honey , you are so sweet . I'll chop up this carrot .
translation.zh: 真正地！哦，亲爱的，你真好。我要把胡萝卜切碎。

translation.en: Mom , the water is boiling !
translation.zh: 妈妈，水开了！

translation.en: Honey , just turn down the stove .
translation.zh: 亲爱的，把炉子关小点。

translation.en: Can you make out what he's saying ?
translation.zh: 你能听懂他在说什么吗？

translation.en: No , it's too loud in here .
translation.zh: 不能，这里太吵了。

translation.en: Don't tell me you're pregnant again .
translation.zh: 别告诉我你又怀孕了。

translation.en: Kate , can we change the channel ?
translation.zh: 凯特，我们能换个频道吗？

translation.en: This channel has so many advertisements , and it doesn't have any good TV programs .
translation.zh: 这个频道广告很多，也没有好的电视节目。

translation.en: OK . You can change it .
translation.zh: 好的，你可以换个频道。

translation.en: What about this one ? Do you like this program ?
translation.zh: 这个怎么样？你喜欢这个节目吗？

translation.en: No , I think it is very boring . Can you change it to Channel Twelve , please ?
translation.zh: 不，我觉得很无聊。请换到12频道好吗？

translation.en: Yes . Oh , it's a talk show .
translation.zh: 好的。哦，是脱口秀。

translation.en: Yeah , it's very funny . Have you ever watched it before ?
translation.zh: 是啊，很有趣。你以前看过吗？

translation.en: No , I haven't . This is my first time to watch it .
translation.zh: 不，我没有。这是我第一次看。

translation.en: I'm sure you will like it .
translation.zh: 我相信你会喜欢的。

translation.en: How much was your watch ?
translation.zh: 你的表多少钱？

translation.en: Take a guess .
translation.zh: 猜猜看。

translation.en: Yes . I ’ m trying to find a pair of earrings to match my necklace . Can you recommend some to me ?
translation.zh: 对。我想找一对耳环来配我的项链。你能给我推荐一些吗？

translation.en: Yes . Your gold necklace has a diamond pendant , and your eardrops should be
translation.zh: 好的。你的金项链带一个钻石坠，那么你的耳坠也应镶有钻石。

translation.en: These look wonderful . Do these come with a guarantee of quality ?
translation.zh: 看起来很棒。这些有质量保证吗？

translation.en: Of course . If there is anything wrong with them , you can come back and show me the guarantee of quality , and then you will surely get free service .
translation.zh: 当然。如果他们有什么问题，你可以回来给我看质量保证书，然后你一定会得到免费服务。

translation.en: I ’ ll take them .
translation.zh: 给我吧。

translation.en: I like these shoes .
translation.zh: 我喜欢这双鞋。

translation.en: Do you realize that all these shoes are half off ?
translation.zh: 你知道这些鞋都是半价吗？

translation.en: Yes , but the offer only lasts this week .
translation.zh: 是的，但优惠只在本周内有效。

translation.en: What would you like to eat tonight ?
translation.zh: 你今晚想吃什么？

translation.en: I'm not sure , what about you ?
translation.zh: 我不确定，你呢？

translation.en: Do you think Kentucky fried chicken is good ?
translation.zh: 肯德基行吗？

translation.en: Sure sounds good to me .
translation.zh: 听起来不错。

translation.en: What's on TV tonight ?
translation.zh: 今晚电视上有什么节目？

translation.en: Good morning . Could you tell me where I can find the Clothing Department ?
translation.zh: 早上好。你能告诉我哪里是服装区吗？

translation.en: On the left of the elevator of the 3rd floor .
translation.zh: 在三楼电梯的左边。

translation.en: I ’ d like to buy a woolen vest for my grandpa .
translation.zh: 我想给我爷爷买件羊毛背心。

translation.en: I ’ m sure you can find your favorite there .
translation.zh: 我相信你能在那里找到你最喜欢的。

translation.en: It ’ s my honor .
translation.zh: 这是我的荣幸。

translation.en: Please give me a piece of ' New York Daily ' .
translation.zh: 请给我一份《纽约日报》。

translation.en: You are late . The last piece has sold out .
translation.zh: 你来晚了。最后一份已经卖完了。

translation.en: Really ? Is there ' Wall Street Journal ' , please ?
translation.zh: 真的吗？请问有《华尔街日报》吗？

translation.en: There are several , take a piece . The crash appears in the headline . It is famous for offering catastrophe stories .
translation.zh: 有几份，你可以拿一份。这期的头版头条是撞车事故。他们做灾难新闻很有名。

translation.en: I have a long flight for ten hours . I need to choose a magazine .
translation.zh: 我要坐10个小时的长途飞机。我想买一本杂志。

translation.en: There are various magazines in the rack .
translation.zh: 架子上有各种杂志。

translation.en: Give me the latest issue of ' National Geographic ' .
translation.zh: 给我最新一期的《国家地理》。

translation.en: That's the top magazine in America and is popular with young people . OK . It is totally 30 dollars .
translation.zh: 那是美国最好的杂志，很受年轻人的欢迎。一共30美元。

translation.en: Have a nice trip .
translation.zh: 祝你旅途愉快。

translation.en: Have you got change for a thousand ?
translation.zh: 你有一千元的零钱吗？

translation.en: Do you develop films here ?
translation.zh: 你们这儿能冲洗胶卷吗？

translation.en: Yes , we shall . What size do you like ?
translation.zh: 是的，我们能。你喜欢多大尺寸的？

translation.en: Well , the 4 x 6 is fine .
translation.zh: 嗯，4x6就行。

translation.en: Which do you prefer , color or black and white ?
translation.zh: 你喜欢哪一种，彩色还是黑白的？

translation.en: The last one is black and white , all the rest should need color .
translation.zh: 最后一个是黑白的，其余的都需要彩色。

translation.en: I hope they will come out well . When should I pick them up ?
translation.zh: 我希望效果还不错。我应该什么时候来取？

translation.en: They will be ready at noon tomorrow . Each negative develops one print , right ?
translation.zh: 明天中午就好了。每张底片可以冲洗一张照片，对吗?

translation.en: Yes , it is . And develop them as glossy as possible .
translation.zh: 是的，是的。尽可能地使它们有光泽。

translation.en: No problem . Do you need another film ?
translation.zh: 没问题。你还需要一卷胶卷吗？

translation.en: Yes , a roll of Kodak film please .
translation.zh: 是的，请给我一卷柯达胶卷。

translation.en: It is totally $ 20 including the deposit for films .
translation.zh: 包括胶卷押金在内总共20美元。

translation.en: Who ate the cookies that were sitting here ?
translation.zh: 谁吃了放在这里的饼干？

translation.en: I did , Mom .
translation.zh: 是我，妈妈。

translation.en: Shame on you . I was saving them for your brother .
translation.zh: 真羞，我原本是要留给你弟弟吃的。

translation.en: Can you tell me what's included in your warranty ?
translation.zh: 你能告诉我你的保修范围包括什么吗？

translation.en: Certainly . The product has a two-year guarantee . If it breaks down during that period we offer a replacement unit completely free of charge . Our products are very reliable but we recommend you take out an extended warranty . This covers you for a further two years .
translation.zh: 当然可以。这个产品有两年的保修期。如果在此期间出现故障，我们提供完全免费的更换装置。我们的产品非常可靠，但我们建议您延长保修期。这可以额外为你提供两年保修。

translation.en: I see . What does that include ?
translation.zh: 我知道了。延长保修期包括什么？

translation.en: It covers all parts and labour , except for normal wear and tear of course .
translation.zh: 它包含所有零件和人工服务，当然正常磨损和破损除外。

translation.en: What sort of response time do you guarantee ?
translation.zh: 你保证多久的回应时间？

translation.en: Our engineers are on call 24 hours a day . We guarantee someone will be with you within four hours , but in practice it's often much sooner .
translation.zh: 我们的工程师24小时待命。我们保证工作人员会在四小时内给予回应，但实际上要快得多。

translation.en: Are there any exclusions ?
translation.zh: 没有额外的内容吗？

translation.en: Not really . It's a very comprehensive warranty . I ’ ll put a copy in the post to you and you can read through the small print .
translation.zh: 没有。这是一个非常全面的质保。我可以给你寄一份，你可以认真看一下附属细则。

translation.en: I'm so sorry about your brother , Mr . Wang .
translation.zh: 你哥哥的事我很抱歉，王先生。

translation.en: Thanks , Jane .
translation.zh: 谢谢，简。

translation.en: If you need any help , just let me know .
translation.zh: 如果你需要帮助，尽管告诉我。

translation.en: Hey , young lady , get back here and have some breakfast .
translation.zh: 嘿，小姐，过来这边吃点早餐。

translation.en: Dad ! I don't have time ! I'll be late for school !
translation.zh: 爸爸！我没时间了！我上学要迟到了！

translation.en: You won't make it through the day without breakfast .
translation.zh: 你不吃早餐没办法撑过整个上午。

translation.en: Dad , I never eat breakfast .
translation.zh: 爸爸，我从不吃早餐。

translation.en: Breakfast is brain food . Maybe that's why your grades are Suffering .
translation.zh: 早餐是智慧的来源，难怪你的成绩那么糟。

translation.en: Uh ! Dad !
translation.zh: 哦！爸爸！

translation.en: Don't ' Uh , Dad ' me . Sit down and have some lovely breakfast .
translation.zh: 别来这套，坐下来吃顿美味的早餐。

translation.en: Alright . You win . Please pass the brain food .
translation.zh: 好，你赢了，请递给我智慧的来源。

translation.en: Can you help me out , Chuck ?
translation.zh: 你能帮帮我吗，查克？

translation.en: Sure . What's it , Yvonne ?
translation.zh: 当然。怎么了，伊冯？

translation.en: I want to put my desk over there , but it's too heavy for me to move .
translation.zh: 我想把桌子放在那边，但太重了，我搬不动。

translation.en: Okay , you take one end and I'll take the other .
translation.zh: 好吧，你抬那边端，我抬另一边。

translation.en: Can you show me some traditional Chinese arts and crafts ?
translation.zh: 你能给我看一些中国传统工艺品吗？

translation.en: Maybe sandalwood fan is good .
translation.zh: 也许檀香扇不错。

translation.en: Would you show me some ?
translation.zh: 你能给我看看吗？

translation.en: They really smell fragrant . How much is a real sandalwood fan ?
translation.zh: 它们闻起来真香。一个真正的檀香扇多少钱？

translation.en: The small ones are one hundred yuan for each . And the big ones are two hundred and thirty yuan .
translation.zh: 小的100元一个。大的是230元。

translation.en: I'll take two small ones and a big one .
translation.zh: 我要两个小的和一个大的。

translation.en: What else are you interested in ?
translation.zh: 你还有什么其他感兴趣的吗？

translation.en: I would like to buy some local handcrafts as gifts to my friends and relatives .
translation.zh: 我想买一些当地的手工艺品作为礼物送给我的朋友和亲戚。

translation.en: There are many stores selling handcrafts in Paris . Our store is wellknown for vase , table wear and jewelry boxes . You can take your time and choose whatever you like .
translation.zh: 巴黎有许多卖手工艺品的商店。我们店以花瓶、餐具和珠宝盒闻名。您可以慢慢挑选您喜欢的。

translation.en: Well , the tapestry is delicate and beautiful .
translation.zh: 嗯，挂毯很精致，很漂亮。

translation.en: You have made an excellent choice , it is our newcomer . The tapestry is on hot sell with the design and quality . The design on it is traditional Paris architecture .
translation.zh: 您眼光真好，这是我们的新品。这条挂毯因为设计和质量卖的很好，图案是巴黎传统的建筑物。

translation.en: 100 frances .
Mmm , it is reasonable . Look at this set of table wear , it is so beautiful !
translation.zh: 嗯。比较合理。看看这套餐具多漂亮！

translation.en: We have a piece of table clothing to go with it . It is a brocade one with pretty stars .
translation.zh: 我们有配套的桌布，是棉质的，上面有可爱的星星。

translation.en: This silver vase is a good ornament for the living room .
translation.zh: 这个银质花瓶放在客厅里是个不错的装饰品。

translation.en: I will take the tapestry , the set of table wear and the vase .
translation.zh: 我要挂毯，那套餐具还有那支花瓶。

translation.en: OK . Do you like these candles ? They are on sale now .
translation.zh: 好的，您喜欢这些蜡烛吗？它们现在正在特价促销呢。

translation.en: All right . I will take one .
translation.zh: 好的。我要一支。

translation.en: Did you ever buy food from the snack stands near our hotel ?
translation.zh: 您在宾馆外那些小摊吃过吗？

translation.en: Yes , several times .
translation.zh: 是的，吃过好几次了。

translation.en: How do you like them ?
translation.zh: 你觉得怎么样？

translation.en: I always have the temptation to eat something there .
translation.zh: 我总想在那里吃点东西。

translation.en: Then , why didn't you do that ?
translation.zh: 那你为什么没去呢？

translation.en: I don't know how much we can trust them . Do you have any ideas ?
translation.zh: 我不知道我们能否相信他们，您觉得呢？

translation.en: Some of them , I think , are not good .
translation.zh: 我觉得有些小摊不怎么样。

translation.en: It doesn't taste good ?
translation.zh: 味道不好吗？

translation.en: No , I mean some of them are not clean enough .
translation.zh: 不是，我是说有些不够干净。

translation.en: That's my greatest concern . But how can you tell which one is clean ?
translation.zh: 这也是我最担心的。但是你怎么知道哪一个是干净的呢？

translation.en: I judge by appearances .
translation.zh: 我从外表判断。

translation.en: I got it . I think it's worth trying .
translation.zh: 我明白了。我觉得值得一试。

translation.en: I'd like to try some kebab , roasted squid , and many different appealing things .
translation.zh: 我想尝尝烤羊肉串，烤鱿鱼，还有很多吸引人的小吃。

translation.en: Don't try everything at one time , please .
translation.zh: 请不要一次吃太多。

translation.en: It is my first time coming to China . I want to buy something unique of China to my friends as gifts .
translation.zh: 这是我第一次来中国。我想买一些中国特产作为礼物送给我的朋友。

translation.en: We have a great variety of Chinese antiques and porcelain . Do you like them ?
translation.zh: 我们有各种各样的中国古董和瓷器。你喜欢吗？

translation.en: Yes , I love them , but they are fragile . It is not convenient to take them .
translation.zh: 是的，我非常喜欢它们，但它们很脆弱。带着它们不方便。

translation.en: You are right . How about paintings and embroidered handkerchiefs ?
translation.zh: 对的。画和绣花手帕怎么样？

translation.en: Sounds good . May I have a look ?
translation.zh: 听起来不错。我可以看看吗？

translation.en: Of course . These paintings have many designs , such as animals , flowers , landscape , aquatics and so on .
translation.zh: 当然。这些画有许多图案，如动物、花卉、风景、水上运动等等。

translation.en: They are beautiful , but I can't understand the connotation in them . Let me see the handkerchiefs .
translation.zh: 它们很美，但我不明白它们的内涵。让我看看手帕吧。

translation.en: All right . Chinese embroidery is one traditional art with elaborate design and high quality .
translation.zh: 好的。中国刺绣是一门设计精巧、质量上乘的传统艺术。

translation.en: Oh , I like the bamboo design . What is this ?
translation.zh: 哦，我喜欢竹子的图案。这是什么？

translation.en: This is a series of animals , called Chinese zodiac .
translation.zh: 这是一系列的动物，叫做中国十二生肖。

translation.en: Good . So I will take three series and five bamboo ones .
translation.zh: 很好。所以我要三套十二生肖的和五张竹子的。

translation.en: OK , I will wrap them for you .
translation.zh: 好的，我帮你包起来。

translation.en: Yes ! I finally lost that last five pounds I've been working on forever !
translation.zh: 太好了！我终于减掉了我一直在努力的最后五磅！

translation.en: How did you finally do it ?
translation.zh: 你最后是怎么做到的？

translation.en: A friend suggested that I stop nibbling between meals .
translation.zh: 一个朋友建议我不要在两餐之间吃东西。

translation.en: Like snacking ?
translation.zh: 比如零食吗？

translation.en: You know , a little piece of chocolate here , some chips on the side , candy now and then ...
translation.zh: 你懂的，这里有一小块巧克力，那里有一些薯条，时不时地还有些糖果……

translation.en: I get what you mean .
translation.zh: 我明白你的意思。

translation.en: Instead , I sit down and have a good snack like a piece of fruit between meals .
translation.zh: （所以，）取而代之，我会坐下来，在两餐之间吃一点有益的零食，比如一点水果之类的。

translation.en: I'm impressed . Good for you !
translation.zh: 我印真佩服你，真为你高兴！

translation.en: Bob , would you come and help me ?
translation.zh: 鲍勃，你能来帮我吗？

translation.en: Of course . What do you want me to do , Mom ?
translation.zh: 当然。你想让我怎么做，妈妈？

translation.en: Could you hold these packages while I look for the key ?
translation.zh: 我找钥匙时，你能帮我拿一下这些包裹吗？

translation.en: Alright , what's in them ? They are so heavy !
translation.zh: 好吧，里面有什么？它们太重了！

translation.en: Just things we need for the picnic tomorrow .
translation.zh: 只是我们明天野餐需要的东西。

translation.en: Well , hurry up and open the door please . I told you these things are heavy .
translation.zh: 好吧，请快点开门。我告诉过你这些东西很重。

translation.en: I'm sorry , but I just can't find the key . You must have it .
translation.zh: 对不起，我就是找不到钥匙。你一定有。

translation.en: Oh , yes , it's in my pocket . But how can I get the key while I'm holding all these bags ?
translation.zh: 哦，是的，它在我的口袋里。但是我拿着这些包怎么能拿到钥匙呢？

translation.en: Be careful . The floor is wet .
translation.zh: 小心。地板是湿的。

translation.en: I spilled my drink .
translation.zh: 我把饮料洒了。

translation.en: Why is there water all over the bathroom floor ?
translation.zh: 为什么浴室地板上到处都是水？

translation.en: I'm sorry - it's my fault . I was filling the bathtub and I left the water running too long , so it overflowed .
translation.zh: 对不起，这是我的错。我在往浴缸里放水，放得太久了，所以水溢出来了。

translation.en: That's OK . As long as you clean it up .
translation.zh: 没关系。只要你把它清理干净就行。

translation.en: Oh , no . Carnations are not very elegant . Artificial flowers have no passion .
translation.zh: 哦，不。康乃馨不是很优雅。假花没有激情。

translation.en: Do you want to add some baby's breath for that ? They are equally popular now .
translation.zh: 你想加一些满天星吗？它们现在同样很受欢迎。

translation.en: Peter , it's time to get up .
translation.zh: 彼得，该起床了。

translation.en: Ten more minutes , mom .
translation.zh: 还有十分钟，妈妈。

translation.en: What time is it now ?
translation.zh: 现在几点了？

translation.en: It's already 3 8 o'clock .
translation.zh: 已经是3点8分了。

translation.en: Well , honey , wake up , or you'll be late for school .
translation.zh: 好吧，亲爱的，醒醒，不然你上学要迟到了。

translation.en: Hi ! Fiona ? I almost didn't recognize you . You are much thinner since I last saw you .
translation.zh: 你好！菲昂纳？我差点认不出你来。自从我上次见到你以来，你瘦多了。

translation.en: Yes . I have lost about ten kilos .
translation.zh: 对。我瘦了大约十公斤。

translation.en: I am on a diet . And I do more exercise regularly .
translation.zh: 我在节食。我经常锻炼。

translation.en: What's the secret then ?
translation.zh: 那秘密是什么？

translation.en: It lies in perseverance .
translation.zh: 秘密在于毅力。

translation.en: Well . It's hard for me . I can't keep doing exercise .
translation.zh: 好。对我来说很难。我不能一直做运动。

translation.en: You should have a try .
translation.zh: 你应该试试。

translation.en: Hello , Can I speak to Tom , please ?
translation.zh: 喂，请问汤姆在吗？

translation.en: May I ask what time he will come back ?
translation.zh: 请问他什么时候回来？

translation.en: I think he will come back at 3 p . m . Do you want to call later ? Or would you like to leave a message for him ?
translation.zh: 我想他下午三点会回来。你想晚点再打电话过来吗？或者你想给他留个口信？

translation.en: I'd like to leave a message . Please ask him to call me back as soon as he returns . I'm A and he has my number .
translation.zh: 我想留个口信。请让他一回来就给我回电话。我是A，他有我的号码。

translation.en: OK . I will do that .
translation.zh: 好的，我会的。

translation.en: Is that Sue ?
translation.zh: 请问是苏吗？

translation.en: A.This is George .
translation.zh: 我是乔治。

translation.en: Hello , George.What ' s up ?
translation.zh: 你好，乔治。怎么了？

translation.en: I'd like to send a fax to Shenzhen .
translation.zh: 我想发一份传真到深圳。

translation.en: Is it a photograph or a document ?
translation.zh: 是照片还是文件？

translation.en: Each of both .
translation.zh: 都有。

translation.en: Could I see both of them ?
translation.zh: 我能看看吗？

translation.en: You can't send this document ; it is not clear enough to send . The photograph is all right .
translation.zh: 您不能发送这个文件，不够清晰，所以无法发送。照片没问题。

translation.en: Well , how long will it take to arrive in Shenzhen ?
translation.zh: 嗯，到深圳要多长时间？

translation.en: Couple of minutes .
translation.zh: 几分钟。

translation.en: Great . How much ?
translation.zh: 太好了。多少钱？

translation.en: 5 $ . You should change another much clearer photograph for fax .
translation.zh: 5美元。你应该换一张更清晰的照片传真。

translation.en: Thank you . I will deal with it .
translation.zh: 非常感谢。我会处理的。

translation.en: Excuse me , is this the parcel counter ?
translation.zh: 打扰一下，这是包裹柜台吗？

translation.en: I'd like to send this parcel , please .
translation.zh: 我想寄这个包裹。

translation.en: Some books and newspapers .
translation.zh: 一些书和报纸。

translation.en: OK . please fill in this form and label it .
translation.zh: 好的，请填写这张表格，并贴上标签。

translation.en: Is it all right ?
translation.zh: 这就好了吗？

translation.en: Yeah . And would you like to mail it by air ?
translation.zh: 是的。您想航空邮寄吗？

translation.en: No , I'd rather send it by sea .
translation.zh: 不，我更想海运。

translation.en: Thirteen yuan , please . Here is the receipt and change .
translation.zh: 十三元。这是收据和零钱。

translation.en: Is this the counter to pick up parcels ?
translation.zh: 这是收包裹的柜台吗？

translation.en: I want to pick up my parcels .
translation.zh: 我想拿我的包裹。

translation.en: Please show me your parcel order .
translation.zh: 请出示您的包裹订单。

translation.en: Let me check your parcel number . Song Ping's parcel number should be CP 06230221 5 CN . Here is your parcel .
translation.zh: 让我查一下你的包裹号码。宋平的包裹号码应该是CP 06230221 5 CN。这是你的包裹。

translation.en: Hi Brittany . What are you doing with all of your clothes on your bed ?
translation.zh: 嗨，布列塔尼。你把衣服都放在床上干什么？

translation.en: I'm trying to decide what to wear to school the first day .
translation.zh: 我正试着决定第一天穿什么去上学。

translation.en: Oh , A . Mom didn't tell you ?
translation.zh: 哦，是的。妈妈没告诉你？

translation.en: Didn't tell me what ? What ?
translation.zh: 没告诉我什么？什么？

translation.en: This Bs ' school you're going to is going to make your life easy .
translation.zh: 你要去的这所学士学校会让你的生活变得轻松。

translation.en: What are you talking about brother ? Spill it .
translation.zh: 你在说什么？告诉我。

translation.en: Uniforms , sis , no more worrying about appearances !
translation.zh: 制服，姐姐，别再担心外表了！

translation.en: You mean I have to wear the same thing every day ? MOM !
translation.zh: 你是说我每天都要穿同样的衣服？妈妈！

translation.en: But Ernie , we're still missing something . We need someone to play the music !
translation.zh: 但是欧尼，我们还是少了点什么。我们需要有人来演奏音乐！

translation.en: Oh right ... you know , my friend Eric is a DJ . Maybe he would like to play with us .
translation.zh: 哦，对了……你知道吧，我的朋友埃里克是个DJ。也许他愿意和我们一起演奏。

translation.en: Hmm ... does he have a good ear for hip hop music ?
translation.zh: 呃……他对嘻哈音乐很在行吗？

translation.en: Well , I don't know , but we can find out . We can talk to him and ask if he wants to join our group .
translation.zh: 嗯，我不知道，但我们可以问一问。我们可以和他谈谈，问他是否愿意加入我们的乐队。

translation.en: What do you do besides work and watching TV ?
translation.zh: 除了工作和看电视，你还做什么？

translation.en: When I have some time , I like to exercise .
translation.zh: 当我有时间的时候，我喜欢锻炼。

translation.en: Do you go jogging or do you go to a health club ?
translation.zh: 你去慢跑还是去健身俱乐部？

translation.en: I joined Samsung Health Club a couple of months ago .
translation.zh: 几个月前我加入了三星健康俱乐部。

translation.en: How do you exercise ?
translation.zh: 你怎么锻炼的？

translation.en: I usually spend 30 minutes on the bicycle for the Carpio , and then I lift weight for about 45 minutes .
translation.zh: 我通常花30分钟骑自行车，然后举重约45分钟。

translation.en: How often do you go ?
translation.zh: 你多久去一次？

translation.en: I want to go four times a week , but I'm too lazy . Last week , I only went to workout once .
translation.zh: 我想一周去四次，但我太懒了。上周，我只去锻炼了一次。

translation.en: You look great ! How do you stay in such good shape ?
translation.zh: 你看起来棒极了！你怎么保持这么好的状态？

translation.en: Well , I go jogging every morning , eat a healthful diet and work out in a gymnasium twice a week .
translation.zh: 嗯，我每天早上都要慢跑，保持健康的饮食，每周去体育馆锻炼两次。

translation.en: Wow , it sounds like a lot of work . I guess I'm too lazy to do all that .
translation.zh: 哇，听起来要做很多事。我想我太懒了，做不了这些。

translation.en: You look terrific and in good shape .
translation.zh: 你看起来棒极了，身材也不错。

translation.en: How do you keep fit ?
translation.zh: 你怎样保持健康？

translation.en: I do yoga twice a weeks
translation.zh: 我每周练两次瑜伽

translation.en: Yoga ? It sounds interesting .
translation.zh: 瑜伽？听起来很有趣。

translation.en: It was hard at the beginning , but now feel it's really relaxing . It makes me flexible .
translation.zh: 刚开始很辛苦，但现在感觉真的很放松。它让我变得灵活。

translation.en: Yes , I often go swimming .
translation.zh: 是的，我经常去游泳。

translation.en: Are you interested in swimming ?
translation.zh: 你对游泳感兴趣吗？

translation.en: Mary , can you tell me how you keep in shape ?
translation.zh: 玛丽，你能告诉我你是怎么保持身材的吗？

translation.en: You'll never be in shape until you eat less and take more exercise .
translation.zh: 除非你少吃多锻炼，否则你永远不会有好身材。

translation.en: Now , tell me what you often eat .
translation.zh: 现在，告诉我你经常吃什么。

translation.en: I often eat fish and eggs .
translation.zh: 我经常吃鱼和鸡蛋。

translation.en: Do you eat a lot of vegetables ?
translation.zh: 你吃很多蔬菜吗？

translation.en: Oh yes , and fruits . I love fruits very much .
translation.zh: 哦，是的，还有水果。我非常喜欢水果。

translation.en: What do you like to drink ?
translation.zh: 你喜欢喝什么？

translation.en: Well , I never drink alcohol , coffee or tea .
translation.zh: 嗯，我从不喝酒，咖啡或茶。

translation.en: Whatever would you like to drink ?
translation.zh: 你想喝点什么？

translation.en: I drink a lot of milk . I drink milk almost every day .
translation.zh: 我喝了很多牛奶。我几乎每天都喝牛奶。

translation.en: How often do you exercise ?
translation.zh: 你多久锻炼一次？

translation.en: Well , I walk every day .
translation.zh: 嗯，我每天走路。

translation.en: It's a good diet and a regular exercise .
translation.zh: 这是一个良好的饮食和定期锻炼。

translation.en: Yes , quite right .
translation.zh: 是的，非常正确。

translation.en: That blouse is absolutely wonderful on you though .
translation.zh: 那件衬衫穿在你身上真是太好了。

translation.en: Well , I'll just buy the shirt .
translation.zh: 好吧，我就买这件衬衫。

translation.en: Come on , fellows . Let's enjoy my wife's cooking !
translation.zh: 来吧，伙计们。让我们尽情享受我妻子的厨艺吧！

translation.en: well , I'm looking for some summer clothes .
translation.zh: 嗯，我想买一些夏装。

translation.en: Oh , it is the right time for you purchasing in our clothes shop . We are now having a low price on all our summer apparel .
translation.zh: 哦，现在正是您在本店购物的好时候，我们的夏装正在低价销售。

translation.en: Everything for summer is 20 % off .
translation.zh: 所有的夏装都打八折。

translation.en: I like this T-shirt . Would you like to help me look for any skirts that go with it ?
translation.zh: 我喜欢这件T恤。你能帮我找一条和它相配的裙子吗？

translation.en: Sure . We have both skirts and trousers that would look well with the T-shirt . Look at this section .
translation.zh: 当然可以。我们有可以配这件T恤衫的裙子和长裤。看看这边。

translation.en: This one is good .
translation.zh: 这条不错。

translation.en: You have good taste . It is very much in style this year .
translation.zh: 您品味真好。这是今年很流行的样式。

translation.en: I'll take this one . How much are they ?
translation.zh: 我就买这条了。总共多少钱？

translation.en: You look depressed . What's on your mind ?
translation.zh: 你看起来有点儿情绪低落。在想什么呢？

translation.en: Well , I had a blood test last week . The doctor said that I have high blood pressure and my blood is thick and sticky . I'm very worried .
translation.zh: 嗯，我上周做了血液检查。医生说我血压高而且血液黏稠。我很担心。

translation.en: Take it easy . When we last talked , you promised there would be more exercises in your life . But now you are putting on some weight .
translation.zh: 别紧张。我们上次聊天时，你保证多运动的。可是你又增体重了。

translation.en: I have to admit it's easier said than done .
translation.zh: 我得承认说起来容易做起来难啊。

translation.en: Well , I think it's time for you to change your eating habits and develop a healthy lifestyle . Regular exercise will improve your health .
translation.zh: 嗯，我想你得改变饮食习惯并养成健康的生活方式。定期锻炼会改善你的健康状况。

translation.en: But you know I'm just not into exercises . And I wouldn't have time for exercises , either .
translation.zh: 可你知道我不喜欢锻炼，而且我也没时间锻炼。

translation.en: You can do some jogging . It's easy and it doesn't take much time .
translation.zh: 你可以慢跑。这很简单，也不需要太多时间。

translation.en: Actually , my doctor said the same thing .
translation.zh: 实际上，我的医生也这么建议我。

translation.en: What shall we do today ?
translation.zh: 我们今天做什么？

translation.en: We'd better stay in the hotel , because the tour will begin tomorrow .
translation.zh: 我们最好呆在旅馆里，因为明天就要去旅游了。

translation.en: Let's go out for some exercise , shall we ?
translation.zh: 我们出去锻炼一下，好吗？

translation.en: What an excellent idea !
translation.zh: 好主意！

translation.en: Shall we do some jogging ?
translation.zh: 我们去慢跑好吗？

translation.en: I feel well now .
translation.zh: 我现在感觉很好。

translation.en: Yes , some exercise is necessary for us .
translation.zh: 是的，一些锻炼对我们来说是必要的。

translation.en: Quite right .
translation.zh: 完全正确。

translation.en: Could you tell me where you put all the pots and pans ?
translation.zh: 你能告诉我你把所有的锅碗瓢盆都放在哪里吗？

translation.en: They ’ re in the cabinet next to the sink .
translation.zh: 它们在水槽旁边的橱柜里。

translation.en: Where do you keep the dishes , Baker ?
translation.zh: 你把盘子放在哪里呢，贝克？

translation.en: They ’ re in the cabinet above the dishwasher .
translation.zh: 它们在洗碗机上方的橱柜里。

translation.en: And the forks and spoons ?
translation.zh: 叉子和勺子呢？

translation.en: They ’ re in that drawer .
translation.zh: 它们在那个抽屉里。

translation.en: OK , I know . Would you please help me clean the kitchen ?
translation.zh: 好吧，我知道。你能帮我打扫厨房吗？

translation.en: Please help yourself at your dishes . I hope you ’ ll enjoy what you ’ Ve got .
translation.zh: 请随便吃。我希望你能享受你所拥有的一切。

translation.en: It suits my taste . You are really a good cook .
translation.zh: 它符合我的口味。你真是个好厨师。

translation.en: Would you like to try my special recipe ?
translation.zh: 你想尝尝我的特别食谱吗？

translation.en: Wow , let me try . It tastes nice . How did you make it ?
translation.zh: 哇，让我试试。味道不错。你是怎么做到的？

translation.en: It ’ s as easy as pie . I always follow recipes .
translation.zh: 这很简单。我总是遵循食谱。

translation.en: I'm glad these batteries are on sale .
translation.zh: 这些电池在打折销售真是太棒了。

translation.en: I'm sorry . These batteries are not on sale .
translation.zh: 抱歉。这些电池没有减价。

translation.en: But that's what the ad said .
translation.zh: 但广告上是这么说的。

translation.en: I'm sorry . If you look at the ad again , you'll see that the other brand is on sale .
translation.zh: 我很抱歉。你再看看广告吧，是另一个牌子在打折。

translation.en: Oh . You're right . I misread the ad .
translation.zh: 哦。你说得对。是我看错了广告。

translation.en: Yes , many people make that mistake .
translation.zh: 是的，很多人都会把这个看错。

translation.en: Well , you can't blame them . It's a confusing ad .
translation.zh: 你也确实不能怪他们。这广告很迷糊人。

translation.en: You're right . Many ads are like that .
translation.zh: 你说得对。很多广告都是这样。

translation.en: Well , as long as I'm here .
translation.zh: 好吧，反正我也在这儿了。

translation.en: Just one second , and I'll give you the batteries that are on sale .
translation.zh: 请稍等，我给你打折的电池。

translation.en: Hello . May I speak to Jerry , please ?
translation.zh: 你好。我可以和杰瑞说话吗？

translation.en: Sorry , but he is out for lunch right now .
translation.zh: 对不起，他现在出去吃午饭了。

translation.en: I see . Can you give me some idea how long he'll be back ?
translation.zh: 我懂了。你能告诉我他会回来多久吗？

translation.en: I think he will be back around 2:00 . If you like , please leave your name and phone number , I'll have him call you as soon as he comes back .
translation.zh: 我想他2点左右回来。如果你愿意，请留下你的姓名和电话号码，他一回来我就让他给你打电话。

translation.en: That's nice . My name is Steven , my phone number is 6789777 . Okay , I'll be waiting for his call . Thank you and bye !
translation.zh: 那很好。我叫史蒂文，电话号码是6789777。好的，我等他的电话。谢谢，再见！

translation.en: My pleasure , bye !
translation.zh: 不客气，再见！

translation.en: I would like to order 2 office-style cabinets and desk calendars . We want office-style cabinets in white . The catalogue number is 90 - f - 2356 .
translation.zh: 我想订两个办公室风格的橱柜和台历。我们想要白色的办公室风格的橱柜。目录号是90-f-2356。

translation.en: How soon do you want it ?
translation.zh: 你什么时候要？

translation.en: Could you deliver it tomorrow ?
translation.zh: 你能明天送吗？

translation.en: Please handle the items carefully .
translation.zh: 请小心处理这些物品。

translation.en: We will pay by collect on delivery .
translation.zh: 我们将货到付款。

translation.en: What kind of cuisine do you have ?
translation.zh: 你们有什么菜？

translation.en: We have Sichuan food , Hangzhou food and Beijing Food . Which do you like best ?
translation.zh: 我们有四川菜、杭州菜和北京菜。你最喜欢哪个？

translation.en: Hangzhou food .
translation.zh: 杭州菜。

translation.en: OK . How about Dongpo meat ?
translation.zh: 好的，东坡肉怎么样？

translation.en: Do you like to use chopsticks
translation.zh: 你喜欢用筷子吗？

translation.en: Yes , I like using chopsticks .
translation.zh: 是的，我喜欢用筷子。

translation.en: Do you like some soup ?
translation.zh: 你喜欢喝汤吗？

translation.en: Yes , but I don't know what soup you have .
translation.zh: 是的，但我不知道你们有什么汤。

translation.en: We have beef soup and tomato soup .
translation.zh: 我们有牛肉汤和番茄汤。

translation.en: Good . I prefer beef soup .
translation.zh: 很好。我喜欢牛肉汤。

translation.en: According to usual practices , we serve dishes first and then soup . If you like we'll bring you some soup first .
translation.zh: 按照惯例，我们先上菜，然后上汤。如果你愿意，我们先给你端点汤来。

translation.en: Save it until you've served dishes .
translation.zh: 还是留到上完菜以后吧。

translation.en: All right . I'll be back right away .
translation.zh: 好的。我马上回来。

translation.en: Do you live in the red house at the end of the road ?
translation.zh: 你住在路尽头的红房子里吗？

translation.en: Yes , I live in that house with my parents and my sister .
translation.zh: 是的，我和我父母和妹妹住在那所房子里。

translation.en: We also have a cat and a dog .
translation.zh: 我们还有一只猫和一只狗。

translation.en: Do you take your dog for a walk every day ?
translation.zh: 你每天带你的狗散步吗？

translation.en: No . My father takes the dog for a walk every Monday , Tuesday and Sunday .
translation.zh: 不。我父亲每星期一、星期二和星期天带狗散步。

translation.en: And I take the dog for a walk every Wednesday , Thursday and Friday .
translation.zh: 我每周三、周四和周五带狗散步。

translation.en: Who takes the dog on Saturday ?
translation.zh: 星期六谁带狗去？

translation.en: On Saturday we all go to the park and the dog comes with us .
translation.zh: 星期六我们都去公园，狗和我们一起来。

translation.en: Do you help with the housework ?
translation.zh: 你帮忙做家务吗？

translation.en: My mum and my sister do the housework and cooking but I clean my room .
translation.zh: 我妈妈和姐姐做家务和做饭，但我打扫房间。

translation.en: Won't you have some of this ?
translation.zh: 你不吃点这个吗？

translation.en: It's my grandmother's favorite recipe for barbecue .
translation.zh: 这是我祖母最喜欢的烧烤食谱。

translation.en: It's very good . How do you make it ?
translation.zh: 非常好吃。你怎么做的？

translation.en: I use a special dressing and homemade catsup .
translation.zh: 我用特制的调味料和自制的番茄酱做的。

translation.en: This salad looks so nice-just right for a hot day .
translation.zh: 这沙拉看起来很好吃，正好适合天气热的时候吃。

translation.en: You Americans usually have nutritious food .
translation.zh: 你们美国人通常都会吃一些有营养的食物。

translation.en: Oh , but Chinese food is so delicious . I wish I knew how to cook Chinese food . Do you follow recipes ?
translation.zh: 哦，但是中国菜太好吃了。我真希望我会做中国菜。你跟着食谱做的吗？

translation.en: We use different spices but few people use recipes . They learn to cook by experience .
translation.zh: 虽然我们用不同的香料来做饭，但很少会有人用食谱。大多数人都是凭经验做饭。

translation.en: I always use a recipe but my grandmother never did . She was a great cook . She would make clam chowder and cornbread every Sunday night .
translation.zh: 我总是用食谱做饭，但我祖母从来没有用过。她是个很棒的厨师。她每个星期天晚上都会做蛤蜊浓汤和玉米面包。

translation.en: Nowadays fewer and fewer people go to the movie theaters to see films . So I am afraid that the film studios are really getting hard time to survive .
translation.zh: 现在去电影院看电影的人越来越少了。所以我担心电影制片厂真的很难生存。

translation.en: What you said is true . But the film producers there are more flexible ways to get more audience . For example , to make more movie Ccds , so people will spend money buying them .
translation.zh: 你说的是真的。但是电影制片人有更灵活的方式来吸引更多的观众。例如，为了制作更多的电影ccd，人们会花钱购买它们。

translation.en: But it is true that cinemas are losing the attraction they used to have in the past .
translation.zh: 但电影院确实正在失去过去的吸引力。

translation.en: Yes . Take myself for example . I seldom go to cinemas , but it doesn't mean I no longer see films ; instead , I see films at home-watching Ccds .
translation.zh: 对。以我自己为例。我很少去电影院，但这并不意味着我不再看电影；相反，我在家里看电影看ccd。

translation.en: Miss , would you like to try this free sample of our new suntan cream ?
translation.zh: 小姐，您想试试我们新的防晒霜的免费样品吗？

translation.en: This is a new product of company this year . It's oil-free .
translation.zh: 这是公司今年的新产品。它不含油。

translation.en: I see . It feels very light on the skin .
translation.zh: 我懂了。感觉它在皮肤上很轻盈。

translation.en: It gives your skin a very natural healthy look .
translation.zh: 它让你的皮肤看起来非常自然健康。

translation.en: I like the cool smell , too .
translation.zh: 我也喜欢清凉的味道。

translation.en: I'd like to taste some local dishes . What would you recommend ?
translation.zh: 我想尝尝本地菜。你有什么建议吗？

translation.en: That's fine . You must try this dish .
translation.zh: 那好啊，你一定要尝尝这道菜。

translation.en: Could you tell me how this thing is cooked ?
translation.zh: 你能告诉我这东西是怎么做的吗？

translation.en: It's fish steamed and served with our special sauce .
translation.zh: 这是蒸好的鱼，配上我们特制的酱汁。

translation.en: Is it good ?
translation.zh: （味道）好吗？

translation.en: Sure . It's a most popular dish .
translation.zh: 当然。这是一道很受欢迎的菜。

translation.en: I think I'll try it , and give me some green salad together .
translation.zh: 我想试试，再来一点蔬菜沙拉。

translation.en: We have two dressings for salad . Which one would you like ?
translation.zh: 我们有两种沙拉酱。您想要哪一个？

translation.en: What kind do you have ?
translation.zh: 你们有什么样的？

translation.en: We have French and Thousand Island .
translation.zh: 我们有法式沙拉酱和千岛酱。

translation.en: Make it Thousand Island .
translation.zh: 千岛酱吧。

translation.en: Let's have a look at the map first .
translation.zh: 让我们先看看地图。

translation.en: All right . Wukesong stop is quite a few stops from here .
translation.zh: 好吧。五棵松站离这儿有好几站。

translation.en: Let's buy some tickets .
translation.zh: 我们去买票吧。

translation.en: The train is coming . There are a lot of people waiting here . let's stand in a better position to get on the train
translation.zh: 地铁来了。有很多人在这里等着。让我们去一个更好的位置上地铁吧

translation.en: Well , it's not as crowded as we expected , is it ?
translation.zh: 嗯，不像我们想象的那么拥挤，是吗？

translation.en: No , but it will be soon . Look , there're two empty seats over there . Let's get them .
translation.zh: 的确，但很快就到了。看，那边有两个空座位。我们去坐吧。

translation.en: What would you have ?
translation.zh: 你想要什么？

translation.en: I'll try Chinese wine .
translation.zh: 我要尝尝中国酒。

translation.en: What about this dry red ? It's good indeed , it never goes to the head .
translation.zh: 这个干红怎么样？这真的很好，它从来不会上头。

translation.en: OK . Give me one , please .
translation.zh: 好的，请给我一瓶。

translation.en: May I recommend you Tsingtao beer ?
translation.zh: 我可以向您推荐青岛啤酒吗？

translation.en: Tsingtao beer ?
translation.zh: 青岛啤酒？

translation.en: Yes , sir . It's one of the best beers in China .
translation.zh: 是的，先生。这是中国最好的啤酒之一。

translation.en: Yes . The beer is brewed by using carefully selected malts , rice , hops and natural water from the Lao Mountain .
translation.zh: 当然。青岛啤酒是用精选的麦芽、大米、啤酒花和老挝山的天然水酿造的。

translation.en: How about its taste ?
translation.zh: 味道怎么样？

translation.en: Fine , sir .
translation.zh: 很好，先生。

translation.en: That sounds great . Two Tsingtao beers , please .
translation.zh: 听起来不错。请来两杯青岛啤酒。

translation.en: Tin or bottle ?
translation.zh: 罐装还是瓶装？

translation.en: Tin , please .
translation.zh: 请给我罐装的。

translation.en: Would you like it on the rocks , sir ?
translation.zh: 先生，您要加冰块吗？

translation.en: Hi ! Do you want a fill-up ?
translation.zh: 你好！你要加满油吗？

translation.en: Which type of gas do you want ? Regular , Super , or Premium Unleaded ?
translation.zh: 你要哪种汽油？普通无铅，超级无铅，还是高级无铅？

translation.en: What's the price difference ?
translation.zh: 价差是多少？

translation.en: Regular is $ 1.15 , Super is $ 1.25 and Premium is $ 1.39 .
translation.zh: 普通车是1.15美元，超级车是1.25美元，保险费是1.39美元。

translation.en: Just fill it up with Regular , Unleaded , please .
translation.zh: 请加满普通无铅汽油。

translation.en: Do you want me to check the tires and the fluids ?
translation.zh: 你要我检查轮胎和油液吗？

translation.en: Yes , I would . Thanks a lot .
translation.zh: 是的，我会的。谢谢。

translation.en: Is there a car park near the supermarket ?
translation.zh: 超市附近有停车场吗？

translation.en: Yes , there is an underground car park near the supermarket .
translation.zh: 是的，超市附近有一个地下停车场。

translation.en: I see . Thanks .
translation.zh: 我懂了。谢谢。

translation.en: Do you eat a lot of healthy food ?
translation.zh: 你吃很多健康食品吗？

translation.en: Compared with healthy food , unhealthy food just tastes so much better . And anyway , I believe if you live a low stress Life and are active , you can get away with eating whatever you like . It's all in the mind .
translation.zh: 与健康食品相比，不健康食品的味道要好得多。无论如何，我相信如果你生活压力小，而且精力充沛，你可以吃你喜欢的任何东西。一切都在心里。

translation.en: You have the point . I think cancer is caused by more worry than by the things we consume . Some good things you should try are cranberry juice , wild rice and yoghurt .
translation.zh: 你说得对。我认为癌症是由更多的忧虑引起的，而不是由我们消耗的东西引起的。你应该尝尝酸果蔓汁、野米和酸奶。

translation.en: What's special about these things ?
translation.zh: 这些东西有什么特别之处？

translation.en: Cranberry juice is very good for destroying harmful bacteria in your guts because it's very acidic . Wild rice is high in fibre so it's good for your guts and it's high in protein and minerals-I think it's also tastier than normal rice . Yoghurt's good because it's also rich in protein , vitamins and is also acidic . People have been making yoghurt for thousands of years and if you have it every day , your guts will be much more settled .
translation.zh: 蔓越莓汁非常有利于消灭肠道里的有害细菌，因为蔓越莓汁酸性很强。野生大米富含纤维，所以对你的肠胃有好处，它富含蛋白质和矿物质，我认为它比普通大米更美味。酸奶很好，因为它也富含蛋白质、维生素和酸性。人们制作酸奶已经有几千年的历史了，如果你每天都喝酸奶，你的肠胃会舒服得多。

translation.en: Thanks . I'm going to follow your advice and pop down to the supermarket right now .
translation.zh: 谢谢。我要听从你的建议，现在就去超市。

translation.en: Could you show me the T-shirt on the model ?
translation.zh: 你能给我看看模特上的T恤吗？

translation.en: Here you are . We have three different colors , white , blue and pink .
translation.zh: 给你。我们有三种不同的颜色，白色，蓝色和粉色。

translation.en: What's the price ?
translation.zh: 价钱是多少？

translation.en: Can you make it any cheaper ?
translation.zh: 你能再便宜一点吗？

translation.en: It is cheap .
translation.zh: 它很便宜。

translation.en: I'll take it if you give me a discount .
translation.zh: 如果你给我打折，我就买了。

translation.en: $ 10 . That's the best I can do .
translation.zh: $ 10 . 我只能这样了。

translation.en: OK . I'll take the blue one .
translation.zh: 好的我要蓝色的。

translation.en: Overseas operator .
translation.zh: 海外运营商。

translation.en: I would like to make a collect call to Taipei , Taiwan , please .
translation.zh: 我要打一个对方付费的电话到台湾台北。

translation.en: Tim Chen .
translation.zh: 蒂姆陈。

translation.en: What's the number , please .
translation.zh: 请问电话号码是多少。

translation.en: The area code is 2 , and the number is 2367-9960 .
The line is connected . Please go ahead .
translation.zh: 线路接通了。请说吧。

translation.en: How much is it to rent an economy car ?
translation.zh: 租一辆经济型汽车要多少钱？

translation.en: ¥ 200 a day or ¥ 1200 a week , unlimited mileage .
translation.zh: 每天200英镑或每周1200英镑，不限里程。

translation.en: Could I have one for tomorrow morning ?
translation.zh: 明天早上能给我一辆吗？

translation.en: Do you have your driver's license ?
translation.zh: 你有驾照吗？

translation.en: Good . Now just complete this form .
translation.zh: 很好。现在请填写这张表格。

translation.en: Where shall I pay the bill ?
translation.zh: 我应该在哪里结账？

translation.en: You can pay here .
translation.zh: 您可以在这里结账。

translation.en: OK . How much is it all together ?
translation.zh: 好的，总共多少钱？

translation.en: It is one hundred and fifty . This is your bill .
translation.zh: 一共一百五。这是您的账单。

translation.en: Is the service charge included ?
translation.zh: 包括服务费吗？

translation.en: Waiter .
translation.zh: 服务员。

translation.en: No , thanks . Please bring us the bill .
translation.zh: 不用了，谢谢。请把帐单给我们。

translation.en: All right . And do you want to separate bills or just one single bill ?
translation.zh: 好的。您想分开结账还是一起结账？

translation.en: Separate bills , please .
translation.zh: 请分开结账。

translation.en: Here is your bill . It comes to 80 yuan . And yours is 60 yuan .
translation.zh: 这是您的帐单。总共80元。您的是60元。

translation.en: Here you are . Thank you
translation.zh: 给你。非常感谢。

translation.en: Where will you go , sir ?
translation.zh: 先生，您要去哪里？

translation.en: Friendship Hotel .
translation.zh: 友谊宾馆。

translation.en: OK , it's not far from here .
translation.zh: 好的，离这儿不远。

translation.en: I have something important to do , can you fast the speed ?
translation.zh: 我有要事要做，能开快点吗？

translation.en: Sure , I'll try my best . Here we are .
translation.zh: 当然，我尽力。我们到了。

translation.en: How much should I pay you ?
translation.zh: 我该付你多少钱？

translation.en: The reading on the meter is 15 yuan .
translation.zh: 电表上显示15元。

translation.en: Here's 20 yuan , keep the change .
translation.zh: 这是21元，不用找了。

translation.en: How slowly you drive !
translation.zh: 你开得太慢了！

translation.en: I'm sorry . Something is wrong with my taxi .
translation.zh: 我很抱歉。我的出租车出毛病了。

translation.en: Where does it go wrong ?
translation.zh: 哪里出了问题？

translation.en: Let me stop my car for check . Oh , my god . I got a flat tyre .
translation.zh: 让我停车检查一下。哦，天哪。我的轮胎瘪了。

translation.en: Can it keep going ?
translation.zh: 能继续行驶吗？

translation.en: Sorry . You'd better get off for taking another taxi .
translation.zh: 对不起。你最好再叫一辆出租车。

translation.en: What can I get for you ? Here is the menu .
translation.zh: 我能为您做些什么吗？这是菜单。

translation.en: Let me have a look . Well , how many kinds of steaks do you have ?
translation.zh: 让我看看。嗯，你们有多少种牛排？

translation.en: We have sirloin steaks , pepper steak , and filet steak .
translation.zh: 我们有沙朗牛排、黑胡椒牛排和菲力牛排。

translation.en: Is there something go with the filet steak ?
translation.zh: 有什么可以配菲力牛排食用的吗？

translation.en: Yes , we have various sauces . What about the gravy ?
translation.zh: 有的，我们有各种酱汁。肉汁怎么样？

translation.en: Operator . Can I help you ?
translation.zh: 我是接线员。有什么我能帮助您的吗？

translation.en: I'd like to make a person-to-person call to Beijing , China . The number is 2135367 8 , and I want to speak to Mr . Zhang .
translation.zh: 我想打一个电话到中国北京。电话号码是21353678，我想和张先生通话。

translation.en: To Mr . Zhang in at 2135-3678 ?
translation.zh: 打给张先生，号码是2135-3678？

translation.en: May I have your name and telephone number ?
translation.zh: 请问您的姓名和电话号码？

translation.en: My name is Luo Gang , and the phone number is 513-3284 .
translation.zh: 我叫罗刚，电话号码是513-3284。

translation.en: Mr . Luo , will you hold the line , please - - - Mr . Luo , there is no Zhang at that number . Will you check the number again , please ?
translation.zh: 罗先生。请别挂断好吗---罗先生，你说的那个号码找不到张先生。请您再核对一下号码好吗？

translation.en: What the number I gave you , operator ?
translation.zh: 接线员，我给你的号码是多少？

translation.en: Oh , I'm sorry . should have been 2135-3668 , not 3678 . I've given you a wrong number .
translation.zh: 哦，对不起。应该是2135-3668，不是3678。我给错电话号码了。

translation.en: Are you sure this time ?
translation.zh: 这次您确定吗？

translation.en: OK . Let me try again .
translation.zh: 好的，让我再试一次。

translation.en: Excuse me ! Does this bus go to the railway station ?
translation.zh: 打扰一下！请问这辆公共汽车是去火车站吗？

translation.en: No , You're got on the wrong bus . You can take a No . 22 bus at the University station and then transfer to a No . 83 bus at the railway station .
translation.zh: 不是，你上错车了。你可以在大学站乘坐22路公交车，然后换乘83路公交车到火车站下。

translation.en: OK ! Thank you very much !
translation.zh: 好的，非常感谢你！

translation.en: Do you have coffee shops in China , too ?
translation.zh: 中国也有咖啡店吗？

translation.en: Yes , of course . There are many tea houses and bars in China , too . People can drink , eat and relax at these places .
translation.zh: 是的，当然。中国也有许多茶馆和酒吧。人们可以在这些地方喝酒、吃饭和休息。

translation.en: You like to go to these places , don ’ t you ?
translation.zh: 你喜欢去这些地方，是吗？

translation.en: Yes , sometimes the music there is so beautiful . It is very romantic . I can stay there for hours .
translation.zh: 是的，有时候那里的音乐很美。很浪漫。我可以在那里呆上几个小时。

translation.en: Do you often go there alone ?
translation.zh: 你经常一个人去吗？

translation.en: No , I often go there with my friends .
translation.zh: 不，我经常和朋友去那里。

translation.en: Darling , I am back . What are you doing ?
translation.zh: 亲爱的，我回来了。你在干什么？

translation.en: I am washing clothes . Are you hungry now ? Wait for a moment , I'll cook dinner for you . ( Steven bends his brows )
translation.zh: 我正在洗衣服。你现在饿了吗？等一下，我给你做晚饭（史蒂文弯着腰）

translation.en: B , should we get a maid ?
translation.zh: 宝贝，我们应该找个女佣吗？

translation.en: I can do all the housework . We don't need a maid .
translation.zh: 我可以做所有的家务。我们不需要女佣。

translation.en: You have worked very hard in the office . If we can get someone to help you , you can have more rest .
translation.zh: 你在办公室工作很辛苦。如果我们能找人帮忙的话，你就可以多休息了。

translation.en: We really don't need to .
translation.zh: 我们真的不需要。

translation.en: You are a good wife , Julia . But you must take care of yourself .
translation.zh: 你是个好妻子，朱莉娅。但你必须照顾好自己。

translation.en: Give me some time to think about it .
translation.zh: 给我点时间考虑一下吧。

translation.en: I am sorry , I have broken my wine glass , and would you please bring me another ?
translation.zh: 对不起，我的酒杯打碎了，请你再给我拿一个好吗？

translation.en: Sure . I will clean the glasses for you .
translation.zh: 当然。我来帮你清理玻璃。

translation.en: Thank you . Where is the washing room ?
translation.zh: 非常感谢。请问洗手间在哪里？

translation.en: Walk straight and turn left .
translation.zh: 一直走，然后左转。

translation.en: I want to keep a pet , but I don't know which one to buy ?
translation.zh: 我正在考虑养宠物，但我不知道养哪种动物合适。

translation.en: Dogs are nice , but they are really energetic , and you need to make sure they get enough exercise every day .
translation.zh: 狗就很好，但它们精力太充沛了，你需要确保它们每天都得到足够的锻炼。

translation.en: Having a dog would probably be too much work for me , then .
translation.zh: 那么，养狗对我来说可能太辛苦了。

translation.en: What about cats ? They are more independent .
translation.zh: 那猫呢？他们更加独立。

translation.en: Actually , I was thinking of something a little more exotic . I don't want a common pet like a dog or a cat .
translation.zh: 实际上，我想要一只有点与众不同的宠物，我不想要像狗或猫这样普通的宠物。

translation.en: How about a lizard ? Are lizards more along the lines of what you were thinking of getting ?
translation.zh: 蜥蜴怎么样？蜥蜴是否更符合你的想法呢？

translation.en: Yeah , are they easy to look after ?
translation.zh: 是的，他们容易照顾吗？

translation.en: Yeah , they are pretty low-maintenance ; they eat almost anything .
translation.zh: 是的，它们的饲养费用很低，他们几乎什么都吃。

translation.en: Bring me some toast , please .
translation.zh: 请给我拿些吐司来。

translation.en: Would you like butter or jam on your toast or do you just want it plain ?
translation.zh: 您是想在吐司上加黄油或果酱，还是只想要吐司？

translation.en: Spread some jam , please .
translation.zh: 请涂点果酱。

translation.en: Black coffee is fine .
translation.zh: 黑咖啡就可以。

translation.en: Excuse me , can I change my order ? I am afraid I don't have so much time to enjoy my dinner .
translation.zh: 打扰一下，我能改一下我点的菜吗？恐怕我没有那么多时间吃晚餐了。

translation.en: I am sorry , sir . Your fish will be ready in five minutes so you can't change it .
translation.zh: 对不起，先生。你的鱼五分钟后就好了，所以你不能换了。

translation.en: I like Chinese food , too . I like dumplings best .
translation.zh: 我也喜欢中国菜。我最喜欢饺子。

translation.en: At school , we sometimes have Chinese food for lunch .
translation.zh: 在学校，我们的午餐有时是中餐。

translation.en: That's good . We eat Chinese food only at the Chinese restaurant .
translation.zh: 那很好。我们只在中餐馆吃中餐。

translation.en: My mother can make some Chinese food .
translation.zh: 我妈妈会做一些中国菜。

translation.en: Excuse me , waiter , would you please bring us a nest ? A friend of mine will join us .
translation.zh: 对不起，服务员，请再给我们拿一套餐具好吗？我的一个朋友将加入我们一起用餐。

translation.en: Wait a moment . Here you are .
translation.zh: 稍等片刻。给你。

translation.en: By the way , we would like to order some dishes for my friend .
translation.zh: 另外，我们想为我的朋友再点些菜。

translation.en: Annie , do you like shopping online ?
translation.zh: 安妮，你喜欢网上购物吗？

translation.en: Yes , I like it , because it's convenient .
translation.zh: 是的，我喜欢它，因为它很方便。

translation.en: Last week , I tried to buy a new cellphone online , but I didn't know how to pay for it .
translation.zh: 上周，我想在网上买一部新手机，但不知道怎么付钱。

translation.en: First , you should open an account at the online bank . After that , you can buy anything you want online .
translation.zh: 首先，你应该在网上银行开户。之后，你可以在网上买任何你想要的东西。

translation.en: Sure . You can find everything all over the world . Let's check it out online ! ( They log in a shopping website . )
translation.zh: 当然。你可以在世界各地找到一切。我们上网看看吧他们登录购物网站。）

translation.en: That's amazing . Oh , an on line virtual supermarket ?
translation.zh: 太神奇了。哦，网上虚拟超市？

translation.en: Welcome , sir . What can I do for you ?
translation.zh: 欢迎，先生。有什么事吗？

translation.en: May I have a look at that china tea set ? It is extremely beautiful .
translation.zh: 我可以看看那套瓷器茶具吗？非常漂亮。

translation.en: You've made a good choice . This china tea set is unusual . It was made in Jingdezhen .
translation.zh: 你做眼光真好。这套瓷器茶具很不一般。它是景德镇制造的。

translation.en: Jingdezhen ? Oh , I know it . Isn't it called the capital of porcelain ?
translation.zh: 景德镇？哦，我知道。它不叫瓷都吗？

translation.en: Oh , it must be very precious . Is it breakable ?
translation.zh: 哦，一定很珍贵。它易碎吗？

translation.en: No , if you take some care when you use them .
translation.zh: 不，如果你用的时候小心点的话。

translation.en: Two thousand .
translation.zh: 两千。

translation.en: Oh , it is beyond my purse .
translation.zh: 哦，我买不起。

translation.en: Yes , I would like a roast duck and my friend wants steaks .
translation.zh: 是的，我想要一只烤鸭，我朋友想要牛排。

translation.en: How do you like your steaks ?
translation.zh: 你的牛排怎么样？

translation.en: I'd like it medium-well .
translation.zh: 我要中号的。

translation.en: OK , sir , wait a minute .
translation.zh: 好的，先生，等一下。

translation.en: Waiter , we have been waiting for 20 minutes . Would you mind hurrying ?
translation.zh: 服务员，我们已经等了20分钟了。你介意快点吗？

translation.en: I am sorry , sir , the fish you ordered will take a longer time because we make it with fresh fish .
translation.zh: 对不起，先生，您点的鱼需要较长时间，因为我们是用鲜鱼做的。

translation.en: That's fine . Would you please bring me some wine ?
translation.zh: 那很好。请给我拿点酒来好吗？

translation.en: Sure , is dry white wine OK ?
translation.zh: 当然可以，干白葡萄酒可以吗？

translation.en: You seem to be upset . What ’ s eating you ?
translation.zh: 你好像很不高兴。谁惹着你了？

translation.en: It ’ s because of my son . Dick keeps getting on my nerves
translation.zh: 还不是因为我儿子。迪克老是惹我生气

translation.en: Dick ? How come ? He used to be as meek as a lamb .
translation.zh: 迪克？怎么会？他以前很听话。

translation.en: Yes , he used to be . But now he ’ s drifting off track .
translation.zh: 是的，他以前是。但现在他长歪了。

translation.en: He must have been in bad company , or he wouldn ’ t be off the beans .
translation.zh: 他一定是交了个坏朋友，不然他不会不听话的。

translation.en: Hey , Steven . What are you going to do this Saturday ?
translation.zh: 嘿，史蒂文。这个星期六你打算干什么？

translation.en: If the weather is good , I'll go to climb mountains .
translation.zh: 如果天气好，我就去爬山。

translation.en: Are you going with your friends ?
translation.zh: 你和你的朋友一起去吗？

translation.en: No , I'm going alone .
translation.zh: 不，我一个人去。

translation.en: Oh , aren't you afraid ?
translation.zh: 哦，你不怕吗？

translation.en: Of course not . For me , mountaineering is both relaxation and a hobby .
translation.zh: 当然不。对我来说，登山既是一种放松方式，也是一种爱好。

translation.en: I think mountaineering is an exciting sport , but a little dangerous .
translation.zh: 我认为登山是一项令人兴奋的运动，但有点危险。

translation.en: Yeah , you are right , but it's really interesting .
translation.zh: 是的，你说得对，但这真的很有趣。

translation.en: Hey , Jim , you're 15 minutes late . What's up ?
translation.zh: 嘿，吉姆，你迟到了15分钟。怎么了？

translation.en: I got stuck in a traffic jam .
translation.zh: 堵车了。

translation.en: Hurry up , the show is about to start .
translation.zh: 快点，演出就要开始了。

translation.en: It looks like you're very interested in the circus .
translation.zh: 看来你对马戏团很感兴趣。

translation.en: Yes , I love to see the animal show .
translation.zh: 是的，我喜欢看动物表演。

translation.en: I have never seen those before , but since you're so excited it should be good .
translation.zh: 我以前从没见过，但既然你这么兴奋，应该很好看。

translation.en: I'm sure you'll love it .
translation.zh: 我相信你会喜欢的。

translation.en: Okay , I will go and get some popcorn first .
translation.zh: 好吧，我先去买些爆米花。

translation.en: What would you like for your main dish ?
translation.zh: 你的主菜要什么？

translation.en: Medium rare , please .
translation.zh: 请给我半生的。

translation.en: May I have a glass of red wine , please ?
translation.zh: 请给我一杯红酒好吗？

translation.en: Excuse me . This bus goes downtown , doesn't it ?
translation.zh: 打扰一下。这辆公共汽车是去市区的，是吗？

translation.en: Yes . Where do you want to go ?
translation.zh: 对。你想去哪里？

translation.en: The Workers'Stadium .
translation.zh: 工人体育场。

translation.en: Will you let me know where to get off ?
translation.zh: 你能告诉我在哪里下车吗？

translation.en: Certainly.Four more stop after this . I'll call out the stops .
translation.zh: 当然可以。这之后还有四站。我会报车站的。

translation.en: Excuse me . Will you please keep an eye on my suitcase ? I just want to make a phone call .
translation.zh: 请原谅我。你能帮我照看一下手提箱吗？我去打个电话。

translation.en: Certainly , but will it take long ?
translation.zh: 当然可以，但是需要很长时间吗？

translation.en: No , I'll be right back .
translation.zh: 不会，我很快就回来。

translation.en: OK . I'll look after it then .
translation.zh: 好的，我会照看好它的。

translation.en: Premium or regular ?
translation.zh: 高级还是普通？

translation.en: Anything else , sir ? Should I check the water and the oil ?
translation.zh: 还有别的事吗，先生？我需要帮您检查一下水和油吗？

translation.en: I need some mascara . Do you have good thickening mascara ?
translation.zh: 我需要一些睫毛膏。你们有好的浓密型睫毛膏吗？

translation.en: Of course . Here is our thickening mascara . We also have mascara designed to lengthen the eyelashes .
translation.zh: 当然。这是我们的浓密型睫毛膏。我们还有纤长型睫毛膏。

translation.en: Alright . And I want to consider your eye shadow too . Do you have a color chart can look at ?
translation.zh: 好的。我也想看一下你们的眼影。你有色卡可以让我看看吗？

translation.en: We have a very wide selection of colors . And our eye shadow is specially designed to moisturize the skin . So it is very gentle on your eyelids . Would you like to sample some ?
translation.zh: 我们有很多颜色可供选择。我们的眼影具有滋润皮肤的特殊设计，所以它对你的眼皮很温和。你想试一试吗？

translation.en: Oh , sure I will need to clean off my own eye shadow first .
translation.zh: 哦，当然，我需要先卸掉我自己的眼影。

translation.en: Yes , in some sense . I should say I like mountain climbing , you know , because I'm not so professional . How about you
translation.zh: 是的，从某种意义上来说。我应该说我喜欢爬山，因为我没有这么专业。你呢？

translation.en: I'm the same with you , an amateur mountain climber . I went climbing in the Rocky Mountains with my friends last summer vacation . We spent two days in the mountains .
translation.zh: 我和你一样，也是一个业余登山爱好者。去年暑假我和朋友去登了落基山脉，我们在那度住了两天。

translation.en: Tasha Mountain ? It's very famous in China , isn't ?
translation.zh: 泰山？在中国很有名的，对吗？

translation.en: Yes . It is one of the Five Mountains .
translation.zh: 对。它是五岳之一。

translation.en: How much further do we have to walk ?
translation.zh: 我们还要走多远？

translation.en: It's about 3 kilometers .
translation.zh: 大约3公里。

translation.en: Shall we have a rest here ? I am tired out .
translation.zh: 我们在这里休息一下好吗？我累坏了。

translation.en: Why not walk further to the tree over there ?
translation.zh: 为什么不走远一点到那边的树那儿呢？

translation.en: Good idea . So we Can rest in the shadow of the tree .
translation.zh: 好主意。那我们就可以在树荫下休息了。

translation.en: I bought this circulator here yesterday but it doesn't work .
translation.zh: 我昨天在这里买了这个循环器，但它坏了。

translation.en: Oh , let's see what's wrong .
translation.zh: 哦，让我们看看怎么了。

translation.en: Did you check before you left the shop ?
translation.zh: 请问您离开商店前检查过商品了吗？

translation.en: Yes , I did . But when I got home , my son put it on and we found the hole .
translation.zh: 是的，检查了。但当我回到家，我儿子戴上它时，我们发现了那个洞。

translation.en: Really ? Let me have a look at it . Mm . OK . Let me change it for another one .
translation.zh: 真的吗？让我看看。嗯。好吧，我给您换一个。

translation.en: Can you develop the roll of film ?
translation.zh: 你能冲洗这卷胶卷吗？

translation.en: 6 hours . If you are in a hurry we can develop it in 3 hours .
translation.zh: 6小时。如果您赶时间的话，我们可以在3小时内完成。

translation.en: There is no need . I will come back tomorrow .
translation.zh: 没有必要。我明天再来。

translation.en: I haver run out of gas .
translation.zh: 我的汽油用完了。

translation.en: What kind of oil do you want ?
translation.zh: 你要什么油？

translation.en: Premium , please . By the way , please don't fill it up . Two gallons will be fine .
translation.zh: 高级的。另外，请不要加满。两加仑就可以了。

translation.en: Well , I'm going on to bed . I'm beat .
translation.zh: 好吧，我要去睡觉了。我累了。

translation.en: Okay . I'm going to stay up a while . I've got to go over the household budget . We're a little overspent this month .
translation.zh: 可以。我得熬一会儿夜，检查一下家庭预算。我们这个月有点超支了。

translation.en: Please tell Tim to close the door to the basement . I don't want the dog down there tonight .
translation.zh: ji de告诉蒂姆关上地下室的门。我今晚不想让狗下去。

translation.en: Okay . Good night . See you at breakfast .
translation.zh: 好的。晚安。

translation.en: Could you tell me where the copy room is ?
translation.zh: 你能告诉我复印室在哪里吗？

translation.en: I'd like to see that pen , please .
translation.zh: 我想看看那支笔。

translation.en: No , the other one in the brown case .
translation.zh: 不，另一个在棕色箱子里的。

translation.en: Oh , this one ... Here .
translation.zh: 哦，这个……在这里。

translation.en: May I try it ?
translation.zh: 我可以试试吗？

translation.en: It's very smooth . I'll take it .
translation.zh: 它很光滑。我要了。

translation.en: Charge , please .
translation.zh: 请记账。

translation.en: Hilton hotel , may I help you ?
translation.zh: 这里是希尔顿酒店，有什么事吗？

translation.en: We would like to book a table for 6 at 7:00 in the evening .
translation.zh: 我们想订个位，晚上7点6个人。

translation.en: OK , sir . We will arrange one for you .
translation.zh: 好的，先生。我们会为您预订一个。

translation.en: Can we bring drinks by ourselves ?
translation.zh: 我们能自己带饮料吗？

translation.en: Sorry , sir . It's not allowed in our hotel .
translation.zh: 对不起，先生。在我们酒店是不允许的。

translation.en: Hello , is Jennifer in ?
translation.zh: 喂，詹妮弗在吗？

translation.en: I am sorry , you have the wrong number .
translation.zh: 对不起，你打错电话了。

translation.en: Oh , I am really sorry .
translation.zh: 哦，真的很抱歉。

translation.en: If this coat doesn't fit , may I bring it back later ?
translation.zh: 如果这件外套不合身，我可以稍后再拿回来退掉吗？

translation.en: Sorry , We don't take returns on sale items .
translation.zh: 对不起，折扣商品无法退换货。

translation.en: Have you brought the receipt with you ?
translation.zh: 您带收据了吗？

translation.en: No , I don't . I left it home .
translation.zh: 不，我没带。我把它忘在家里了。

translation.en: Sorry , but we can't do anything without the receipt . Come back with it .
translation.zh: 对不起，没有收据我们什么都做不了。请您将它带来。

translation.en: I didn't know . I'll go to get it . How late will you be open ?
translation.zh: 我事先不知道。我回去拿吧。你们营业到多久？

translation.en: Till 5:30 .
Wow ! What's the hold up ?
translation.zh: 哇！有什么问题吗？

translation.en: May I have a menu , please ?
translation.zh: 请给我一份菜单好吗？

translation.en: Lobster ? It is steamed and served with our special sauce .
translation.zh: 龙虾？它是用我们的特制酱汁蒸的。

translation.en: Sure . It is a most popular dish .
translation.zh: 当然。这是一道很受欢迎的菜。

translation.en: I think I will try some lobster , and give me some green salad together .
translation.zh: 我想尝尝龙虾，再来一些蔬菜沙拉。

translation.en: How do you like your overcoat , sir ?
translation.zh: 先生，您的大衣怎么样？

translation.en: It's a bit too large . Would you please shorten the sleeves ?
translation.zh: 有点太大了。请你把袖子缩短一点好吗？

translation.en: OK , no problem . Let me take your measurement .
translation.zh: 好的，没问题。让我给你量尺寸。

translation.en: Besides , can you take up the hem one inch ?
translation.zh: 另外，你能把下摆收起来一英寸吗？

translation.en: I can't find the price tag .
translation.zh: 我找不到价格标签。

translation.en: It's right here . $ 100 .
translation.zh: 就在这里，100美元。

translation.en: But I heard other stores were having great mark-downs on this item .
translation.zh: 但我听说其他商店的这件衣服都在降价处理。

translation.en: Ours are of really good quality .
translation.zh: 我们的衣服质量真的很好。

translation.en: I see , please wrap it .
translation.zh: 我明白了，请把它包起来。

translation.en: We have three dressings for salad . Which one would you like ?
translation.zh: 我们有三种沙拉酱。你想要哪一种？

translation.en: We have Italian , French and Thousand Island .
translation.zh: 我们有意大利的、法式的和千岛的。

translation.en: Make it French please .
translation.zh: 请给我法式的。

translation.en: Ahem ... uh , sir , I beg your pardon ... Uh , mister , are you waiting to buy a ticket for the movie ?
translation.zh: 啊。。。呃，先生，对不起。。。呃，先生，你在等着买电影票吗？

translation.en: What's it look like , lady ? This is the ticket line I'm standing in , isn't it ?
translation.zh: 那你认为我在干什么，女士？这是买票的队伍吧，不是吗？

translation.en: Well , yes , it is , but ...
translation.zh: 嗯，是的，但是。。。

translation.en: So , what's your beef anyway , lady ?
translation.zh: 那么，你在抱怨些什么，女士？

translation.en: You just cut into line , in front of me and everyone else , that's what ! Go take your place back at the end of the line , like every - one else !
translation.zh: 你刚才插队了，插在我和其他人的前面，我就在抱怨这个！到队伍的后面去，像其他人一样！

translation.en: Oh sure , lady , and fat chance I'd get a ticket before they're sold out . I'm staying right here , understand ? So be a nice lady and butt out !
translation.zh: 哦，当然，女士，那我可能就买不到票了。我就站在这里，懂吗？当个乖女士别再唠叨了！

translation.en: Just what gives you the right ... ?
translation.zh: 谁给你权力……？

translation.en: Because I'm no sucker ; only suckers go to the end of the line . It's as simple as that , lady .
translation.zh: 因为我不是傻瓜；只有傻瓜才会走到队伍的尽头。就这么简单，女士。

translation.en: Well , you're no gentleman , either .
translation.zh: 你也不是绅士。

translation.en: Okay , lady , just to show what a gentleman I really am , I'll let you go in front of me . Now , just buy your ticket and shut your trap , will you , lady ?
translation.zh: 好吧，女士，为了证明我是一个真正的绅士，我让你走在我前面。现在，买了你的票，闭上你的嘴，好吗，女士？

translation.en: Whew ! I got the last one . This must be my lucky day !
translation.zh: 呼！我买到最后一张。今天一定是我的幸运日！

translation.en: What was that you just said ? Last one ... ? Hey , they've closed the ticket window !
translation.zh: 你刚才说什么？最后一张？嘿，他们关了售票窗口！

translation.en: Yes , I'm afraid I bought the last ticket , and to think , if you hadn't been such a gentleman . . .
translation.zh: 是的，恐怕我买了最后一张票，想想看，如果你不是那么绅士的话。

translation.en: Lady ! This is unfair ! I've been cheated ! I was in line before you.That should have been my ticket ! Come on , hand it over , lady !
translation.zh: 女士！这不公平！我被骗了！我排在你前面。那应该是我的票！快，把它交出来，女士！

translation.en: Gentleman ! Hah ! Fat chance ! Hah ! Eat your heart out , sucker ! Hah !
translation.zh: 先生！哈哈！机会渺茫！哈哈！后悔去吧，笨蛋！哈哈！

translation.en: Have you decided what you'd like ?
translation.zh: 你决定好要什么了吗？

translation.en: Yes . First I'll have tomato juice .
translation.zh: 嗯。首先我要番茄汁。

translation.en: I'll have the lamb chops , well-done , please .
translation.zh: 我要烤好的羊排。

translation.en: I would like to order a waistcoat .
translation.zh: 我想定做一件背心。

translation.en: Have you chosen the material ?
translation.zh: 你选好要什么材质了吗？

translation.en: Yes , I want it to made of tweed .
translation.zh: 是的，我想要粗花呢的。

translation.en: Fine . And the charge is $ 100 .
translation.zh: 好的。定做费用是100美元。

translation.en: Excuse me , sir , but you have to put your bags here before entering the market .
translation.zh: 对不起，先生，您在进入市场之前必须把您的包放在这里。

translation.en: Oh . I am sorry . I was busy looking for some whisky.Can you tell me the exactly place where I can find any ?
translation.zh: 哦。我很抱歉。我正在找威士忌。你能告诉我在哪儿能找到吗？

translation.en: Yes , it's on the third floor .
translation.zh: 是的，在三楼。

translation.en: I think I have a piece of apple pie .
translation.zh: 我想吃一块苹果派。

translation.en: OK . Sit down and I'll get it .
translation.zh: 好的，坐下吧，我去拿。

translation.en: Yes . I bought the can two days ago , but today I found that is beyond the guarantee period .
translation.zh: 对。我两天前买的罐头，今天发现已经超过保质期了。

translation.en: Let me see . I am sorry , sir . We will change another one for you . Please wait a moment .
translation.zh: 我看看。对不起，先生。我们会给你换一个。请稍等。

translation.en: What can I get you ?
translation.zh: 你想要什么？

translation.en: A cheeseburger and an order of french fries would be great .
translation.zh: 一个芝士汉堡和一份炸薯条就好了。

translation.en: I feel like having a Coke .
translation.zh: 我想喝杯可乐。

translation.en: That's a good idea . I think I'll join you .
translation.zh: 这是个好主意。我也要。

translation.en: Welcome to the McDonald's . What will it be for you , madam ?
translation.zh: 欢迎光临麦当劳。夫人，您要点什么？

translation.en: One Big Mac and French Fries .
translation.zh: 一个巨无霸和炸薯条。

translation.en: Give me one coke , please .
translation.zh: 请给我一杯可乐。

translation.en: To go , please .
translation.zh: 我要带走。

translation.en: That comes to four dollars and ten cents .
translation.zh: 总共是四美元十美分。

translation.en: It's on the service counter over there . Please go to help yourself .
translation.zh: 在那边的服务台上。请自便。

translation.en: Hi , I'm George . I'll be your waiter this evening . Are you ready to order or do you need a few more minutes ?
translation.zh: 嗨，我是乔治。今晚我为您提供服务。您准备好点菜了吗？还是需要几分钟？

translation.en: I'm ready now . I'd like the roast chicken and a side order of corn .
translation.zh: 我准备好了。我要烤鸡，还要玉米，作为附菜。

translation.en: And would you like an appetizer before your meal ? The soup of the day is our delicious tomato soup .
translation.zh: 饭前您要开胃菜吗？今天特别推荐的汤是美味的番茄汤。

translation.en: I'll pass on the soup , but I'd like a garden salad .
translation.zh: 我不喝汤，但我想要一份花园沙拉。

translation.en: Yes , I'd like a glass of iced tea .
translation.zh: 是的，我想要杯冰茶。

translation.en: Okay . I'll be back in a minute with your drink and salad .
translation.zh: 好的。我马上给您上饮料和沙拉。

translation.en: A cup of coffee sounds good , doesn't it ?
translation.zh: 一杯咖啡听起来不错，不是吗？

translation.en: Yes , but I think I'll have orange juice first .
translation.zh: 是的，但我想我要先喝橙汁。

translation.en: Do you feel like having anything to eat ?
translation.zh: 你想吃点什么吗？

translation.en: Well , I think I'll try the pancakes . How about you ?
translation.zh: 嗯，我想我要尝尝薄煎饼。你呢？

translation.en: Sounds great . That's just what I feel like having .
translation.zh: 听起来很棒。那正是我想要的。

translation.en: You look fresh recently . And .. what's your weight now ?
translation.zh: 你最近看起来精神很好。还有……你现在的体重是多少？
