translation.en: The 10th ? I'm sorry , but you see I'm going to attend an international conference on the 11th . Could you have the suit ready by the 8th , or at the latest , the 9th ?
translation.zh: 10号？对不起，我要参加11日的一个国际会议。你能在8号之前，或最迟9号之前把衣服准备好吗？

translation.en: Well , a business suit usually takes ten days ' time . But in your case , we'll try to have it ready sooner . How about coming for your fitting on the 8th ? Then your suit will be ready for you on the 10th ?
translation.zh: 嗯，做一套西装通常需要十天的时间。但考虑到您的情况，我们会尽快准备好的。8号来试衣怎么样？那么你的衣服10号应该就可以准备好了？

translation.en: That's fine , thank you .
translation.zh: 很好，谢谢。

translation.en: I have to be there before 17 o'clock .
translation.zh: 我必须在17点以前到那里。

translation.en: We'll make it except a jam . You know it's rush hour .
translation.zh: 除非堵车，我们会做到的。你知道现在是高峰时间。

translation.en: Here is your receipt . Thank you .
translation.zh: 这是您的收据。非常感谢。

translation.en: Oh , this way please . What size do you wear ?
translation.zh: 噢，请这边走。你穿多大号的？

translation.en: It feels all right . But if it were a darker color , I'd like it better . This seems too light for winter . Do you think you could get me one ?
translation.zh: 感觉很好。但如果颜色更深一点，我会更喜欢。这件冬天穿颜色似乎太浅了。你能帮我找一件吗？

translation.en: All right . I'll show you something darker . Do you like this one ?
translation.zh: 好吧。我给你看些颜色更深的。你喜欢这件吗？

translation.en: It looks good . But can I try it on ?
translation.zh: 看起来不错。我能试穿一下吗？

translation.en: Of course . Let me help you .
translation.zh: 当然。我来帮你。

translation.en: Thanks . It's comfortable . Well , how much is it , please ?
translation.zh: 谢谢。很舒服。嗯，请问多少钱？

translation.en: Ok . I'll take it . Here's the money .
translation.zh: 好的，我要了。这是钱。

translation.en: I need some stamps for this letter .
translation.zh: 我需要一些邮票寄这封信。

translation.en: I must weigh it first . Err ... It's five grams over weigh , Do you want to send it as an ordinary or registered letter ?
translation.zh: 我得先称一下。呃……超重5克，你想寄普通信还是挂号信？

translation.en: I want it registered . How much is it then ?
translation.zh: 我要挂号信。那要多少钱？

translation.en: Registration plus overnight ... err ... seven dollars in all .
translation.zh: 挂号加超重…呃…总共七美元。

translation.en: Here's a 10 - dollar bill .
translation.zh: 这是十美元。

translation.en: Now , your receipt , and the change .
translation.zh: 这是你的收据和零钱。

translation.en: Thanks . Good-bye .
translation.zh: 谢谢。再见。

translation.en: Give me a pack of first-class stamps , please .
translation.zh: 请给我一包头等邮票。

translation.en: Here you are . That will be five dollars . Anything else ?
translation.zh: 给你。一共五美元。还有别的需要吗？

translation.en: Yes . I want some post cards and some airmail stamps . I want to send some letters to South America .
translation.zh: 有的。我想要一些明信片和航空邮票。我想寄几封信到南美洲。

translation.en: Just a moment , I'll look up the rate for air-mail letters to South America .
translation.zh: 请稍等，我查一下寄往南美的航空信的费率。

translation.en: Can you tell me how much it will cost to send a package to Colombia ? Also , I what to know how long it will take .
translation.zh: 你能告诉我寄一个包裹到哥伦比亚要多少钱吗？还有，我想知道需要多长时间。

translation.en: Do you have the package with you ? I would have to weigh it to see how much it would cost .
translation.zh: 你带了包裹吗？我得称一下，看看要花多少钱。

translation.en: Do you insure package ?
translation.zh: 你们可以为这个包裹投保吗？

translation.en: Yes . All you have to do declare the value of the package and decide how much you want to insure it for .
translation.zh: 可以的。你所要做的就是申报包裹的价值，并决定你想为它投保多少。

translation.en: Is there a way that I can be sure that the people in South america receive my package ?
translation.zh: 有没有办法可以让我确定南美洲那边的人收到了我的包裹？

translation.en: The post office rarely loses package . You can , however , request a rectum receipt .
translation.zh: 邮局很少丢失包裹。不过，你可以申请一张收据。

translation.en: One last question-what are your hours ?
translation.zh: 最后一个问题，请问你们的工作时间是什么时候？

translation.en: We open at eight-thirty in the morning and close at five-thirty in the afternoon .
translation.zh: 我们早上八点半开门，下午五点半关门。

translation.en: Thank you , you helped me a lot .
translation.zh: 谢谢你，你帮了我很多。

translation.en: I am returning something that I bought yesterday .
translation.zh: 我要退昨天买的东西。

translation.en: What would you like to return ?
translation.zh: 您想退什么？

translation.en: I'm returning a cellphone .
translation.zh: 我要退一部手机。

translation.en: Was there something wrong with it ?
translation.zh: 有什么问题吗？

translation.en: It's defective .
translation.zh: 它有缺陷。

translation.en: What isn't working on it ?
translation.zh: 有哪里无法使用吗？

translation.en: It keeps turning off on it's own .
translation.zh: 它会自动关机。

translation.en: Alright , do you have the receipt ?
translation.zh: 好的，您有收据吗？

translation.en: I'm going to take care of this and refund your money .
translation.zh: 我会处理好这件事并退还您的钱。

translation.en: Can I borrow five bucks ?
translation.zh: 我能借五块钱吗？

translation.en: Come on ! I'll pay you back on Tuesday .
translation.zh: 拜托！我星期二还你钱。

translation.en: Last time I lent you money , you never paid me back .
translation.zh: 上次我借钱给你的时候，你从来没还过我。

translation.en: I promise if you lend me five dollars today , I will repay you in full next week .
translation.zh: 我保证，如果你今天借给我五美元，我下周会全额还你的。

translation.en: Ok , but I'm taking your skateboard as collateral .
translation.zh: 好吧，但我拿你的滑板当抵押。

translation.en: Fine ! I can't believe you don't trust me .
translation.zh: 好的！我不敢相信你不相信我。

translation.en: It's nothing personal , just business .
translation.zh: 这不是私事，只是公事。

translation.en: I'm done . Can I watch TV ?
translation.zh: 好了。我能看电视吗？

translation.en: Here's some water . Take these multi-vitamins and Tylenol .
translation.zh: 这里有一些水。把这些复合维生素和泰诺药片吃了。

translation.en: Uh ! I can't swallow them , Mom !
translation.zh: 啊，我咽不下去了，妈妈！

translation.en: Your throat must be swollen .
translation.zh: 你的喉咙一定肿了。

translation.en: Do I have to take them ?
translation.zh: 我一定要吃吗？

translation.en: Here , I'll break them up , so they're smaller . And here's some cough syrup .
translation.zh: 来，我要把这些药片分开，它们就更小一点。这是止咳糖浆。

translation.en: Yuck !
translation.zh: 讨厌死了！

translation.en: I know , it tastes horrible . But it'll make you feel better . Try holding your nose . It won't taste as bad .
translation.zh: 我知道，药很难吃。但这会让你好起来。试着捏住你的鼻子。就没那么难吃了。

translation.en: That's really convenient . We were wondering if you could take a little off the rent , though .
translation.zh: 那真的很方便。不过，我们想知道你能不能减掉一点房租。

translation.en: I can take two thousand off . That'll make the rent twenty-eight thousand .
translation.zh: 我可以减掉两千。那就是两万八千的租金了。

translation.en: That's great . Every little bit counts . And we don't need the parking space . I guess we could rent it out .
translation.zh: 太好了。能省多少是多少。而且我们不需要停车位。我想我们可以把它租出去。

translation.en: Sure , for at least three thousand per month .
translation.zh: 当然，每月至少三千英镑。

translation.en: That'll bring the price down to twenty-five . That's the price we were shooting for .
translation.zh: 那样房租就只要两万五千多了。正是我们想要的价格。

translation.en: I'm glad . Now , there's a deposit fee of two month's rent .
translation.zh: 我很高兴。另外，押金是两个月的租金。

translation.en: Oh , well . It was fun to be the winner . But ... it's too big . I must be an extra small in the States .
translation.zh: 当然了，赢比赛很爽。但是...这太遥远了。我在美国一定是个小角色。

translation.en: So what about the tennis racket ?
translation.zh: 那网球拍呢？

translation.en: Look ! It's amazing . I can't wait to try it out !
translation.zh: 网球拍超级棒！我等不及要试试了！

translation.en: How much did that end up costing you ?
translation.zh: 你最后花了多少钱？

translation.en: Oh ... around twenty bucks . A bargain if you ask me . Look at the picture of her playing with it !
translation.zh: 我想想...大约二十美元。其实是我占便宜了。你看她用这把拍子打球的照片！

translation.en: Hey , two for one . That's a super deal .
translation.zh: 嘿，一样的价钱得了两个好东西。真划算。

translation.en: And here's her signature !
translation.zh: 而且这里有她的的签名！

translation.en: I'm in heaven ! A Whirlpool dryer !
translation.zh: 我到天堂了！惠而浦的烘干机！

translation.en: I love them , too . Let's move into the kitchen . Wait until you see the refrigerator .
translation.zh: 我也很喜欢。我们去厨房吧。等看到冰箱，你会更兴奋。

translation.en: This is too good to be true .
translation.zh: 这太好了，这根本是在作梦。

translation.en: And the stove is brand new . You know how to use a gas stove , right ?
translation.zh: 炉子是全新的。你知道怎么用煤气炉，对吧？

translation.en: Yes . We've lived in Taiwan for a while . I had a gas stove in the States , too .
translation.zh: 对。我们在台湾住过一段时间。我在美国也有一个煤气炉。

translation.en: It's better for cooking Chinese food . Well , what do you think ?
translation.zh: 煮中国菜比较方便。所以，你们的想法如何？

translation.en: We love it . But we'd like to know about the neighbors .
translation.zh: 我们很喜欢这间房子。但我们想知道邻居的情况。

translation.en: They're here ! Now that's speedy service ! And they arrived within two days of each other !
translation.zh: 东西来了！现在真是服务迅速！而且这两样收到的时间，间隔不到两天！

translation.en: What are you waiting for ? Rip ‘ em open !
translation.zh: 还等什么？拆开它们吧！

translation.en: Wow ... this shirt is nice , but looks big .
translation.zh: 哇！这件衬衫不错，但看起来有点太大了。

translation.en: It's nice , but how much did you end up paying ?
translation.zh: 是不错，不过你最后付了多少钱？

translation.en: With the shipping included--seventy dollars .
translation.zh: 算上运费的话七十美元。

translation.en: Hmm ... not so hot . They sell them here for about that .
translation.zh: 嗯……不怎么划算。这里差不多也卖这样的价钱。

translation.en: Can you fix me a cup of tea , Johnny ?
translation.zh: 约翰尼，你能给我倒杯茶吗？

translation.en: Well ... uh ... how about a glass of juice instead ?
translation.zh: 好。。。嗯。。。来杯果汁怎么样？

translation.en: No . I'd like tea . Can you put it in my favorite cup ? You probably washed it ...
translation.zh: 不。我想要茶。你能把它放在我最喜欢的杯子里吗？你可能洗过了。。。

translation.en: Oh , yeah . Well , uh , about your mug ...
translation.zh: 哦，是的。呃，关于你的杯子。。。

translation.en: I'll find it ... Where are all the floral pattern plates ? And dad's Yankee's mug ?
translation.zh: 我会找到的。。。那些花型盘子呢？爸爸的洋基杯子呢？

translation.en: Hi , I would like to return this TV .
translation.zh: 嗨，我想退掉这台电视机。

translation.en: Sure , do you have the receipt ?
translation.zh: 好的，你有收据吗？

translation.en: Yeah here you go . Actually I also want to return this keyboard .
translation.zh: 是的，给你。其实我也想退了这个键盘。

translation.en: Ok . may I ask what is the reason for returning these products ?
translation.zh: 好的，请问退货的原因是什么？

translation.en: The TV flickers a lot when I am watching a movie and at times the image is not very clear .
translation.zh: 我看电影时，电视屏幕经常闪烁，有时图像也不是很清晰。

translation.en: I see , and what about the keyboard ?
translation.zh: 我知道了，那键盘呢？

translation.en: I spilled some coffee on it and now it won't work .
translation.zh: 我把咖啡洒在上面了，现在不能用了。

translation.en: I am sorry mam , but we can only exchange or refund defective products , we cannot take responsibility for misuse or damages .
translation.zh: 对不起，女士，我们只能退换有缺陷的产品，对用坏或损坏的产品我们不承担责任。

translation.en: Fine ! I don't know why they make these things so delicate anyways .
translation.zh: 好吧！我不知道为什么要把这些东西弄得这么脆弱易坏。

translation.en: Bruno Bistro , how may I help you ?
translation.zh: 这里是布鲁诺小酒馆，有什么事吗？

translation.en: Yes , hello , I would like to make a reservation please .
translation.zh: 是的，你好，我想预订房间。

translation.en: Certainly sir , For which day and time please ?
translation.zh: 当然可以，先生，请问您想预订哪一天、哪一时间？

translation.en: Tonight at seven .
translation.zh: 今晚七点。

translation.en: I'm sorry sir , but we are fully booked tonight until eight .
translation.zh: 对不起，先生，今晚八点之前的房间都已经订满了。

translation.en: In that case , eight o'clock is fine .
translation.zh: 那就八点吧。

translation.en: Very well , and how many people will attend tonight ?
translation.zh: 好的，请问今晚有几人入住？

translation.en: Four people .
translation.zh: 四个人。

translation.en: Lastly , may I please know what name I should make the reservation under ?
translation.zh: 最后，我可以知道您是应该用哪个名字预订吗？

translation.en: Mark .
translation.zh: 马克。

translation.en: Welcome to Al's Bakery . What can I get you ?
translation.zh: 欢迎来到艾尔的面包店。需要点什么 ？

translation.en: Hi ! Let me get a dozen croissants , four blueberry muffins and a loaf of sourdough bread .
translation.zh: 你好！我要一打牛角面包，四个蓝莓松饼和一条酸面包。

translation.en: Sure . Would you like to have the loaf sliced ?
translation.zh: 当然。你要把面包切成片吗？

translation.en: No , that's OK . Do you have any whole wheat bread ?
translation.zh: 不用，没关系。有全麦面包吗？

translation.en: We are out at the moment . May I suggest some rye bread ?
translation.zh: 目前是卖完了。考虑拿些黑麦面包吗？

translation.en: Sure that sounds good . Do you have any cakes ?
translation.zh: 听起来不错。有蛋糕吗？

translation.en: We have various birthday cakes and also ice cream cakes .
translation.zh: 我们有各种各样的生日蛋糕和冰淇淋蛋糕。

translation.en: I'll just take a cheesecake .
translation.zh: 我要一个芝士蛋糕。

translation.en: Your total is forty three dollars and twenty cents .
translation.zh: 总共是43美元20美分。

translation.en: Hello Mrs Parker , how have you been ?
translation.zh: 你好，帕克太太，最近怎么样？

translation.en: Hello Dr Peters . Just fine thank you . Ricky and I are here for his vaccines .
translation.zh: 你好，彼得斯医生。我很好，谢谢。我是瑞奇来给打疫苗的。

translation.en: Very well . Let's see , according to his vaccination record , Ricky has received his Polio , Tetanus and Hepatitis B shots . He is 14 months old , so he is due for Hepatitis A , Chickenpox and Measles shots .
translation.zh: 很好。让我看看，根据他的疫苗接种记录，瑞奇已经接种了小儿麻痹症、破伤风和乙肝疫苗。他已经14个月大了，应该注射甲肝、水痘和麻疹疫苗。

translation.en: What about Rubella and Mumps ?
translation.zh: 那风疹和腮腺炎怎么办？

translation.en: Well , I can only give him these for now , and after a couple of weeks I can administer the rest .
translation.zh: 是这样，我现在只能给他打这些，几周后我可以给他打剩下的。

translation.en: OK , great . Doctor , I think I also may need a Tetanus booster . Last time I got it was maybe fifteen years ago !
translation.zh: 行，太好了。医生，我想我还需要一个破伤风增强剂。我上一次接种大概是15年前了！

translation.en: We will check our records and I'll have the nurse administer and the booster as well . Now , please hold Ricky's arm tight , this may sting a little .
translation.zh: 我们会检查我们的记录，我会让护士管理然后我拿一下助推器。现在，麻烦您抱紧瑞奇的胳膊，这可能有点刺痛。

translation.en: Good morning , young lady . You can call me Ma . Do you see anything you like ?
translation.zh: 早上好，小姐。你可以叫我玛。你看到你喜欢的东西了吗？

translation.en: Yes . Many things ! I especially love this beautiful quilt .
translation.zh: 对。很多东西！我特别喜欢这床漂亮的被子。

translation.en: That quilt was passed down to me from my ma in Holland .
translation.zh: 那被子是我在荷兰的妈妈传给我的。

translation.en: It sounds like a special quilt . Why do you want to sell it ?
translation.zh: 听起来像一床特别的被子。你为什么要卖掉它？

translation.en: Well , this home is too big for me now , so I'm moving to an apartment that is much smaller . Therefore , I need to part with a few things .
translation.zh: 嗯，这个家现在对我来说太大了，所以我要搬到一个小得多的公寓去。因此，我需要放弃一些东西。

translation.en: Oh , I see . Umm , how much do you want for the quilt ?
translation.zh: 哦，我明白了。嗯，这被子你要多少钱？

translation.en: Is fifteen dollars OK ?
translation.zh: 十五美元可以吗？

translation.en: Smells good ! What ’ s for breakfast ?
translation.zh: 好香啊！早餐吃什么？

translation.en: Well , since we are getting up so late , I decided to make a big breakfast !
translation.zh: 好吧，既然我们起得这么晚，我决定做一顿丰盛的早餐！

translation.en: Nice ! Brunch !
translation.zh: 很好！早午餐！

translation.en: Kind of , so I made scrambled and soft boiled eggs , some french toast and buttermilk pancakes !
translation.zh: 有点，所以我做了炒鸡蛋和煮鸡蛋，一些法式吐司和酪乳煎饼！

translation.en: Wow ! You really went all out ! Did you make any coffee ?
translation.zh: 哇！你真的全力以赴了！你煮咖啡了吗？

translation.en: Yeah , just the way you like it ! I also put out some cereal and muesli if you feel like having something more light .
translation.zh: 是啊，就是你喜欢的方式！如果你想喝点清淡的，我还放了一些麦片和牛奶。

translation.en: Looks good ! I ’ ll squeeze us some fresh orange juice .
translation.zh: 看起来不错！我给我们榨些鲜橙汁。

translation.en: Get the jam and butter while you are in there ! Oh ! And don ’ t forget the syrup !
translation.zh: 你顺便将果酱和黄油拿来。别忘了拿糖浆。

translation.en: I ’ m hungry , let ’ s go grab a bite to eat .
translation.zh: 我饿了，我们去吃点东西吧。

translation.en: Yeah me too . Oh ! Can we stop at the shop really fast ? I lost my makeup bag at the airport and I want to pick up a few things .
translation.zh: 嗯，我也饿了，我们能在商店旁停一下吗？我在机场弄丢了化妆包，我想买些东西。

translation.en: Will you take long ?
translation.zh: 你要花很长时间吗？

translation.en: No ! Five minutes I promise !
translation.zh: 不！我保证五分钟就好！

translation.en: Come on ! We have been here for almost an hour ! I thought you said you were only going to get a few things ! How long does it take you to pick out a lipstick and some nail polish !
translation.zh: 快点，我们在这儿已经快1个小时了，我记得你说过你只买几样东西。选一支口红和一些指甲油怎么用这么长时间。

translation.en: Are you crazy ? You have no idea what you are talking about ! Just for my eyes I have to get eye-liner , an eyelash curler , eye shadow , an eyebrow pencil and mascara . Then I need to get foundation , liquid foundation .
translation.zh: 你疯了吗？你根本不知道你在说什么！就拿我的眼睛来说，我就得买眼线笔、睫毛夹、眼影、眉笔和睫毛膏。然后我需要粉底，粉底液。

translation.en: Whoa whoa whoa ! Are you nuts ? How much is all this going to cost ? I ’ m looking at the price at each one of these little things and it ’ s outrageous ! This is basically a crayon !
translation.zh: 哇！你疯了吗？这些东西得花多少钱？我看了下这些东西的每样报价，太不可思议了。这简直就是蜡笔。

translation.en: What about you ? You spend as much or more money on your razors , after shave , cologne and gel ! Not to mention how much you spend on clothes and ...
translation.zh: 那你呢？你花了同样或很多的钱用来买电动刮胡刀，刮脸后搽的润肤水以及古龙水上面。更不用你花在买衣服和……的钱。

translation.en: Fine ! Get the stupid thirty dollar crayon !
translation.zh: 好吧，买那个愚蠢的30美元蜡笔吧！

translation.en: We have been over this a hundred times ! We are not getting a pet !
translation.zh: 我们已经讨论过一百次了！我们不能养宠物！

translation.en: Why not ? Come on ! Just a cute little puppy or a kitty !
translation.zh: 为什么不？得了吧！只是一只可爱的小狗或小猫！

translation.en: Who is going to look after a dog or a cat ?
translation.zh: 谁来照看狗或猫？

translation.en: I will ! I ’ ll feed it , bathe it and walk it every day ! We can get a Labrador or a German Shepard !
translation.zh: 我会的！我要喂它，给它洗澡，每天带它散步！我们可以买一只拉布拉多或德国牧羊犬！

translation.en: What if we want to take a vacation ? Who will we leave it with ? Plus , our apartment is too small for that breed of dog .
translation.zh: 如果我们想休假呢？我们把它留给谁？另外，我们的公寓对那种狗来说太小了。

translation.en: Ok . How about we get a cat or a ferret ?
translation.zh: 好吧，那我们养只猫或雪貂怎么样？

translation.en: We ’ re planning on having children soon , I don ’ t think those animals are a good idea with a baby in the house .
translation.zh: 我们计划将来要个小孩，我认为屋子里有小孩就不适合样这些宠物。

translation.en: Fine ! Let ’ s get a bird then ! We can keep it in its cage and teach it to talk ! A parrot would be awesome !
translation.zh: 好吧，那养只鸟吧。我们能放在笼子里养，并教它说话。养鹦鹉就很棒。

translation.en: I ’ ll tell you what , I can get you some hamsters and we ’ ll take it from there .
translation.zh: 我要告诉你，我会给你买个仓鼠，先从养那个开始。

translation.en: Would you like us to deliver the mattress for you , sir ?
translation.zh: 先生，您要我们帮您送床垫吗？

translation.en: I need it delivered at 12 o'clock .
translation.zh: 在12点的时候寄给我。

translation.en: Very affordable mam . You can take it out of this lot today with 0 % down payment and no interest for the first year ! You can test drive it now and we can sign the papers when we get back .
translation.zh: 很实惠的。你今天就可以把它从这批货里拿出来，首付0%，第一年没有利息！你现在可以试驾，我们回来后可以签文件。

translation.en: I'm going to buy a new living room set .
translation.zh: 我需要为我的客厅买一套新家具。

translation.en: Where are you going to buy one ?
translation.zh: 你要去哪里买？

translation.en: You like my living room set , don't you ?
translation.zh: 你想知道我在哪里买的吗？

translation.en: I found mine at IKEA .
translation.zh: 我从宜家买的。

translation.en: Are they expensive ?
translation.zh: 你花了多少钱？

translation.en: Everything I got from IKEA cost me a couple thousand .
translation.zh: 整套花了我几千英镑。

translation.en: Is the furniture crafted well ?
translation.zh: 家具质量好吗？

translation.en: The furniture isn't built cheap .
translation.zh: 家具做得非常好。

translation.en: I'll pay the money , as long as I'm getting what I pay for .
translation.zh: 只要质量好，我不介意花很多钱。

translation.en: You will feel comfortable paying the money .
translation.zh: 你会觉得物超所值的。

translation.en: I'm about to run out of business cards . I need some new ones .
translation.zh: 我的名片快用完了。我需要一些新的。

translation.en: We can print as many as you like . Just tell me how many .
translation.zh: 你想印多少就印多少。请告诉我你需要多少张。

translation.en: Two thousand should get me through the year .
translation.zh: 两千张应该够我用一年了。

translation.en: Here's a form to get you started .
translation.zh: 请先填一下这张表格。

translation.en: My old card is perfect , so all I want you to do is copy it exactly .
translation.zh: 我的旧版名片挺好的，所以我只想让你把它复制下来。

translation.en: I think you'll be very pleased with how well we duplicate your old card .
translation.zh: 我们可以很好地复制你的旧版名片，我想你会很高兴的。

translation.en: ... Here you go
translation.zh: .……就是这样。

translation.en: Thanks . Come back here next Wednesday to pick up your order , please .
translation.zh: 谢谢。请下星期三过来取你的名片。

translation.en: I'm sorry , but can you give me a three-day turnaround ?
translation.zh: 对不起，你能多给我三天时间周转吗？

translation.en: If you don't mind paying a little extra , it's absolutely no problem .
translation.zh: 如果你不介意多付一点钱，那绝对没问题。

translation.en: Where'd you get it from ?
translation.zh: 你从哪儿弄来的？

translation.en: OK , that ’ s all of them . No more gifts . Now who wants to guess when the baby is due ?
translation.zh: 所有礼物都在这儿了。现在谁想猜孩子什么时候出生？

translation.en: Ahhs ! I'm beat !
translation.zh: 啊哈！我被打败了！

translation.en: What happened to you ? You look like you got hit by a tornado !
translation.zh: 你怎么了？你看起来像被龙卷风袭击了！

translation.en: I just got back from fighting the crowds .
translation.zh: 我刚和人群战斗回来。

translation.en: You mean at the mall ? Was there a sale ?
translation.zh: 你是说在商场吗？有大减价吗？

translation.en: Yeah . For five minutes , everything was half off . It was total chaos ...
translation.zh: 是啊。有五分钟，一切都是半价。一片混乱……

translation.en: Grabbing , pushing and shoving ...
translation.zh: 抓，推，推……

translation.en: OK , Allen . It's your turn . Are you ready ?
translation.zh: 好的，艾伦。轮到你了。你准备好了吗？

translation.en: Come on ! In the two hours we've been here you haven't sung even one song !
translation.zh: 加油！我们在这儿两个小时了，你一首歌都没唱！

translation.en: Well , you asked for it . Why don't you put on an Elvis song for him . He loves " The King . "
translation.zh: 是你自找的。你为什么不为他唱一首猫王的歌呢。他喜欢“国王”

translation.en: I'm starving . Let's get something to eat .
translation.zh: 我饿死了。我们去吃点东西吧。

translation.en: Can we go somewhere nearby ? I don't feel like walking too far .
translation.zh: 我们能去附近的某个地方吗？我不想走太远。

translation.en: Sure . What kind of food do you like ?
translation.zh: 当然。你喜欢什么样的食物？

translation.en: I mean the food for something spicy .
translation.zh: 辛辣的食物。

translation.en: How about some Korean food ? There's a place right there on the corner .
translation.zh: 来点韩国菜怎么样？拐角处有家店。

translation.en: That sounds great . I love Korean food .
translation.zh: 听起来不错。我喜欢韩国菜。

translation.en: Hello , sir . I'm ready for you .
translation.zh: 您好，先生。该您了。

translation.en: Is it my turn ?
translation.zh: 轮到我了吗？

translation.en: Yes , please sit on the chair.How do you want to have your hair cut ?
translation.zh: 是的，请坐在椅子上。你想要什么发型？

translation.en: Not too long.Cut a little off behind and on both sides , too .
translation.zh: 不要太长。后面和两边也剪一点。

translation.en: OK.Now lean back a little and keep still . I'm going to shave your face .
translation.zh: 好的。现在向后靠一点，不要动。我要给您刮脸。

translation.en: Do you want a shampoo ?
translation.zh: 你要洗头吗？

translation.en: What brand do you prefer ?
translation.zh: 喜欢什么牌子的洗发水？

translation.en: An ordinary one will do.Would you put me under a hot dryer after that ? I'm in a hurry .
translation.zh: 一般的就行。之后给我热吹风好吗？我赶时间。

translation.en: All right , miss.This one is very hot . I'll come to turn it off in fifteen minutes.Will that be alright ?
translation.zh: 好的，小姐。这个吹风机很热。我十五分钟后来把它关掉。可以吗？

translation.en: Dad , can you lend me some money ?
translation.zh: 爸爸，你能借我点钱吗？

translation.en: I want to get a ticket for a concert tonight .
translation.zh: 我想买一张今晚音乐会的票。

translation.en: All right.Here ' s the money . I suppose I'll have to drive you there .
translation.zh: 好的。这是钱。我想我得开车送你去那儿。

translation.en: A ticket to London , please .
translation.zh: 请给我一张去伦敦的票。

translation.en: A cheap day return ticket ?
translation.zh: 廉价往返票吗？

translation.en: Yes , including London Tube .
translation.zh: 是的，包括伦敦地铁。

translation.en: That'll be twelve pounds .
translation.zh: 一共12英镑。

translation.en: I'm after some chinese incense burner ? How's this one ?
translation.zh: 我在找中国香炉？这个怎么样？

translation.en: How's this one ?
translation.zh: 这个怎么样？

translation.en: Oh , I need a small one , otherwise my luggage will be overweight .
translation.zh: 哦，我需要一个小的，否则我的行李会超重。

translation.en: Oh , this is fine .
translation.zh: 哦，这很好。

translation.en: Staying out all night , you frightened me to death .
translation.zh: （你）整晚呆在外面，快把我吓死了。

translation.en: I stayed with my friends .
translation.zh: 我和朋友呆在一起。

translation.en: You should at least give me a call .
translation.zh: 你至少应该给我打个电话。

translation.en: I'm sorry , Mum .
translation.zh: 对不起，妈妈。

translation.en: Excuse me . I bought the CD here two days ago . It's scratched , and doesn't play properly .
translation.zh: 打扰一下。我两天前在这里买了这张CD。它被刮伤了，不能正常播放。

translation.en: I'm sorry about that , sir . I'll get you another one .
translation.zh: 很抱歉，先生。我再给您拿一个。

translation.en: The thing is I've replaced once already . I think it's just a faulty batch .
translation.zh: 问题是我已经换过一次了。我想这一批CD都有问题。

translation.en: I see . Maybe I can offer you a credit note .
translation.zh: 我明白了。也许我可以给您一张信用证。

translation.en: Well . To be honest , that's not much use to me . I'll leave the country tomorrow . I'd really prefer a refund .
translation.zh: 嗯。老实说，那对我没什么用。我明天要离开这个国家了。我只想要退款。

translation.en: OK , sir . I'll see what I can do .
translation.zh: 好的，先生。我看看我该怎么做。

translation.en: Need a gift for your girlfriend or wife ...
translation.zh: 是您的女朋友或妻子需要礼物之类的吗……

translation.en: Didn't you say your friend was American ? Where is she going on her honeymoon ?
translation.zh: 你不是说你的朋友是美国人吗？她要去哪里度蜜月？

translation.en: They're going skiing in Colorado .
translation.zh: 他们要去科罗拉多滑雪。

translation.en: What a coincidence ! These pajamas would be perfect to take along on the honeymoon !
translation.zh: 太巧了！带这些睡衣去度蜜月真是完美！

translation.en: You're probably right . Oh , what the heck ! I'll take it all ... in maroon , like you said .
translation.zh: 你或许你说得对。哦，管他的！我全买了。就照你所说，要红棕色的。

translation.en: Hey ! What happened ? ! My song was only half way through and it skipped to the next song .
translation.zh: 嘿！怎么了！我的歌刚唱完一半，就跳到了下一首歌。

translation.en: I don't know what happened !
translation.zh: 我不知道发生了什么！

translation.en: You cancelled the song , didn't you , Jack ?
translation.zh: 你取消了那首歌，是吗，杰克？

translation.en: No , I didn't . Really !
translation.zh: 不，我没有。真的！

translation.en: Then , is the machine broken or ...
translation.zh: 那么，是机器坏了还是。。。

translation.en: Um , hello again . Are you sure you don't want to make a purchase , sir ?
translation.zh: 嗯，您好。先生，您确定不想买东西吗？

translation.en: I have a question .
translation.zh: 我有个问题

translation.en: Hush ... OK . What is it ?
translation.zh: 呃……好吧，什么问题？

translation.en: Why do people like all this fancy , expensive underwear ?
translation.zh: 为什么人们喜欢这些花哨昂贵的内衣？

translation.en: What kind of question is that ?
translation.zh: 您这是什么意思？

translation.en: I'm just curious . I think women are beautiful without this stuff .
translation.zh: 我只是好奇。我认为没有这些东西女人才是美丽的。

translation.en: Uh ... yeah , right ...
What are you doing ? Checking the " to do " list for the wedding ?
translation.zh: 你在做什么？检查婚礼的待办事项吗？

translation.en: Yep . There's still so much to do !
translation.zh: 是的。还有好多事要做啊！

translation.en: So let's start by checking off what we've already done .
translation.zh: 那我们先把已经办好的事划掉。

translation.en: Did you reconfirm the plane reservations for all the Taiwanese guests ?
translation.zh: 你确定所有台湾客人的机票都预订了吗？

translation.en: Not yet , I was busy getting that videographer who films stuff for the Net .
translation.zh: 还没，我忙着连络我们婚礼网站的录像师。

translation.en: Cool ! I can't believe he agreed to go all the way to Dallas with us !
translation.zh: 酷！我不敢相信他竟然同意和我们一路去达拉斯！

translation.en: Hey ! We're paying for his ticket !
translation.zh: 嘿！我们要给他包机票的！

translation.en: Holly ? Holly Madison , is that you ? You look great ! You haven't changed a bit .
translation.zh: 霍莉？霍莉·麦迪逊，是你吗？你看起来棒极了！你一点都没变。

translation.en: Uh ... Andrew . Hello . I can't quite remember you .
translation.zh: 啊，安德鲁。你好。我都快认不出你了。

translation.en: It's me . The D-man ! I sat behind you in English . Are you and Taylor still dating ?
translation.zh: 是我。小D！我坐在你后面学英语。你和泰勒还在谈恋爱吗？

translation.en: Um ... we never were . We're just friends .
translation.zh: 嗯……我们从来没有谈过恋爱。我们只是朋友。

translation.en: Well , if you're not seeing anyone , maybe we could ...
translation.zh: 如果你没有恋人，也许我们可以……

translation.en: ... I am seeing someone . This is Yi-jun , my ...
translation.zh: ... 我有恋人了。这是怡君，我的……

translation.en: I'm glad you're on your ten-year reunion planning committee .
translation.zh: 我很高兴你加入了你的十年团圆计划委员会。

translation.en: Yeah , you get the TV to yourself while I spend my nights surfing the Net for missing classmates .
translation.zh: 是啊，你自己在看电视，而我却在夜以继日地上网寻找失散的同学们。

translation.en: That's not why . This way I can see how you guys do this sort of thing .
translation.zh: 不是的。我这样做就能知道你们是怎么做的了。

translation.en: I guess . Don't you have reunions in Taiwan ?
translation.zh: 可能是吧。你在台湾没有团聚吗？

translation.en: Definitely . Every year . But just for our forty-person class .
translation.zh: 肯定有啊。每年都会聚。但就只是我们40人的班级小聚。

translation.en: Ours are for everyone that graduated in the same year .
translation.zh: （但现在）我们是为同一年毕业的每个人（重聚而努力）。

translation.en: Excuse me , could you tell me the bookshop ’ s address ?
translation.zh: 对不起，你能告诉我书店的地址吗？

translation.en: Yes , the bookshop is just around the corner.Turn left and you ’ ll see the bookshop .
translation.zh: 是的，书店就在拐角处。向左拐你就会看到它了。

translation.en: Thank you very much.By the way , is the hospital beside the bookshop .
translation.zh: 非常感谢。顺便问一下，医院在书店旁边吗？

translation.en: Right , if you see the bookshop , you can see the hospital .
translation.zh: 对，如果你看到书店，你就能看到医院。

translation.en: I'd like to buy a bottle of Centrum , a dozen tooth brushes , some baby's wipes , and a small bottle of aspirin .
translation.zh: 我想买一瓶善存片，一打牙刷，一些婴儿湿巾和一小瓶阿司匹林。

translation.en: Give me one bottle of one hundred tablets .
translation.zh: 给我一瓶一百片的。

translation.en: This one is 10 % off . That one has no reduction , but you can get a free tube of toothpaste with six toothbrushes .
translation.zh: 这种打九折。那种不减价，但是你买六支牙刷可以送一支牙膏。

translation.en: So if I buy a dozen , I'll get two free tubes of toothpaste ?
translation.zh: 如果我买一打，我就能免费得到两支牙膏？

translation.en: Good . I ' ll take a dozen of them then .
translation.zh: 很好。那我就买一打。

translation.en: And here is your aspirin . What else did you say you want ?
translation.zh: 这是你的阿司匹林。你说你还要什么？

translation.en: Baby's wipes . Johnson's .
translation.zh: 婴儿湿巾。强生的。

translation.en: Well , actually I'd like to buy some vitamins for my son . He's five months old . Can you suggest any ?
translation.zh: 嗯，实际上我想给我儿子买些维生素。他五个月大。你有什么建议吗？

translation.en: Sure . Here you are . This one is excellent . Just mix one drop of it with milk .
translation.zh: 当然。给你。这个很棒。只要在牛奶里加入一滴就行了。

translation.en: Thanks . That'll be all .
translation.zh: 谢谢。就这些了。

translation.en: Excuse me , I ’ Ve been waiting my main dish for quite a time .
translation.zh: 对不起，我等主菜等了好长时间了。

translation.en: Yes sir , just a minute , please . I ’ ll check with the kitchen . Thank you for waiting . It takes another 10 to 15 minutes , I ’ m afraid .
translation.zh: 好的，先生。请稍等，我去厨房看看。谢谢您的等候。恐怕还要十到十五分钟。

translation.en: I have an appointment in half an hour .
translation.zh: 我们半小时后有个约会。

translation.en: Do you have anything else I can have instead ?
translation.zh: 你们还有什么菜可以上吗？

translation.en: Well sir , yes . How about this stew ? We can serve you at once .
translation.zh: 嗯，有。炖牛肉怎么样？我们可以马上为您上菜。

translation.en: I ’ ll take this stew then .
translation.zh: 那我要炖牛肉。

translation.en: Excuse me , would you tell me how to return to Hilton Hotel . I'm afraid I lost my way .
translation.zh: 劳驾，您能告诉我怎么回希尔顿饭店吗。恐怕我迷路了。

translation.en: Did you have hotel card or something ?
translation.zh: 您有酒店名片吗？

translation.en: Let me see . Yes , I have the address and hotel telephone number here .
translation.zh: 我看一下。是的，我这里有酒店的地址和电话号码。

translation.en: Oh , you stay at the down town Hilton . When you go down two blocks this way and turn left , you will find it on your right .
translation.zh: 哦，你可以到希尔顿的市中心。沿着这条路走两个街区然后左转，你会发现酒店就在你的右边。

translation.en: I don't understand very well . Could you give me a map ?
translation.zh: 我不太明白。你能给我一张地图吗？

translation.en: Don't take too much off . I'm trying to grow my hair longer .
translation.zh: 别剪得太多。我想把头发留长些。

translation.en: How about two inches ?
translation.zh: 两英寸怎么样？

translation.en: That sounds perfect . Do you think I can get some highlights today , too ? I've always wanted red .
translation.zh: 听起来很完美。听起来很棒。你觉得我今天也可以挑染吗？我一直想染红的。

translation.en: I think that will over-process your hair , you should wait at least two weeks .
translation.zh: 我想那对你头发伤害太大了，你最少应该先等个两星期。

translation.en: All right . I'll just have the cut and perm today .
translation.zh: 好吧。那我今天先剪发和烫就好了。

translation.en: Great . My assistant will wash your hair , and then I'll be back to help you .
translation.zh: 很好。我的助手会来帮你洗头，然后我会马上回来帮你。

translation.en: Well , it's illegal to bring food and drinks into the theater .
translation.zh: 呃，把食物和饮料带进剧院是违法的。

translation.en: Too bad . I did anyway .
translation.zh: 真糟啊。反正我都已经带了。

translation.en: No wonder you brought such a big bag today .
translation.zh: 怪不得你今天带了这么大的包。

translation.en: I brought Strawberry Sticks . See ?
translation.zh: 我带了草莓棒。看到了吗？

translation.en: Those are the ones that are pre-dipped in sweet coating !
translation.zh: 这些就是会先裹上一层糖衣的那种！

translation.en: Yep . And there's real strawberry chunks in the coating .
translation.zh: 是的。糖衣里还有真正的草莓块呢。

translation.en: This needs dry-cleaning.Can you remove this stain without harming the fabric ?
translation.zh: 这个需要干洗。你能在不损坏衣服的情况下去除这个污渍吗？

translation.en: Let me see . We ’ ll try , but I ’ m not sure that we can remove it .
translation.zh: 我想一下。我们可以试试，但不敢保证能把它完全去除。

translation.en: Ok , then . We ’ ll I ’ d also like to have this pressed .
translation.zh: 那好吧。我还想把这个熨一下。

translation.en: Any starch ?
translation.zh: 要上浆吗？

translation.en: No starch .
translation.zh: 不用。

translation.en: Am I ever hungry ? When will supper be ready ?
translation.zh: 我饿过吗？晚饭什么时候准备好？

translation.en: It's almost ready . Can you set the table ?
translation.zh: 差不多准备好了。你能摆好桌子吗？

translation.en: Want to taste this dish ?
translation.zh: 想尝尝这道菜吗？

translation.en: Yeah . Oh , it's delicious !
translation.zh: 是的。哦，真好吃！

translation.en: Definitely . It's a wonderful meal . Thank you , Honey .
translation.zh: 绝对地。这是一顿美餐。谢谢你，亲爱的。

translation.en: If you like to help me do the dishes , I'll be more dreadful .
translation.zh: 如果你愿意帮我洗碗，我会很感激的。

translation.en: I wish I could , but I won't .
translation.zh: 我希望我可以，但我不会帮你洗。

translation.en: My lease ends next month , so I have to find a new place .
translation.zh: 我的租约下个月就要到期了，所以我得找个新住处。

translation.en: I feel sorry for you . It's a jungle out there .
translation.zh: 我为你感到难过。外面是一片丛林。

translation.en: Do you know any places ?
translation.zh: 你知道有什么地方（在出租）吗？

translation.en: Well . I guess I can ask around to see if anyone's got a room or apartment available .
translation.zh: 嗯。我想我可以问问周围是否有人有空房间或公寓。

translation.en: Thank you . I think I should also have a look at the Internet to see if anyone's got a sublet .
translation.zh: 谢谢你。我想我也应该上网看看是否有人转租

translation.en: How much do are you looking to spend ?
translation.zh: 你打算花多少钱（租房）？

translation.en: I can only afford about 1,000 yuan a month .
translation.zh: 我一个月只能负担1000元左右。

translation.en: Looks like you'll have to get a place in the suburbs .
translation.zh: 看来你得在郊区找个地方住了。

translation.en: It doesn't matter , but it needs to be close to the subway or on a convenient bus route .
translation.zh: 不要紧，但它需要靠近地铁或在一条方便的公交线路上

translation.en: Anything you need to have in the place ?
translation.zh: （关于住处）你有什么要求吗？

translation.en: I want a bedroom with full bath , and it'll be better if the bedroom is on the sunny side .
translation.zh: 我想要一间带浴室的卧室，如果卧室向阳就更好了。

translation.en: You can also check out university bulletin boards .
translation.zh: 你也可以查看大学的公告栏。

translation.en: Why ? Will those be students who are leaving ?
translation.zh: 为什么？那些是要离开的学生转租的吗？

translation.en: Not really , but landlords put up notices to attract students and they often have low rent .
translation.zh: 其实不是，但房东们会张贴告示来吸引学生，而且他们的租金通常很低。

translation.en: Thank you . I'll be sure to take a look .
translation.zh: 非常感谢。我一定去看看。

translation.en: $ 19 a day or $ 129 a week , unlimited mileage .
translation.zh: 每天19美元或每周129美元，不限里程。

translation.en: Could I see your driver's license ?
translation.zh: 我能看看你的驾照吗？

translation.en: Sure here it is .
translation.zh: 当然，在这里。

translation.en: Hello ? This is John Smith.Can I speak to Mr.White , please ?
translation.zh: 你好，我是约翰·史密斯。请问怀特先生在吗？

translation.en: This is Mr.White speaking .
translation.zh: 我就是。

translation.en: Hi . I understand that you have a house for sale , haven ’ t you ?
translation.zh: 你好。我知道你有房子要出售，是吗？

translation.en: I ’ d like to know more about it .
translation.zh: 我想了解更多相关信息。

translation.en: Can you come to my office this afternoon at 3 o ’ clock ?
translation.zh: 你今天下午三点能来我办公室吗？

translation.en: OK . I will be there .
translation.zh: 好的。我到时候会去的。

translation.en: Thank you for calling.Goodbye .
translation.zh: 谢谢你打电话来，再见。

translation.en: Excuse me , could you tell me where Peking University is on this map ?
translation.zh: 劳驾，你能告诉我北京大学在这张地图上的位置吗？

translation.en: Let me see . Here it is .
translation.zh: 我想一下。在这里。

translation.en: Could you tell me how to get there ?
translation.zh: 你能告诉我怎么去那里吗？

translation.en: I ’ m afraid I can ’ t because I ’ m a stranger here .
translation.zh: 恐怕不行，因为我对这里不熟悉。

translation.en: Oh , thanks all the same .
translation.zh: 哦，还是谢谢你。

translation.en: Not at all . You can ask the policeman over there .
translation.zh: 不客气。你可以问问那边的警察。

translation.en: Emergency road service . May I help you ?
translation.zh: 紧急道路服务。需要帮忙吗？

translation.en: I have a flat tyre .
translation.zh: 我的轮胎瘪了。

translation.en: All right . What's your membership card , please ?
translation.zh: 好吧。请问您的会员卡号是多少？

translation.en: And your name ?
translation.zh: 你叫什么名字？

translation.en: Eve .
translation.zh: 伊夫。

translation.en: What's the expiration date on your card ?
translation.zh: 你的会员卡的有效期是多久？

translation.en: It's July 16,2009 .
Where is your car now ?
translation.zh: 你的车现在在哪里？

translation.en: It's on the west street , near Royal Hotel .
translation.zh: 在西街，靠近皇家饭店。

translation.en: And which direction were you going ?
translation.zh: 你要往哪个方向走？

translation.en: I was going west .
translation.zh: 我要往西走。

translation.en: What is the make and model of your car ?
translation.zh: 你的汽车是什么牌子和型号的？

translation.en: BMW 530 .
It's red .
translation.zh: 它是红色的。

translation.en: What's your licence plate number ?
translation.zh: 你的车牌号是多少？

translation.en: SAY 201 .
All right , Madam . I'll have a tow truck there within 30 minutes .
translation.zh: 好的，夫人。我会在30分钟内派一辆拖车过去。

translation.en: Waitress .
translation.zh: 服务员。

translation.en: Yes sir . How can I help you ?
translation.zh: 你好，先生。我能帮你什么？

translation.en: Please clean up the table .
translation.zh: 请把桌子收拾干净。

translation.en: OK . And anything else I can do for you ?
translation.zh: 好的，还有什么我能帮你的吗？

translation.en: I like a refill please .
translation.zh: 我需要续杯。

translation.en: So what do you think of my new dress ?
translation.zh: 你觉得我的新裙子怎么样？

translation.en: I think it ’ s great ! I really like the color , and it goes really well with your eyes . I ’ Ve actually been eyeing that dress at Maxine ’ s for a while now , but I wasn ’ t sure I could afford ninety-five dollars for a dress at the moment .
translation.zh: 我觉得太棒了！我真的很喜欢这个颜色，而且很配你的眼睛。事实上，我已经在马克辛家关注这条裙子有一段时间了，但我那时还不知道自己花九十五美元就能买到这条裙子。

translation.en: Um , ninety-five dollars ?
translation.zh: 呃，95美元？

translation.en: Yes , that ’ s the price they were advertising it at . I was hoping it might go on sale soon . Why , how much did you pay for it ?
translation.zh: 是的，这就是他们的官方价格。我之前希望它能很快上市。为什么，你付了多少钱？

translation.en: I bought it for one hundred and forty-five dollars at Helen ’ s Boutique . I didn ’ t know I could get it cheaper somewhere else .
translation.zh: 我在海伦的精品店花了145美元买的。我不知道我能在别的地方买到更便宜的。

translation.en: Of course ! Everything at Helen ’ s is overpriced , and they sell things that you can find at almost every other clothing store ! Why didn ’ t you shop around ?
translation.zh: 当然！海伦家的每样东西都定价过高了，他们卖的东西你几乎在其他所有的服装店都能找到！你为什么不货比三家？

translation.en: I don ’ t know , I just saw the dress and thought about how pretty it looks and how much I wanted it . I guess I was too impulsive .
translation.zh: 我不知道，我只是看到了那件衣服，想了想它看起来有多漂亮，我有多想要它。我想我太冲动了。

translation.en: An idea about killing time on a train ?
translation.zh: 有在火车上消磨时间的（好）主意吗？

translation.en: I advise you to read Playboy.You can get a lot from it .
translation.zh: 我建议你读《花花公子》，你可以从中了解到很多（东西）。

translation.en: But there's quite a lot of rumors about it .
translation.zh: 但是有很多关于它的谣言。

translation.en: That's why it's interesting .
translation.zh: 所以才有趣啊。

translation.en: I'd like to buy some souvenirs .
translation.zh: 我想买些纪念品。

translation.en: What do you think of the pamphlets with beautiful pictures ?
translation.zh: 你觉得有漂亮图片的小册子怎么样？

translation.en: That's nothing new .
translation.zh: 这并不稀奇。

translation.en: I'll buy an electric map of the city .
translation.zh: 那我买一张城市电子地图。

translation.en: Which restaurant do you prefer ?
translation.zh: 你喜欢哪家餐馆？

translation.en: I'd like to taste Mexican food .
translation.zh: 我想尝尝墨西哥菜。

translation.en: How about the one on Baker Street ?
translation.zh: 贝克街的那个怎么样？

translation.en: Oh , I've never seen a better Mexican restaurant .
translation.zh: 哦，我从没去过比这更好的墨西哥餐馆。

translation.en: Excuse me.Could you tell me how to return to the Hilton Hotel ? I am afraid I lost my way .
translation.zh: 打扰一下，你能告诉我怎么回希尔顿饭店吗？恐怕我迷路了。

translation.en: Do you have a hotel card or something ?
translation.zh: 你有酒店卡吗？

translation.en: Let's see.Yes , I have the address and telephone number here .
translation.zh: 我看看。是的，我这里有地址和电话号码。

translation.en: Oh , you're staying at the downtown Hilton.Then , you go down two blocks this way and turn left.You ' ll find it on the right .
translation.zh: 哦，你住在希尔顿市中心。然后，沿着这条路走两个街区然后左转。你会发现它在右边。

translation.en: Well , I don't understand it very well.Will you draw me a map ?
translation.zh: 嗯，我不太明白。你能给我画张地图吗？

translation.en: Oh , I ’ m staving . I ’ d like to try some real Chinese cuisine . What would you recommend waiter ?
translation.zh: 哦，我快饿死了。我想尝尝真正的中国菜。服务生，你有什么推荐吗？

translation.en: Well , depends . You see , there are eight famous Chinese food cuisines , for instance , sichuan cuisine and HUNAN cuisine .
translation.zh: 好吧，要看情况。您知道吧，中国有八大菜系，比如川菜和湘菜。

translation.en: There're all spicy or hot of heard .
translation.zh: 我听说这两种都很辣。

translation.en: That ’ s right . If you have hot dishes , you can try some .
translation.zh: 没错。如果您爱吃辣的，可以试试。

translation.en: It might be too hot for me .
translation.zh: 对我来说可能太辣了。

translation.en: And there are Cantonese cuisine and Kiangsu cuisine .. Most people like them .
translation.zh: 还有粤菜和江苏菜……大多数人都挺喜欢的。

translation.en: What about any special Beijing dishes ?
translation.zh: 有什么北京特色菜吗？

translation.en: There ’ re Beijing roast duck .
translation.zh: 有北京烤鸭。

translation.en: OH , yes . I heard of a lot of about it . I like very much to try it . Where can I find it ?
translation.zh: 哦，是的。我听说过很多次了。我很想尝尝。我在哪里能找到北京烤鸭呢？

translation.en: You can find it in most restaurant . The best place certainly is Quanjude restaurant .
translation.zh: 您在大多数餐馆都能找到。最好的地方当然是全聚德餐厅。

translation.en: Is it near here ?
translation.zh: 离这儿近吗？

translation.en: Not too near but not too far either . A taxi will take you there in fifteen minutes . the traffic is not too bad , I mean .
translation.zh: 不太近，也不太远。乘出租车15分钟就能到。我是说，要是不堵车的话。

translation.en: Well , thank you for your information . What ’ s the name of that restaurant again ?
translation.zh: 好吧，谢谢你的指点。那家餐馆叫什么名字来着？

translation.en: Let me write it down on a piece of paper for you . You can show to the taxi driver .
translation.zh: 我给您写在一张纸上。您可以给出租车司机看。

translation.en: That ’ s very kind of you . Thanks a lot .
translation.zh: 你真是太好了。谢谢。

translation.en: Oh , damn . There ’ s another traffic jam on the highway .
translation.zh: 哦，真糟糕。高速公路上又堵车了。

translation.en: How can there be a traffic jam on a 16 - lane highway every day ?
translation.zh: 16车道的主干道上怎么可能天天堵车？

translation.en: There are just too many people , and too many cars .
translation.zh: 人太多了，车也太多了。

translation.en: I wonder if there was an accident .
translation.zh: 我想知道是不是出了事故。

translation.en: No , they just said it too many people were trying to get off at the Capitol exits .
translation.zh: 不，他们只是说太多人想在国会大厦出口下车。

translation.en: Well , let ’ s put on some music . We ’ re going to be stuck in this for a while .
translation.zh: 好吧，我们放点音乐吧。可能要困在这里一会儿。

translation.en: All right , what do you want to listen to ?
translation.zh: 好吧，你想听什么？

translation.en: How about some Beatles ?
translation.zh: 披头士乐队怎么样？

translation.en: Yeah , all right .
translation.zh: 好的，挺好。

translation.en: Hi , John .
translation.zh: 嗨，约翰。

translation.en: Oh , hi , Mary , come on in . Any problem ?
translation.zh: 哦，嗨，玛丽，进来吧。有什么问题吗？

translation.en: Great . I forgot to ask you , though . How long did you want the place ?
translation.zh: 很好。还有忘了问你，你想租多久？

translation.en: Oh , well , that might be a problem . I usually only sign one year leases .
translation.zh: 哦，那可能是个问题。我通常只签一年的租约。

translation.en: Well , one year would be fine , too . I ’ m not planning on leaving the area anytime soon .
translation.zh: 嗯，一年也可以。我不打算马上离开这个地区。

translation.en: Well , if it ’ s not a problem . Then here you go .
translation.zh: 如果没有问题的话。你就在这儿签字吧。

translation.en: Just let me look at it quickly .
translation.zh: 让我再看看。

translation.en: Looks like a standard lease .
translation.zh: 看起来像是标准租约。

translation.en: Yeah , and don ’ t worry about the security deposit . If everything ’ s all right when you move out , you ’ ll get it back .
translation.zh: 是的，不用担心押金。如果你搬出去时屋内一切都好的话，我会退还你的。

translation.en: O . K . Great . Just sign and date it here ?
translation.zh: 好，很好。在这儿写姓名和日期吗？

translation.en: Yes . Thanks . You can move your stuff in tomorrow .
translation.zh: 对。谢谢。你明天就可以把东西搬进来。

translation.en: Dear , time is up , let ’ s go there now .
translation.zh: 亲爱的，时间到了，我们现在就去吧。

translation.en: Just a minute . I ’ m putting on my clothes .
translation.zh: 等一下。我正在穿衣服。

translation.en: Have you taken the key to the door ?
translation.zh: 你拿房门钥匙了吗？

translation.en: Yes . Oh , dear , I can ’ t find my hairbrushes . Can you help me ?
translation.zh: 拿了。天哪，我找不到我的梳子了。你能帮我一下吗？

translation.en: Where have you put it ?
translation.zh: 你把它放哪儿了？

translation.en: I put it in the dressing room .
translation.zh: 我把它放在衣帽间里的。

translation.en: Then , have you looked downstairs ?
translation.zh: 那你在楼下找过了吗？

translation.en: Yes , I ’ Ve looked everywhere downstairs .
translation.zh: 找过，楼下到处都找过了。

translation.en: Look , dear . It ’ s over there .
translation.zh: 亲爱的，在那儿呢。

translation.en: On the floor .
translation.zh: 地板上。

translation.en: Hello . I sent out my laundry yesterday.Aren ' t they ready ?
translation.zh: 你好。我昨天把要洗的衣服寄过来了。还没洗好吗？

translation.en: They'll be ready by this afternoon .
translation.zh: 今天下午就可以了。

translation.en: Oh , no ! I'm leaving for Japan at 11 this morning .
translation.zh: 哦，不！我今天上午11点就要动身去日本。

translation.en: Is that right ? We're very sorry .
translation.zh: 这样吗？太抱歉了。

translation.en: I thought it was " the same day " service.Anyway , please do hurry .
translation.zh: 我以为是“24小时”服务。不管怎样，请快点。

translation.en: I'm afraid we can't return it by 11 o'clock .
translation.zh: 恐怕我们不能在11点前归还。

translation.en: Well , then , would you send it to Japan , please ?
translation.zh: 那么，请把它寄到日本好吗？

translation.en: Yes , we'll do so .
translation.zh: 好的，我们会的。

translation.en: Is this the central park to East Market bus ?
translation.zh: 这是中央公园到东市场的巴士吗？

translation.en: This is the East market to Central park bus . Where do you want to go ?
translation.zh: 这是从东市场去中央公园的巴士。你想去哪里？

translation.en: To the ministry government hall .
translation.zh: 去部政府大厅。

translation.en: Take the same number bus going other direction . There ’ s stop right cross the street .
translation.zh: 乘反向的同一路公交。街对面就有一个车站。

translation.en: I ’ m going to Bihai park . Is this the right bus please ?
translation.zh: 我要去碧海公园。请问是这辆车吗？

translation.en: No . you ’ re going the wrong way . You wanna 103 from the Beijing zoo .
translation.zh: 不。你上错车了。你应该上开往北京动物园的103路车。

translation.en: how can I get it , please ?
translation.zh: 请问我怎样才能坐到那辆车？

translation.en: You get off at the next stop , cross the street and you will find the stop not far on the right hand side .
translation.zh: 你在下一站下车，过马路，你会发现车站就在右手边不远处。

translation.en: could I have a transfer , please ?
translation.zh: 我可以换点钱吗？

translation.en: Excuse me . I've been waiting for my main dish for quite a time .
translation.zh: 打扰一下。我等主菜等了好长时间了。

translation.en: Yes , sir.Just a minute , please , I'll check with the kitchen .
translation.zh: 好的，先生。请稍等，我去厨房看看。

translation.en: Thank you for waiting.It takes another ten to fifteen minutes , I'm afraid .
translation.zh: 谢谢您的等候。恐怕还要十到十五分钟。

translation.en: We have an appointment in half an hour .
translation.zh: 我们半小时后有个约会。

translation.en: Well , yes.How about beef stew ? We can serve you at once .
translation.zh: 嗯，有。炖牛肉怎么样？我们可以马上为您上菜。

translation.en: I'll take beef stew , then .
translation.zh: 那我要炖牛肉。

translation.en: Excuse me ! What time is it ? My watch stopped .
translation.zh: 打扰一下！请问现在几点了？我的表停了。

translation.en: Let me see . It's 9
translation.zh: 我看一下。九点了。

translation.en: I think so . I set it by the radio this morning .
translation.zh: 我认为是对的。我今天早上用收音机调的。

translation.en: By the way , can you tell me what the date it is today , and what day it is , please ?
translation.zh: 顺便问一下，你能告诉我今天几号、星期几吗？

translation.en: Well , it's the 10th and on the Tuesday .
translation.zh: 今天是10号，星期二。

translation.en: Good morning.This is Mary.Can I speak to Anne please ?
translation.zh: 早上好。我是玛丽。我能和安妮讲话吗？

translation.en: I ’ m sorry She isn ’ t in at the momment.She will come back at half past nineCan I take a message for her ?
translation.zh: 对不起，她不在家。她九点半回来。我能帮她捎个口信吗？

translation.en: Thank you.But I will call her later
translation.zh: 谢谢。但我稍后会打电话给她

translation.en: What sort of shopping is nearby , Mr . Taylor ?
translation.zh: 泰勒先生，请问附近有什么样的商店？

translation.en: Call me John . This is a great area of the city for shopping . There ’ s a grocery store just around the corner .
translation.zh: 叫我约翰就好。这一片是市里购物的好地方。拐角处就有一家杂货店。

translation.en: What about things other than food ?
translation.zh: 有卖除了食物以外的东西呢？

translation.en: Well , the Riverside Mall has 200 stores in it , including four major department stores .
translation.zh: 嗯，河滨购物中心里有200家商店，包括四家主要的百货公司。

translation.en: Are there small shops near here as well ?
translation.zh: 这附近也有小商店吗？

translation.en: Yes , on 4th street , near the movie theater there are many specialty shops , including clothing boutiques .
translation.zh: 是的，在第四大街，电影院附近有许多专卖店，包括服装店。

translation.en: Well , that sounds just wonderful .
translation.zh: 好的，听起来太棒了。

translation.en: Yes , it ’ s a really nice neighborhood .
translation.zh: 是的，这是一个非常好的社区。

translation.en: The city square , please .
translation.zh: 请到城市广场。

translation.en: Yes , I have to be there to meet a friend at 5 thirty pm . So we're sure we can get there on time ?
translation.zh: 是的，我下午5点半要去见一个朋友。所以我们能准时到达那里吗？

translation.en: I'm afraid not , sir . Generally we can , but you know how it is in the rush hour now .
translation.zh: 恐怕不行，先生。一般来说我们可以，但你知道现在的交通高峰期是怎样的。

translation.en: I see . Here's the extra 5 $ for you if you can get me there on time .
translation.zh: 我懂了。如果你能按时把我送到那里，我会付你额外的5美元。

translation.en: All right . I'll do my best .
translation.zh: 好吧。我会尽力的。

translation.en: Oh.we made it . Thank you . How much do I own you ?
translation.zh: 哦，我们成功了。非常感谢。我应该付你多少钱？

translation.en: The reading on the kilometer is 12 $ .
translation.zh: 全程12美元。

translation.en: Here's the money , keep the changes , please .
translation.zh: 这是钱，请不要找零钱。

translation.en: Do you need a receipt ?
translation.zh: 你需要收据吗？

translation.en: Yes , emergency . There is a huge fire here .
translation.zh: 你好，紧急情况。这里有一场大火。

translation.en: Calm down , sir . What's your name and where are you now ?
translation.zh: 冷静点，先生。你叫什么名字？你现在在哪里？

translation.en: My name is Jerry and we are on the intersection of West Road and East Road .
translation.zh: 我叫杰瑞，我们在西路和东路的交叉口。

translation.en: Sir , leave the house if the fire draws any closer to your house . Our men will be over in 5 minutes .
translation.zh: 先生，如果火势再靠近你的房子，请离开这所房子。我们的救援人员5分钟后就到。

translation.en: Excuse me , sir . You can't park here .
translation.zh: 不好意思，先生。您不能在这里停车。

translation.en: I am just waiting for my friends . It won't be long .
translation.zh: 我只是在等我的朋友。不会太久的。

translation.en: Sir , the curb here is not for parking .
translation.zh: 先生，这里路边不是用来停车的。

translation.en: But I didn't see the sign , Ma ’ am .
translation.zh: 但我没看到任何标志啊小姐。

translation.en: There is a sign at the corner of the street . When you turned in here , you should have seen it .
translation.zh: 在街道的拐角处有一个标志。您开车转进来的时候应该看见它了。

translation.en: I didn't see it .
translation.zh: 我没看见。

translation.en: I am sorry , sir . I have to give you a ticket . You can appeal to the court within 14 days . You will avoid paying the fine if you can prove that you are not at fault .
translation.zh: 对不起，先生。我得给您一张罚单。14天之内您可以向法院上诉。如果您能证明您没有过错，就不用交罚款。

translation.en: my mp3 player is broken , so I want to change it for an mp4 player . Can you offer any advice about which brand and model to buy ?
translation.zh: 我的mp3播放器坏了，所以我想把它换成mp4播放器。你能就购买哪个品牌和型号给我提点建议吗？

translation.en: an mp4 player ? why don't you buy a new cell phone ? You can find an mp4 player inside any of the latest cell phones .
translation.zh: mp4播放器？你为什么不买部新手机呢？你可以在任何最新的手机里找到mp4播放器。

translation.en: look at my cell phone . I can listen to music , watch movies , take pictures , play games , surf the web and download documents . It's just like a PAD .
translation.zh: 看看我的手机。我可以听音乐，看电影，拍照，玩游戏，上网和下载文件。就像个平板电脑。

translation.en: that's cool . I can use the computer and the internet pretty well , but I'm a little bit slow in the latest trends of digital products .
translation.zh: 太酷了。我可以很好地使用电脑和互联网，但我对数码产品的最新趋势有点迟钝。

translation.en: that's Ok . you know , digital devices are becoming smaller and easier to carry , and they won't cost you too much .
translation.zh: 没关系。你知道，数字设备正变得越来越小，越来越容易携带，而且它们不会花你太多钱。

translation.en: yeah , if I buy a cell phone like this , I don't have to take a music player everywhere I go , and I can save the cost of buying an extra mp4 .
translation.zh: 是的，如果我买这样的手机，我不必带着mp4播放器到处走，我可以额外省下买mp4的钱。

translation.en: that's right . what's the flash memory of your old mp3 ?
translation.zh: 没错。你旧mp3的闪存是多少？

translation.en: then any cell phone can meet your need because they generally have memories of over 512MB .
translation.zh: 那么任何手机都可以满足你的需要，因为它们的内存一般都超过512MB。

translation.en: Hi , Sam . I want to buy a pet . Do you have any ideas ?
translation.zh: 嗨，山姆。我想买一只宠物。你有什么想法吗

translation.en: You really should go to Rachel's pet store .
translation.zh: 你应该去瑞秋的宠物店

translation.en: why ? anything special there ?
translation.zh: 为什么？有什么特别的吗？

translation.en: it's more than special . You can find as many kinds of animals as you can put a name to and more .
translation.zh: 它不仅仅是特别。你可以找到尽可能多的动物种类，只要你能给它们取个名字，甚至更多。

translation.en: Oh , really ? are there any snakes ?
translation.zh: 哦，真的吗？有蛇吗

translation.en: snakes ? there are even rodents and monkeys ! it's a world of exotic pets .
translation.zh: 蛇？甚至还有啮齿动物和猴子！这是一个充满异国情调宠物的世界。

translation.en: that's terrific . I can't wait to check it out .
translation.zh: 太棒了。我等不及要去看看了。

translation.en: Hang on . are you sure you want to keep a non-traditional pet ?
translation.zh: 等等。你确定要养一只非传统的宠物吗？

translation.en: why not ? it's so cool .
translation.zh: 为什么不？太酷了。

translation.en: but it will pose a risk to your health .
translation.zh: 但这会给你的健康带来危险。

translation.en: pardon ?
translation.zh: 啥意思？

translation.en: i mean , most reptiles carry some harmful bacteria . they are likely to cause immune system problems .
translation.zh: 我的意思是，大多数爬行动物携带一些有害细菌。它们很可能引起免疫系统问题。

translation.en: well , I didn't realize that .
translation.zh: 噢，我没意识到。

translation.en: I don't believe it's a good choice to keep those pets , especially for families with young children .
translation.zh: 我不认为养这些宠物是个好选择，尤其是对于有小孩的家庭。

translation.en: oh , I should have thought of my brother's baby girl . Maybe I'll just have a dog instead of an exotic pet .
translation.zh: 哦，我应该想到我弟弟的小女儿。也许我会养一只狗而不是一只奇异的宠物。

translation.en: yes , good luck , Maria .
translation.zh: 是的，祝你好运，玛丽亚。

translation.en: Hi , good morning , Miss ? what can I help you with ?
translation.zh: 嗨，早上好，女士？我能帮到你什么吗？

translation.en: Good morning I'd like to mail this box of books to Taiwan .
translation.zh: 早上好我想把这一箱书邮寄到台湾。

translation.en: OK , please put it on this scale.Airmail or by sea ?
translation.zh: 好的，请把他放在这个秤上。空运还是海运？

translation.en: How long does it take to reach Taiwan by sea ?
translation.zh: 从海上到台湾要多长时间？

translation.en: Usually about two month .
translation.zh: 通常两个月左右。

translation.en: That's too long.How long does it take to reach Taiwan by airmail ?
translation.zh: 太长了。空运到台湾要多长时间？

translation.en: About ten days .
translation.zh: 大约十天。

translation.en: Then how much is that by airmail ?
translation.zh: 那空运多少钱？

translation.en: Let me see.It ' s 57 dollars , 20 cents , including tax .
translation.zh: 让我看看。税后57美元20美分。

translation.en: That's a little bit expensive .
translation.zh: 那有点贵。

translation.en: Although it's expensive to send it by airmail , it's quicker and safer than by sea .
translation.zh: 虽然空运很贵，但比海运更快更安全。

translation.en: I guess I have to send it by airmail .
translation.zh: 我想我得航空邮寄。

translation.en: Do you want to ensure the contents , Miss ?
translation.zh: 小姐，您要确保里面所有的东西吗？

translation.en: Please fill out this form , also please write the value of the items in this space .
translation.zh: 请填好这张表格，同时请写下这个箱子里东西的价值。

translation.en: I know you are keen on photography . It ’ s very useful for you to be able to download photos from your digital camera . Then you attach the picture files to emails and send them to anyone , anywhere , at a
translation.zh: 我知道你很喜欢摄影。从数码相机倒入照片对你来说非常有用。然后你将图片文件附加到电子邮件中，并将它们发送给任何人，任何地方，任何时间。

translation.en: It ’ s wonderful , isn ’ t it ? Would you like to see some photos that I took recently ?
translation.zh: 太棒了，不是吗？你想看看我最近拍的照片吗？

translation.en: You're finally here ! What took so long ?
translation.zh: 你可算来了！怎么花了这么长时间？

translation.en: It's always rather congested down there during rush hour . Maybe you should try to find a different route to get home .
translation.zh: 在交通高峰期，那里总是很堵。也许你应该换条路回家。

translation.en: It would be better for the environment , too .
translation.zh: 对环境也有好处。

translation.en: Taking the subway would be a lot less stressful than driving as well .
translation.zh: 坐地铁比开车压力小得多。

translation.en: The only problem is that I'm going to really miss having the freedom that you have with a car .
translation.zh: 唯一的问题是，我真的会怀念拥有汽车的自由。

translation.en: Well , when it's nicer outside , you can start biking to work . That will give you just as much freedom as your car usually provides .
translation.zh: 好吧，当外面好一点的时候，你就可以骑自行车去上班了。这会给你和汽车一样多的自由。

translation.en: That's true . I could certainly use the exercise !
translation.zh: 确实。我还可以骑车锻炼身体！

translation.en: So , are you going to quit driving to work then ?
translation.zh: 那么，你打算不开车上班了吗？

translation.en: Yes , it's not good for me or for the environment .
translation.zh: 是的，这对我和环境都不好。

translation.en: Are you crazy ? You have no idea what you are talking about ! Just for my eyes I have to get eye-liner , an eyelash curler , eye shadow , an eyebrow pencil and mascara . Then I need to get foundation , liq
translation.zh: 你疯了吗？你不知道自己在说什么。仅化眼妆，我就得需要眼线（笔）, 睫毛夹，眼影和眉笔及睫毛膏。我还得买粉饼和粉底液。

translation.en: Thank god you are open ! I have an emergency !
translation.zh: 谢天谢地，你们还在营业。我有紧急的事。

translation.en: Hello , Mr . Henderson what can I do for you ?
translation.zh: 亨德森先生，你好，需要什么服务？

translation.en: I need this dress and this suit dry cleaned ASAP !
translation.zh: 我需要将这件裙子和这套衣服尽可能快地干洗好。

translation.en: OK , I can have it ready by the end of the week .
translation.zh: 好的，这周末衣服能洗好。

translation.en: No , you don ’ t understand , I need this tomorrow morning ! I accidentally spilled beer all over my wife ’ s dress and we have a wedding to attend tomorrow ! She ’ s gonna kill me !
translation.zh: 你没明白我的意思，我明早上就要。我不小心将啤酒撒到了我妻子的裙子上，我们明天要去参加一个婚礼。她会杀了我的。

translation.en: OK , I can have it ready tomorrow afternoon , but this suit is also very stained . I can ’ t guarantee we can remove it completely .
translation.zh: 好吧，明天下午衣服能洗好。但这套衣服有污渍，我不敢保证能彻底洗去。

translation.en: Fine ! Can you also iron and starch this shirt ?
translation.zh: 好的！你能浆洗并熨平这件衬衫吗？

translation.en: Great ! This is our secret ! If you see my wife , say nothing to her about this !
translation.zh: 太好了。这是我们之间的秘密。如果你看见我的妻子，千万不要告诉她。

translation.en: I don ’ t know about that.with all the uncertainty in the markets right now , it would be a very unwise decision to invest . I don ’ t know if you ’ re aware son , but there has been a lot of turmoil in the markets recently . There have already been half a million layoffs in the last few months , and we have no idea how the proposed stimulus package will impact the economy . There ’ s just too much instability . I wouldn ’ t feel comfortable investing in this climate .
translation.zh: 我不知道，现在市场充满了不确定性，投资是一个非常不明智的决定。我不知道你是否知道，儿子，但是最近市场上有很多混乱。过去几个月已经有50万人失业，我们不知道拟议的刺激计划将对经济产生怎样的影响。太不稳定了。在这种环境下投资我会感到不舒服。

translation.en: But look at it this way , every challenge is an opportunity.And anyway , I ’ m not talking about investing in the domestic market . There are emerging markets that promise great returns . Look at China , for example.they have 1.4 billion people , half a billion of whom have recently entered the middle class . Here alone , the aggregate demand for consumer goods represents an amazing wealth generating opportunity .
translation.zh: 但从这个角度看，每一个挑战都是一个机遇，不管怎样，我不是在说投资国内市场。有一些新兴市场有望获得巨大回报。以中国为例，中国有14亿人口，其中5亿人最近进入了中产阶级。仅在这里，消费品的总需求就代表了一个惊人的创造财富的机会。

translation.en: Mom , will you have time to help me with my homework today ?
translation.zh: 妈妈，你今天有时间帮我做作业吗？

translation.en: Sorry , I won't . I'll be working against the clock to finish my presentation .
translation.zh: 对不起，我不能。我要争分夺秒地完成我的报告。

translation.en: Can you give me a hand with the dishes ?
translation.zh: 你能帮我洗碗吗？

translation.en: Sure . Should I wash or dry ?
translation.zh: 当然。我是洗还是烘干？

translation.en: I wash and you'll dry .
translation.zh: 我来洗，你烘干。

translation.en: OK . Let's do it .
translation.zh: 好的，我们开始吧。

translation.en: Sir , would you like some dessert now ?
translation.zh: 先生，您现在想吃甜点吗？

translation.en: Please show me the menu again .
translation.zh: 请把菜单再给我看看。

translation.en: Here you are . sir , the chocolate cake is very delicious .
translation.zh: 给你。先生，巧克力蛋糕很好吃。

translation.en: No , thanks . I don't like chocolate . I'd like strawberry pie .
translation.zh: 不用了，谢谢。我不喜欢巧克力。我想要草莓派。

translation.en: I am afraid there is none .
translation.zh: 恐怕没有了。

translation.en: Then I'll have vanilla ice cream .
translation.zh: 那我要香草冰淇淋。

translation.en: Fine . I will bring it right away .
translation.zh: 好的。我马上给您送过来。

translation.en: Hey , buddy , can ’ t you see there ’ s a line ?
translation.zh: 嘿，伙计，你没看到有人排队吗？

translation.en: Oh , sorry . I didn ’ t know .
translation.zh: 哦，对不起。我不知道。

translation.en: What ? You haven ’ t taken the bus before ?
translation.zh: 什么？你以前没坐过公共汽车吗？

translation.en: Well , you have to wait in line like everyone else . Besides , you should let old people on first .
translation.zh: 你得像其他人一样排队。另外，你应该先让老人上车。

translation.en: It ’ s all right . Where are you going ?
translation.zh: 没关系。你要去哪里？

translation.en: I wanted to see the White House .
translation.zh: 我想看看白宫。

translation.en: Oh , well you don ’ t want this bus , anyway . It goes to Georgetown .
translation.zh: 哦，反正你也不是这辆车。这辆车是去乔治敦的。

translation.en: It ’ s all right , though . Just get off at the next stop and catch the 79A .
translation.zh: 不过，没关系。在下一站下车，乘79A。

translation.en: Oh , well thank you very much .
translation.zh: 哦，非常感谢。

translation.en: So how can I make it ?
translation.zh: 那我怎么做呢？

translation.en: First you make a list of what you wanna buy ...
translation.zh: 首先你列一张你想买的东西的清单。。。

translation.en: But I ’ Ve gotta have the budge before anything else .
translation.zh: 但我得先做些让步。

translation.en: Well , that ’ s a problem , isn ’ t it ?
translation.zh: 好吧，那是个问题，不是吗？

translation.en: While you ’ re cleaning the cooker , I ’ ll wipe the worktop . That was a great meat , by the way .
translation.zh: 你在打扫炉子的时候，我来擦台面。顺便说一句，肉很美味。

translation.en: We've been waiting here for nearly ten minutes now , and there still isn't a bus in sight .
translation.zh: 我们已经在这里等了将近十分钟了，仍然看不到公共汽车。

translation.en: I'm afraid we'll be late for the party .
translation.zh: 恐怕我们聚会要迟到了。

translation.en: Have you got the time , Tom ?
translation.zh: 汤姆，你有时间吗？

translation.en: Yes , my watch says a quarter to seven . but there is something wrong with my watch !
translation.zh: 是的，我的表是七点一刻。但是我的手表有点问题！

translation.en: But you bought it only last month .
translation.zh: 但你上个月才买的。

translation.en: Yes , but ever since I bought it , it gains about five minutes a day , so I ' Ve got to have it repaired .
translation.zh: 是的，但是自从我买了它以后，它一天大约长五分钟，所以我得请人修理一下。

translation.en: How long will it take us to get there ?
translation.zh: 我们到那里要多长时间？

translation.en: I think about ten minutes by bus .
translation.zh: 我想乘公共汽车大约十分钟。

translation.en: It's not far away , then . Let's walk , it's beginning to rain .
translation.zh: 那就不远了。我们走吧，天开始下雨了。

translation.en: Wait ! I think I see a bus coming now . Let's hope it's the No . 22 bus .
translation.zh: 等待！我想我看到一辆公共汽车来了。希望是23路公共汽车。

translation.en: Harry , come here immediately !
translation.zh: 哈利，马上过来！

translation.en: Don't take that tone with me ! I saw you hit your brother .
translation.zh: 别用那种口气跟我说话！我看见你打了你弟弟。

translation.en: No ! He hit me first .
translation.zh: 不是的！是他先打我。

translation.en: I don't care . You know better than to hit him . Go sit on your bed for 10 minutes .
translation.zh: 我不管。你不该打他。去你的床上静坐10分钟。

translation.en: have you moved into your new house yet , Michael ?
translation.zh: 迈克尔，你搬进新房子了吗？

translation.en: we just moved in yesterday , actually .
translation.zh: 嗯，我们昨天刚搬进来。

translation.en: so , what do you think about the place ? Are you glad that you moved in ?
translation.zh: 你觉得新房子怎么样？你搬进去高兴吗？

translation.en: it's great ! Unfortunately , we're going to spend a fortune doing everything up .
translation.zh: 太棒了！只是我们还需要花一大笔钱来整理。

translation.en: how old is the house then ?
translation.zh: 那房子有几年了？

translation.en: it's about 200 years old . It has a lot of history !
translation.zh: 大约有200年的历史了。它有很多故事！

translation.en: sounds fascinating . Where is your new house located ?
translation.zh: 听起来很有趣。你的新房子在哪里？

translation.en: it's just off of the ring road .
translation.zh: 就在环路的尽头。

translation.en: do you have a big yard ?
translation.zh: 你有一个大院子吗？

translation.en: it's bigger than our last one . I've got flowers in the front , and fruits , vegetables and a fish pond in the back .
translation.zh: 它比上一个大。我前面有花，后面种了水果、蔬菜，还有鱼塘。

translation.en: is your house well-lit ?
translation.zh: 你的房子光线好吗？

translation.en: oh , yes . Our windows let plenty of natural light in . They've also got wonderful views of the park behind our house .
translation.zh: 哦，是的。我们的窗户可以让充足的自然光照进来。通过窗户还可以看到我们房子后面公园的美景。

translation.en: how many rooms does your house have ?
translation.zh: 你家有多少房间？

translation.en: right now , there are three bedrooms , two barrooms , a kitchen , a sitting room , a dining room , and a living room . We're hoping to add on a green room and a guest bedroom . In fact , when the guest room i
translation.zh: 有三间卧室，两间酒吧间，一间厨房，一间客厅，一间餐厅和一间起居室。我们希望再增加一间休息室和一间客房。事实上，当我在客房……

translation.en: I ’ m thinking about buying this sweater . I know it ’ s June now , but it will be perfect for autumn and winter .
translation.zh: 我想买这件毛衣。我知道现在是六月，但是秋冬穿会很合适的。

translation.en: Yes , it ’ s half price . It ’ s supposed to be too large--that ’ s the fashion .
translation.zh: 是的，半价。就应该是大的，那才时尚。

translation.en: I might get one too , but in a different color . I prefer light blue to white 。
translation.zh: 我也应该买一件，但是要不同的颜色。比起白色我更喜欢浅蓝色。

translation.en: There.It looks great , don ’ t you think ? I ’ m going to get these jeans as well . I need a new pair . I ‘ m also going to buy this scarf ready for winter .
translation.zh: 就说吧。看起来不错，你觉得呢？我还要这条牛仔裤。我需要一条新的了。我还要买这条冬天用的围巾。

translation.en: I ’ m getting this beret ? Doesn ’ t it look cool ? I ’ d like to get some jeans too , but I don ’ t have enough cash on me .
translation.zh: 我要买这顶贝雷帽。看起来是不是很酷？我也想买几件牛仔裤，但是我身上带的现金不多了。

translation.en: Hi , can I speak with the apartment manager , please ?
translation.zh: 嗨，我能和公寓经理通话吗？

translation.en: Hello , this is the apartment manager speaking .
translation.zh: 喂，我是公寓经理。

translation.en: I'm calling about the apartment for rent on Main Street .
translation.zh: 我打电话来是想问一下主街的公寓出租的事。

translation.en: Would you be interested in seeing the apartment ?
translation.zh: 你有兴趣看看公寓吗？

translation.en: I would love to see it .
translation.zh: 我很想看看。

translation.en: Are you free today at around 6 p . m . ?
translation.zh: 你今天下午6点左右有空吗。M

translation.en: Yes , I will be able to make it then .
translation.zh: 是的，到时候我能来。

translation.en: Well , I'll see you at 6 p . m . Do you know how to get there ?
translation.zh: 好吧，下午6点见。M你知道怎么去那里吗？

translation.en: I used to live in that area .
translation.zh: 我以前住在那个地区。

translation.en: I'll give you an application form when I see you .
translation.zh: 我一见到你就给你一张申请表。

translation.en: That sounds good . Do I need to bring anything ?
translation.zh: 听起来不错。我需要带什么东西吗？

translation.en: No . Just bring yourself .
translation.zh: 不。带上你自己。

translation.en: What are your thoughts on the apartment ?
translation.zh: 你对公寓有什么看法？

translation.en: I think that it ’ s absolutely gorgeous .
translation.zh: 我认为这间公寓绝对是华丽的。

translation.en: There aren ’ t any problems with the apartment ?
translation.zh: 公寓没问题吧？

translation.en: I think that the apartment looks very nice , but I do see some problems .
translation.zh: 我认为这套公寓看起来很不错，但我确实看到了一些问题。

translation.en: What problems ?
translation.zh: 什么问题？

translation.en: I did notice a few stains in the carpet .
translation.zh: 我确实注意到地毯上有一些污渍。

translation.en: We will have the carpet cleaned before you move in .
translation.zh: 在你搬进来之前，我们会把地毯擦干净。

translation.en: You will ?
translation.zh: 你会？

translation.en: Yes , but other than that , are there any more problems ?
translation.zh: 是的，但除此之外，还有什么问题吗？

translation.en: That was the only thing that I saw that was wrong with the apartment .
translation.zh: 那是我唯一看到的公寓有问题的地方。

translation.en: I ’ m happy that you find this apartment so appealing .
translation.zh: 我很高兴你觉得这套公寓很吸引人。

translation.en: It is . I love it .
translation.zh: 它是。我喜欢。

translation.en: Do you like the apartment ?
translation.zh: 你喜欢这个公寓吗？

translation.en: I absolutely love the apartment .
translation.zh: 我非常喜欢这个公寓。

translation.en: Everything is okay ?
translation.zh: 一切都还好吗？

translation.en: I do have one problem with the apartment .
translation.zh: 其实我觉得公寓有一个问题。

translation.en: I don ’ t like all those stains in the carpet .
translation.zh: 我不喜欢地毯上的那些污渍。

translation.en: We will have the carpet cleaned before you move into the apartment .
translation.zh: 在你搬进公寓之前，我们会把地毯弄干净的。

translation.en: I assure you that we will , and if there are any more problems , feel free to tell me .
translation.zh: 我向你保证我们会的，如果还有什么问题，请随时告诉我。

translation.en: That was the only thing that I saw wrong with the apartment .
translation.zh: 这是我唯一认为公寓有问题的地方。

translation.en: I ’ m glad to know that you think the apartment is so nice .
translation.zh: 我很高兴知道你觉得这套公寓很好。

translation.en: It ’ s absolutely incredible . I ’ ll take it .
translation.zh: 简直是完美。我要了。

translation.en: Hello , I was wondering if I could talk with the apartment manager .
translation.zh: 你好，我想和公寓经理谈谈。

translation.en: I was wondering if the apartment on Main Street is still available .
translation.zh: 我想知道主街上的公寓是否还有空的。

translation.en: Yes , it's still vacant . Are you interested in seeing it ?
translation.zh: 是的，还有空的。你有兴趣来看看吗？

translation.en: Yes , I would love to see the apartment .
translation.zh: 是的，我想看看公寓。

translation.en: I will be at the apartment today at 6
translation.zh: 我打算今天6点到公寓

translation.en: Great . I'll see you at 6 . Do you know where it is ?
translation.zh: 真好。那我们6点见。你知道位置在哪里吗？

translation.en: Yes , I have a friend who lives in that neighborhood .
translation.zh: 是的，我有个朋友住在那附近。

translation.en: I'll be bringing an application form .
translation.zh: 我会带一张申请表。

translation.en: OK , should I bring anything with me ?
translation.zh: 好的，我应该带点什么吗？

translation.en: No . I might need to see your ID card , but that's about it .
translation.zh: 不用。我可能需要看看你的身份证，但仅此而已。

translation.en: Hey , Jim . It's time to wake up and get out of bed .
translation.zh: 嘿，吉姆。该起床起床了。

translation.en: You'd better get up , or you'll be late .
translation.zh: 你最好起床，否则你会迟到的。

translation.en: What're you talking about ? My alarm even hasn't gone off yet .
translation.zh: 你在说什么？我的闹钟还没响呢。

translation.en: Yes , it did . It went off thirty minutes ago . You slept right through it . You're like a dead person while you sleep .
translation.zh: 是的，是的。三十分钟前就响了。你睡得很熟。你睡觉的时候就像死人一样。

translation.en: I know , I know . But I don't want any worms .
translation.zh: 我知道，我知道。但我不想要虫子。

translation.en: Ha ! Ha ! If you don't make an effort now , later on it'll be a lot tougher for you .
translation.zh: 哈！哈！如果你现在不努力，以后对你来说会困难得多。

translation.en: I want to rent this apartment .
translation.zh: 我想租这间公寓。

translation.en: You will have to pay $ 1050 every month .
translation.zh: 你每个月得付1050美元。

translation.en: What can you afford ?
translation.zh: 多少钱你能负担得起？

translation.en: I was thinking $ 800 a month .
translation.zh: 我想一个月800美元。

translation.en: I ’ ll need you to pay more than that .
translation.zh: 我需要你付更多的钱。

translation.en: How much more ?
translation.zh: 还想要多少？

translation.en: How does $ 900 every month sound to you ?
translation.zh: 你觉得每月900美元怎么样？

translation.en: I can live with that .
translation.zh: 我可以接受。

translation.en: We have a deal then .
translation.zh: 我们说好了。

translation.en: Can I take your order now , Madam ?
translation.zh: 夫人，现在可以点菜了吗？

translation.en: Yes , what would you recommend ?
translation.zh: 是的，你有什么建议吗？

translation.en: I'm happy to recommend the fish , It testes delicious , and it is today's special . Our chef is from the coast , and love seafood . Today special is actually his favorite dish . so I'm sure it is a
translation.zh: 我很乐意推荐这道鱼，它很好吃，而且是今天的特色菜。我们的厨师来自海边，喜欢海鲜。今天的特色菜其实是他最喜欢的菜。所以我肯定这是一个（不错的选择）。

translation.en: It does sound wonderful , maybe I'll try it .
translation.zh: 听起来不错，也许我可以尝尝。

translation.en: Is there anything else ? Maybe I can interest you in one of fine appetizers , such as the escargot .
translation.zh: 还有别的需要吗？或许我可以给您上点开胃菜，像是食用蜗牛。

translation.en: Not today , thanks . But I'd like to know any of the vegetarian dishes .
translation.zh: 今天先不要了，谢谢。有什么素菜吗?

translation.en: Yes , here's the menu . What would you think of your order .
translation.zh: 有，这是菜单。您想点什么。

translation.en: Maybe I don't want the fish , I think I had the greenbean dish instead .
translation.zh: 我不想要鱼了，我想要毛豆。

translation.en: I'd like the egg drop soup .
translation.zh: 我想要鸡蛋汤。

translation.en: Ok , is that all ?
translation.zh: 好的，就这些吗？

translation.en: what would you like anything to drink or you wait ?
translation.zh: 你想要点儿喝的，还是先等等？

translation.en: Just nice water , thanks .
translation.zh: 一杯水就好，谢谢。

translation.en: I'd like the double cheese burger meal , please .
translation.zh: 我想要双芝士汉堡餐。

translation.en: What kind of drink would you like with that ?
translation.zh: 你想要什么样的饮料？

translation.en: Just coke will be fine .
translation.zh: 只要可乐就行了。

translation.en: Would you like a super size meal ? Only 2 RIB more , you'll get large coke and fries instead of medium . And today we are offering free toys all the meal boxes .
translation.zh: 你想吃大餐吗？只要再加2RIB，你就可以得到大份的而不是中等份的可乐和薯条。今天我们在所有餐盒里都提供免费玩具。

translation.en: That sounds good , thanks , I'd like that . Actually I'd like sprite instead of coke , thanks .
translation.zh: 听起来不错，谢谢，我喜欢。实际上我想要雪碧而不是可乐，谢谢。

translation.en: That's not a problem , Miss . Will that be it ?
translation.zh: 那不是问题，小姐。就这样吗？

translation.en: That will be 25RMB , please
translation.zh: 请付25元

translation.en: I ’ m a new student . My name ’ s Robert .
translation.zh: 我是一个新学生。我叫罗伯特。

translation.en: Nice to meet you . My name ’ s Sophie .
translation.zh: 很高兴认识你。我叫索菲。

translation.en: Are you French ?
translation.zh: 你是法国人吗？

translation.en: Yes , I ’ m . Are you French , too ?
translation.zh: 是的，我是。你也是法国人吗？

translation.en: No , I ’ m not .
translation.zh: 不，我不是。

translation.en: What nationality are you ?
translation.zh: 你是什么国籍？

translation.en: I ’ m Italian . Are you a teacher ?
translation.zh: 我是意大利人。你是老师吗？

translation.en: What ’ s your job ?
translation.zh: 你的工作是什么？

translation.en: I ’ m a keyboard operator . What ’ s your job ?
translation.zh: 我是个电脑键盘操作员。你的工作是什么？

translation.en: I ’ m an engineer .
translation.zh: 我是个工程师。

translation.en: Give me a book please , Jane .
translation.zh: 简，请给我一本书。

translation.en: Which book ? This one ?
translation.zh: 哪本书？这本吗？

translation.en: No , not that one . The red one .
translation.zh: 不，不是那本。是红色的那本。

translation.en: Would you like some cookies ? I just made them .
translation.zh: 你想要些饼干吗？我刚做的。

translation.en: Thank you . Yes , I would .
translation.zh: 非常感谢。是的，我要一些。

translation.en: These are chocolate , and those are almond-flavored .
translation.zh: 这些是巧克力味的，那些是杏仁味的。

translation.en: I guess I'll try a chocolate one first.Mmmm ... this is delicious.Are they hard to make ?
translation.zh: 我想先尝尝巧克力味的。嗯……这很好吃。难做吗？

translation.en: No , they're really quite easy . Wait a minute , I've got the recipe right here.See ... these are the ingredients , and then you just follow the directions .
translation.zh: 不，它们真的很简单。稍等，我这里有菜谱。看……这些是配料，然后你只要按照说明做就行了。

translation.en: That does look easy . I think I'll make some tonight .
translation.zh: 看起来很简单。我想我今晚可以做一些。

translation.en: What kind of a car do you have ?
translation.zh: 你有一辆什么样的车？

translation.en: An old one .
translation.zh: 一辆旧车。

translation.en: I know it's old , but what make is it ?
translation.zh: 我知道它很旧，但它是什么牌子的？

translation.en: It's a Chevrolet . Why do you ask ? You going into the car business ?
translation.zh: 是雪佛兰。你为什么问这些？你要做汽车生意吗？

translation.en: Nothing like that . My cousin is going to take a job overseas and he can't take his car with him , so he's going to sell it - cheap . It's practically new .
translation.zh: 不是那样的。我表哥要去国外工作，他不能带车，所以他打算低价出售。车几乎是新的。

translation.en: well I have been thinking about getting a newer car . I can't afford a brand new one .
translation.zh: 我一直在考虑买一辆新车。但我买不起全新的。

translation.en: Would you like to look at my cousin's car ?
translation.zh: 你想看看我表妹的车吗？

translation.en: Is it a four-door or a two-door ?
translation.zh: 是四门的还是两门的？

translation.en: It's a coupe with a vinyl roof .
translation.zh: 这是一辆有乙烯基车顶的轿跑车。

translation.en: Does it have automatic transmission ? .
