translation.zh: 它有自动变速器吗。

translation.en: Yes , and it also has power steering , power brakes , and air conditioning .
translation.zh: 是的，它还有动力转向、动力刹车和空调。

translation.en: I guess I might take a look at it .
translation.zh: 我想我可以看看。

translation.en: do you like animals ?
translation.zh: 你喜欢动物吗？

translation.en: yes , doesn't everyone ?
translation.zh: 是的，不是每个人都这样吗？

translation.en: what's your favorite animal ?
translation.zh: 你最喜欢的动物是什么？

translation.en: it's hard to say . While dogs are more affectionate , cats are much easier to take care of .
translation.zh: 很难说。虽然狗更亲切，但猫更容易照顾。

translation.en: have you ever had a dog ?
translation.zh: 你养过狗吗？

translation.en: when I was little , we had a few domestic dogs at home .
translation.zh: 我小的时候，家里养了几只狗。

translation.en: they always say that dogs are a man's best friends . do you think that's true ?
translation.zh: 人们常说狗是人最好的朋友。你认为是这样吗？

translation.en: definitely . rich or poor , dogs always love their masters .
translation.zh: 没错。无论贫富，狗都爱主人。

translation.en: how about cats ? Have you ever had one for a pet ?
translation.zh: 猫呢？你养过吗？

translation.en: i had one a few months ago , but she ended up running away .
translation.zh: 几个月前我养过一次，但她最后跑丢了。

translation.en: how did that happen ?
translation.zh: 怎么会这样？

translation.en: she left through a window that was open one night and never returned .
translation.zh: 有一个晚上她从开着的窗户跑了，就再也没有回来。

translation.en: you must have been devastated !
translation.zh: 你一定很伤心！

translation.en: i was pretty sad . i still hope that she'll return some day !
translation.zh: 我确实很伤心。我还是希望她有一天会回来！

translation.en: I hope she does . Do you think you'll ever get another pet ?
translation.zh: 我希望她会。你觉得你还会再养一只宠物吗？

translation.en: I think I will . It's difficult to feel longly when you have a pet around .
translation.zh: 我想我会的。当你身边有宠物的时候，很难感觉到孤单。

translation.en: i hope your cat finds its way back home .
translation.zh: 我希望你的猫能找到回家的路。

translation.en: i do , too .
translation.zh: 我也是。

translation.en: Sorry , you have the wrong number . There ’ s no Brian here .
translation.zh: 对不起，你打错电话了。这里没有布莱恩这个人。

translation.en: That ’ s OK .
translation.zh: 没关系。

translation.en: Not necessarily . If we use a realtor to find a house , it will be more expensive .
translation.zh: 不需要。如果我们委托经纪人找房子，会比较贵。

translation.en: Realtors always get a commission.If the realtor helps us find something , we have to pay him .
translation.zh: 房地产经纪人都要抽佣金的。如果经纪人帮我们找到房子，我们就要付他钱。

translation.en: I still think we should have a realtor.We ' re new in this country . We don't know all the laws of buying a house.And also , the realtor will inspect the house.He can tell us if the house has
translation.zh: 我还是认为应该要找个经纪人。我们才刚来这个国家，不知道买房子的所有法律条款。而且经纪入还会检查房子。他可以告诉我们房子有没有问题。

translation.en: Of course we need a home inspector.But we can hire an inspector on our own.And as for the legal problems , I have friends . They can help us .
translation.zh: 当然我们需要房子检查员。不过我们可以自己请检查员就好。至于法律问题，我有朋友，他们可以帮忙。

translation.en: It takes a little more time . We have to check the ads in the paper.Probably also there are special real estate magazines with ads.Then we have to drive to the homes and look at them .
translation.zh: 要花多一点时间。我们必须看看报纸上的广告。或许专门的房地产杂志上也有广告。然后我们必须开车去看房子。

translation.en: Because if the seller has a realtor , their price will be higher.He will have to pay a commission to the realtor .
translation.zh: 因为如果卖主找经纪人，房价就会比较高。他必须付经纪人佣金。

translation.en: It is . But buying a house is very important . So it takes time.That ' s why we haven't done it yet . It's very troublesome .
translation.zh: 是啊。不过买房子很重要，所以要花时间。那就是为什么我们还没开始的原因，很麻烦的。

translation.en: Alright . I'll buy a newspaper when I go to the drug store .
translation.zh: 好，我去杂货店的时候会买份报纸的。

translation.en: Hi , Nally , are you hungry ?
translation.zh: 嗨，纳利，你饿了吗？

translation.en: I'm starving . Let's go grab a bite .
translation.zh: 我饿死了。我们去吃点东西吧。

translation.en: How about Karlis ?
translation.zh: 卡里斯怎么样？

translation.en: Are you kidding ? That place is too ritzy for lunch .
translation.zh: 你在开玩笑吗？那个地方太豪华了，午饭可吃不起。

translation.en: True . ok Let's go to Grumose ?
translation.zh: 是的。好吧，我们去格鲁莫斯？

translation.en: Same thing , meals there all coarsen arm and leg .
translation.zh: 也不行，那里的饭菜都会使人发胖。

translation.en: I guess it is a little pricy .
translation.zh: 我想这还是有点贵。

translation.en: Let's stop it at Multicolor for a quick lunch ..
translation.zh: 让我们就在多色餐厅吃顿便饭吧。

translation.en: That will be Ok . Come on , I can't wait to chow down .
translation.zh: 那就可以了。走吧，我等不及要狼吞虎咽了。

translation.en: That was a great lunch , the food was good , but the service was lousy .
translation.zh: 这是一顿很棒的午餐，食物很好，但服务很差。

translation.en: Is that why you stiffed the waiter ?
translation.zh: 所以你才给服务生消费吗？

translation.en: You got it . All right , Let's go back to school .
translation.zh: 对。好了，我们回学校去吧。

translation.en: no , no , you helped me with my computer last week . I want to repay the favor .
translation.zh: 不，不，你上周帮我用电脑。我想报答你的恩惠。

translation.en: no , it's definitely my turn to treat you ... you paid last time !
translation.zh: 不，轮到我请你了。。。你上次付钱了！

translation.en: oh , that was just a quick bite to eat---that doesn't count !
translation.zh: 哦，我只是随便吃了点东西——那不算数！

translation.en: ok , ok , how about we just go Dutch ? It's settled . Listen , I'm still pretty new around here , would it be alright if you found the restaurant ?
translation.zh: 好吧，好吧，我们各付各的怎么样？事情解决了。听着，我对这里还很陌生，你能找到那家餐馆吗？

translation.en: ok ... sure .
translation.zh: 好的当然。

translation.en: what shall we do after the volleyball match ?
translation.zh: 排球比赛结束后我们去干嘛？

translation.en: how about going to the Olympic souvenir store to have a look ? I remember there is one in the gym .
translation.zh: 去奥运纪念品商店看看怎么样？我记得体育馆里有一个。

translation.en: that's a good idea . I was thinking of buying some gifts for my family .
translation.zh: 这是个好主意。我正想着给家人买些礼物。

translation.en: me , too . What did you have in mind ?
translation.zh: 我也是。你想买什么？

translation.en: I agree . They're very lovely , especially " Huan Huan " .
translation.zh: 我同意。它们太可爱了，尤其是“欢欢”。

translation.en: is that the red one ? That is my favorite , too . Do you know how much they are ?
translation.zh: 是红色的那个吗？那也是我最喜欢的。你知道他们多少钱吗？

translation.en: the five dolls are sold together as a set , and they're priced according to the size . The bigger they are the more expensive .
translation.zh: 这五个玩偶是一套一起卖的，而且是根据大小来定价的。它们越大越贵。

translation.en: oh , I see . If I buy more than a set , can I get any discount ?
translation.zh: 哦，我明白了。如果我多买一套，能打折吗？

translation.en: any other ideas ?
translation.zh: 还有其他选择吗？

translation.en: there are lots of things , such as postcards , key chains , posters and various arts and crafts .
translation.zh: 有很多东西啊，比如明信片，钥匙链，海报和各种工艺品之类的。

translation.en: it all sounds great . We can go there after the match . I can't wait to see what they have .
translation.zh: 听起来都很棒。比赛后我们可以去那里。我迫不及待地想看看都有些什么了。

translation.en: What's wrong , officer ?
translation.zh: 怎么了，警官？

translation.en: You do realize that you ran a red light , don't you ?
translation.zh: 你知道你闯红灯了吧？

translation.en: I did ?
translation.zh: 是吗？

translation.en: You didn't see the red light ?
translation.zh: 你没看到红灯？

translation.en: I'm sorry for running it , but I really didn't know .
translation.zh: 我很抱歉我闯红灯了，但我真的不知道。

translation.en: Didn't you learn that red means stop ?
translation.zh: 你不知道红色代表停止吗？

translation.en: Then tell me why you sped up on the yellow light .
translation.zh: 那告诉我你为什么在黄灯下加速。

translation.en: I'm giving you a ticket for this .
translation.zh: 我给你一张罚单。

translation.en: I'm sorry for the misunderstanding .
translation.zh: 很抱歉。

translation.en: Maybe you'll think about this before you decide to run another light .
translation.zh: 也许在你下一次闯红灯之前你会考虑一下。

translation.en: Isn't it past your bedtime already ?
translation.zh: 不是已经过了你的就寝时间了吗？

translation.en: I am not sleepy .
translation.zh: 我不困。

translation.en: It's getting late , and you have to wake up early tomorrow .
translation.zh: 天太晚了，明天你得早起。

translation.en: There is no way that I can fall asleep right now .
translation.zh: 我现在不可能睡得着。

translation.en: Try listening to some soft music .
translation.zh: 试着听听舒缓的音乐。

translation.en: It won't work . I'm nowhere close to being tired .
translation.zh: 这行不通。我一点也不累。

translation.en: I really don't care , just go to sleep .
translation.zh: 我不在乎，赶紧去睡觉吧。

translation.en: What if I stay up and do something , until I get tired ?
translation.zh: 如果我熬夜做点什么，直到累了怎么样？

translation.en: You'll be up all night if I let you do that .
translation.zh: 如果我让你那样做，你会整夜不睡的。

translation.en: I'm going to get to sleep eventually .
translation.zh: 我终究还是会睡着的。

translation.en: You need to go to sleep now , so go to sleep .
translation.zh: 你现在需要去睡觉了，所以去睡觉吧。

translation.en: I'm not sure about how to operate the washer and dryer .
translation.zh: 我不知道如何使用洗衣机和烘干机。

translation.en: I need help turning them on .
translation.zh: 我需要有人来帮我启动它们。

translation.en: You need change .
translation.zh: 你需要零钱。

translation.en: The machines take change ?
translation.zh: 使用机器需要零钱吗？

translation.en: Yes . It costs fifty cents for the washer and a dollar for the dryer .
translation.zh: 对。洗衣机五十美分，烘干机一美元。

translation.en: Where do i put the money in ?
translation.zh: 我把钱放哪儿？

translation.en: You put the coins into the slot , push it in , and it will turn on .
translation.zh: 你把硬币放进投币口，把它推进去，机器就会启动了。

translation.en: There's nothing else to it .
translation.zh: 没有别的了。

translation.en: You're welcome . Let me know if you need anything else .
translation.zh: 不客气。如果你还需要什么，请告诉我。

translation.en: I really want to make something for dinner .
translation.zh: 我真的很想做点吃的。

translation.en: What are you going to cook ?
translation.zh: 你打算做什么？

translation.en: I haven't the slightest clue what I'm going to make .
translation.zh: 我完全不知道要做什么。

translation.en: A teriyaki bowl sounds nice .
translation.zh: 照烧饭听起来不错。

translation.en: I don't know how to make that .
translation.zh: 我不知道怎么做。

translation.en: All you need to make it is white rice and some teriyaki beef .
translation.zh: 你只需要做米饭和一些照烧牛肉。

translation.en: That sounds fairly simple , but how do I cook it ?
translation.zh: 听起来很简单，但我该怎么做呢？

translation.en: The first and simplest thing you have to do is make some white rice .
translation.zh: 你要做的第一件事也是最简单的事，那就是做一些白米饭。

translation.en: Then you should shred your beef and pour some teriyaki marinade over it .
translation.zh: 然后你应该切碎你的牛肉，倒一些日本照烧汁在上面。

translation.en: What's the next thing I need to do ?
translation.zh: 接下来要做什么？

translation.en: Then all you need to do is cook it and enjoy .
translation.zh: 接下来你所需要做的就是烹饪和享受（这顿美食了）。

translation.en: What are we eating for lunch ?
translation.zh: 我们午餐吃什么？

translation.en: I have no idea . What about you ?
translation.zh: 我不知道。你呢？

translation.en: I kind of want pizza .
translation.zh: 我有点想吃披萨。

translation.en: I ate pizza the other day .
translation.zh: 前几天我吃过披萨了。

translation.en: So , what do you feel like eating then ?
translation.zh: 那你想吃什么？

translation.en: How about some burgers ?
translation.zh: 来点汉堡怎么样？

translation.en: I already had a burger yesterday .
translation.zh: 我昨天已经吃过汉堡了。

translation.en: What are we going to do ?
translation.zh: 那我们吃什么？

translation.en: We can just each get what we want to get .
translation.zh: 我们可以吃我们各自想吃的。

translation.en: That sounds like a plan .
translation.zh: 听起来还行。

translation.en: Do you know a place that sells pizza and burgers ?
translation.zh: 你知道哪里既卖比萨饼又卖汉堡吗？

translation.en: I think they sell both at the cafeteria .
translation.zh: 我想自助餐厅会卖。

translation.en: What's the side dish that you're making for dinner ?
translation.zh: 你晚餐要做的配菜是什么？

translation.en: I'm not sure . I was thinking of making a vegetable .
translation.zh: 我不确定。我在想做个蔬菜。

translation.en: What kind of vegetable are you thinking about making ?
translation.zh: 你想做什么蔬菜？

translation.en: Do you know what kind of vegetable you want to eat ?
translation.zh: 你想吃什么蔬菜吗？

translation.en: Why don't you make some corn ?
translation.zh: 你为什么不做些玉米呢？

translation.en: How would you like the corn ?
translation.zh: 你想要什么样的玉米？

translation.en: I don't understand what you mean .
translation.zh: 我不明白你的意思。

translation.en: Do you want it boiled , grilled , or microwaved ?
translation.zh: 你要煮的、烤的还是用微波炉做的？

translation.en: Why don't you grill it ?
translation.zh: 你为什么不烤一下呢？

translation.en: That's how you want it ?
translation.zh: 这就是你想要的？

translation.en: Yeah , that sounds delicious .
translation.zh: 是啊，听起来不错。

translation.en: Okay , I'll grill some corn then .
translation.zh: 好吧，那我烤些玉米。

translation.en: I think that we have a pretty good idea of what we would like to order .
translation.zh: 我想我们很清楚我们要点什么。

translation.en: Let me tell you about the specials of the day , which are chicken in a wine sauce with capers , and grilled garlic shrimp .
translation.zh: 我来给你讲讲今天的特色菜吧，那就是鸡汤配山柑，还有烤蒜虾。

translation.en: I was wondering if the chef could leave off the sauce .
translation.zh: 我在想厨师能不能把酱汁去掉。

translation.en: The chef would be happy to accommodate your special requests .
translation.zh: 厨师很乐意满足您的特殊要求。

translation.en: I am a vegetarian . Do you have any vegetarian selections ?
translation.zh: 我是素食主义者。有素食选择吗？

translation.en: You could choose the roasted vegetable and garlic pizza or the goat cheese and candied walnut salad .
translation.zh: 你可以选择烤蔬菜和大蒜披萨或山羊奶酪和核桃糖沙拉。

translation.en: I think that we will split the roasted vegetable and garlic pizza .
translation.zh: 我想我们要把烤蔬菜和蒜味披萨分开。

translation.en: That is a good selection , and I can bring your salads now or serve them with your entree .
translation.zh: 这是一个很好的选择，我现在可以给您带来沙拉，也可以和您的主菜一起上。

translation.en: You can bring us our salads when you bring us our entree .
translation.zh: 当你给我们上主菜时，你可以给我们上沙拉。

translation.en: It's time for bed .
translation.zh: 该睡觉了。

translation.en: I'm not ready to go to sleep . I'm not tired .
translation.zh: 我还没准备好睡觉。我不累。

translation.en: It's quite late , and you have an early day tomorrow .
translation.zh: 已经很晚了，明天你还有一个早班。

translation.en: I'm not going to be able to fall asleep .
translation.zh: 我睡不着了。

translation.en: Why don't you try counting sheep ?
translation.zh: 你为什么不数羊呢？

translation.en: I've tried that before . It really doesn't work .
translation.zh: 我以前也试过。真的不行。

translation.en: That's beside the point , you still need to go to bed .
translation.zh: 那不是重点，你还是要上床睡觉。

translation.en: Why can't I just stay up until I fall asleep ?
translation.zh: 为什么我不能一直睡到睡着？

translation.en: If I let you do that , then you're just going to be up all night .
translation.zh: 如果我让你这么做，你就得整晚都不睡。

translation.en: I promise I'll go to sleep soon .
translation.zh: 我保证我很快就会睡着。

translation.en: No , you're going to sleep now , so good night .
translation.zh: 不，你现在要睡觉了，晚安。

translation.en: See you in the morning .
translation.zh: 明早见。

translation.en: Do you wash clothes here often ?
translation.zh: 你经常在这里洗衣服吗？

translation.en: I have been coming here for the past few years .
translation.zh: 过去几年里我一直来这里洗。

translation.en: Why do you wash here ?
translation.zh: 你为什么在这里洗？

translation.en: It's actually a lot cheaper for me to wash my clothes here .
translation.zh: 在这里洗衣服便宜多了。

translation.en: I've only washed my clothes here a couple times .
translation.zh: 我只在这里洗过几次衣服。

translation.en: Why don't you wash clothes at home ?
translation.zh: 你为什么不在家洗衣服？

translation.en: I would , if my washing machine wasn't broken .
translation.zh: 如果我的洗衣机没有坏的话，我会的。

translation.en: Why don't you just get it fixed ?
translation.zh: 你为什么不把它修好？

translation.en: I can't afford it .
translation.zh: 我修不起。

translation.en: So you plan on washing your clothes here from now on ?
translation.zh: 你打算从现在开始都在这里洗衣服吗？

translation.en: That's my only option right now .
translation.zh: 这是我现在唯一的选择。

translation.en: Don't worry . Besides , it's a lot cheaper to wash clothes this way .
translation.zh: 别担心。再说，这样洗衣服便宜多了。

translation.en: Did you clean your room today ?
translation.zh: 你今天打扫房间了吗？

translation.en: Well , when were you planning on doing that ?
translation.zh: 你打算什么时候做？

translation.en: I'm going to clean it up later .
translation.zh: 我待会再收拾。

translation.en: Didn't I ask you to clean it up earlier ?
translation.zh: 我不是叫你早点打扫吗？

translation.en: I'm going to clean it .
translation.zh: 我会去打扫的。

translation.en: I want you to vacuum in your room , and don't forget to dust everything .
translation.zh: 我要你用吸尘器打扫房间，别忘了把所有东西都打扫干净。

translation.en: I know . I'll do it .
translation.zh: 我知道。我会的。

translation.en: Make sure you clean it up before you do anything else .
translation.zh: 在做其他事情之前一定要把它清理干净。

translation.en: I'm not going anywhere until later , so I'll clean it then .
translation.zh: 我一会才会去别的地方，到时候我会打扫干净的。

translation.en: It's nice to meet you . Thanks for coming .
translation.zh: 很高兴见到你。谢谢你能来。

translation.en: I wanted to meet with you to discuss your daughter .
translation.zh: 我想和你谈谈你女儿的事。

translation.en: Is she acting up in class ?
translation.zh: 她会在课堂上捣乱吗？

translation.en: Not at all . She's a joy to have in my class .
translation.zh: 一点也不。她是我们班上的一个开心果。

translation.en: She is absolutely wonderful .
translation.zh: 她真是太棒了。

translation.en: So she isn't causing you any problems ?
translation.zh: 所以她没有给你惹麻烦？

translation.en: No . She is actually very intelligent and well behaved .
translation.zh: 不。她其实非常聪明，举止也很得体。

translation.en: I'm glad to know that you like her .
translation.zh: 知道你喜欢她我很高兴。

translation.en: You have nothing to worry about with her .
translation.zh: 你对她没什么好担心的。

translation.en: I needed to ask you a question .
translation.zh: 我要问你一个问题。

translation.en: How many hours of the behind-the-wheel course do I need to take ?
translation.zh: 我需要学习多少小时的驾驶课程？

translation.en: Why do you need to take the course ?
translation.zh: 你为什么要上这门课？

translation.en: I want to get my license .
translation.zh: 我想拿到驾照。

translation.en: You have to do six hours behind the wheel .
translation.zh: 你得学习六个小时。

translation.en: How many days do I need to finish the course ?
translation.zh: 我需要多少天来完成这门课？

translation.en: You can't finish in less than three days .
translation.zh: 不能少于三天。

translation.en: Pasadena Traffic School . How can I help you ?
translation.zh: 这里是帕萨迪纳交通学校。我能帮你什么吗？

translation.en: I would like to sign up for some classes .
translation.zh: 我想报名参加一些课程。

translation.en: What classes did you want to sign up for ?
translation.zh: 你想报名参加什么课程？

translation.en: I need to take a driver's course .
translation.zh: 我需要修一门驾驶课程。

translation.en: You'll have to make an appointment .
translation.zh: 你得预约一下。

translation.en: What do I need to make an appointment for ?
translation.zh: 我为什么需要预约？

translation.en: You need an appointment so you can sign the papers .
translation.zh: 你需要预约才能在文件上签字。

translation.en: All right , can I make an appointment right now ?
translation.zh: 好吧，我现在可以预约吗？

translation.en: Can I make it for tomorrow at 9
translation.zh: 我能预约明天9点吗？

translation.en: I can schedule you for that day and time .
translation.zh: 我可以为你安排这个日期和时间。

translation.en: Thanks a lot . I'll be there tomorrow .
translation.zh: 谢谢。我明天就到。

translation.en: Do you think we can go driving right now ?
translation.zh: 你觉得我们现在可以开车去吗？

translation.en: Yeah , sure . Let's go .
translation.zh: 是的，当然。走吧。

translation.en: Buckle up .
translation.zh: 系好安全带。

translation.en: All right . Now what ?
translation.zh: 好吧。现在怎么办？

translation.en: Now you put the key in the ignition and start the car .
translation.zh: 现在你把钥匙插进点火开关，然后发动汽车。

translation.en: Which direction should I take ?
translation.zh: 我该往哪个方向走？

translation.en: Make a left on this next street .
translation.zh: 在下一条街左转。

translation.en: Tell me how far to go .
translation.zh: 告诉我要走多远。

translation.en: Keep going until I tell you to stop .
translation.zh: 一直走，直到我叫你停下来。

translation.en: Okay , but let me know ahead of time .
translation.zh: 好的，在你想让我停下来之前告诉我。

translation.en: That's all for today , so park right there .
translation.zh: 好的，试着把车停在这里吧。

translation.en: That was great . Thanks for taking me driving .
translation.zh: 太棒了。谢谢你带我开车。

translation.en: Let's go practice your driving .
translation.zh: 我们去练习开车吧。

translation.en: If that's what you want to do , then we can .
translation.zh: 如果你想这么做的话，可以。

translation.en: Did you buckle your seatbelt ?
translation.zh: 你系好安全带了吗？

translation.en: I'm buckled up . What's next ?
translation.zh: 我系好了。下一步是什么？

translation.en: You need to start the car now .
translation.zh: 你现在需要发动汽车。

translation.en: What do you want me to do ?
translation.zh: 接着我要做什么？

translation.en: Go left .
translation.zh: 向左走。

translation.en: How far should I go ?
translation.zh: 我该走多远？

translation.en: I'll let you know when I want you to stop .
translation.zh: 需要你停下来的时候我会告诉你的。

translation.en: Tell me before you want me to stop .
translation.zh: 在你想让我停下来之前告诉我。

translation.en: All right , try parking here .
translation.zh: 好的，试着把车停在这里吧。

translation.en: Thanks . Let's go driving again tomorrow .
translation.zh: 谢谢。我们明天再来练车吧。

translation.en: Only a few .
translation.zh: 有几次。

translation.en: What's a few ?
translation.zh: 几次是多少？

translation.en: I've gotten six , I think .
translation.zh: 我想有六次吧。

translation.en: Did you pay your fines ?
translation.zh: 你交罚款了吗？

translation.en: Of course I have .
translation.zh: 当然了。

translation.en: How much are the parking tickets ?
translation.zh: 停车罚款多少钱？

translation.en: I think they're $ 130 .
translation.zh: 我想是130美元。

translation.en: I just got a parking ticket .
translation.zh: 我刚拿到一张停车罚单。

translation.en: You should probably pay the fine soon .
translation.zh: 你应该尽快交罚款。

translation.en: I'm going to pay it today .
translation.zh: 我今天就去交。

translation.en: I need to find a bus that'll take me to the Gold Line .
translation.zh: 我得坐辆巴士去金线。

translation.en: I live up in Altadena .
translation.zh: 我住在阿尔塔德纳。

translation.en: The 264 will take you there .
translation.zh: 264路可以送你过去。

translation.en: It goes all the way there ?
translation.zh: 沿路站点都有吗？

translation.en: I know for a fact that it goes to the station .
translation.zh: 我只知道这辆巴士是去那一站的。

translation.en: What street would I catch it on ?
translation.zh: 我应该在哪条街上坐264路？

translation.en: If you go to Altadena Drive , you can catch it there .
translation.zh: 你去阿尔塔迪纳大道，就可以找到264路了。

translation.en: I didn't know that bus went to the Gold Line station .
translation.zh: 我都不知道那辆巴士还能到金线车站。

translation.en: Yup , it does .
translation.zh: 是的，它能到。

translation.en: Well , thanks for letting me know .
translation.zh: 好的，谢谢你让我知道。

translation.en: I have been thinking of buying a house and would like to speak with you .
translation.zh: 我一直在考虑买房这事，（所以我）想和你谈谈。

translation.en: I have time to speak with you . Where would you like to purchase your house ?
translation.zh: 我有时间和你谈谈。你想在哪里买房子？

translation.en: I am most interested in Pasadena or Arcadia , but would be open to other suggestions .
translation.zh: 我对帕萨迪纳或阿卡迪亚的房子最感兴趣，但也愿意接受其他建议。

translation.en: How many bedrooms and bathrooms do you need ?
translation.zh: 你需要多少间卧室和浴室？

translation.en: We have several generations of family living in our household and so need a very large home .
translation.zh: 我们家有好几代人一起住，所以需要一个很大的房子。

translation.en: Do you need to be located in a particular school district ?
translation.zh: 你需要在某个特定的学区房吗？

translation.en: It doesn ’ t matter , as we do not have any children .
translation.zh: 不用，因为我们没有孩子。

translation.en: Is a view important to you , or would you rather be located on a lakeshore lot ?
translation.zh: 房间的风景对你来说重要吗？或者说你喜欢坐落在湖边的地段吗？

translation.en: In a perfect world , we would like a home with a view of the lake .
translation.zh: 理想化地来说，我们想要一个能看到湖景的家。

translation.en: Thank you for all of the information . I will help you find the perfect house for you .
translation.zh: 谢谢你提供的所有信息。我会帮你找到最适合你的房子。

translation.en: I've brought this dress back to exchange it .
translation.zh: 我买了这条裙子，不过现在想换条。

translation.en: That's not a problem . Leave it with me , and find something that you like .
translation.zh: 没问题。把它给我吧，你可以去挑件你喜欢的。

translation.en: I was hoping you'd have something on sale today .
translation.zh: 我本来是希望今天有打折的东西。

translation.en: We have nothing on sale today . But we're having a big sale next weekend .
translation.zh: 我们今天没有特价商品。但我们下周末要大减价。

translation.en: Is the sale going to include dresses ?
translation.zh: 下次减价包括连衣裙吗？

translation.en: Everything you can see will be on sale .
translation.zh: 所有你能看到的东西都会减价出售。

translation.en: I like the sound of that . I'll just come back next weekend .
translation.zh: 这个消息不错，那我下周再来。

translation.en: The savings will be worth the short wait . See you next weekend .
translation.zh: 下周再来一定会很值的，下周见了。

translation.en: Hi , where can I find a cheap cashmere sweater ?
translation.zh: 嗨，哪里有便宜的羊绒衫？

translation.en: How about an outlet ?
translation.zh: 去大卖场怎么样？

translation.en: Outlets give good deals .
translation.zh: 大卖场的生意很好。

translation.en: Where can I find the produce ?
translation.zh: 我在哪里能找到农产品？

translation.en: What sales do they have today ?
translation.zh: 他们今天有卖什么？

translation.en: I'm sure something is on sale . Please check with the produce person .
translation.zh: 我肯定有东西在卖。请与生产人员核对。

translation.en: Hi . I'm looking for a gift for my niece .
translation.zh: 你好。我在为我侄女找礼物。

translation.en: Well , little girls seem to love Barbie dolls .
translation.zh: 嗯，小女孩们似乎喜欢芭比娃娃。

translation.en: That's perfect . I want to see one .
translation.zh: 太完美了。我想看看。

translation.en: Here you are — she's called Digital Barbie .
translation.zh: 给你，她叫数码芭比。

translation.en: Oh , I like Digital Barbie ! How much does she cost ?
translation.zh: 哦，我喜欢数码芭比！她要多少钱？

translation.en: This Barbie is only $ 29.95 .
translation.zh: 这个芭比娃娃只要29.95美元。

translation.en: That's perfect . Let me have her .
translation.zh: 太完美了。我要她了。

translation.en: Very good . Is there anything else you would like ?
translation.zh: 非常好。你还要别的什么吗？

translation.en: No , that'll do it for now .
translation.zh: 不，就这样吧。

translation.en: Including tax , your total will be $ 32.42 . Cash or charge ?
translation.zh: 包括税在内，一共是是32.42美元。现金还是刷卡？

translation.en: Let me give you cash , please .
translation.zh: 现金吧。

translation.en: Here's your change and receipt . Thank you .
translation.zh: 这是找你的钱和收据。感谢惠顾。

translation.en: I want to buy some flowers for my wife's birthday .
translation.zh: 我想买些花作为我妻子的生日礼物。

translation.en: Red roses are always a popular gift for birthdays .
translation.zh: 红玫瑰对于生日礼物的来说最适合不过了。

translation.en: What are the roses going for ?
translation.zh: 这些玫瑰多少钱？

translation.en: They're only $ 20 a dozen .
translation.zh: 一打才20美元。

translation.en: That sounds nice and cheap .
translation.zh: 听上去还不错，还算便宜。

translation.en: Yes , you're saving money because they're on sale today .
translation.zh: 是的，您还能省些钱，因为它们今天打折。

translation.en: Okay , give me the roses .
translation.zh: 好吧，给我玫瑰吧。

translation.en: Could I interest you in anything else ?
translation.zh: 你还有什么想买的吗？

translation.en: No , but thanks anyway .
translation.zh: 不，没有了，谢谢你。

translation.en: Your wife will be thrilled with the roses .
translation.zh: 您的妻子看到玫瑰会很开心的。

translation.en: You really need to look at some of the problems we are having with the apartment .
translation.zh: 你真的需要看看我们公寓的一些问题。

translation.en: That apartment never had any problems before . Are you sure the problem isn ’ t you ?
translation.zh: 那间公寓以前从没出过问题。你确定问题不是出在你身上吗？

translation.en: We spoke with you the first week we moved in about things that you promised to fix .
translation.zh: 我们搬来的第一周就和你说过了这些问题，你答应会修的。

translation.en: Where do you think you have problems ?
translation.zh: 你觉得你哪里有问题？

translation.en: There is no hot water , the bedroom has a broken window , and there are rats in the kitchen .
translation.zh: 没有热水，卧室的窗户坏了，厨房里有老鼠。

translation.en: You know , no one else who has been in that apartment has had a problem before .
translation.zh: 你知道吧，以前住那间公寓的人都没有这这些问题。

translation.en: You are obligated to maintain your building and my apartment .
translation.zh: 你有义务维修你的房子和我住的公寓。

translation.en: I will fix these problems when I get around to it .
translation.zh: 等我有时间的时候我会解决这些问题的。

translation.en: I will be withholding my rent check this Friday unless these problems are addressed immediately .
translation.zh: 除非这些问题立即得到解决，否则我将在本周五拒付房租。

translation.en: You can ’ t do that ! It ’ s illegal !
translation.zh: 你不能那样做！这是违法的！

translation.en: What are the appliances .
translation.zh: 有哪些装置。

translation.en: I'm broke , and I have to catch another bus .
translation.zh: 我没钱了，我得搭另一辆公共汽车。

translation.en: Why don't you have any money for another bus ?
translation.zh: 你为什么没有钱再搭一辆公共汽车呢？

translation.en: I got hungry and bought some chips .
translation.zh: 我饿了，买了些薯条。

translation.en: That was smart .
translation.zh: 真聪明。

translation.en: Anyway , do you have any change I can use for the bus ?
translation.zh: 不管怎样，你有零钱可以（借我）搭公共汽车吗？

translation.en: I don't have any .
translation.zh: 我没有。

translation.en: I don't know how I'm going to get home .
translation.zh: 我不知道怎么回家。

translation.en: Get a transfer from the bus driver .
translation.zh: 从司机那里换钱。

translation.en: How much is a transfer ?
translation.zh: 换钱要花多少钱？

translation.en: It doesn't cost anything .
translation.zh: 不花钱。

translation.en: That's great ! Thanks for your help .
translation.zh: 太棒了！谢谢你的帮助。

translation.en: You know what ? Don't mention it .
translation.zh: 你知道点什么啊？不用谢了。

translation.en: Good morning . I need to speak with the property manager , please .
translation.zh: 早上好。我需要和物业经理谈谈。

translation.en: Good morning . You are speaking to the property manager .
translation.zh: 早上好。你现在谈话的正是物业经理。

translation.en: While it was raining last night , water started leaking in from the ceiling .
translation.zh: 昨晚下雨时，水开始从天花板漏进来。

translation.en: Was it leaking in the bedroom ?
translation.zh: 卧室漏水了吗？

translation.en: It was in the living room .
translation.zh: 在客厅里。

translation.en: Can you tell me which floor you are on ?
translation.zh: 你能告诉我你在哪一层吗？

translation.en: We are on the bottom floor .
translation.zh: 我们在底层。

translation.en: I would like to look at the leak . Will you be home this morning ?
translation.zh: 我想看看漏水处。今天早上你会回家吗？

translation.en: Yes , someone will be here to let you in .
translation.zh: 是的，会有人让你进来的。

translation.en: Just in case you have to leave , we will just use the master key .
translation.zh: 万一你要离开家，我们就用万能钥匙。

translation.en: Did you go and buy your bus pass ?
translation.zh: 你去买公共汽车票了吗？

translation.en: When are you going to go get it ?
translation.zh: 你什么时候去拿？

translation.en: I'm not sure where they sell bus passes at .
translation.zh: 我不知道他们在哪里卖公共汽车票。

translation.en: Why didn't you just ask me ?
translation.zh: 你为什么不直接问我？

translation.en: Where should I go ?
translation.zh: 我该去哪里？

translation.en: You can get one from student services .
translation.zh: 你可以从学生服务处得到一个。

translation.en: I had no clue that I could get it there .
translation.zh: 我不知道我能把它送到那里。

translation.en: I already knew that .
translation.zh: 我早就知道了。

translation.en: I'm going to go and get it right now .
translation.zh: 我现在就去拿。

translation.en: How much does it cost for a bus pass ?
translation.zh: 一张公共汽车票要多少钱？

translation.en: It'll be $ 65 for a monthly pass .
translation.zh: 月票65美元。

translation.en: Is there anything cheaper than that ?
translation.zh: 有比这更便宜的吗？

translation.en: If you're in school , you can get a student pass .
translation.zh: 如果你在学校，你可以拿到学生通行证。

translation.en: Well , I am how much will that cost ?
translation.zh: 好吧，那要多少钱？

translation.en: The pass is free .
translation.zh: 通行证是免费的。

translation.en: I don't have to pay for anything ?
translation.zh: 我什么都不用付？

translation.en: You'll only have to pay for the monthly sticker .
translation.zh: 你只需支付每月的贴纸费。

translation.en: How much is the monthly sticker ?
translation.zh: 月票多少钱？

translation.en: It's $ 24 for each month .
translation.zh: 每月24美元。

translation.en: I'll take the student bus pass .
translation.zh: 我要学生巴士通行证。

translation.en: Okay , I'll get you one .
translation.zh: 好的，我给你拿一个。

translation.en: Have you bought a bus pass yet ?
translation.zh: 你买公共汽车票了吗？

translation.en: I'm not getting one .
translation.zh: 我不买了。

translation.en: It's cheaper if I don't buy one .
translation.zh: 如果我不买的话就便宜多了。

translation.en: Buying a bus pass will save you money .
translation.zh: 买一张公共汽车通行证可以省钱。

translation.en: There's no limit to how often you can use your bus pass .
translation.zh: 你可以使用公共汽车通行证的频率没有限制。

translation.en: Plus , you don't have to use change for the bus anymore .
translation.zh: 另外，你再也不用找零钱了。

translation.en: You want to buy one now ?
translation.zh: 你现在想买一个吗？

translation.en: I'm going to .
translation.zh: 我要去。

translation.en: What are you having for lunch ?
translation.zh: 你午饭吃什么？

translation.en: I got a sandwich , some chips , and a soda .
translation.zh: 我有一个三明治，一些薯片和一杯苏打水。

translation.en: Did you bring that from home ?
translation.zh: 你从家里带来的吗？

translation.en: I got it from the cafeteria .
translation.zh: 我从自助餐厅买的。

translation.en: What kind of sandwich did you get ?
translation.zh: 你买了什么三明治？

translation.en: They messed up my order and gave me a bologna sandwich .
translation.zh: 他们弄错了我的订单，给了我一个博洛尼亚三明治。

translation.en: Considering it wasn't what I ordered , it was still pretty good .
translation.zh: 考虑到不是我点的，还是不错的。

translation.en: I think I got a sandwich there once before .
translation.zh: 我记得我以前也在那儿吃过三明治。

translation.en: Yes , and they didn't get my order right either .
translation.zh: 是的，他们也没把我的订单弄好。

translation.en: I would like to purchase some meat .
translation.zh: 我想买些肉。

translation.en: What kind of meat would you like to get today ?
translation.zh: 你今天想吃什么肉？

translation.en: First off , I'm going to need a pound of ground beef .
translation.zh: 首先，我需要一磅碎牛肉。

translation.en: A pound of ground beef is $ 2.48 .
translation.zh: 一磅碎牛肉2.48美元。

translation.en: What else will you be needing ?
translation.zh: 你还需要什么？

translation.en: I'm also going to need three pounds of chicken breasts .
translation.zh: 我还需要三磅鸡胸。

translation.en: The chicken breasts cost $ 4.05 per pound .
translation.zh: 鸡胸肉每磅4.05美元。

translation.en: What's the total price for the chicken ?
translation.zh: 鸡肉的总价是多少？

translation.en: It's going to be $ 12.15 .
Okay , I think that will be all for me today .
translation.zh: 好吧，我想今天就这些了。

translation.en: Look , here is a very special business card from an illustrator . Every time I go through my book of business cards , I will notice it . It is an eye-catching one .
translation.zh: 看，这是一位插画家的一张非常特别的名片。每次我翻阅名片册时，我都会注意到它。它很引人注目。

translation.en: Wow , fantastic . I like the font and color for his name . It is creative yet personal .
translation.zh: 哇，太棒了。我喜欢他名字的字体和颜色。它既有创意又有个性。

translation.en: Yes , it is a bold design . People will believe he can make an illustration as an impressive as a business card . It just stands out from those plain and standard ones used by government people or other big private and public organizations .
translation.zh: 是的，这是粗体设计。人们会认为他的插图画和他的名片一样令人印象深刻。在政府工作人员和其他大型公私机构使用的那些简单又普通的名片中，它显得很突出。

translation.en: I agree . Business cards are great tools for promoting personal business . It won ’ t take much time to design an amazing card , but it can make a big difference among the crowd . And you ’ ll always notice it from your collection . For they have outspoken colors , own design and the sizes are not always according the mainstream business card . I wish to have one like this . But for sure our company has its own corporate design which all employees have to follow .
translation.zh: 我同意。名片是促进个人业务的极好工具。设计一张令人惊叹的卡片不需要太多时间，但它可以在人群中产生巨大的影响。在名片册中，你总能注意到它。因为它们有突出的颜色，自己的设计图样，而且大小总是和主流名片不一样。我想要一个这样的。但可以肯定的是，我们公司有自己的企业设计图样，所有员工都必须遵循。

translation.en: Do you sometimes feel overwhelmed by your work ?
translation.zh: 你有时会被工作压得喘不过气来吗？

translation.en: Of course ! It is the No . 1 stressor in my life . You know job stress has become a very common problem these days . So we must learn to cope with it .
translation.zh: 当然！工作是我生活中的主要压力来源。你知道现在工作压力已经成为一个非常普遍的问题了。所以我们必须学会处理它。

translation.en: Totally agree . What is your solution ?
translation.zh: 完全同意。你的情况是怎样的？

translation.en: Well , there are two causes of job stress . One is employee characteristic and the other is company condition . So if we want to manage job stress , both we and the companies should do something . For me , I am trying to balance work and leisure time . You know , all work and no play make Jack a dull boy .
translation.zh: 嗯，工作压力有两个原因。一个是员工的性格，另一个是公司条件。因此，如果我们要处理工作压力，我们和公司都应该做些什么。对我来说，我一直在努力平衡工作时间和闲暇时间。你知道，只工作不玩耍会使人变迟钝。

translation.en: You seem to have a very relaxed outlook .
translation.zh: 你看起来似乎很放松。

translation.en: It is necessary . Positive attitude helps to prevent stress .
translation.zh: 这是有必要的。积极的态度可以防止压力。

translation.en: But I don ’ t think we can change our working condition . Anyway , we are not the bosses .
translation.zh: 但我认为我们不能改变工作条件。不管怎样，我们不是老板。

translation.en: I heard some companies are providing stress management training and making changes inside them , like avoiding unrealistic deadlines and organizing relaxation activities . Our boss is a smart person . He will be learning from that if he would like to an efficient and healthy team .
translation.zh: 我听说一些公司提供了压力管理培训，进行内部改变，比如避免提出不切实际的工作期限，组织娱乐活动。我们老板是个聪明人。如果他想要一支高效、健康的团队，他就会一直从中学习。

translation.en: I can't believe you wear jeans to the office ! Are you trying to lose your job ?
translation.zh: 我不敢相信你居然穿牛仔裤去办公室！你想失业吗？

translation.en: Of course not . I'm just observing casual day . On Fridays , the company doesn't require us to wear formal business attire .
translation.zh: 当然不是。我只是在例行休闲日。公司不要求我们在周五穿正式的工作服。

translation.en: Wow ! Nobody told me about that . Won't the relaxed dress code damage the company image ?
translation.zh: 哇！没人告诉过我。着装规范过于宽松不会损害公司形象吗？

translation.en: We don't think so . Casual days are becoming more common , and we believe employees can maintain a professional image without wearing uncomfortable clothes .
translation.zh: 我们不这么认为。休闲日越来越普遍，我们相信员工可以保持职业形象，而不必穿不舒服的衣服。

translation.en: I guess it lets people express their individual tastes . But won't some people abuse it ?
translation.zh: 我觉得这确实能让人们表达他们的个性品位。但不会有人滥用它吗？

translation.en: Not really . Besides , there is a separate dress code for casual day . People can't just wear whatever they want .
translation.zh: 并没有吧。而且，休闲日还有单独的着装规定。大家也不是随便穿什么都行。

translation.en: It seems that a relaxed atmosphere could hinder productivity .
translation.zh: 但似乎轻松的气氛会妨碍生产力。

translation.en: Believe it or not , it has the opposite effect . Employees are actually more productive on casual days .
translation.zh: 信不信由你，结果正好相反。实际上，员工在休闲日的工作效率更高。

translation.en: I come from Greece .
translation.zh: 我来自希腊。

translation.en: It's very pleasant .
translation.zh: 非常宜人。

translation.en: What's the weather like in spring ?
translation.zh: 春天的天气怎么样？

translation.en: It's often windy in March . It's always warm in April and May , but it rains sometimes .
translation.zh: 三月经常刮风。四月和五月一直很暖和，但偶尔会下雨。

translation.en: What's it like in summer ?
translation.zh: 夏天怎么样？

translation.en: It's always hot in June , July and August . The sun shines every day .
translation.zh: 六月、七月和八月一直很很热，每天都是阳光灿烂的。

translation.en: Is it cold or warm in autumn ?
translation.zh: 秋天冷还是暖和？

translation.en: It's always warm in September and October . It's often cold in November and it rains sometimes .
translation.zh: 九月和十月都很暖和。十一月大部分时候都很冷，有时会下雨。

translation.en: It's often cold in December , January and February . It snows sometimes .
translation.zh: 十二月、一月和二月大部分时候都很冷，有时会下雪。

translation.en: Can ’ t you come in and have tea now , Peter ?
translation.zh: 彼得，你现在不能进来喝茶吗？

translation.en: Not yet , I must water the garden first .
translation.zh: 不能，我必须先给花园浇水。

translation.en: Do you have to water it now ?
translation.zh: 你必须现在浇水吗？

translation.en: I ’ m afraid I must . Look at it ! It ’ s terribly dry .
translation.zh: 恐怕我必须（现在浇水）。快看！（花）都快枯萎了。

translation.en: Last summer it was very dry , too . Don ’ t you remember ? I had to water it every day .
translation.zh: 去年夏天也很干燥。你不记得了吗？我不得不每天给花园浇水。

translation.en: Well , I ’ ll have tea by myself . That was quick ! Have you finished already ?
translation.zh: 好吧，我一个人喝茶。太快了！你已经做完了吗？

translation.en: Yes , Look out of the window .
translation.zh: 是的，看看窗外。

translation.en: It ’ s raining . That means you needn ’ t water the garden .
translation.zh: 下雨了。那意味着你不必给花园浇水了。

translation.en: That was a pleasant surprise . It means I can have tea , instead .
translation.zh: 真是个惊喜。我可以喝茶了。

translation.en: Your boyfriend is so considerate to you . When do you plan to marry ?
translation.zh: 你男朋友对你真体贴。你打算什么时候结婚？

translation.en: It ’ s still up in the air . There is something wrong between us .
translation.zh: 这事还悬而未决。我们之间有点不对劲。

translation.en: Once you arrive at the American airport , please call me .
translation.zh: 一旦你到达美国机场，请给我打电话。

translation.en: OK , don ’ t worry about it . I will .
translation.zh: 好吧，别担心。我会的。

translation.en: Darling , the airplane is going to take off . I have to go .
translation.zh: 亲爱的，飞机要起飞了。我得走了。

translation.en: Take care ! I will miss you so much .
translation.zh: 一切小心！我会非常想念你的。

translation.en: Don ’ t throw your weight around . I can ’ t bear you any more .
translation.zh: 别到处乱丢东西。我再也受不了你了。

translation.en: I dare you to say that again .
translation.zh: 你敢再说一遍。

translation.en: It seems that many boys are fighting there .
translation.zh: 似乎有许多男孩在那里打架。

translation.en: Break it up ! I will not permit fighting in this campus .
translation.zh: 停下来！我不允许有人在这个校园里打架。

translation.en: What ’ s your attitude when do wrong things at work ?
translation.zh: 当你在工作中做错事时，你的态度是什么？

translation.en: The buck stops here .
translation.zh: 敢作敢当。

translation.en: I miss grandma . I dreamed about her yesterday .
translation.zh: 我想念奶奶。我昨天梦到她了。

translation.en: Dear , let ’ s drop the subject .
translation.zh: 亲爱的，我们别谈这个话题了。

translation.en: I am so worried about this English contest . I have butterflies in my stomach now !
translation.zh: 我很担心这次英语比赛。我现在心里七上八下的！

translation.en: I have confidence in you . Believe in yourself .
translation.zh: 我对你有信心。相信你自己。

translation.en: I am sorry . I didn ’ t accomplish the job on time .
translation.zh: 我很抱歉。我没有按时完成工作。

translation.en: That ’ s all right . Everyone feels under the weather sometimes . Just finish the rest when you feel well .
translation.zh: 没关系。每个人都有效率不佳的时候。等你效率恢复了，把剩下的工作接着干完就行。

translation.en: I firmly believe that if we invested in funds we could earn a lot of money .
translation.zh: 我坚信，如果我们投资基金，我们可以赚很多钱。

translation.en: All wet.You are such a fool .
translation.zh: 胡说。你真是个傻瓜。

translation.en: I ’ m so surprised to meet you in this remote village . Long time no see .
translation.zh: 我很惊讶在这个偏僻的村子里见到你。好久不见。

translation.en: We are doing Secret Santa at the office again this year .
translation.zh: 今年我们又打算在办公室办秘密圣诞老人活动了。

translation.en: Did you hear about Lulu ?
translation.zh: 你听说露露的事了吗？

translation.en: She and Vic broke up and now she ’ s asked for a transfer .
translation.zh: 她和维克分手了，现在她要求调职。

translation.en: Get out of here ! I didn ’ t even know they were dating !
translation.zh: 竟然要离开这里！我都不知道他们在谈恋爱！

translation.en: No one really did . They were very discreet and professional at the office .
translation.zh: 根本就没有人知道。他们在办公室非常谨慎和专业。

translation.en: Did you see the picture of the guy on the front page of the newspaper this morning ?
translation.zh: 你看到今天早上报纸头版上那个人的照片了吗？

translation.en: No . I haven't had a chance to read the paper yet .
translation.zh: 不。我还没有机会看报纸。

translation.en: you've got to see it . It's an unbelievable picture !
translation.zh: 你得看看。这是一张难以置信的照片！

translation.en: What's so interesting about it ?
translation.zh: 有什么有趣的？

translation.en: Well , this guy fell asleep on the sofa and when he woke up , half his face had been bitten off !
translation.zh: 好吧，这家伙在沙发上睡着了，当他醒来时，他的半张脸被咬掉了！

translation.en: What ? How did that happen ?
translation.zh: 什么？怎么会这样？

translation.en: They think his dog was trying to wake him up and couldn't , so ended up biting him in his face .
translation.zh: 他们认为他的狗想把他叫醒，但没能叫醒，所以最后咬了他的脸。

translation.en: Wow . What does his look like now ?
translation.zh: 哇！他现在长什么样？

translation.en: It looks pretty frightening . He doesn't have any lips , so all you can see are his gums and teeth . Most of his nose and chin are missing too .
translation.zh: 看起来很吓人。他的嘴唇都没有了，所以你只能看到他的牙龈和牙齿。他的大部分鼻子和下巴也不见了。

translation.en: What did he look like before his dog bit his face off ?
translation.zh: 他的狗咬掉他的脸之前他长什么样？

translation.en: He was actually quite handsome . What a shame .
translation.zh: 他其实很帅。真可惜。

translation.en: What's he going to do now ?
translation.zh: 他现在要做什么？

translation.en: It said that he's hoping to get a face transplant , but until then , he's looking forward to Halloween so he isn't the only one wearing a mask .
translation.zh: 据说他希望接受面部移植手术，但在那之前，他很期待万圣节，那样他就不是唯一一个戴面具的人了。

translation.en: My husband and I have thought about it , but we've decided not to have any . They're just too expensive . Besides , with all the news about global warming on the news lately , who knows what kind of Worl
translation.zh: 我和我老公考虑过这个问题，但是我们决定不要。养小孩太贵了。此外，最近电视和广播中总是全有全球变暖的问题，谁知道我们未来的世界是怎样的呢。你呢？

translation.en: Well , I've always wanted to have lots of children . Growing up with only one brother , I always felt a bit lonely . What do you think about families with only one child ?
translation.zh: 嗯，我一直想有很多孩子。我和一个哥哥一起长大，总觉得有点孤独。你觉得只有一个孩子的家庭怎么样？

translation.en: For me , growing up in a big family always made me yearn for attention . I always wanted to be an only child so that I could always do what I wanted and so that I wouldn't ever have to share .
translation.zh: 对我来说，在一个大家庭里长大总是让我渴望被关注。我一直想成为一个独生子，这样我就可以一直做我想做的事，也不必和别人分享了。

translation.en: Don't you think you would miss having other people around ?
translation.zh: 你不觉得你会想念身边有其他人吗？

translation.en: No way ! I spent 20 years of my life with relatives around me 24-7 . You know , I don't think I've ever actually spent any time by myself in my parents ' home . What do you think fo the one-child policy
translation.zh: 一点也不！我过了20年一周24小时都有亲人围在身边的生活。你知道的，实际上我认为在我父母的家里我从来没有过过自己的生活。你怎么看待独生子女政策？

translation.en: If China didn't have such a policy , can you imagine how many people there would be in China now ?
translation.zh: 如果中国没有这样的政策，你能想象现在中国会有多少人吗？

translation.en: That's true . But as a woman , I'm glad that even though I don't want any children , I at least have a choice in how many children I have . On the other hand , I can't imagine what China would be like
translation.zh: 那确实。但是作为一个女人，我很高兴，即使我不想要小孩，我至少也可以选择要多少个小孩。另一方面，我不能想像如果中国没有独生子女政策，中国会变成什么样子。

translation.en: I don't know what other people think , but I , for one , envy only children !
translation.zh: 我不知道别人怎么想，但我，就我个人而言，我就嫉妒独生子女！

translation.en: Come on . Don ’ t cheat on me . It ’ s a long shot .
translation.zh: 哎呀。别骗我。这是不可能的。

translation.en: It ’ s true . You should be happy about that .
translation.zh: 这是真的。你应该为此感到高兴。

translation.en: Come on . All of us are waiting for you .
translation.zh: 快点。我们都在等你呢。

translation.en: Oh , sorry . Cross my fingers .
translation.zh: 哦，对不起，算我幸运。

translation.en: You have been staying at home for several days . Would you like to hang out with me ?
translation.zh: 你已经在家呆了好几天了。你愿意和我一起出去玩吗？

translation.en: No problem . Wait a moment .
translation.zh: 没问题。稍等一会儿。

translation.en: the air quality in this city is horrendous ! The pollution levels were so high that we weren't supposed to go outside with a face mask again !
translation.zh: 这个城市的空气质量糟透了！污染程度太高了，我们不应该再戴着口罩出门了！

translation.en: exhaust fumes from vehicles cause a great deal of damage to the environment .
translation.zh: 汽车排放的废气对环境造成很大的破坏。

translation.en: on top of that , there are a few large chemical factories in the suburbs , which are contributing to the high pollution levels in the water and the air in this city .
translation.zh: 除此之外，郊区还有几家大型化工厂，造成了本市水和空气的严重污染。

translation.en: as much as I love this city , I think I'm going to have to find a greener city to live in . Living in a polluted city like this just can't be good for my health .
translation.zh: 虽然我很喜欢这座城市，但我想我得找个更环保的城市住。住在这样一个污染严重的城市对我的健康没有好处。

translation.en: I know what you mean . However , there are so few places left that have not been affected by global warming . If it's not the pollution , then it's the natural disasters , deforestation , or the greenhouse
translation.zh: 我知道你的意思。然而，没有受到全球变暖影响的地方所剩无几。如果不是污染，那就是自然灾害、森林砍伐或温室效应

translation.en: what is the greenhouse effect exactly ?
translation.zh: 温室效应到底是什么？

translation.en: it's the gradual rise in the earth's temperature .
translation.zh: 就是地球温度逐渐升高。

translation.en: they're related to one another , yes .
translation.zh: 是的，他们是有关联的。

translation.en: people joke about the benefits of the increase in temperature , but it's not all good news . They've been experiencing a lot of deadly storms there as well .
translation.zh: 人们开玩笑说了一些气温升高的好处，但也不全是好消息，他们也经历了很多致命的风暴。

translation.en: people always seem to make jokes as a way to deal with unfortunate situations .
translation.zh: 人们似乎总是拿开玩笑来应对不幸的情况。

translation.en: what happened ? Why didn't he win ?
translation.zh: 发生什么事了？他为什么没赢？

translation.en: didn't you hear ? He was disqualified .
translation.zh: 你没听见吗？他被取消了资格。

translation.en: how did that happen ? He's so talented ! I thought he had a great chance of winning a gold medal !
translation.zh: 怎么会这样？他那么优秀！我以为他很有可能赢得金牌！

translation.en: if he didn't have any drug problems , he would have won .
translation.zh: 如果他没有出现药物问题，他应该已经赢了。

translation.en: what ? What kind of drugs was he using ?
translation.zh: 什么？他服用了哪种类型的药物？

translation.en: he was taking steroids to make him stronger and faster .
translation.zh: 他服用了类固醇类的药物为了让自己跑得更快，更有力。

translation.en: I thought that all athletes were supposed to be regularly tested for drugs .
translation.zh: 我觉得所有运动员都应该定期接受药检。

translation.en: they are . The reason why they didn't disqualify him until after the race is because the results from the text only came back afterwards .
translation.zh: 是的，这次之所以在比赛之后才取消他的资格就是因为药检的结果出来的晚了。

translation.en: that's so disappointing . I don't know why top athletes would feel the need to take drugs .
translation.zh: 太令人失望了。我不明白为什么顶尖选手还觉得自己需要服用药物。

translation.en: I don't think it's right , but I can understand why they might . Imagine how much pressure there would be to win for your country !
translation.zh: 我觉得这么做不对,但是我可以理解他们这么做的原因。想想为了自己代表的国家能够获胜他们需要承受多大的压力!

translation.en: regardless of how much pressure you're under , there's never a good reason to take drugs .
translation.zh: 不管他们承受了多大的压力，这都不是服用违禁药物的好理由。

translation.en: I agree . Hopefully with the new regulations , fewer athletes will try to cheat with drugs .
translation.zh: 我同意。希望新规定开始执行之后,服药作弊的运动员能少一些.。

translation.en: let's hope so .
translation.zh: 但愿如此。

translation.en: what do you think about the public service advertisement for quiting smoking ?
translation.zh: 你觉得那个戒烟的公益广告怎么样？

translation.en: while I think it's great that they're trying to get people to quit smoking , but I don't really care for the advertisement .
translation.zh: 虽然我认为他们试图让人们戒烟是件好事，但我并不太喜欢那个喜欢广告。

translation.en: the fish hook that they use is quite disturbing !
translation.zh: 他们用的鱼钩真让人觉得不舒服！

translation.en: it's a pun . They use the fish hook to make you think about how you can get hooked on smoking .
translation.zh: 这是双关语。他们用鱼钩来让你思考你怎么会对吸烟上瘾。

translation.en: I know , but I think it's not really appropriate for young children .
translation.zh: 我知道，但我觉得这不太适合青少年。

translation.en: I think they're trying to scare the young people so that they don't ever start smoking .
translation.zh: 我想他们是想警告青少年，不要尝试抽烟。

translation.en: all advertisers like to catch young people because they know the meaning of loyalty .
translation.zh: 所有的广告商都喜欢吸引年轻人，因为他们深知品牌忠实度的含义。

translation.en: perhaps you're right , though . Maybe the advertisement would be more effective with adults anyhow .
translation.zh: 也许你是对的。也许这个广告对成年人会更有效。

translation.en: I have nothing against them putting the advertisements in magazines and newspapers that are read by adults , but I don't think they should have their ad on billboards where children can see them .
translation.zh: 我不反对他们把广告放在成人阅读的杂志和报纸上，但我认为他们不应该把广告放在青少年可以看到的广告牌上。

translation.en: that's a good point . I think I was so delighted to see that a billboard was being used to promote health that I didn't think about how children might understand the ad .
translation.zh: 这是一个很好的观点。我想我很高兴看到一个广告牌被用来促进健康，但真不知道青少年对上面的话能理解多少。

translation.en: you have to give them credit , though . It's about time people started becoming more aware of the dangers of smoking .
translation.zh: 不过，你还是得充分承认这个广告。是时候让人们开始意识到吸烟的危害了。

translation.en: it's a lovely day out today , isn't it ?
translation.zh: 今天外面天气真好，是吧？

translation.en: it's beautiful . Enjoy it while it lasts . It's supposed to get cold tomorrow .
translation.zh: 很好。尽情享受吧。明天应该会降温。

translation.en: what's the weather forecast for tomorrow ?
translation.zh: 明天的天气预报怎么说?

translation.en: it's supposed to snow early tomorrow morning and then tomorrow afternoon there's a chance of freezing rain .
translation.zh: 明天一早应该会下雪，下午有可能下冻雨。

translation.en: that doesn't sound pretty .
translation.zh: 听起来不太好。

translation.en: do you have any plans for tomorrow ?
translation.zh: 你明天有什么打算吗？

translation.en: well , I was going to drive to Birmingham to see some friends .
translation.zh: 我本来打算开车去伯明翰看朋友的。

translation.en: you might want to change your plans . With the cold and wet weather that we're supposed to have tomorrow , the roads are going to be rather slippery .
translation.zh: 你大概要改主意了。明天天气又冷又湿，路会很滑。

translation.en: if you're lucky , it'll get cancelled and you can have a snow day !
translation.zh: 如果你走运的话，也许课会取消，那样你就可以看雪景了！

translation.en: if that happens , then I'll invite you over and we can drink hot cocoa and watch movies .
translation.zh: 如果真是那样的话，我就可以请你到我家喝杯热可可，然后看电影。

translation.en: that sounds like fun .
translation.zh: 听起来很有趣。

translation.en: hey , look outside ! It's started to drizzle !
translation.zh: 嘿，看看外面！开始下毛毛雨了！

translation.zh: 嗨，杰克，我们今晚有个聚会，想过来玩吗？你可以带你女朋友蒂娜来。

translation.en: I don't have a girlfriend . I'm single .
translation.zh: 我没有女朋友。我单身。

translation.en: Oh , that's right . Well , there are going to be many beautiful girls at the party tonight , anyway .
translation.zh: 哦，这样啊。好吧，不管怎么说，今晚的聚会上会有很多美女。

translation.en: No , I like being single . I never thought lonely , I'm focus on my career . Maybe I'll start to look for my girl when I achieve success .
translation.zh: 不，我喜欢单身得状态。我从不觉得孤独，因为我专注于我的事业。也许当我成功的时候，我才会开始寻找我的另一半。

translation.en: Because I'm living a real world , a man enriched have a good career and make a lot of money . Franklin speaking the girls I've met wounldn't married a man wounldn't make enough money .
translation.zh: 因为我的生活很现实，就是一个富有的男人有一个好的事业，赚很多钱。富兰克林说过，他见过的女孩不会嫁给一个赚不到足够多钱的男人。

translation.en: I agree , a man needs good career.But that doesn't mean he should have a little fun , too .
translation.zh: 我同意，一个人需要好的事业，但这并不意味着他就不应该享受一点乐趣。

translation.en: Ten to nine .
translation.zh: 差十分钟到九点。

translation.en: Your watch is ten minutes slow . So it's should be nine sharp . I'm gonna be late again . What will be my excuse this time ? It should be set the alarm for seven thirty .
translation.zh: 你的表慢了十分钟。所以应该是九点整。我又要迟到了。这次我要找什么借口呢，我们应该把闹钟设到7点半。

translation.en: Don't cry over spilled milk , Fred ? Could you stay with me a few minutes ?
translation.zh: 不要做无用的后悔了。弗雷德？你能和我呆几分钟吗？

translation.en: What ? Why ? What's wrong with you ?
translation.zh: 什么？为什么？你怎么了？

translation.en: I just hate being alone at home with nothing to do about listen to the clock ticking.It ' s so lonely and boring . My sickness makes it worse . When will I recover ?
translation.zh: 我只是讨厌一个人在家听着钟表滴滴答答，无事可做。好孤单好无聊啊。再加上我现在生病，就更糟了，我什么时候才能好啊？

translation.en: You will be fine in the couple of month , just be patient . I've got to woke now , I'll be late .
translation.zh: 再过几个月你就会好的，耐心点。我得起床了，不然就要迟到了。

translation.en: You only care about your work .
translation.zh: 你只关心你的工作。

translation.en: Sorry , baby , you are everything to me . all I do just for our family .
translation.zh: 对不起，宝贝，你是我的一切。我所做的一切都是为了我们的家庭。

translation.en: Stay just a few minutes longer , OK ?
translation.zh: 再多呆几分钟，好吗？

translation.en: OK , I'll leave at 9:15 , Is that all right ?
translation.zh: 好的，我9点15出门，可以吗？

translation.zh: 我以后会花更多时间和你在一起的，迪娜。

translation.zh: 下午好，和平饭店，有什么事吗？

translation.zh: 我想预订一个两个人的座位，我和我妻子。

translation.zh: 好的，先生。先生，您想订几点的？

translation.zh: 我不确定。大概晚上8点左右吧。

translation.zh: 朱丽叶，朱丽叶·伯曼。

translation.zh: 谢谢你，伯曼先生。你喜欢吸烟区还是无烟区？

translation.zh: 无烟区。但更重要的是有一张靠窗的桌子。今天是我们的周年纪念日，我想过得特别些。

translation.en: I'll try my best . With a toward to having with this tonight , Mr.Berman .
translation.zh: 我会尽力的。伯曼先生，很高兴今晚你能来我们这里。

translation.zh: 再见，祝你今天愉快。

translation.zh: 嗨，莎莉！你在和一个骄傲的、新生女婴的爸爸说话！

translation.zh: 恭喜你，鲍勃！这真是个好消息，你女儿叫什么名字？

translation.zh: 我们用我妻子祖母的名字给她起了名，叫爱丽丝。

translation.zh: 真是个好听的名字。代我向你妻子问好！

translation.zh: 不怎么担心。我知道这会发生，但如果你从信誉良好的公司购买安全的网站，你应该没事。即使我使用网上购物工具，我也不认为这是购物的最佳方式

translation.zh: 当然。当你在电脑商店的时候。我将参观对面的书店。我喜欢浏览他们的书，看看他们有没有什么有趣的东西。

translation.zh: 我的名字叫杰夫。

translation.zh: 我是个足病医生。你呢？

translation.en: I ’ m a nurse.What do you do in your free time ?
translation.zh: 我是一名护士。你在空闲时间做什么？

translation.en: I like to play piano , go bowling and chat with my friends.And you ?
translation.zh: 我喜欢弹钢琴，打保龄球，和朋友聊天。你呢？

translation.en: I like to hang out with my friends , play games and go swimming .
translation.zh: 我喜欢和我的朋友们出去玩游戏和游泳。

translation.en: Would you like to go out some time ?
translation.zh: 你想找个时间出去吗？

translation.en: Sure , that ’ d be great.Where would you like to go ?
translation.zh: 当然，那太好了。你想去哪里？

translation.en: Anywhere with you .
translation.zh: 和你在一起的任何地方。

translation.en: Aren ’ t you sweet .
translation.zh: 你真可爱。

translation.zh: 这是一个艰难的选择。火车快一点，但要贵得多。

translation.en: Buses are more cramps and you can't walk around .
translation.zh: 公共汽车比较拥挤，而且你不能到处走。

translation.en: That's true.But I feel that I see more when I travel by bus .
translation.zh: 是的。但是我觉得乘公共汽车旅行时我能看到更多的东西。

translation.en: So which form of transport do you prefer to use ?
translation.zh: 那你更喜欢哪种交通方式呢？

translation.en: I prefer going by train , even though it costs more .
translation.zh: 我更愿意坐火车去，尽管要花更多的钱。

translation.en: Ok , then we'll go by train . I'm sure we'll have a good journey.Shall we go to the station and buy the tickets ?
translation.zh: 好吧，那我们坐火车去。我相信我们会一路顺风的。我们去车站买票好吗？

translation.en: The trains aren't usually full.We can get them on the day we travel.We should buy return tickets , because they are much cheaper than getting 2 singles .
translation.zh: 火车通常是坐不满的。旅行当天我们都还可以买到票。我们应该买往返票，因为这比买两张单程票划算得多。

translation.en: We should take a packed lunch on the journey.The food they sell on the trains is always expensive .
translation.zh: 我们应该带一份便当在旅途中翅。火车上卖的食物总是很贵。

translation.zh: 那太糟糕了。飞了多长时间？

translation.zh: 汤姆，你儿子上学了吗？

translation.en: Next week , it ’ s going to be quite a shock for him !
translation.zh: 下周（就要上了），这对他来说会是一个很大的打击！

translation.en: He ’ ll get used to it . They always do . I still remember when my daughter started . Are you going with him on his first day ?
translation.zh: 他会适应的。孩子们都这样，我还记得我女儿当时的样子。第一天你和他一起去吗？

translation.en: You bet . I wouldn ’ t miss it !
translation.zh: 当然。我不会错过的！

translation.zh: 喂，哪位？

translation.zh: 真的吗？什么时间和地点？

translation.zh: 晚上7:30在伦敦中餐厅。如果你需要搭车，我七点到你家接你。

translation.zh: 是的，我需要搭车。到时候我会等你的。

translation.zh: 明天七点见。穿正式点。我听说这家餐厅有点高档。

translation.zh: 琳达，你在读什么？

translation.zh: 我在读一本小说《弗洛斯河上的磨坊》，这是著名小说家乔治的作品。

translation.zh: 这个故事是关于一对兄妹的，他们住在弗洛斯河上的磨坊里。小说描写了这对兄妹的童年以及矛盾导致他们分开，最后他们的结局是快乐的

translation.en: Is it difficult to understand ?
translation.zh: 读着难理解吗？

translation.en: Not really , i would consider it easy .
translation.zh: 并不会，我觉得还挺好理解的。

translation.en: Besides novels , any other types literary works that you indulgence .
translation.zh: 除了小说，你还喜欢其他类型的文学作品吗？

translation.en: I really like short stories .
translation.zh: 我很喜欢短篇小说。

translation.en: Have you read anything else besides literature ?
translation.zh: 除了文学作品，你还读过别的吗？

translation.en: Certainly I have . I like to read books on vary subjects , and i can read everything I can get my hands on in my spare time . I don't want to idle away and waste my time .
translation.zh: 当然有。我喜欢读各种题材的书，而且我会在业余时间读我能读到的任何东西。我不想闲着浪费时间。

translation.en: I agree . People who don't read are no better often people who can't read . I also agree that books are like food for the mind .
translation.zh: 我同意。不读书的人比不识字的人好不到哪儿去。我也觉得书就像是心灵的食物。

translation.en: Kate , you never believe what's happened .
translation.zh: 凯特，你永远不会相信发生了什么。

translation.en: Masha and Hero are getting divorced .
translation.zh: 玛莎和Hero要离婚了。

translation.en: You are kidding . What happened ?
translation.zh: 你在开玩笑。发生什么事了？

translation.en: Well , I don't really know , but I heard that they are having a separation for 2 months , and filed for divorce .
translation.zh: 嗯，我真的不知道，但我听说他们要分居两个月，并提出离婚。

translation.en: That's really surprising . I always thought they are well matched . What about the kids ? Who get custody ?
translation.zh: 这真令人惊讶。我一直认为他们很般配。孩子们呢？谁得到监护权？

translation.en: Masha , it seems quiet and makable , no quarrelling about who get the house and stock and then contesting the divorce with other details worked out .
translation.zh: 玛莎，这看起来很平和，也很可行，没有为谁得到房子和股票而争吵，在解决了其他细节后离婚。

translation.en: That's the change from all the back stepping we usually hear about . Well , I still can't believe it , Masha and Hero , the perfect couple . When would they divorce be final ?
translation.zh: 这是我们通常听到的所有后退的改变。我还是不敢相信，玛莎和Hero，完美的一对。他们什么时候离婚？

translation.en: Early in the New Year I guess .
translation.zh: 我想是在新年初吧。

translation.en: Here's some flowers , love . Happy Valentine's Day .
translation.zh: 这是一些花，亲爱的。情人节快乐。

translation.en: Those are beautiful . They smell lovely . Thank you .
translation.zh: 它们很漂亮。闻起来也很香。非常感谢。

translation.en: This is let you know that I still you after all this years . I knew there are some up and down when I married you , but through at all , you've always been may my Valentine .
translation.zh: 送你这花是为了让你知道这么多年了，我依然爱你。当我嫁给你的时候，我就知道会遇到一些困难，但不管怎样，你一直都是我的爱人。

translation.en: Oh , sweet . You've always been my love too .
translation.zh: 哦，太好了。你也一直是我的至爱。

translation.en: I don't think I say this enough , but I want to thank you for your kind listen patience , you ' Ve always been there for me .
translation.zh: 我很少说，但我还是要感谢你的耐心，是你一直陪在我身边。

translation.en: I'll do everything for you , love . You know that , maybe you didn't realize , but you made everyday a enjoys moment and happy occasion .
translation.zh: 我会为你做一切的，亲爱的。你知道吗，也许你没有意识到，但是正是你让我的每一天都是快乐的。

translation.en: I am so glad we met one another .
translation.zh: 我很高兴我们相遇了。

translation.en: Merry Christmas , Bill .
translation.zh: 圣诞快乐，比尔。

translation.en: Merry Christmas , Jina .
translation.zh: 圣诞快乐，吉娜。

translation.en: What are you doing there on the computer ?
translation.zh: 你在电脑旁做什么？

translation.en: Come have a look , I received many beautiful e-cards . They are from my friends , all over the world . Christmas wishes for all my friends .
translation.zh: 过来看看，我收到了很多漂亮的电子贺卡。来自我全世界的朋友给我的圣诞祝福。

translation.en: That's pretty interesting . Did you get one from Haven ? The reason I ask is that I am looking for her number .
translation.zh: 这很有趣。你有哈文的电子贺卡吗？我问这个的原因是我在找她的电话号码。

translation.en: Sorry , I don't have it . But I do have her Email . You want me to sent it to you ?
translation.zh: 对不起，我没有。但我有她的电子邮件地址。你要我发给你吗？

translation.en: Yeah , that would be great . Thanks .
translation.zh: 是的，那太好了。谢谢。

translation.en: No worries . I just for her card . And you can get her from Email . I would really like to talk to her again . I kind of miss her a little this days .
translation.zh: 别担心。我只是给你她的名片。你可以通过电子邮件找到她。我真的很想再和她谈谈。这几天我有点想她。

translation.en: Thanks million .
translation.zh: 万分谢谢。

translation.en: Oh , hello , Tom ! Beautiful day , isn ’ t it ?
translation.zh: 哦，你好，汤姆！天气真好，不是吗？

translation.en: Yes , it is !
translation.zh: 是的，的确如此！

translation.en: Long time no see , George !
translation.zh: 好久不见了，乔治！

translation.en: Yes , a very long time .
translation.zh: 是的，很长时间了。

translation.en: Happy Birthday , this is for you , Brian .
translation.zh: 生日快乐，这是给你的，布莱恩。

translation.en: I'm so happy you remember , please come in and enjoy the party . Everyone's here , I'm sure you have a good time .
translation.zh: 我很高兴你还记得我的生日，请进来享受这个聚会吧。大家都来了，我相信你们会玩得很开心。

translation.en: Brian , may I have a pleasure to have a dance with you ?
translation.zh: 布莱恩，我能和你跳支舞吗？

translation.en: This is really wonderful party .
translation.zh: 这真是个很棒的聚会。

translation.en: Yes , you are always popular with everyone . and you look very pretty today .
translation.zh: 是的，你总是受到大家的欢迎。你今天看起来很漂亮。

translation.en: Thanks , that's very kind of you to say . I hope my necklace goes with my dress , and they both make me look good I feel .
translation.zh: 谢谢，你这么说真是太好了。我希望我的项链和我的裙子相配，它们都能让我看起来很好。

translation.en: You look great , you are absolutely glowing .
translation.zh: 你看起来棒极了，容光焕发。

translation.en: Thanks , this is a fine party . We should have a drink together to celebrate your birthday
translation.zh: 谢谢，这是一个很好的聚会。我们应该一起喝一杯庆祝你的生日。

translation.en: What's the name of the girl that has just passed us ?
translation.zh: 刚刚经过我们身边的那个女孩叫什么名字？

translation.en: Her name is Rose.Why ?
translation.zh: 她叫罗斯。怎么了？

translation.en: She's so pretty . I'd like to make friends with her .
translation.zh: 她真漂亮。我想和她交朋友。

translation.en: Oh , shut up.She ' s already got married .
translation.zh: 哦，闭嘴。她已经结婚了。

translation.en: Which one of them is Marys brother ?
translation.zh: 谁是玛丽的哥哥？

translation.en: The one with a very big nose .
translation.zh: 鼻子很大的那个。

translation.en: I'd like to meet him.Will you introduce him to me ?
translation.zh: 我想认识一下他。你能把他介绍给我吗？

translation.en: I believe we ' Ve met before . My name's David .
translation.zh: 我感觉我们以前见过。我叫大卫。

translation.en: Yes , at your company , I think . I'm Frank .
translation.zh: 是的，应该是在你们公司。我是弗兰克。

translation.en: Oh , I remember now.Very nice to meet you again .
translation.zh: 哦，我想起来了。很高兴再次见到你。

translation.en: I don't think you've met my sister , Mary .
translation.zh: 我想你没见过我妹妹，玛丽。

translation.en: No , I haven't had the pleasure .
translation.zh: 是啊，我没有这个荣幸。

translation.en: Come and meet her now .
translation.zh: 快来见见她。

translation.en: How are you doing , Jim ?
translation.zh: 你好吗，吉姆？

translation.en: Fine , just fine.How about you ?
translation.zh: 嗯，很好。你呢？

translation.en: Excuse me , are you Jane ?
translation.zh: 不好意思，你是简吗？

translation.en: No , I'm Mary .
translation.zh: 不，我是玛丽。

translation.en: Oh , are you in Class Four ?
translation.zh: 哦，你在四班吗？

translation.en: No , I'm in Class There .
translation.zh: 不，我在三班。

translation.en: Mike , you're seventeen years old , right ?
translation.zh: 迈克，你十七岁了，对吧？

translation.en: Yeah , Why ?
translation.zh: 是啊，怎么了？

translation.en: You look quite mature beside your cousin who is eighteen .
translation.zh: 你和你十八岁的表哥比起来，显得很成熟。

translation.en: Tom , it's time for you to go to bed .
translation.zh: 汤姆，你该睡觉了。

translation.en: Good night , mum .
translation.zh: 晚安，妈妈。

translation.en: Why didn't you go to school yesterday ?
translation.zh: 你昨天为什么不去上学？

translation.en: I stayed home because I wasn't feeling well .
translation.zh: 因为我身体不舒服，就待在家里了。

translation.en: What was your problem ?
translation.zh: 你怎么了？

translation.en: My stomach was bothering me .
translation.zh: 我胃疼。

translation.en: Are you feeling any better ?
translation.zh: 你现在感觉好些了吗？

translation.en: I'm still feeling a little sick .
translation.zh: 我还是觉得有点不舒服。

translation.en: I'm going to the store , would you like any Pesto Pistol ?
translation.zh: 我要去商店，你想要点香蒜酱手枪吗？

translation.en: I'd appreciate that .
translation.zh: 万分感谢。

translation.en: Do you have any cars available ?
translation.zh: 你们有现车吗？

translation.en: We have only one mid-size car left .
translation.zh: 我们只剩下一辆中型车了。

translation.en: Great , what's the rate per day ?
translation.zh: 太好了，每天多少钱？

translation.en: It's 40 $ plus tax per day on limited mileage .
translation.zh: 每天有限的里程加41美元的税。

translation.en: I'm going to need it for three days .
translation.zh: 我要用三天。

translation.en: Can I see your driver's license ?
translation.zh: 我能看看你的驾照吗？

translation.en: Sure , here is my driver's license .
translation.zh: 当然，这是我的驾照。

translation.en: Please sign here .
translation.zh: 请在这里签名。

translation.en: Every honored guests , welcome to Hang Thou . Now we are visiting Tiger-running Spring .
translation.zh: 各位嘉宾，欢迎光临杭州。现在我们正在参观虎跑泉。

translation.en: How can we relate tiger to this spot , Miss Zhang ?
translation.zh: 张小姐，我们怎么能把老虎和这个地方联系起来呢？

translation.en: Its name originates from a legend that two tigers run here and made a hole , and then a spring gushed out from it .
translation.zh: 它的名字来源于一个传说，两只老虎跑在这里，打出了一个洞，然后就有泉水从里面涌出来了。

translation.en: How ignorant I am !
translation.zh: 我真无知！

translation.en: The Longing Tea and the Tiger-running Spring water are always considered as the “ Two Wonders in West Lake . ”
translation.zh: “龙井茶”和“虎跑泉水”历来被誉为“西湖两大奇观”

translation.en: I know that tea . It smells fragrant .
translation.zh: 我知道那种茶。闻起来很香。

translation.en: That's right . All my guests , attention please . We will have half an hour to visit the spring and take photos . And next spot will be the Moon Reflected in Three Pools .
translation.zh: 是的。各位来宾请注意。我们将有半个小时的时间参观虎跑泉并拍照。下一个景点是三潭映月。

translation.en: Janice , David , come here . We take some photos here . I can't imagine how beautiful it is !
translation.zh: 珍妮丝，大卫，快过来。我们在这里拍一些照片。简直太美了！

translation.en: It was nice talking to you .
translation.zh: 很高兴和你谈话。

translation.en: Why are you trying to rush me off the phone ?
translation.zh: 你为什么要催我挂电话？

translation.en: I really have to go .
translation.zh: 我真的得挂了。

translation.en: Why ? I still wanted to talk to you .
translation.zh: 为什么？我还是想和你谈谈。

translation.en: I have things to do .
translation.zh: 我有事情要做。

translation.en: Don't be nosey .
translation.zh: 别多管闲事。

translation.en: I'm not . I just want to know .
translation.zh: 我不是。我只是想知道。

translation.en: Well , it's really none of your business .
translation.zh: 嗯，这真的不关你的事。

translation.en: That's harsh .
translation.zh: 太小气了。

translation.en: I'm sorry , but I have to go .
translation.zh: 对不起，我得挂了。

translation.en: Oriental China Airlines . Good morning , may I help you ?
translation.zh: 这里是东方航空。早上好，请问您有什么事吗？

translation.en: I would like the round-way ticket to Shanghai on December 10th .
translation.zh: 我想要12月10日去上海的往返票。

translation.en: Lady , let me check . Do you want the morning or the afternoon flight ?
translation.zh: 女士，我看一下。您是要上午的航班还是下午的航班？

translation.en: What's the departure time ?
translation.zh: 什么时候出发？

translation.en: Well , the afternoon will be fine .
translation.zh: 嗯，下午的就行。

translation.en: First class or economy ?
translation.zh: 头等舱还是经济舱？

translation.en: First class will be preferred .
translation.zh: 头等舱好一点。

translation.en: Well , afternoon flight on December 10th to Shanghai . May I have your name , please ?
translation.zh: 好的，12月10日下午飞往上海的航班。请问您叫什么名字？

translation.en: My name is Janice . Well , I book this ticket for Nova , the marketing manager of Pineapple Computer Company . Where can I get the flight ticket ?
translation.zh: 我叫珍妮丝。嗯，这张票是我给菠萝电脑公司的市场经理诺娃订的。我在哪能取到机票？

translation.en: You may take it up at the ticket office . That is located on International Street 150 .
translation.zh: 你可以到售票处去取。售票处位于国际街150号。

translation.en: Oh hi , Linda , this is Todd .
translation.zh: 嗨，琳达，我是托德。

translation.en: Yes , Todd , how nice to hear your voice !
translation.zh: 啊，托德，听到你的声音真好！

translation.en: Linda , I just wanted to say that I had a wonderful evening with you last Friday .
translation.zh: 琳达，我只想说上周五我和你度过了一个美好的夜晚。

translation.en: I really enjoyed our evening together , Todd .
translation.zh: 我真的很享受我们在一起的夜晚，托德。

translation.en: I had fun also and was wondering if you would like to go hiking with me in the mountains on Saturday .
translation.zh: 我也过的很开心，你愿意周六和我一起去爬山吗？

translation.en: Hiking would be perfect ! May I bring along a picnic lunch for us to share ?
translation.zh: 徒步旅行不错。我可以带上午餐一起分享吗？

translation.en: A picnic lunch would be a nice thing to have along .
translation.zh: 带上午餐会很不错的事。

translation.en: I'll work on the lunch , and you can work out the details of where we will go . What time will you be at my house ?
translation.zh: 我来准备午餐，你可以想想我们将去哪儿。你什么时候来我家接我？

translation.en: Nine would be good , don't you think ?
translation.zh: 你认为九点钟怎样？

translation.en: Nine is good . See you on Saturday !
translation.zh: 九点钟可以，周六见。

translation.en: I would like to take a trip to the beach this weekend .
translation.zh: 这个周末我想去海滩旅行。

translation.en: A trip to the beach would be fun . How is the weather going to be ?
translation.zh: 去海滩旅行会很有趣的。天气怎么样？

translation.en: The forecast says that it will be warm on the weekend .
translation.zh: 天气预报说周末会暖和。

translation.en: So do you think it'll be perfect weather for the beach ?
translation.zh: 那你觉得这是去海滩的好天气吗？

translation.en: It sounds like it will be .
translation.zh: 听起来会的。

translation.en: I really hope it doesn't get cold .
translation.zh: 我真希望天气不要变冷。

translation.en: That would ruin things , I want to go so badly .
translation.zh: 那会毁了一切，我真想去。

translation.en: The weather in California is unpredictable , so you never know .
translation.zh: 加利福尼亚的天气变幻莫测，所以你永远不知道。

translation.en: That is true . The weather is constantly changing .
translation.zh: 这是真的。天气在不断变化。

translation.en: It would be nice if the weather would never change .
translation.zh: 如果天气永远不变就好了。

translation.en: That would be great , then we could plan things sooner .
translation.zh: 那太好了，我们可以早点计划。

translation.en: True . Predictable weather would make life easier .
translation.zh: 是的。可预测的天气会使生活更轻松。

translation.en: Have you attended school today ?
translation.zh: 你今天上学了吗？

translation.en: I attended school today . Did you ?
translation.zh: 我今天上学了。你呢？

translation.en: I wasn't able to attend school because I was feeling ill .
translation.zh: 我生病了，没去上学。

translation.en: I'm sorry to hear that . Would you like the assignments from English class ?
translation.zh: 听到这个消息我很难过。你想要知道英语课的作业吗？

translation.en: I would really appreciate that , thanks .
translation.zh: 我太感激你了，谢谢。

translation.en: If you get sick , I'll return the favor .
translation.zh: 如果你生病了，我也会帮你的。

translation.en: Thanks . See you at school tomorrow if you feel better .
translation.zh: 谢谢。如果你感觉好些的话，明天学校见。

translation.en: I haven't told you what happened yet , have I ?
translation.zh: 我还没告诉你发生了什么，是吗？

translation.en: My boss offered me a promotion , and I took it .
translation.zh: 我老板给我升职了，我接受了。

translation.en: Yes , I am really excited .
translation.zh: 是的，我真的很兴奋。

translation.en: That's great . Congratulations .
translation.zh: 太好了。祝贺你。

translation.en: You have no idea how happy I am for you .
translation.zh: 你不知道我有多为你高兴。

translation.en: I believe you were the best choice for that promotion . I really do .
translation.zh: 我觉得你是升职的最佳人选。我真的这么认为。

translation.en: Would you like some more coffee ?
translation.zh: 你想再来点咖啡吗？

translation.en: No thanks . I'm full . We need to find our waitress and get our bill .
translation.zh: 不用了，谢谢。我吃饱了。我们得找服务员拿账单。

translation.en: Good luck finding the waitress !
translation.zh: 祝你能够找到服务员！

translation.en: The service this evening has kind of sucked . Is that our server over there ?
translation.zh: 今晚的服务有点糟啊。那个是我们的服务员吗？

translation.en: I'll go get the check , since our server doesn't seem to be headed this way .
translation.zh: 我去拿账单，因为我们的服务员好像没有往这边走。

translation.en: Good . I'll just stay here until you get back .
translation.zh: 好。我就呆在这儿等你回来。

translation.en: So the total is $ 36.00 for our dinner .
translation.zh: 我们的晚餐总共是36美元。

translation.en: How much of a tip do you think our waitress deserves ?
translation.zh: 你认为我们的女服务员应该得到多少小费？

translation.en: I wonder if no tip would be appropriate in light of the service .
translation.zh: 我不知道从服务的角度看，给她小费是否合适。

translation.en: I kind of feel the same way , but they may have just been really short-staffed tonight .
translation.zh: 我也有同感，但他们今晚可能真的人手不够。

translation.en: I think that we should leave 10 % .
translation.zh: 我认为我们应该给10%。

translation.en: $ 3.60 will be the right amount for the tip .
translation.zh: 给3.60美元的小费是合适的。

translation.en: Have you seen the new girl in school ?
translation.zh: 你在学校见过那个新来的女孩吗？

translation.en: She's really pretty .
translation.zh: 她真的很漂亮。

translation.en: Describe her to me .
translation.zh: 给我描述一下。

translation.en: She's not too tall .
translation.zh: 她不太高。

translation.en: Well , how tall is she ?
translation.zh: 嗯，她有多高？

translation.en: She's about 5 feet even .
translation.zh: 她身高约5英尺。

translation.en: What does she look like , though ?
translation.zh: 那她长什么样？

translation.en: She has pretty light brown eyes .
translation.zh: 她有一双漂亮的浅棕色眼睛。

translation.en: I may know which girl you're talking about .
translation.zh: 我可能知道你说的是哪个女孩。

translation.en: So you have seen her around ?
translation.zh: 你在附近见过她？

translation.en: I think that you look very cute today .
translation.zh: 我觉得你今天看起来很漂亮。

translation.en: Is that right ? This is a brand new outfit .
translation.zh: 是这样吗？我穿了一套新衣服。

translation.en: What store did you get it from ?
translation.zh: 你从哪家店买的？

translation.en: I went to Macy's and picked it out .
translation.zh: 我在梅西百货买的。

translation.en: I love your outfit right now .
translation.zh: 我喜欢你现在的打扮。

translation.en: Well , I think you look nice today too .
translation.zh: 我觉得你今天看起来也不错。

translation.en: Thanks . I found these new shoes earlier at the store .
translation.zh: 谢谢。我前段时间在商店里发现了这双新鞋。

translation.en: I think that those are some really nice shoes . What kind are they ?
translation.zh: 我觉得这双鞋真不错。它们是什么类型的？

translation.en: These are Chucks .
translation.zh: 这些是卡克。

translation.en: Your shoes look really nice . How much did you get them for ?
translation.zh: 你的鞋子真好看。你花了多少钱买的？

translation.en: They only cost me about forty dollars .
translation.zh: 只花了大约四十美元。

translation.en: I'm going to go get a pair for myself .
translation.zh: 我也要去给我自己买一双。

translation.en: The waitress is bringing the bill right now .
translation.zh: 服务员正把账单拿过来。

translation.en: This waitress has really been on top of things , hasn't she ?
translation.zh: 这个女服务员真的很周到，不是吗？

translation.en: Yes , this waitress did a great job .
translation.zh: 是的，这个女服务员做得很好。

translation.en: OK , let's see what the damage is . The total for our meal is $ 36.00 .
translation.zh: 好的，让我们看看消费了多少。我们这顿饭总共36美元。

translation.en: What do you think would be the right amount to leave for a tip ?
translation.zh: 你认为给多少小费合适？

translation.en: Fifteen percent is a normal tip , but she really did a great job . What do you think about 20 % this time ?
translation.zh: 15%是一般的小费数量，但她确实做得很好。你觉得这次给20%怎么样？

translation.en: Yes , 20 % would be perfect .
translation.zh: 可以，20%就很不错。

translation.en: Her tip will end up being $ 7.20 plus the bill of $ 36.00 . The total will be $ 43.20 .
translation.zh: 她的小费是7.20美元，加上36.00美元的账单，总共是43.20美元。

translation.en: Yes , that was one fantastic meal !
translation.zh: 是的，真是一顿美餐！

translation.en: I agree . Maybe we can come back again next week .
translation.zh: 我同意。也许我们下周可以再来。

translation.en: Cindy . We were going to try to surprise you for your birthday . But you ’ re just too busy ! Can you tell me when you ’ ll be free ?
translation.zh: 辛迪。我们本来打算给你一个生日惊喜的。但你太忙了！你能告诉我你什么时候有空吗？

translation.en: Oh , Brian . That ’ s really sweet of you guys . I would love to get together with all of you . How about Friday ?
translation.zh: 哦，布莱恩。你们真是太好了。我很想和你们大家聚在一起。星期五怎么样？

translation.en: Great ! What time ?
translation.zh: 太好了！几点？

translation.en: I ’ m free all afternoon . Why don ’ t we meet at 1 o ’ clock in the lobby ?
translation.zh: 我整个下午都有空。我们一点钟在大厅见面怎么样？

translation.en: Good afternoon . I'll show you to your room .
translation.zh: 下午好。我带你去你的房间。

translation.en: Could you tell me which bags are yours ?
translation.zh: 你能告诉我哪些包是你的吗？
