translation.en: Oh , boy ! This is going to be great . I'm going to the gym right now !
translation.zh: 哦，天哪！这很棒。我现在就去健身房！

translation.en: I'm sure you'll enjoy your workout , sir . Everyone seems to like the swim stations .
translation.zh: 我相信你会享受锻炼的，先生。每个人似乎都喜欢游泳站。

translation.en: Recently I have been getting headache and my eyes don't seems to see focus properly .
translation.zh: 最近我一直头痛，我的眼睛似乎无法聚焦。

translation.en: Two years ago . At that time I had no problems.Now I can ’ t even make out something ten meters away .
translation.zh: 两年前。那时我没什么问题，现在我连十米外的东西都认不出来了。

translation.en: Come over here . I will test your eyes . First cover your left eye like this , and when I point , please read the chart from the top , and go as far as you can , telling me which way the “ E ” points .
translation.zh: 过来。我要测试你的眼睛。先这样捂住你的左眼，当我指的时候，请从上面看图表，并尽可能地走远，告诉我“E”指的是哪条路。

translation.en: Good.Now the other eye .
translation.zh: 很好。现在换另一只眼睛。

translation.en: How is the result of your lab test ?
translation.zh: 你的化验结果怎么样？

translation.en: When it comes to that , I have a lot to say .
translation.zh: 说到这个，我有很多话要说。

translation.en: Then say it .
translation.zh: 那就说吧。

translation.en: When I went back to my doctor to hear the results of my lab tests , I tried to keep a poker face even though I was scared to death . Then you guess what he said .
translation.zh: 当我回到我的医生那里听我的化验结果时，我试着保持淡定，尽管我快吓死了。你猜他说了什么。

translation.en: That ’ s just what I want to know .
translation.zh: 这正是我想知道的。

translation.en: He told me the tests were negative and there was nothing wrong with me .
translation.zh: 他告诉我检查结果是阴性的，我没有什么问题。

translation.en: I feel run down , tired . I've been having headaches almost every day . And I'm not getting as much sleep as usually do .
translation.zh: 我觉得筋疲力尽，疲惫不堪。我几乎每天都头痛。而且我的睡眠也不像平时那么多。

translation.en: You'd better have a good rest for a week . Be sure to have regular meals . Stay away from alcohol.Give up smoking at least a little while .
translation.zh: 你最好好好休息一周。一定要有规律的饮食。远离酒精，至少戒烟一段时间。

translation.en: Yes . I'm going to give you some.Take one tablet of this medicine three times a day before meals . For that one , two tablets . And remember to come to the out patient department for a consultation in two weeks , please .
translation.zh: 对。我会给你开一些。饭前吃一片这种药，一天三次。那种药是一次两片。请记住两周后到门诊部会诊。

translation.en: You're welcome . We wish you a speedy recovery.Goodbye .
translation.zh: 不客气。祝你早日康复。再见。

translation.en: Hm ... I think you ' Ve got the flu .
translation.zh: 我想你得了流感。

translation.en: Thank you , Doctor.Goodbye .
translation.zh: 谢谢你，医生。再见。

translation.en: Hi , I need a hotel room .
translation.zh: 嗨，我需要一个酒店房间。

translation.en: That's no problem at all . May I have your name , please ?
translation.zh: 完全没问题。请问您叫什么名字？

translation.en: Certainly . My name is John Sandals .
translation.zh: 好的。我叫约翰·桑德斯。

translation.en: It's a pleasure , Mr . Sandals . My name is Michelle . What days will you need a room ?
translation.zh: 很高兴见到您，桑德斯先生。我叫米歇尔。你需要在这个房间住多少天？

translation.en: Friday afternoon , April 14 through Monday morning , April 17 .
translation.zh: 4月14日星期五下午到4月17日星期一上午。

translation.en: One minor problem , sir . Our prices are now slightly higher . Is that acceptable , sir ?
translation.zh: 有一个小问题，先生。我们的价格现在有些高。请问您可以接受吗，先生？

translation.en: Please tell me the price , so I can make a decision .
translation.zh: 请告诉我价格，这样我才能做决定。

translation.en: It'll be $ 308 nightly .
translation.zh: 每晚308美元。

translation.en: That's a reasonable price .
translation.zh: 这是一个合理的价格。

translation.en: Good ! Now , sir , do you have a preference for smoking or nonsmoking ?
translation.zh: 很好！先生，您喜欢吸烟房还是无烟房？

translation.en: I quit smoking , so nonsmoking .
translation.zh: 我戒烟了，所以不抽烟。

translation.en: I hear you , sir . Nonsmoking . Now , about the bed , is a queen-size okay ?
translation.zh: 我知道了，先生。无烟房。那么大号床可以吗？

translation.en: A queen sounds great .
translation.zh: 听起来不错。

translation.en: Okay , sir , let me reserve those dates , there . Now , if you'll just tell me your phone number .
translation.zh: 好的，先生，让我为您订一下这个日期的房间。现在请告诉我你的电话号码。

translation.en: That would be 626-555-1739 .
That's 626-555-1739 . Thank you so much for choosing our hotel , sir !
translation.zh: 电话号码是626-555-1739。非常感谢您选择我们的酒店，先生！

translation.en: I made a reservation earlier this week , but I have to cancel it .
translation.zh: 我这周早些时候预订了房间，现在我需要取消预订。

translation.en: No problem , sir . Just tell me your name , phone number , and date of reservation .
translation.zh: 没问题，先生。请告诉我您的名字，电话号码和预订日期。

translation.en: Great ! I'm Rudy Randolph , 818-555-1234 , and my reservation was for April 9 to 15 .
translation.zh: 太好了！我是鲁迪·伦道夫，电话号码是818-555-1234，我预订的是4月9日至15日的房间。

translation.en: Okay , sir , let me hit the delete button , and your reservation will be cancelled .
translation.zh: 好的，先生，只要我按一下删除按钮，您的预订就可以取消了。

translation.en: That was nice and fast . Thanks .
translation.zh: 真是又好又快。谢谢。

translation.en: I hate to do this , but I've got to cancel a reservation I made earlier this week .
translation.zh: 我不想这样做，但我得取消本周早些时候预订的房间。

translation.en: All I need is your name , phone , and reservation date .
translation.zh: 我只需要你的名字、电话和预订日期。

translation.en: My name is Rudy Randolph . I'm at 818-555-1234 . The reservation was for April 9 .
translation.zh: 我叫鲁迪·伦道夫。我的电话是818-555-1234。预订时间是4月9日。

translation.en: Randolph , Rudy . Let me hit one button , sir , and now your reservation is cancelled .
translation.zh: 鲁迪，伦道夫。先生，让我按一下按钮，现在您的预订取消了。

translation.en: Okay , thank you . I'll make another reservation as soon as I can .
translation.zh: 好的，谢谢。我会尽快再预订。

translation.en: It's been my pleasure to help you .
translation.zh: 我很乐意帮助你。

translation.en: You're looking rather pale , why ?
translation.zh: 你脸色很苍白，怎么了？

translation.en: I couldn't sleep well recently .
translation.zh: 我最近睡眠不好。

translation.en: You'd get plenty of sleep for you work so hard .
translation.zh: 你工作这么辛苦得有充足的睡眠才行啊。

translation.en: I always drink too much wine in the evening .
translation.zh: 我晚上总是喝太多酒。

translation.en: You shan't drink more wine in the evening .
translation.zh: 你晚上不能再喝酒了。

translation.en: And you'd take some exercise every day .
translation.zh: 然后你可以每天都锻炼身体。

translation.en: Many thanks for your advice .
translation.zh: 非常感谢你的建议。

translation.en: A guy in my office got the flu the other day . Today I seem to have come down with it , too .
translation.zh: 前几天我办公室有个人得了流感。今天我好像也被传染了。

translation.en: Very likely . You have a slight fever . Do you have a headache , too ?
translation.zh: 很有可能。你有点发烧。你也头痛吗？

translation.en: Yes . I wonder if you could do something to help me recover soon , because I'll be on a business trip in two days .
translation.zh: 对。不知道你能不能让我尽快康复，因为我两天后要出差。

translation.en: Well , you have to let your flu run its course . You must stop working and stay in bed to get plenty of rest . Usually it will take 4 to 6 days to make a full recovery .
translation.zh: 嗯，你得让流感顺其自然。你必须停止工作，卧床休息。通常需要4到6天才能完全康复。

translation.en: But I'm going on a business trip in two days !
translation.zh: 但我两天后要出差！

translation.en: Maybe you'll have to cancel it or postpone it . If you go out while you are sick , it won't help you recover . You may even pass your disease on to others .
translation.zh: 也许你得取消或推迟。如果你生病时去出差，对你的康复没有帮助。你甚至可能把你的病传染给别人。

translation.en: Doctor , save my baby , please
translation.zh: 医生，请救救我的孩子

translation.en: He has had a fever for one day . Just now at home , he had febrile convulsions with teeth and fists clenched and eyes turned up . We were at a loss what to do . We called an ambulance and brought the baby here .
translation.zh: 他已经发烧一天了。刚在家时，他还有发热性抽搐，牙关和拳头紧闭，眼睛睁大的症状。我们不知所措。我们叫了一辆救护车把他送来了。

translation.en: How long did the convulsion last ?
translation.zh: 抽搐持续多长时间？

translation.en: About 3 minutes .
translation.zh: 大约3分钟。

translation.en: Does he have any other complaints ?
translation.zh: 他还有别的什么症状吗？

translation.en: Three days ago , he began to cough , sneeze and have a running nose . Yesterday , he began to have a fever .
translation.zh: 三天前，他开始咳嗽，打喷嚏，流鼻涕。昨天，他开始发烧。

translation.en: Have you taken his temperature ?
translation.zh: 你量过他的体温吗？

translation.en: It was 38 ° C this morning and it was 39 ° C just now .
translation.zh: 今天早晨是38℃，现在是39℃。

translation.en: Let me examine him to see if there is any rash . No rash .
translation.zh: 让我检查一下他有没有皮疹。没有皮疹。

translation.en: Is it serious ? Is it meningitis ?
translation.zh: 严重吗？是脑膜炎吗？

translation.en: No , it is not meningitis . Just a high fever and convulsions , which results from a virus upper respiratory tract inflection .
translation.zh: 不，不是脑膜炎。只是高烧和抽搐，这是由上呼吸道感染引起的。

translation.en: Does he have to be admitted to hospital ?
translation.zh: 他必须要住院吗？

translation.en: No . No need for admission . I'll give the baby analgia nose drops to bring down the temperature first . Then I will give you a prescription . The pink tablets are used for his fever . When his temperature is over 38 ° C , give him one tablet . The other tablets are sedatives for his convulsions . The white liquid is for the cold . Give the baby plenty of water to drink .
translation.zh: 不用，不必住院。我给这孩手打安乃近鼻部点滴来退烧。然后我给你开个药方。白药片用来退烧。当他的体温超过38℃时，给他吃一片。其他药片是用来治抽搐的。白色药片用来治感冒。给孩子多喝水。

translation.en: Hello . This is Dr . Galas Office . Can I help you ?
translation.zh: 您好。这里是加拉斯医生的办公室。有什么我能帮助你的吗？

translation.en: Yes . I ’ d like to make an appointment with Dr . Galas . Could you arrange it for me ?
translation.zh: 是的。我想约一下加拉斯医生。你能帮我安排一下吗？

translation.en: Sure . Let me check his schedule . How about tomorrow afternoon at 2:30 ?
translation.zh: 当然。让我查一下他的日程安排。明天下午两点半怎么样？

translation.en: I ’ m not available tomorrow afternoon . How about tomorrow morning ?
translation.zh: 我明天下午没空。明天早上怎么样？

translation.en: I ’ m sorry . Dr . Galas is fully engaged tomorrow morning . How about the day after tomorrow at 9:30 in the morning ?
translation.zh: 对不起。加拉斯博士明早的日程已经排满了。后天上午9:30怎么样？

translation.en: That ’ s fine . Thanks .
translation.zh: 可以。谢谢。

translation.en: You ’ re welcome . Could I have your name and phone number , please ?
translation.zh: 不客气。请问您的姓名和电话号码是什么？

translation.en: Certainly . My name is Janet Smith , and my phone number is 610-555-1234 .
translation.zh: 好的。我叫珍妮特·史密斯，电话号码是610-555-1234。

translation.en: Very good , Ms . Smith . I have scheduled an appointment for you on Wednesday at 9:30 am .
translation.zh: 很好，史密斯女士。我为你安排了一个星期三上午9:30的约会。

translation.en: Would Dr.Black be able to see me at 9:00 a . m . tomorrow ?
translation.zh: 请问我明天上午9点能见到布莱克医生吗？

translation.en: I'm sorry , but she won't have any openings until 11:00 , unless there's a cancellation .
translation.zh: 对不起，除非有人取消预约，否则她11点之前不会有空。

translation.en: Would 1 : OO p . m . be convenient ?
translation.zh: 那下午1点方便吗？

translation.en: Yes , she's free then .
translation.zh: 可以，她那时有空。

translation.en: My wife . She suffers from a bad cold .
translation.zh: 我妻子。她患了重感冒。

translation.en: What symptoms does she have ?
translation.zh: 她有什么症状吗？

translation.en: I see . Don't worry , just a common cold .
translation.zh: 我知道了。别担心，只是普通感冒。

translation.en: What kind of medicine does she need ?
translation.zh: 她需要什么药？

translation.en: Patulin will be enough .
translation.zh: 棒曲霉素就够了。

translation.en: Nine pills per day , and three pills after each meal .
translation.zh: 每天九片，每顿饭后三片。

translation.en: I've got a temperature and my stomach hurts .
translation.zh: 我发烧了，胃痛。

translation.en: You seem to have picked up some kind of infection .
translation.zh: 你好像染上了某种传染病。

translation.en: Take a few days off from work and don't wear yourself out .
translation.zh: 请几天假，别累坏了。

translation.en: O . K . , O . K . , I ’ ll go .
translation.zh: 行，行，我去就是了。

translation.en: Good . You'll feel better after you do .
translation.zh: 很好。你做了以后会感觉好些的。

translation.en: How do I use this adhesive ?
translation.zh: 我怎样使用这种粘合剂？

translation.en: This is a special adhesive for easing the pain . Apply it to the painful area and change it in every 2 days .
translation.zh: 这是一种缓解疼痛的特殊粘合剂。敷于疼痛部位，每2天更换一次。

translation.en: How do I use the lotion ?
translation.zh: 那这种洗液呢？

translation.en: Apply some of the ointment , and rub it into the skin .
translation.zh: 取一些药膏，揉搓使皮肤吸收。

translation.en: I think I caught a cold .
translation.zh: 我想我感冒了。

translation.en: Do you have any symptoms ?
translation.zh: 你有什么症状吗？

translation.en: Runny nose and coughing .
translation.zh: 流鼻涕和咳嗽。

translation.en: I have just taken the temperature , I don't think so .
translation.zh: 我刚量过体温，我想应该没有。

translation.en: It's not serious .
translation.zh: 这不严重。

translation.en: You should drink more hot water , and do some exercise .
translation.zh: 你应该多喝些热水，适当做些运动。

translation.en: Excuse me . My name is Dan Ford . I have an appointment with the dentist at 3:30 .
translation.zh: 打扰一下。我叫丹·福特。我约好3:30看牙医。

translation.en: Yes , Mr . Ford . The dentist will be ready to see you in a minute . Have a seat .
translation.zh: 是的，福特先生。牙医马上就要来给你看病了。请坐。

translation.en: My toothache started nearly a month ago . The pain's been keeping me awake . Would you please have a look ?
translation.zh: 我的牙痛大约一个月前就开始了。晚上痛得睡不着觉。请你帮我检查 一下好吗？

translation.en: Open your mouth , please . Which one ?
translation.zh: 请张开嘴。哪颗牙？

translation.en: The one right at the back .
translation.zh: 就是最后面的那颗。

translation.en: I'm afraid we can ’ t save that one . It will have to come out .
translation.zh: 这颗牙恐怕保不住了，得拔掉它。

translation.en: Will it hurt much ?
translation.zh: 会痛吗？

translation.en: I'll give you an injection , then you won't feel pain .
translation.zh: 我会给你打一针，这样你就不感到痛了。

translation.en: ( 5 minutes later ) OK , it's all over . Spit there and bite the cotton ball tightly in place for half an hour .
translation.zh: （5分钟后）好，拔完了。把口水吐掉，把棉球紧咬在伤口上半小时。

translation.en: I need my minibar restocked .
translation.zh: 我的小冰箱需要补货。

translation.en: Everything is gone , sir ?
translation.zh: 东西都没了吗，先生？

translation.en: There's not a drop left of anything .
translation.zh: 什么都没有了。

translation.en: Is there anything in particular you want ?
translation.zh: 您有什么特别想要的吗？

translation.en: Yes , the Perrier and the Jim Beam hit the spot . Let me have three more of each .
translation.zh: 有，毕雷矿泉水和占边威士忌就好。请每种给我三瓶。

translation.en: Got it . Anything else ?
translation.zh: 知道了。还有别的需要的吗？

translation.en: I really liked the apples . Bring me a couple of apples , please .
translation.zh: 我很喜欢苹果。请再给我拿两个苹果来。

translation.en: Not a problem . Anything else ?
translation.zh: 没问题。还需要别的吗吗？

translation.en: Oh , yes , one more thing
translation.zh: 哦，对了，还有一件事

translation.en: Someone will be up shortly with your order , sir .
translation.zh: 先生，马上会有人给您送上来。

translation.en: I'm in 507 . I have a few problems with my room .
translation.zh: 我在507.我的房间有一些问题。

translation.en: What is that problem , sir ?
translation.zh: 先生，有什么问题？

translation.en: There are cockroaches in my room .
translation.zh: 我房间里有蟑螂。

translation.en: Are you sure , sir ? Flies I could believe , but cockroaches ?
translation.zh: 你确定吗，先生？我可以相信苍蝇，但是蟑螂？

translation.en: I've counted nine different cockroaches , and I accidentally stepped on another one .
translation.zh: 我已经数了有九种不同的蟑螂，还不小心踩在另一只上。

translation.en: Sir , we run a spotless and cockroach-less hotel .
translation.zh: 先生，我们经营的是一家一尘不染的，没有蟑螂的酒店。

translation.en: You dare to doubt me ?
translation.zh: 你敢怀疑我？

translation.en: I'm sorry , sir . Let me transfer you to my supervisor .
translation.zh: 我很抱歉，先生。我把你转给我的主管。

translation.en: I've been looking for a swimming pool , but I haven't found one yet .
translation.zh: 我一直在找游泳池，但没找到。

translation.en: We have no pool , sir , but we do have swim stations in our gym .
translation.zh: 我们没有游泳池，先生，但我们的体育馆里有游泳站。

translation.en: Swim stations ? Could you be a little more explicit ?
translation.zh: 游泳站？你能说得再清楚一点吗？

translation.en: You know how you run on a treadmill but don't go anywhere ? Well , it's the same thing .
translation.zh: 你知道你怎么在跑步机上跑却哪儿也不去吗？嗯，是一样的。

translation.en: Gee , that's a great idea . Now , how much do I have to pay ?
translation.zh: 天啊，真是个好主意。现在，我要付多少钱？

translation.en: The stations are absolutely free to guests , sir .
translation.zh: 游泳站对我们的客人是完全免费的，先生。

translation.en: Great ! Now , when can I go down there and use the stations ?
translation.zh: 太好了！那我什么时候可以去那里使用游泳站？

translation.en: The swim stations are open daily from 7 a . m . to 10 p . m .
translation.zh: 游泳站每天早上七点到晚上十点开放

translation.en: Boy , oh boy ! I can't wait to change into my swim trunks .
translation.zh: 天哪，天哪！我等不及要换上泳裤了。

translation.en: Be warned , sir . At certain hours the swim stations are very crowded .
translation.zh: 请注意，先生。在某些时间段，游泳站会非常拥挤。

translation.en: I have a reservation . My name is John Sandals .
translation.zh: 我有一个预约。我叫约翰·桑德斯。

translation.en: May I see your ID , please , Mr . Sandals ?
translation.zh: 桑德斯先生，请出示您的身份证。

translation.en: Certainly . Here it is .
translation.zh: 当然。给你。

translation.en: Thank you . Do you have a credit card , Mr . Sandals ?
translation.zh: 非常感谢。桑德斯先生，您有信用卡吗？

translation.en: Sorry , sir , just VISA or MasterCard .
translation.zh: 对不起，先生，只能用维萨卡或万事达卡。

translation.en: Okay . Here's my VISA card .
translation.zh: 可以。这是我的维萨卡。

translation.en: Yes , it sounds like everything I expected .
translation.zh: 好的，听起来像我想要的。

translation.en: Hello ! My name is Sandals , I have a reservation .
translation.zh: 你好！我叫凉鞋，我有预约。

translation.en: May I see your identification , please , sir ?
translation.zh: 先生，请出示您的证件好吗？

translation.en: Thanks . Do you have a credit card , sir ?
translation.zh: 谢谢。先生，您有信用卡吗？

translation.en: Of course . Will American Express do ?
translation.zh: 当然。美国运通行吗？

translation.en: I'm very sorry , sir . We accept only VISA or MasterCard .
translation.zh: 非常抱歉，先生。我们只接受VISA或万事达卡。

translation.en: No problem . Here's my VISA .
translation.zh: 没问题。这是我的签证。

translation.en: Thanks . Room 507 is a spacious , nonsmoking room , with a queen bed . Does that meet your expectations ?
translation.zh: 谢谢。507房间宽敞无烟，配有大床。这符合你的期望吗？

translation.en: Yes , that sounds like what I want .
translation.zh: 是的，听起来像是我想要的。

translation.en: That's wonderful , sir . Now , here's your key . Should you need anything , just dial 0 .
translation.zh: 太好了，先生。现在，这是你的钥匙。如果你需要什么，就拨0。

translation.en: Ahhchooo !
translation.zh: 啊呼！

translation.en: You've been sneezing a lot lately . Are you sick or something ?
translation.zh: 你最近打了很多喷嚏。你是病了还是怎么了？

translation.en: No . Every spring time around April , I'm stricken with allergies .
translation.zh: 不。每年春天四月份左右，我都会过敏。

translation.en: I never have seasonal allergies .
translation.zh: 我从来没有季节性过敏。

translation.en: Consider yourself lucky .
translation.zh: 我想你应该觉得自己是幸运的。

translation.en: What are all the symptoms ?
translation.zh: 过敏的症状是什么？

translation.en: Well , as you just saw , I sneeze a lot . Also , my nose becomes very runny , my throat sometimes itches , and my eyes start to water .
translation.zh: 你刚才看到了，我经常打喷嚏。而且，我的鼻子会流鼻涕，喉咙有时会发痒，接着眼睛就会流泪。

translation.en: That doesn't sound good .
translation.zh: 听起来太惨了。

translation.en: No , it's not . So you don't have any type of allergies ?
translation.zh: 是啊，超级难受。所以你没有任何过敏症吗？

translation.en: Well , I have a severe allergic reaction to alcohol . It runs in the family .
translation.zh: 嗯，我对酒精有严重的过敏反应。是家族遗传。

translation.en: Everyone to some extent is allergic to alcohol .
translation.zh: 在某种程度上，每个人都对酒精过敏。

translation.en: I get it pretty bad . My whole face turns red , including my ears . My eyes become bloodshot , and I start to itch all over my body .
translation.zh: 我很严重。我整个脸都会变红，包括我的耳朵。我的眼睛会充血，全身会发痒。

translation.en: That's pretty bad .
translation.zh: 那太糟糕了。

translation.en: But that doesn't stop me from drinking . Ahahah .
translation.zh: 但这并不能阻止我喝酒。啊哈。

translation.en: Doctor , what is the best way to stay healthy ?
translation.zh: 医生，保持健康的最好方法是什么？

translation.en: Having a good diet is probably the most important thing .
translation.zh: 良好的饮食可能是最重要的。

translation.en: It is very confusing to know what to eat .
translation.zh: 知道吃什么很困惑。

translation.en: You need plenty of fruits and vegetables , small amounts of protein , and whole grains .
translation.zh: 你需要大量的水果和蔬菜，少量的蛋白质和全谷物。

translation.en: Are there certain things that I should avoid ?
translation.zh: 有什么我应该忌口的吗？

translation.en: You shouldn ’ t consume too much sugar or caffeine . Also , watch your intake of fatty food .
translation.zh: 你不应该摄入太多的糖或咖啡因。另外，注意脂肪食物的摄入量。

translation.en: After watching my diet , what else should I do ?
translation.zh: 除了我的饮食外，我还需要做什么？

translation.en: You need to stop smoking , and make sure that you get 30 minutes of exercise every day .
translation.zh: 你需要戒烟，并确保每天锻炼30分钟。

translation.en: Can I have a glass of wine now and then ?
translation.zh: 我能偶尔喝杯酒吗？

translation.en: As long as you don ’ t overdo it , a glass of wine a day should be OK .
translation.zh: 只要你不过量，一天一杯酒就可以了。

translation.en: Hello ! Is this Mr . Chang ?
translation.zh: 你好！请问是张先生吗？

translation.en: Yes . Who is speaking ?
translation.zh: 对。你是哪位？

translation.en: This is Kelly speaking . I am calling from London . How are you , Mr . Chang ?
translation.zh: 我是凯莉。我是从伦敦打来的。你好吗，张先生？

translation.en: Oh , Kelly , I couldn't recognize your voice . Well , I'm fine .
translation.zh: 哦，凯莉，我没听出你的声音。嗯，我很好。

translation.en: Mr . Chang , I just want to tell you that we are leaving London for Beijing by flight CP 645 on Saturday morning . Could you meet us at the airport , please ?
translation.zh: 张先生。我只是想告诉你，我们将于星期六上午搭乘CP645航班离开伦敦飞往北京。你能到机场接我们吗？

translation.en: Excuse me , I couldn't quite hear you . This line is crossed . Can you speak louder , please ?
translation.zh: 对不起，你说什么？我听不见。电话有杂音，你可以大声音一点吗？

translation.en: I will say it again ... Do you hear me now ?
translation.zh: 我再说一遍……你现在听见了吗？

translation.en: Much better . I will definitely go to the airport to meet you .
translation.zh: 好多了。我一定去机场接你。

translation.en: Thank you very much . Goodbye .
translation.zh: 非常感谢你。再见。

translation.en: Hi Bob , I won't be in work tomorrow .
translation.zh: 嗨，鲍勃，我明天不上班。

translation.en: Why , what's the problem ?
translation.zh: 怎么了，怎么了？

translation.en: I have a dentist appointment .
translation.zh: 我预约了牙医。

translation.en: Can you help me find a lotion for a problem I am having ?
translation.zh: 能帮我找一款对症的涂抹剂吗？

translation.en: That ’ s what I am here for . What questions can I answer for you ?
translation.zh: 当然了。能描述一下您的问题吗？

translation.en: I have poison oak , and I need help with the rash that won ’ t stop itching .
translation.zh: 我中了橡树毒，而且我身上起了疹子痒个不停。

translation.en: The best product is Techne , and you can buy either the lotion or cream .
translation.zh: 最好的产品是Techne，你可以买它的乳或膏。

translation.en: Which one is best ?
translation.zh: 哪一个最好？

translation.en: The cream form is very popular .
translation.zh: 膏状的比较受欢迎。

translation.en: Can I do anything else to help with the itching ?
translation.zh: 我还能做些什么来止痒吗？

translation.en: You could also take an antihistamine to help the rash go away quicker .
translation.zh: 你也可以服用抗组胺药来帮助皮疹更快消失。

translation.en: I appreciate you helping me find a solution to the itching .
translation.zh: 能找到解决瘙痒的办法真是太感谢了。

translation.en: Anytime you have a question , please feel free to ask .
translation.zh: 之后有任何问题，您随时问我。

translation.en: Hello , how are you doing today ?
translation.zh: 你好，今天怎么样？

translation.en: I ’ Ve been having trouble breathing lately .
translation.zh: 我最近有点呼吸困难。

translation.en: Have you had any type of cold lately ?
translation.zh: 你最近感冒了吗？

translation.en: No , I haven ’ t had a cold . I just have a heavy feeling in my chest when I try to breathe .
translation.zh: 不，我没有感冒。当我试着呼吸的时候，我的胸口总有一种沉重的感觉。

translation.en: Do you have any allergies that you know of ?
translation.zh: 你有什么过敏症吗？

translation.en: No , I don ’ t have any allergies that I know of .
translation.zh: 不，据我所知我没有任何过敏症。

translation.en: Does this happen all the time or mostly when you are active ?
translation.zh: 这种情况经常发生还是主要发生在你剧烈运动的时候？

translation.en: It happens a lot when I work out .
translation.zh: 我锻炼的时候经常这样。

translation.en: I am going to send you to a pulmonary specialist who can run tests on you for asthma .
translation.zh: 我会把你转去肺科医生那里，他们可以给你做哮喘检查。

translation.en: Thank you for your help , doctor .
translation.zh: 谢谢你的帮助，医生。

translation.en: Doctor , I have the worst toothache !
translation.zh: 医生，我牙疼得厉害！

translation.en: How long have you had this pain ?
translation.zh: 你疼了多久了？

translation.en: For about a week or so , but it ’ s gotten really bad in the last couple of days .
translation.zh: 大约一个星期了，但最近几天情况变得很严重。

translation.en: Did you do anything that might have aggravated your tooth ?
translation.zh: 你做了什么可能会加重你牙疼的事吗？

translation.en: You know , I was eating jawbreakers in the movies the other day , and I accidentally bit down really hard on one .
translation.zh: 嗯，前几天我边看电影边吃硬糖，不小心磕了一下牙。

translation.en: What kind of toothbrush do you use ?
translation.zh: 你用什么样的牙刷？

translation.en: I just use a regular hard bristle toothbrush .
translation.zh: 我用普通的硬毛牙刷。

translation.en: Does it bother you when you eat something really cold ?
translation.zh: 当你吃一些很冷的东西时，你会感到难受吗？

translation.en: Yes , it definitely bothers me more when I do that .
translation.zh: 是的，当我这么做的时候，我确实更难受了。

translation.en: Sorry , Mary , I can't make it in time for dinner .
translation.zh: 对不起，玛丽，我来不及吃晚饭了。

translation.en: Okay , Bob , when will I see you ?
translation.zh: 好吧，鲍勃，我什么时候能够再见你？

translation.en: Maybe I will be around later .
translation.zh: 也许我晚些时候会回来。

translation.en: Okay , I'll see you later .
translation.zh: 好的，回头见。

translation.en: Mrs . Phoebe , here are your ordered goods . Please inspect the goods now .
translation.zh: 菲比夫人，这是你订的货。请检查一下。

translation.en: All right . Let me have a check . Can you tell me how can you inspect your exported goods ?
translation.zh: 好的。让我看看。你能告诉我你们如何检验出口货物吗？

translation.en: Our quality control department is in charge of the inspection , which is directly under general manager . It is essential to attach the importance to the quality of goods . It is the basement for the future cooperation .
translation.zh: 由我们的质管部负责检验，而且质管部由总裁直接调遣。重视产品的质量是至关重要的。这是将来合作的基础。

translation.en: That is good . And here I give you a piece of advice . You should have used stronger cardboard boxes for such a heavy item . Besides , it's better to secure the cartons with metal straps . What's more , the order number wasn't anywhere on some of the boxes .
translation.zh: 那很好。我给你一个建议， 这么重的货物，应该用更结实的瓦愣纸箱。还有，最好用铁条捆住纸箱来确保万无一失。还有，订货号要打在包装纸箱上。

translation.en: I realize that now . I will do that after a while .
translation.zh: 我知道了。过一会儿我就去做。

translation.en: Thank you . Can I open the packages to check the color and style ?
translation.zh: 非常感谢。我能打开包装检查一下颜色和款式吗？

translation.en: Of course , let me help you .
translation.zh: 当然，我来帮你。

translation.en: The color and style are consistent with the sample . Great !
translation.zh: 颜色和样式与样品一致。好极了！

translation.en: You know , we are superior to other clothes companies .
translation.zh: 您要知道，我们是最好的服装公司。

translation.en: Yes , that's for sure . There is nothing wrong with the quality . I think you'd better pack them first in plastic bags , than in cartons .
translation.zh: 是的，那是肯定的。质量没有问题。不过我觉得应该先用塑料袋包好，然后再用纸箱包装。

translation.en: OK . We will manage it later .
translation.zh: 好的，我们稍后会处理。

translation.en: Hello , Fred . What are you doing ?
translation.zh: 你好，弗雷德。你在干什么？

translation.en: I'm doing the business online .
translation.zh: 我在网上做生意。

translation.en: Can you tell me the concept of e-commerce ? Now , many people mentioned the word , ' e-commerce ' , in front of me .
translation.zh: 你能告诉我电子商务的概念吗？现在，很多人在我面前提到了‘电子商务’这个词。

translation.en: E-commerce , or Electronic Commerce is the practice of purchasing and selling products or services over the Internet .
translation.zh: 电子商务是指通过互联网购买和销售产品或服务的行为。

translation.en: What kinds of channels can you use in e-commerce ?
translation.zh: 在电子商务中你可以使用什么样的渠道？

translation.en: We can complete a trade by email , electronic data interchange and smart cards , and so on .
translation.zh: 我们可以通过电子邮件、电子数据交换和智能卡等方式完成交易。

translation.en: What are the benefits of e-commerce ?
translation.zh: 电子商务的好处是什么？

translation.en: Firstly , it can overcome the geographic limitation . And secondly , e-commerce can lower the internal costs . And thirdly , people like us , can also open stores on Internet .
translation.zh: 首先，它可以克服地理上的局限性。其次，电子商务可以降低内部成本。第三，像我们这样的人，也可以在网上开店。

translation.en: How things have changed now !
translation.zh: 现在情况发生了多大的变化！

translation.en: I am dropping off my prescription to get it filled .
translation.zh: 我想开个药方去配药。

translation.en: You can come back in twenty minutes , and it will be ready .
translation.zh: 你可以在二十分钟后回来，药方就准备好了。

translation.en: If I couldn ’ t wait , could the prescription be mailed to me ?
translation.zh: 如果我等不及了，能把药方寄给我吗？

translation.en: Yes , you can have it delivered or filled at any location in our HMO .
translation.zh: 可以，您可以在我们医院的任何地方配药。

translation.en: When should I take this medication ?
translation.zh: 我应该什么时候吃这种药？

translation.en: You need to take it at bedtime .
translation.zh: 你需要在睡前服用。

translation.en: Should I take this medicine on an empty stomach ?
translation.zh: 我应该空腹吃这种药吗？

translation.en: Don ’ t mix alcohol with this medication , but you can take it with or without food .
translation.zh: 吃药时不能喝酒，但是你可以用餐时吃，也可以空腹吃。

translation.en: What are the side effects of this medication ?
translation.zh: 这种药有什么副作用吗？

translation.en: You might feel a little dizzy at first , but it should pass .
translation.zh: 一开始你可能觉得有点头晕，但很快就会好的。

translation.en: You ’ Ve got a fever and playing football isn ’ t a good idea for a boy with a fever . What ’ s that on your arm ?
translation.zh: 你发烧了，对一个发烧的男孩来说踢足球不是个好主意。你胳膊上是什么？

translation.en: It ’ s rash . I ’ d better take you to see the doctor . How did you get that bruise on your leg ?
translation.zh: 这是皮疹。我还是带你去看医生（吧）。你腿上的淤青又是怎么搞的？

translation.en: Hello , I want to know how much it costs to have a manicure and pedicure .
translation.zh: 你好，我想知道修指甲修脚要多少钱。

translation.en: Usually it's 60 dollars for a manicure , and 80 dollars for a pedicure . But with this special discount , the total for both is only one hundred and 20 dollars , and you can get them painted .
translation.zh: 通常修指甲要60美元，修脚要80美元。但是有了这个特别折扣，这两样东西总共才一百二十美元，你可以把给它们刷上颜色。

translation.en: That's nice . I'd like to give it a try . I think I like passion red . please .
translation.zh: 那很好。我想试一试。我想我喜欢激情红。拜托。

translation.en: Alright.Do you want your cuticles cut , too ?
translation.zh: 好的。你的角质层也要剪吗？

translation.en: Would you like the shapes square or round ?
translation.zh: 你喜欢方形还是圆形？

translation.en: Square . But with round at the edges , please .
translation.zh: 正方形。但边缘要圆的。

translation.en: All right , it's done . Please follow me to the drying section .
translation.zh: 好了，结束了。请跟我到烘干区。

translation.en: How long will it take to get them dry ?
translation.zh: 要多久才能把它们弄干？

translation.en: Ten or about five minutes . You'll be all set .
translation.zh: 十分钟或五分钟左右。你会被安置好的。

translation.en: Hi , Mr . Smith . I'm Doctor Hawkins . Why are you here today ?
translation.zh: 嗨，先生。史密斯。我是霍金斯医生。你今天为什么在这里？

translation.en: I found it would be a good idea to get a check-up .
translation.zh: 我发现做个检查是个好主意。

translation.en: Yes , well , you haven't had one for 5 years . You should have one every year .
translation.zh: 是的，好吧，你已经6年没这样做了。你应该每年体检一次。

translation.en: I know . I figure as long as there is nothing wrong , why go see the doctor ?
translation.zh: 我知道。我想只要没什么问题，为什么要去看医生？

translation.en: Well , the best way to avoid serious illnesses is to find out about them early . So try to come at least once a year for your own good .
translation.zh: 好吧，避免重病的最好方法是尽早发现。所以，为了你自己好，尽量每年至少来一次。

translation.en: I've tried hundreds of times , but I just can't seem to kick the habit .
translation.zh: 我试过几百次了，但我似乎无法戒掉这个习惯。

translation.en: Well , we have classes and some medications that might help . I'll give you more information before you leave .
translation.zh: 嗯，我们有课程和一些药物可能会有所帮助。你走之前我会给你更多的信息。

translation.en: Ok , thanks doctor .
translation.zh: 好的，谢谢医生。

translation.en: hey , you look great ! how's everything ?
translation.zh: 嘿，你看起来棒极了！一切都好吗？

translation.en: yeah , you know what ? I've been going to the club regularly . The training really pays off . Now I am in a good shape and I know more about how to keep fit .
translation.zh: 是的，你知道吗？我经常去（健身）俱乐部。训练真的很有成效。现在我的状态很好，我更懂得如何保持健康。

translation.en: really ? tell me about it . I haven't gone to the club for a long time . I am too busy with work .
translation.zh: 真的吗？跟我说说，我很久没去俱乐部了。我工作太忙了。

translation.en: it's important to do proper exercises .
translation.zh: 做适当的运动很重要。

translation.en: you're right . Too much or too little won't do any good .
translation.zh: 你说得对。太多或太少都无济于事。

translation.en: the trainer tells me , besides regular sports activities , I should also have a healthy and balanced diet .
translation.zh: 教练告诉我，除了有规律的体育活动外，我还应该有健康均衡的饮食。

translation.en: sounds reasonable .
translation.zh: 听起来很合理。

translation.en: we should eat more vegetables instead of junk food to stay energetic .
translation.zh: 我们应该多吃蔬菜而不是垃圾食品来保持精力。

translation.en: and fruits !
translation.zh: 还有水果！

translation.en: surely it is . Getting enough sleep is also crucial for fitness .
translation.zh: 当然。充足的睡眠对健康也至关重要。

translation.en: I've heard that . Does your trainer tell you anything about keeping fit ?
translation.zh: 我听说了。你的教练有没有告诉你如何保持健康？

translation.en: yeah , he advises me to stay in a good mood . That can help one to keep sound physical health .
translation.zh: 有，他建议我保持好心情。这可以帮助一个人保持健康的身体。

translation.en: I think if you follow your trainer's advice , you'll be on the right track .
translation.zh: 我想如果你听从教练的建议，你就会身体健康的。

translation.en: Well , Mr . Smith . That ’ s a nasty infection you have .
translation.zh: 嗯，史密斯先生。你的感染很严重。

translation.en: Yes . Is there anything you can give me to get rid of it , Doctor ?
translation.zh: 是的。医生，有没有什么药可以清除感染？

translation.en: I ’ m going to prescribe some antibiotics , and some cream to ease the itching and burning .
translation.zh: 我给你开一些抗生素和一些药膏来止痒，减轻灼伤。

translation.en: OK . Thank you . Where should I buy them ?
translation.zh: 好的，非常感谢。我应该在哪里买到这些药？

translation.en: The pharmacy will give you a discount since you came to the clinic .
translation.zh: 既然你来了诊所，药房会给你打折的。

translation.en: Great . What floor is the pharmacy on ?
translation.zh: 太好了！药房在哪一层楼？

translation.en: The fourth . I ’ ll send the prescription down there , so you can just pick it up on your way out .
translation.zh: 四楼。我会把处方送到楼下，这样你离开的时候就可以顺便去拿。

translation.en: Can you tell me where it hurts ?
translation.zh: 你能告诉我哪里疼吗？

translation.en: I am so glad they called you . It feels like something is really wrong with my stomach !
translation.zh: 我很高兴他们打电话给你。感觉我的胃有点不对劲！

translation.en: It ’ s mostly on my right side . Right here !
translation.zh: 主要是我的右边疼得厉害。就是这里！

translation.en: Have you been feeling this way for awhile ?
translation.zh: 你有这种感觉有一段时间了吗？

translation.en: I started feeling kind of sick last night after dinner , but this morning the pain got really bad !
translation.zh: 昨晚晚饭后我开始觉得有点恶心，但是今早开始疼得厉害了！

translation.en: Have you eaten anything unusual lately ?
translation.zh: 你最近吃了什么不常吃的东西吗？

translation.en: No , not that I remember .
translation.zh: 没有，我不记得。

translation.en: We are going to take you to an emergency room right now .
translation.zh: 我们马上送你去急诊室。

translation.en: I will feel better when I know what the problem is . Thank you for the drugs .
translation.zh: 当我知道是什么问题时，我会感觉好点。谢谢你。

translation.en: Good . You feel better after you do .
translation.zh: 很好。你做了之后就会感觉好很多的。

translation.en: Where are you feeling the pain ?
translation.zh: 你在哪里觉得疼？

translation.en: I can ’ t stand up ! My stomach is killing me !
translation.zh: 我站不起来！我的肚子疼死了！

translation.en: Can you put your hand where it hurts the most ?
translation.zh: 你能把你的手放在最疼的地方吗？

translation.en: It hurts smack in the middle of my gut !
translation.zh: 我的肚子疼得要命！

translation.en: Did this just come on suddenly ?
translation.zh: 这是突然发生的吗？

translation.en: I felt OK until an hour or so ago , and then I just doubled over .
translation.zh: 一个小时前我都还感觉很好，然后我就突然开始疼了。

translation.en: Have you exercised strenuously or played sports recently ?
translation.zh: 你最近有锻炼过或剧烈运动过吗？

translation.en: No , and I don ’ t usually get a lot of stomachaches .
translation.zh: 没有，我也很少胃疼。

translation.en: We need to get you to an emergency room to see what the problem is .
translation.zh: 我们需要带你去急诊室看看有什么问题。

translation.en: I think that that is the best way to figure out what is causing this . Thank you .
translation.zh: 我认为这是找出原因的最好办法。非常感谢。

translation.en: Hi , I need to make an appointment to see the doctor .
translation.zh: 嗨，我要预约看医生。

translation.en: I have a rash that I need a doctor to look at .
translation.zh: 我的皮疹需要医生检查。

translation.en: Do you have a fever with that rash ?
translation.zh: 你发皮疹发烧吗？

translation.en: No , it just itches a lot .
translation.zh: 不，只是很痒。

translation.en: I have openings on Tuesday or Wednesday . Which would be best for you ?
translation.zh: 我星期二或星期三有空缺。哪个对你最好？

translation.en: I need an appointment on Tuesday .
translation.zh: 我星期二需要预约。

translation.en: Fine , I am putting you down for 9
translation.zh: 好吧，我给你记9分

translation.en: I would like to see Dr . Jones .
translation.zh: 我想见琼斯医生。。

translation.en: I can schedule you with him with no problem . We look forward to seeing you .
translation.zh: 我可以安排你和他见面，没问题。我们期待着见到你

translation.en: I am sorry , but I cannot stay for the rest of class today .
translation.zh: 很抱歉，我今天不能留下来上课了。

translation.en: Why do you need to leave early ?
translation.zh: 你为什么要早点走？

translation.en: I don ’ t feel so good .
translation.zh: 我感觉不太好。

translation.en: What doesn ’ t feel right ?
translation.zh: 什么感觉不对？

translation.en: I feel as if I am going to be sick to my stomach .
translation.zh: 我觉得好像要胃不舒服似的。

translation.en: Perhaps you should get checked out at the Student Health Center before you go home .
translation.zh: 也许你应该在回家前到学生健康中心检查一下。

translation.en: I have some medicine at home that I could take .
translation.zh: 我家里有些药可以吃。

translation.en: Are you going to be OK to drive home , or would you like someone to go with you ?
translation.zh: 你可以开车回家吗，还是想有人陪你一起去？

translation.en: Thank you , but my friend is in the library , and he can give me a ride home .
translation.zh: 谢谢，但是我的朋友在图书馆，他可以载我回家。

translation.en: We hope that you are feeling better soon . E-mail me if you have any questions .
translation.zh: 我们希望你很快就会好起来。如果您有任何问题，请发电子邮件给我。

translation.en: Good morning , I made an appointment with Dr . Smith , but I have to change it .
translation.zh: 早上好，我之前和史密斯医生约好了。但我必须改变一下约定时间。

translation.en: When you made your appointment , what day did you choose ?
translation.zh: 请问您你预约的是哪一天？

translation.en: My appointment was on Wednesday .
translation.zh: 我原本预约的是星期三。

translation.en: At what time was that appointment ?
translation.zh: 预约的是哪个时间段？

translation.en: It was for 4
translation.zh: 四点。

translation.en: I can see the appointment that you had . What day do you need to change to ?
translation.zh: 我找到您的预约。你需要改到哪一天？

translation.en: I want to change to next Tuesday .
translation.zh: 我想改到下星期二。

translation.en: What time would you prefer ?
translation.zh: 你想要什么时间？

translation.en: I would prefer three o ’ clock in the afternoon .
translation.zh: 我想要下午三点。

translation.en: I will put you down for that time . Thank you for calling to reschedule .
translation.zh: 我会把你的约定安排到那个时候的。谢谢你打电话来改期。

translation.en: Sounds like you may be far-sighted . OK , then , cover your left eye and read the chart in front of you .
translation.zh: 听起来你可能有点远视。好的，那么，闭上你的左眼，认读你面前的图表。

translation.en: I often sneeze after having a bad itch inside my nose . Sometimes this is accompanied by an itching throat .
translation.zh: 我鼻子里痒得厉害，经常打喷嚏。有时伴有喉咙瘙痒。

translation.en: Any other discomfort ?
translation.zh: 还有其他不适吗？

translation.en: Yes . Sometimes I can notice a constriction in the chest and shortness of breath after a fit of sneezing . And I often suffer from a running nose with a profuse watery discharge .
translation.zh: 对。有时我会注意到一阵喷嚏后胸口有点缩，呼吸急促。我经常流鼻涕，流很多水。

translation.en: Does it occur seasonally or all year round ?
translation.zh: 它是季节性的还是全年性的？

translation.en: It has been seasonal during these past three years .
translation.zh: 在过去的三年里是季节性的。

translation.en: Are you sensitive to other things ?
translation.zh: 你对其他事情敏感吗？

translation.en: Yes , things like seafood and penicillin-type drugs .
translation.zh: 是的，像海鲜和青霉素类药物。

translation.en: OK . Let me examine your nose . According to your case history and the examination , I believe that it's allergic rhinitis .
translation.zh: 好的让我检查一下你的鼻子。根据你的病史和检查，我认为是过敏性鼻炎。

translation.en: What useful treatment can you offer ?
translation.zh: 你能提供什么有用的治疗？

translation.en: I'll give you a series of specific skin tests . Then we'll know exactly what substances you're allergic to . Then I'll give you some causes of desensitization therapy .
translation.zh: 我会给你做一系列特殊的皮肤测试。那我们就知道你对什么物质过敏了。然后我会给你一些脱敏治疗的疗法。

translation.en: I have a laceration on my left forearm .
translation.zh: 我左前臂有一处裂口。

translation.en: Let me have a look . How did this happen ?
translation.zh: 让我看看。这是怎么回事？

translation.en: I got hit by a car in an accident .
translation.zh: 我在车祸中被车撞的。

translation.en: Was there much bleeding afterward ?
translation.zh: 后来出血多吗？

translation.en: No , not much .
translation.zh: 不，不多。

translation.en: Well , this doesn't look too serious . Nurse , could you please get me a suture set ?
translation.zh: 嗯，这看起来不太严重。护士，能帮我准备一套缝合工具吗？

translation.en: Will I need stitches ?
translation.zh: 我需要缝针吗？

translation.en: Yes . Three , I think . It wont ' be too painful . Alright , we're done . That wasn't so bad , was it ?
translation.zh: 对。我想得缝三针。不会太疼。好了，缝好了。没那么疼吧？

translation.en: You're lucky there was no lasting damage . I'll set up an appointment for you to come back in five days . We'll take those stitches out then . So long .
translation.zh: 你还是比较幸运的，没有永久性的损伤。我跟你约个时间，五天后你再来。到时候我们把线拆掉。再见。

translation.en: Thank you , doctor . Bye .
translation.zh: 谢谢你，医生。再见。

translation.en: Sit down , please . What's wrong with you ?
translation.zh: 请坐。你怎么了？

translation.en: I feel cold , and I'm shivering . I have a terrible headache and a sore throat .
translation.zh: 我觉得冷，而且在发抖。我头痛得厉害，喉咙痛。

translation.en: How long have you been like that ?
translation.zh: 你这样多久了？

translation.en: About a day .
translation.zh: 大约一天。

translation.en: Let me have a look at your throat first . Please open your mouth and say " ah " .
translation.zh: 让我先看看你的喉咙。请张开嘴说“啊”。

translation.en: And show me your tongue ... Thank you . That'll do . You have slight tonsillitis , and your throat is inflamed . How is your appetite ?
translation.zh: 让我看看你的舌头。。。非常感谢。那就行了。你有轻微的扁桃体炎，喉咙发炎。你的胃口怎么样？

translation.en: Not so good .
translation.zh: 不太好。

translation.en: Now , let me take your temperature . Please put this thermometer under your armpit and let me feel your pulse ?
translation.zh: 现在，让我量你的体温。请把体温计放在腋下，让我摸摸你的脉搏？

translation.en: Your pulse is weak .
translation.zh: 你的脉搏很弱。

translation.en: Do I have a temperature , doctor ?
translation.zh: 医生，我发烧吗？

translation.en: Yes , you have a high fever . I'd like to give you a blood test .
translation.zh: 是的，你发高烧。我想给你验血。

translation.en: Good Morning . What can I do for you ?
translation.zh: 早上好。有什么事吗？

translation.en: Then you need to register as a new patient . Can I have a look at you ID card ? I need your name , age , occupation , address and contacting number .
translation.zh: 那你需要注册为新病人。我能看看你的身份证吗？我需要你的姓名，年龄，职业，地址和联系电话。

translation.en: Well , Mr . Smith . That's a nasty infection you have .
translation.zh: 嗯，史密斯先生。你的感染很严重。

translation.en: Yes . Is there anything you can give me to get rid of it , doctor ?
translation.zh: 是的。医生，有没有什么药可以清除感染？

translation.en: I'm going to prescribe some antibiotics and some cream to ease the itching and burning .
translation.zh: 我给你开一些抗生素和一些药膏来止痒，减轻灼伤。

translation.en: Ok , thank you ! Where should I buy them ?
translation.zh: 好的，非常感谢。我应该在哪里买到这些药？

translation.en: Great ! What floor is pharmacy on ?
translation.zh: 太好了！药房在哪一层楼？

translation.en: The fourth . I'll send the prescription down there so you can just pick it up on your way out .
translation.zh: 四楼。我会把处方送到楼下，这样你离开的时候就可以顺便去拿。

translation.en: These goods can be broken very easily , so we would be thankful if you would be sure to use durable packing materials .
translation.zh: 由于这批货极易受损，所以拜托你们务必使用耐用的包装材料。

translation.en: That will be no problem . We never use any kind of inferior packaging . Your goods will be safe .
translation.zh: 绝对没问题。我们公司从来不使用任何劣等包装。你的货会很安全的。

translation.en: Good . Can we ask you to put a country of origin mark on each container ?
translation.zh: 那好！能否请您在每个包装箱上都印上原产国标志呢？

translation.en: We always do that , but I will make a point to check it for you since it is so important .
translation.zh: 我们一向都这么做，不过既然这个标志这么重要，我一定会再帮你检查的。

translation.en: Do you always put a quality mark on each container ? For this shipment it is crucial to us that you do .
translation.zh: 每个包装箱上也有品质标签吗?这点对这批货很重要。

translation.en: We don't usually do that unless we are asked to . I'lI tell my staff to take care of this for you .
translation.zh: 除非客户要求，我们通常不会加印。不过我会交代手下帮你特别注意这点。

translation.en: Thanks . This shipment is so important to us there cannot be any foul-ups .
translation.zh: 谢谢。这批货对我们来说太重要了，不能出一点差错的。

translation.en: David , how is your interview ?
translation.zh: 大卫，你的面试怎么样？

translation.en: I was nervous at that time . What about you ?
translation.zh: 我当时很紧张。你呢？

translation.en: Just fine . I tried to answer every question raised by HR carefully . I found some answering skills are useful . These questions are different from exams .
translation.zh: 很好。我试着仔细回答人事经理提出的每一个问题。我发现一些回答技巧很有用。这些问题不同于考试。

translation.en: We can have a rest now after this tough interview .
translation.zh: 经过这次艰难的面试，我们现在可以休息了。

translation.en: Don't be rush . It is suggested to write a letter for the Personnel Department of Future Clothes Company .
translation.zh: 别着急。建议再给未来服装公司人事部写封信。

translation.en: Sounds like a good idea . And I think this can leave deep impression to HR . How can we write a suitable letter ?
translation.zh: 听起来是个好主意。我认为这会给人事经理留下深刻的印象。我们怎样才能写一封得体的信呢？

translation.en: Just to show your gratitude to the chance and tell them your impression on the company . And you can mention some details in your own interview to remind them of you .
translation.zh: 只要表达一下你对这次面试机会的感激之情，告诉他们你对公司的印象。也可以提到一些自己面试中的细节，让他们记起你来。

translation.en: I am getting to know your meaning .
translation.zh: 我明白你了。

translation.en: Janice , I can't find the document I was working on last month . Can you help me to look for it ?
translation.zh: 珍妮丝，我找不到上个月我在整理的文件。你能帮我找一下吗？

translation.en: Susan , I'm sorry . Did you look up those files I requested ?
translation.zh: 苏珊，对不起。你查过我要的那些文件了吗？

translation.en: Yes , but I still can not find it . Maybe it is in this cabinet .
translation.zh: 是的，但我还是找不到。也许在这个文件夹里。

translation.en: I couldn't find the files you request , even though I checked all the cross-references . I don't think it's there .
translation.zh: 我找不到你要的文件，尽管我查了所有的交叉引用。我想不在哪儿。

translation.en: I am sure that document was filed .
translation.zh: 我肯定那个文件已经归档了。

translation.en: Well , let me check again under a different heading .
translation.zh: 好吧，让我换个标题再查一遍。

translation.en: Good idea ! It seems that I asked you to put it in Nova's files .
translation.zh: 好主意！好像是我让你把它放在诺瓦的文件夹里的。

translation.en: Maybe that's why I couldn't find it . All the documents on Nova are filed under ' V ' .
translation.zh: 也许这就是我找不到它的原因。诺瓦上的所有文件都在“V”字母下存档。

translation.en: Well , if you have no further questions , then we have done .
translation.zh: 好了，如果你没有别的问题要问的话，那么就到此为止吧。

translation.en: Thank you , Mr . Owens , for taking time out of your busy schedule to interview me .
translation.zh: 谢谢，欧文斯先生，感谢您百忙中抽空给我面试。

translation.en: You ’ re welcome . I appreciate your coming .
translation.zh: 不客气，谢谢你来面试。

translation.en: When can I contact you about your final decision ?
translation.zh: 什么时候我同您联系，以便知道最后结果？

translation.en: We need to consider several other applicants and we hope to make a decision by the end of this month . We will call you regardless of whether you are hired or not .
translation.zh: 我们还要考虑其他几名应试者，希望在本月底做出决定。无论录取与否，我们都会给您电话的。

translation.en: Thanks a lot ! I will look forward to the good news . Please call me at this number between nine and eleven in the morning .
translation.zh: 谢谢！我会期待好消息的。请在上午九点到十一点之间打这个号码给我。

translation.en: Well , I really appreciate your coming today .
translation.zh: 我会打电话给你的，感谢你来应聘。

translation.en: The pleasure is mine . It ’ s nice talking with you . Good-bye , Mr . Owens .
translation.zh: 这是我的荣幸。很高兴和您谈话。再见，欧文斯先生。

translation.en: How can I help you , sir ?
translation.zh: 先生，我能为您效劳吗？

translation.en: I am here to have a discussion on your company's investment issue .
translation.zh: 我是来贵公司讨论投资问题的。

translation.en: Sorry , could you tell me your name ?
translation.zh: 对很抱歉，请问您能告诉我您的名字吗？

translation.en: I am James Pond from FAM Company and I am here to discuss it with Nova .
translation.zh: 我是来自FAM公司的詹姆斯·庞德，我需要和诺瓦讨论这个问题。

translation.en: Yes , I did it yesterday . Our meeting should be 2 pm .
translation.zh: 是的，我昨天预约的。我们的会议应该是下午2点。

translation.en: I guess she forgot your meeting . She is attending an important meeting in the company . Will you have a seat ? May I leave a memo for her ?
translation.zh: 我猜她可能忘了你的会议。她正在公司参加一个重要会议。您要先坐一下吗？需要我给她留个便条吗？

translation.en: She will be back soon .
translation.zh: 她很快就会回来。

translation.en: What a pity you are leaving so soon . I wish you could stay a few more days . Sir , can you deliver a speech for us ?
translation.zh: 真遗憾你那么快就要走了。我还是希望你能多呆几天。先生，你能为我们做个演讲吗？

translation.en: Dear friends . Here , I wish to say a word of thanks for holding this send-off party for me . Actually I didn't expect at all for this . I owe a lot to all of you here . It's been 5 days since I came to visit here . Time really flies . I feel grateful for your welcome and help in the five days . I will miss you while I am leaving . Let's keep in touch in any way . What's more , to the success of our face-to-face meeting , to the upcoming cooperation of our two companies , bottom up !
translation.zh: 亲爱的朋友们。感谢你们为我举办这场欢送会，首先，我想说声谢谢。其实我根本没想到你们会这样做。我非常感谢在座的各位。我来这里已经五天了。时间过得真快。感谢大家在这五天里的欢迎和帮助。我离开后会想念你们的。不管怎样，我们都要保持联系。更重要的是，为我们面对面会谈的成功，为我们两家公司即将展开的合作，干杯吧！

translation.en: Cheers ! And we are honored to have such an honored guest today . Mr . James , I hope we will meet somewhere in the near future .
translation.zh: 干杯！我们很荣幸今天有这么一位贵宾出席。詹姆斯先生，我希望我们能在不久的将来再次见面。

translation.en: Madam , we also welcome you to visit our company . I hope you can also bring your family there to have a look of our company . In this way , we will know each other better .
translation.zh: 女士，我们也欢迎你来我们公司参观。我希望你也能带着你的家人去看看我们公司。这样，我们就更了解对方了。

translation.en: Definitely ! Thank you !
translation.zh: 一定！非常感谢。

translation.en: Do you work well under pressure ?
translation.zh: 有压力的工作你能做好吗？

translation.en: Working under pressure is exciting and challenging . I don ’ t mind working under pressure . I work well under that circumstance . People can , I can .
translation.zh: 有压力的工作具有挑战性，令人兴奋。 我不介意在压力下工作。在那种情况 下,我能干好。别人行，我就行。

translation.en: How soon can you begin working for us ?
translation.zh: 你什么时候能来我们这里工作？

translation.en: I need about two to three weeks for necessary formalities . I will quit then transfer to your company .
translation.zh: 我需要两三周时间办手续。然后辞职转入贵公司。

translation.en: Any questions ?
translation.zh: 有什么问题吗？

translation.en: Can we get in touch with you by e-mail ? Is this convenient for you ?
translation.zh: 我们可以用电子邮件和你联系吗？这对你来说方便吗？

translation.en: It ’ s quite convenient .
translation.zh: 很方便。

translation.en: Sorry , I overslept . My clock didn't go off this morning .
translation.zh: 对不起，我睡过头了。今天早上我的钟没响。

translation.en: Well , if it breaks down again tomorrow , I'll definitely buy a new one .
translation.zh: 好吧，如果明天还不响的话，我一定会买一个新的。

translation.en: David , we have been doing business for three years , haven't we ?
translation.zh: 大卫，我们做生意已经三年了，不是吗？

translation.en: Yes , I'm glad we've had very pleasant cooperation in the previous years . And your achievement for promoting our clothes was great in the three years .
translation.zh: 是的，我很高兴我们前几年合作愉快。在这三年里，你推销我们的服装的成就是巨大的。

translation.en: So , I wish to apply for the sole agency of your product in our local market . If you give us the agency , that will be more substantial for our cooperation .
translation.zh: 因此，我想申请成为贵公司产品在我们当地市场的独家代理。如果你给我们代理权，那对我们的合作将更有意义。

translation.en: To be frank , you are not the only one who applies for an agent for us in your country . I'd like to know some ideas of terms on which you would be willing to operate as our agent .
translation.zh: 坦率地说，你不是唯一一个为我们在贵国申请代理的人。我想知道你方作为我方代理的条件的一些想法。

translation.en: As we are a well-established company , we are very familiar with the customers ' needs . Besides , we can make full use of our good connections with the wholesalers and retailers here and develop a good market for your products if appointed as your agent .
translation.zh: 由于我们是一家成熟的公司，我们非常熟悉客户的需求。此外，我们可以充分利用我们与这里批发商和零售商的良好关系，如果我们被指定为你们的代理，我们可以为你们的产品开拓一个很好的市场。

translation.en: Sounds reasonable . I will tell my boss about you agent application . Another question , what do you think is the minimum annual sales you can guarantee ?
translation.zh: 听起来很合理。我会告诉我老板你的代理申请。另一个问题，你认为你能保证的最低年销售量是多少？

translation.en: To be on the safe side , and for garment of all materials , sizes , and styles , I think the amount will be 50,000 pieces a year .
translation.zh: 为了安全起见，对于所有材料、尺寸和款式的服装，我想每年的数量将是50000件。

translation.en: Well . As our sole agency , you will neither handle the same or similar products of other origins nor re-export our goods to any other area outside your own .
translation.zh: 好。作为我们的独家代理，你们既不经营其他来源的相同或类似产品，也不将我们的货物再出口到你们以外的任何地区。

translation.en: No , certainly not .
translation.zh: 不，当然不是。

translation.en: Nice to meet you , sir . I come from New Times Clothes Company . We learnt that your exhibits on the Trade Fair in Shanghai this month were marvelous . Would you please quote the price ?
translation.zh: 很高兴见到你，先生。我来自新时代服装公司。我们得知贵公司本月在上海商品交易会上的展品非常棒。请报一下价格好吗？

translation.en: Before we discuss the price , may I ask you what kind of exhibits you are interested in ?
translation.zh: 在我们讨论价格之前，我可以问一下您对什么样的展品感兴趣吗？

translation.en: Your summer clothes for white-collar and men's jackets .
translation.zh: 你们的白领夏装和男士夹克。

translation.en: Can you give us a rough idea of the quantity you require ? It is generally known that the price varies according to the quantity .
translation.zh: 你能大致告诉我们你们所需的货品数量吗？众所周知，价格因数量而异。

translation.en: That is to say , 10000 sets for the one of white-collar and 5000 for men's jackets .
translation.zh: 也就是说，白领夏装10000套，男式夹克5000套。

translation.en: In that case , our offer for the white-collar series is US $ 200 , and the other is US $ 300 per set .
translation.zh: 那样的话，我们的白领系列的报价是200美元一套，另一个是300美元一套。

translation.en: Do you quote CIF or FOB ?
translation.zh: 你们报到岸价还是离岸价？

translation.en: We usually quote on a CIF basis and a commission of five percent for you . You will find our price is most competitive .
translation.zh: 我们通常报到岸价，会付给你们百分之五的佣金。你会发现我们的价格是最有竞争力的。

translation.en: Letter of credit at sight .
translation.zh: 即期信用证。

translation.en: Another question . Could you tell me the earliest possible time of shipment ?
translation.zh: 另一个问题。你能告诉我最早的装船时间吗？

translation.en: Within a month after your letter of credit reaches us .
translation.zh: 在你方信用证到达我方后一个月内。

translation.en: Well , I got all the point . All the decision will be made since I get the approval from my supervisor .
translation.zh: 好吧，我明白了。所有的决定都将在我得到主管批准后作出。

translation.en: OK ! I expect you to accept our general terms and conditions of trade . We believe that through our cooperation , large transactions will be brought to speedy conclusion .
translation.zh: 好的，我希望你们能接受我们的一般贸易条款。我们相信，通过我们的合作，一大笔交易将迅速成交。

translation.en: We have settled the question of price , quality and quantity . Now I am calling to talk about the terms of payment . What are your terms of payment ?
translation.zh: 我们已经解决了价格、质量和数量的问题。现在我打电话来是想谈谈付款条件。你们的付款条件是什么？

translation.en: Well . We only accept the payment to be made by confirmed and irrevocable L \ C , payable against shipping documents .
translation.zh: 好。我们只接受保兑的、不可撤销的、凭装运单据付款的信用证付款。

translation.en: I see . Payment by LC is the safest method , but could you make an exception and accept DA or DP ?
translation.zh: 我懂了。信用证付款是最安全的方法，但你能破例接受承兑交单或付款交单吗？

translation.en: I'm afraid not . That is our usual practice , because we are sure we will get the right amount of money that way .
translation.zh: 恐怕不行。这是我们的惯常做法，因为我们确信这样我们会得到适当的钱。

translation.en: What about the cost of delivery ?
translation.zh: 送货的费用是多少？

translation.en: We would like to do it in accordance with an F . O . B .
translation.zh: 我们想按照F来做。哦。B

translation.en: Tom . Please do not disturb me for the next hour .
translation.zh: 汤姆。接下来一个小时请不要打扰我。

translation.en: Are you having a meeting ?
translation.zh: 你在开会吗？

translation.en: Yes , and I don't want to be interrupted .
translation.zh: 是的，我不想被打扰。

translation.en: Bob from accounting is on the line . Do you want to speak with him ?
translation.zh: 会计部的鲍勃在接电话。你想和他通话吗？

translation.en: Yes , I need to talk to him .
translation.zh: 是的，我要和他谈谈。

translation.en: I'll put the call through then .
translation.zh: 那我把电话转给他。

translation.en: Marry Wang's Office , this is Marry .
translation.zh: 这里是玛丽·王的办公室，我是玛丽。

translation.en: Hi Marry , this is Tom .
translation.zh: 嗨，玛丽，我是汤姆。

translation.en: I need to see if we can get together today .
translation.zh: 我想看看我们今天能不能聚一聚。

translation.en: Do you want to talk with John with tongue ?
translation.zh: 你想约翰通话吗？

translation.en: No , tell him I'm tied up .
translation.zh: 不想，告诉他我有事。

translation.en: When should I tell him to call back ?
translation.zh: 我应该告诉他什么时候给你打电话呢？

translation.en: Tell him to call me tomorrow morning .
translation.zh: 告诉他明天早上给我打电话。

translation.en: Marry Lin's Office , this is Linda .
translation.zh: 这里玛丽·林的办公室，我是琳达。

translation.en: Linda , this is David Wang .
translation.zh: 琳达，我是王大卫。

translation.en: Hi , Mr . Wang , what can I help you with ?
translation.zh: 嗨，王先生，有什么事吗？

translation.en: I need to talk with Marry .
translation.zh: 我想和玛丽童话。

translation.en: Certainly , hold on .
translation.zh: 好的，稍等。

translation.en: Good morning everyone . Thank you for attending the meeting today . I'm sure you all have a copy of the agenda . So let's get started with the first issue .
translation.zh: 大家早上好。谢谢你们来参加今天的会议。我相信你们都有一份会议议程了。让我们从第一个问题开始。

translation.en: We're here today to present to you the results of our marketing research regarding the consumer behavior .
translation.zh: 我们今天在这里向大家介绍我们关于消费者行为的市场调查结果。

translation.en: I would like to begin by introducing our foreign guests to our stuff on your left ( right ) , we have Mr . Brown , who is Vice President of Sales . Next to him is Ms . Arts , Director of Marketing for the Atlas Company . In the back row is Dr . Barolo , who is visiting from Italy . Thank you all for coming .
translation.zh: 我想首先介绍一下我们的外宾，在你们左边（右边），是布朗先生——销售部的副经理，他旁边的是奥托斯先生，亚特拉公司营销部的主席，在后排的是巴洛拉博士，他来自意大利。感谢各位的光临。

translation.en: I am glad to see everyone is here and on time . Let's get started ! Susan , toss out some of your ideas .
translation.zh: 很高兴看到大家都准时出席，我们开始吧，苏珊，拿出一些点子来吧。

translation.en: How was your interview ?
translation.zh: 你的面试怎么样？

translation.en: Pretty good . The HR manager asked me the usual questions . Then he wondered why I had decided to leave my previous job .
translation.zh: 不错。人事经理问了我一些常见的问题。然后他想知道为什么我决定离开以前的工作。

translation.en: I told him that I hadn ’ t got a raise for three years . I also told him that one of my best co-workers quitted her job because she had not been promoted for eight years .
translation.zh: 我告诉他我已经三年没有加薪了。我还告诉他，我的一个最好的同事辞职了，因为她已经八年没有升职了。

translation.en: Did he want to know the reasons ?
translation.zh: 他想知道原因吗？

translation.en: Yes . I told him that my boss made some excuses of the recession . But I thought he had a pattern and a record of promoting men only .
translation.zh: 对。我告诉他我老板为经济衰退找了一些借口。但我以为他有只提拔男性的习惯和记录。

translation.en: That ’ s sex discrimination . When will you get the reply ?
translation.zh: 这就是性别歧视。你什么时候能得到答复？

translation.en: In a couple of days , I was told .
translation.zh: 几天后，我会被通知的。

translation.en: Wish you good luck !
translation.zh: 祝你好运！

translation.en: I see there are some workmen on the site . When is the building work due to start ?
translation.zh: 我看到工地上有一些工人。建筑工程什么时候开始？

translation.en: Well , it'll take three weeks to demolish the old building and clear away the debris . We should be ready to start the construction work in week 23 .
translation.zh: 嗯，拆除这座旧建筑和清除废墟需要三个星期。我们应该准备在第23周开始施工。

translation.en: How long will the sub contractors be on site ?
translation.zh: 分包商将在现场停留多长时间？

translation.en: About ten weeks in total if everything goes according to plan .
translation.zh: 如果一切按计划进行，总共大约十周。

translation.en: I'm sure it will . So , we should be able to start moving the machinery in during week 34 . I'll confirm that date with our suppliers .
translation.zh: 肯定会按计划进行的。所以，我们应该可以在第34周开始移动机器。我会和我们的供应商确认那个日期。

translation.en: Quality is very important to us . We work to very low tolerance levels . We need to have guaranteed supplies of consistently high quality raw materials . Over the years we've built up very good relationships with our suppliers .
translation.zh: 质量对我们很重要。我们工作的容忍度很低。我们需要保证始终如一的高质量原材料的供应。多年来，我们与供应商建立了良好的关系。

translation.en: Do you have many different suppliers ?
translation.zh: 你们有很多不同的供应商吗？

translation.en: Yes . There are about fifty names on our approved supplier list , but for raw materials we tend to deal with three local companies .
translation.zh: 对。我们批准的供应商名单上大约有51家，但在原材料方面，我们倾向于与三家当地公司打交道。

translation.en: I'm an apprentice with a local engineering firm . My training lasts for two years . Two days a week I study Engineering at a local college . If I pass all my exams , I hope the company will take me on as an engineer .
translation.zh: 我是当地一家工程公司的学徒。我的学习为期两年。我每周有两天会去本地一所大学学习工程学。如果我通过了所有的考试，我希望公司能聘用我为工程师。

translation.en: Hello , this is Lucy . May I speak to Mr . Smith ?
translation.zh: 你好，我是露西。我可以和史密斯先生讲话吗。？

translation.en: Oh , hello , Lucy . What's up ?
translation.zh: 哦，你好，露西。怎么了？

translation.en: I'm afraid I can't come to work today , Mr . Smith .
translation.zh: 史密斯先生，恐怕我今天不能来上班了。。

translation.en: Oh , what's wrong with you ?
translation.zh: 哦，你怎么了？

translation.en: I've got a fever and a very sore throat .
translation.zh: 我发烧，喉咙痛。

translation.en: Well , you sound ill over the phone .
translation.zh: 嗯，你在电话里听起来很不舒服。

translation.en: Yes . I have to stay in bed today , but I'll be able to come tomorrow .
translation.zh: 对。我今天必须卧床休息，但我明天能来。

translation.en: That's all right . Have a good rest until you feel well enough .
translation.zh: 没关系。好好休息，直到你感觉好为止。

translation.en: Thank you , Mr . Smith . Goodbye .
translation.zh: 谢谢你，先生。史密斯。再见。

translation.en: Goodbye , Lucy .
translation.zh: 再见，露西。

translation.en: Do you have any particular conditions that you would like our company to take into consideration ?
translation.zh: 您有什么特别的条件需要我们公司考虑吗？

translation.en: All right . If we decide to hire you , we'd pay you two thousand and five hundred yuan a month at the start . You can have Saturdays and Sundays off . Besides , you may have a paid month holiday every year . How do you think about it ?
translation.zh: 好吧。如果我们决定雇用你，一开始我们会每月付给你两千五百元。周末双休。此外，你每年可能有一个月的带薪假期。你觉得怎么样？

translation.en: As regards salary , I leave it to you to decide after experience of capacity .
translation.zh: 就薪水而言，我让你们在考验我的能力之后再决定。

translation.en: Well , we'll give you our decision in a couple of days . It's a pleasure to talk to you , Mr . Liu .
translation.zh: 好吧，过几天我们会告诉你我们的决定。很高兴与你交谈，刘先生

translation.en: Thank you , Mr . White . I really appreciate your assistance .
translation.zh: 谢谢你，怀特先生。我真的非常感谢你的帮助。

translation.en: What does your job involve ?
translation.zh: 你的工作包括什么？

translation.en: I'm the Project Manager so I have to make sure our projects run smoothly . I work with three Project Engineers . They take care of after-sales service and look after the maintenance side of the business .
translation.zh: 我是项目经理，所以我必须确保我们的项目顺利进行。我和三个项目工程师一起工作。他们负责售后服务和维修方面的业务。

translation.en: Mr . Wang , I've had scheduled for your two days stay in Shanghai . You can make some changes if it does not suit you .
translation.zh: 王先生，我为你在上海两天的逗留作了安排。如果你觉得不合适的话，可以作些变动。

translation.en: All right . Please read it to me .
translation.zh: 好吧。请念给我听听。

translation.en: On Friday morning , Mr . Wang , the director of Shanghai Research Institute , will visit you at the hotel . In the afternoon , you will discuss some problems with Mr . Yang , vice manager of computer corporation .
translation.zh: 星期五上午，上海研究所所长王先生会来饭店拜访你。下午你将和电脑公司副经理杨先生讨论一些问题。

translation.en: On Saturday , you'll leave the hotel for sightseeing . Miss Lu will be your guide .
translation.zh: 星期六，你将离开旅馆去观光。陆小姐将是你的导游。

translation.en: Oh , that's great .
translation.zh: 哦，太好了。

translation.en: Our usual supplier has let us down and I ’ Ve been looking through your parts catalogue . I need fifty GT670s . How soon can you deliver ?
translation.zh: 我们经常用的供货商让我们失望，我在看贵方的配件目录。我需要五十件GT670s.。你们多快能发货？

translation.en: Just a moment and I'll check . We ’ re expecting a delivery on Friday . We've only got ten in stock at the moment . I can deliver those by first thing tomorrow morning . There'll be an extra charge for special delivery . I'll have to send them by courier .
translation.zh: 稍等片刻，我查一下。我们预计在星期五发次货。我们目前库存只有10件。这些我可以明早一早就发货。特别送货服务需要额外收费, 我只能经快递公司送货。

translation.en: Our new production control program's going live on Monday . The old and the new programs will operate in tandem for four to six weeks . That should give us time to iron out any little problems .
translation.zh: 我们新的生产控制程序将于周一上线。新老项目将同步运行4到6周。这应该给我们时间解决任何小问题。

translation.en: Hope it all goes well . We're very busy at the moment and certainly don't want any problems at this time of year .
translation.zh: 希望一切顺利。我们现在很忙，每年这个时候当然不想有任何问题。

translation.en: Yes , I realise that . We've spent a long time planning and preparing for the change-over . I'm confident we won't have any major problems .
translation.zh: 是的，我知道。我们花了很长时间计划和准备换代。我相信我们不会有什么大问题的。

translation.en: We need to take the accounts system offline to carry out the upgrade . But don't worry , it won't cause too much inconvenience . We're going to do it over the weekend .
translation.zh: 我们需要让账户系统离线进行升级。不过别担心，不会造成太多不便的。我们打算在周末做。

translation.en: How long will the system be down for ?
translation.zh: 系统将关闭多长时间？

translation.en: We'll be taking everything offline in about two hours ' time . It'll be down for a minimum of twelve hours . If everything goes according to plan , it should be up again by 6 pm on Saturday .
translation.zh: 我们将在两个小时后把所有东西离线。至少要停12个小时。如果一切按计划进行的话，星期六下午6点前就应该可以恢复了。

translation.en: That's fine . We've allowed forty-eight hours to be on the safe side .
translation.zh: 那很好。为了安全起见，我们已经允许48小时了。

translation.en: Could you type up this document for me , Sandra ?
translation.zh: 桑德拉，你能帮我把这份文件打出来吗？

translation.en: Sure , but I have to finish this report first .
translation.zh: 当然，但我得先完成这份报告。

translation.en: Never mind . I'll do it .
translation.zh: 没事。我自己打吧。

translation.en: I think your presentation impressed the client , Daniel . You did a good job .
translation.zh: 我认为你的陈述给客户留下了深刻的印象，丹尼尔。你做得很好。

translation.en: Thank you , Mr . Cooper . I hope we get the contract .
translation.zh: 谢谢你，库珀先生。我希望我们能拿到合同。

translation.en: Is the factory fully-automated ?
translation.zh: 工厂是全自动化的吗？

translation.en: Not completely . Our production process is partially-automated . We use robots on the production line for routine assembly jobs but some of the work is still done manually .
translation.zh: 不是。我们的生产过程是部分自动化的。在生产线上我们使用机器人进行日常装配工作，但有些工作仍然是手工完成的。

translation.en: What about supply of parts to the production line ?
translation.zh: 生产线的零件供应呢？

translation.en: Well , the parts are automatically selected from the store room using a bar-code system . And there is an automatic feeder which takes them to the conveyor belt at the start of the production line .
translation.zh: 嗯，这些零件是通过条形码系统从储藏室自动挑选出来的。并且我们还有一个自动进料器，将它们送到生产线传送带的起点。

translation.en: What about the smaller components ?
translation.zh: 那些更小的零部件呢？

translation.en: They're transported to the workstations on automated vehicles - robot trucks - which run on guide rails around the factory .
translation.zh: 它们通过机器人卡车被被运送到工作站，这些机器人卡车是运行在工厂周围的导轨上的自动化车辆。

translation.en: Good morning , Mr . Smith . Welcome to Wuhan .
translation.zh: 早上好，史密斯先生。欢迎来到武汉。

translation.en: Mr . Smith , did you have a good journey ?
translation.zh: 史密斯先生，旅途愉快吗？

translation.en: I just feel a little tired . You know , it took me 16 hours to get here .
translation.zh: 我只是觉得有点累。你知道，我花了16个小时才到这里。

translation.en: You must take a rest today .
translation.zh: 你今天必须休息一下。

translation.en: That's very kind of you , but I can do without a rest . I have long wanted to have a talk with you about the possibility of business between us .
translation.zh: 你真是太好了，不过我可以不休息。我一直想和你谈谈我们之间做生意的可能性。

translation.en: We welcome good business . Anyhow , we know you must get tired by the flight , so we arrange a meeting tomorrow . Today you can have a good rest .
translation.zh: 我们欢迎有意义的业务往来。但是我们知道你坐飞机一定累了，所以我们安排明天见面。今天你可以好好休息了。

translation.en: We hope your stay here a pleasant one !
translation.zh: 希望您在这里过得愉快！

translation.en: I believe I will .
translation.zh: 我相信我会的。

translation.en: John hasn't turned up and Stefan is ill . Do we have anyone on stand-by ?
translation.zh: 约翰没来，斯蒂芬病了。有人在待命吗？

translation.en: I'm afraid not , we're very short-staffed at the moment . Can you ask the shift supervisor to ask one of his team to do some overtime ? Perhaps Tommy can stand in for an hour or two until we find a replacement .
translation.zh: 恐怕不行，我们现在人手很缺。你能让值班主任让他的一个小组加班吗？也许汤米可以在我们找到替代者之前先等一两个小时。

translation.en: We are interested in some precision machine tools . We have some inquires on hand .
translation.zh: 我们对一些精密机床很感兴趣，我手头有些询价。

translation.en: That's fine . We can supply all kinds of precision machine tools . Our products are much admired in the world market and enjoy a wide acceptance in modern industry .
translation.zh: 太好了！我们能供应各种精密机床，我们的产品在世界市场上是很受欢迎的，在现代工业中也被广泛应用。

translation.en: Can I have a look at your catalogue and the corresponding technical data ?
translation.zh: 我能看看你们的样本目录和相应的技术资料吗？

translation.en: Why , of course . Here are some that will show you our latest development . You may select which ever you need .
translation.zh: 当然可以。这是些有关我们最新技术发展情况的样本，从中可选择你需要的产品。

translation.en: I think our users have the impression that your prices are always much too high , compared with those of other supplies .
translation.zh: 我想我们的用户认为你们的价格与其他供应商所出的价格相比，太高了。

translation.en: Excuse me . It's true that our products do cost slightly more than the other makers , but It's only due to our technological superiority .
translation.zh: 请原谅，我们的产品是由于具有髙技术性能而比其他厂家的产品贵一点。

translation.en: Your products may have certain advantages , but your prices are too stiff .
translation.zh: 你们的产品可能有一定的优势，但你们的价格太高了。

translation.en: If you give us your inquiry , I shall go very carefully into the price and try my best to put you on the best of the terms .
translation.zh: 如果你把询价给我们,我们愿把价格好好算一算，尽最大努力给你们最优惠的条件。

translation.en: OK , I'll come back to discuss it to some details after our users have studied your catalogues and price list .
translation.zh: 好的，等我们的用户研究了你们的产品目录和价目表之后，我再来详细讨论一下。

translation.en: Yes , surely . We hope to do some substantial business with you .
translation.zh: 好吧，我们希望同你们大量成交。

translation.en: Oh , gosh ! I feel everything around me is against me .
translation.zh: 哦，天哪！我觉得周围的一切都在跟我过不去。

translation.en: Don't take it too hard . There are some tips you should know in job-hunting of 2010 .
translation.zh: 别把事情想得太严重了。我这儿有几条2010年求职的诀窍。

translation.en: Well , I am all ears . Maybe they are helpful .
translation.zh: 好吧，我洗耳恭听。或许真有点用处。

translation.en: Firstly , you must always show your best to the interviewer . And secondly , try to avoid spamming through e-mails , because this will make the reader go crazy . The last but not the least , there is no substitute for pounding the pavement in such a digital age .
translation.zh: 首先，你必须把最好的自己展现给面试官。第二点，在投寄电子邮件时.避免投寄垃圾邮件，因为这样会让读信人疯掉的。最后一点也是最重要的一点则是在这样的数字时代依旧没有什么可以取代街头找工作。

translation.en: I understand what you mean , and I will not upset myself . Face it .
translation.zh: 我明白你的意思了，而且我也不会自寻麻烦。面对现实吧。

translation.en: Good luck to us .
translation.zh: 祝我们好运。

translation.en: Yes . We regret we cannot maintain our original price . Since the prices of the raw materials have been raised , we have to adjust the price of our products accordingly .
translation.zh: 对。很抱歉，我们不能维持原价。由于原材料的价格提高了，我们不得不相应地调整产品的价格。

translation.en: I agree with you there , but your price is unreasonable .
translation.zh: 这一点我同意，但是你们的价格是不合理的。

translation.en: I don't think so . You must compare our price with that of other export houses . I'm sure our offer is in line with the prevailing market price level .
translation.zh: 我不这么认为。你必须把我们的价格与其他出口公司的价格作比较。我相信我们的报盘与现行市场价格水平是一致的。

translation.en: I don't think we'll be able to pay the price . To have this business concluded , you need to lower your price at least by 3 % .
translation.zh: 我想我们付不起这个价格。要做成这笔生意，你们至少要降价3%。

translation.en: I ’ m afraid that there is no room for any reduction in price .
translation.zh: 恐怕没有降价的余地了。

translation.en: Don't you agree with me that in the long run , moderate prices will bring about large sales and more profit ?
translation.zh: 你不同意我的看法吗？从长远来看，适中的价格会带来大量的销售和更多的利润？

translation.en: Yes , this is the best we can do .
translation.zh: 是的，这是我们能做的最好的了。

translation.en: I'm sorry we can't handle the price you offered .
translation.zh: 很抱歉，我们不能接受你方的报价。

translation.en: I can't open this email attachment our Paris office has sent me .
translation.zh: 我无法打开我们巴黎办事处发给我的电子邮件附件。

translation.en: Are you sure you're using the right program ?
translation.zh: 你确定你用的程序对吗？

translation.en: Well , yes it's definitely the same program but I might have the wrong version . Their system is newer than ours .
translation.zh: 嗯，是的，它肯定是同一个程序，但我可能有错误的版本。他们的系统比我们的新。

translation.en: That's why you can't open it . You'll have to upgrade before you can read the file .
translation.zh: 所以你不能打开它。你必须先升级才能读取文件。

translation.en: Come in and sit down .
translation.zh: 进来，请坐。

translation.en: Thanks , Mr . Liang .
translation.zh: 谢谢，梁先生。

translation.en: Among all the assistants , I think you're on top of it . Based on the annual evaluation , the board of directors decided to give you a bonus .
translation.zh: 在众多助理当中，我认为你的能力是数一数二的。根据今年的绩效考评，董事会决定给你发一笔奖金。

translation.en: Really ? I am too happy .
translation.zh: 真的吗？我太高兴了。

translation.en: I've been reviewing your work over the past few months . Thanks to your excellent work , we benefit much from your project . And you should get the perfect attendance award too .
translation.zh: 过去几个月以来，我一直在考察你的表现。由于你的出色工作，我们从你负责的项目中受益匪浅，并且你也应该得到全勤奖。

translation.en: Thanks for your trust . Owing to my colleagues ' help , I've successfully completed my task .
translation.zh: 谢谢您的信任。多亏了同事们的帮忙，我才得以完成了自己的任务。

translation.en: You are very modest and diligent . The distribution of bonus derived from the performance evaluation . You deserve it .
translation.zh: 你很谦虚，很勤奋。奖金是根据绩效考评的成绩而发放的，是你应得的。

translation.en: Thank you very much . I will redouble my efforts in the future .
translation.zh: 非常感谢您。今后我会加倍努力的。

translation.en: Were you a leader when you were in college ?
translation.zh: 你上大学时是领导吗？

translation.en: Yes . I was Propaganda department minister of our university .
translation.zh: 对。我是我们大学的宣传部部长。

translation.en: Did you get any honors or awards at your university ?
translation.zh: 你在大学里获得过什么荣誉或奖励吗？

translation.en: No . It ’ s a pity about it .
translation.zh: 不。真遗憾。

translation.en: Were you involved in any club activities at your university ?
translation.zh: 你在大学里参加过什么社团活动吗？

translation.en: Yes . I was a member of the basketball Society . I like playing basketball .
translation.zh: 对。我是篮球协会的会员。我喜欢打篮球。

translation.en: What extracurricular activities did you usually take part in at your college ?
translation.zh: 你在大学里通常参加什么课外活动？

translation.en: I sometimes played basketball and sometimes played football .
translation.zh: 我有时打篮球，有时踢足球。

translation.en: The environment varies greatly because of difference in language , customs and traditions .
translation.zh: 由于语言、习俗和传统的不同，出口环境也会有很大的差别。

translation.en: Yes . This gap can be filled by export market research before exporting .
translation.zh: 对。出口前对出口市场的研究从某种程度上可以弥补这种差异。

translation.en: But the importance of the export research is often neglected by the managers .
translation.zh: 但出口研究的重要性往往被管理者所忽视。

translation.en: That's right . They do not appreciate its value and consider it to be a luxury .
translation.zh: 没错。他们认识不到出口研究的重要性，只觉得它是一种不必要的奢侈。

translation.en: Therefore , when enterprises are spending a lot of money in trying to penetrate a new market , they should research whether their products can be sold at high enough a price and in a satisfactory amount .
translation.zh: 所以企业在花很多钱企图打开一个新市场时，也应该去调研他们的产品是否能卖出足够高的价格与令人满意的数量。

translation.en: Hello , Steven . How do you get along with your job ?
translation.zh: 你好，史蒂文。你的工作怎么样？

translation.en: Actually , I learn many things from it . I find that I am a quick learner in new things .
translation.zh: 事实上，我从中学到了很多东西。我发现我学习新事物的速度很快。

translation.en: Practice makes perfect . By the way , what do you learn from your job ?
translation.zh: 熟能生巧嘛。那么，你从工作中学到了什么呢？

translation.en: At first I didn't know anything about the machine . Now I know how to operate it . Besides , the work gives me a sense of fulfillment and achievement .
translation.zh: 一开始我对这台机器一无所知。现在我知道怎么操作了。此外，这份工作给我带来了一种满足感和成就感。

translation.en: Yeah , you are a good learner . I must commend you for your good performance .
translation.zh: 是啊，你是个很好的学习者。我必须要夸一夸你的出色表现。

translation.en: Thank you . That's a long way to go for my job .
translation.zh: 非常感谢。我还是任重而道远呢。

translation.en: I appreciate your effort very much . The coffee break is over ; it's about time we set to work .
translation.zh: 我很欣赏你的努力。休息时间结束了；我们该开始工作了。

translation.en: Good morning , Helen .
translation.zh: 早上好，海伦。

translation.en: Good morning , Steven .
translation.zh: 早上好，史蒂文。

translation.en: So , what's the status of our advertising campaign ?
translation.zh: 我们的广告活动情况如何？

translation.en: It'll be a national campaign starting next week .
translation.zh: 这场全国性活动从下周开始。

translation.en: What style will the ads be ?
translation.zh: 广告的风格是什么？

translation.en: I suggest that we focus on slice of life , showing how you can beat the summer heat by biting into a cool ice-cream sandwich .
translation.zh: 我建议我们把重点放在生活片段上，比如展示咬一口冰激凌三明治就能赶走夏天的炎热。

translation.en: Sounds like a good idea . Will we have a new slogan ?
translation.zh: 听起来是个好主意。我们会有新的口号吗？

translation.en: Our factory locates at a village in the east of the city . The area of it is 3,600 square meters .
translation.zh: 我们的工厂建在市东的一个村庄里。占地3600平米。

translation.en: We'd like to visit the factory . Can you show me the way ?
translation.zh: 我们很想去参观你们的工厂，你能给我们带路么？

translation.en: That's OK ! We'll take you to have a tour . Please follow me .
translation.zh: 可以。我们带你们去参观。请随我来。

translation.en: How many shifts are there in your factory ?
translation.zh: 你们工厂几班轮流？

translation.en: There are two shifts now in total .
translation.zh: 现在是两班制。

translation.en: What about your company's QC management ?
translation.zh: 公司的品质管理如何？

translation.en: We established the strict QC standards and we have followed it for about five years with good results .
translation.zh: 我们建立了严格的品质管理要求，在这五年内,我们一直遵守这个要求，取得了良好的效果。
