translation.zh: 那太好了。你人太好了。

translation.en: I've already made a hotel reservation for you , let's go to the hotel first and drop off your things . Then , I'd like to have a drink so that we can get better acquainted . I've booked a table at an exclusive restaurant downtown . Afterwards , I've made arrangements to take you to see the city lights . Seattle ’ s nightlife can be really quite exciting . How does that schedule sound to you ?
translation.zh: 我已经为你预订了旅馆，我们先去旅馆把你的东西送过去吧。然后我门喝一杯，以便我们能更好地认识一下彼此。我在市区一家高级餐厅订了一张桌子。之后，我安排带你去看城市灯光秀。西雅图的夜生活真的很刺激。你觉得这个安排怎么样？

translation.en: Sounds great . Thank you for your hospitality .
translation.zh: 听起来很棒。谢谢你的盛情款待。

translation.en: Ms.Dawson , I need you to take a dictation for me .
translation.zh: 道森女士，我需要你给我记一份口授记录。

translation.en: Yes , sir ...
translation.zh: 好的，先生。。。

translation.en: This should go out as an intra-office memorandum to all employees by this afternoon.Are you ready ?
translation.zh: 今天下午之前，这将作为公司内部备忘录发给所有员工。你准备好了吗？

translation.en: Yes , sir.Go ahead .
translation.zh: 是的，先生。请讲。

translation.en: Attention all staff ... Effective immediately , all office communications are restricted to email correspondence and official memos.The use of Instant Message programs by employees during working hours is strictly prohibited .
translation.zh: 全体员工注意。。。从即日起，所有办公室通信仅限于电子邮件和正式备忘录。严禁员工在工作时间使用即时消息程序。

translation.en: Sir , does this apply to intra-office communications only ? Or will it also restrict external communications ?
translation.zh: 先生，这只适用于内部通信吗？还是会限制对外交流？

translation.en: It should apply to all communications , not only in this office between employees , but also any outside communications .
translation.zh: 它应该适用于所有的通信，不仅在本办公室的员工之间，而且任何外部通信。

translation.en: But sir , many employees use Instant Messaging to communicate with their clients .
translation.zh: 但是，先生，许多员工使用即时信息与客户沟通。

translation.en: They will just have to change their communication methods . I don't want any - one using Instant Messaging in this office.It wastes too much time ! Now , please continue with the memo.Where were we ?
translation.zh: 他们将不得不改变他们的沟通方式。我不想让任何人在办公室里使用即时通讯，这太浪费时间了！现在，请继续写备忘录。我们讲到哪里了？

translation.en: This applies to internal and external communications .
translation.zh: 这适用于内部和外部通信。

translation.en: Yes.Any employee who persists in using Instant Messaging will first receive a warning and be placed on probation.At second offense , the employee will face termination.Any questions regarding this new policy may be directed to department heads .
translation.zh: 是的。任何坚持使用即时通讯的员工将首先受到警告并进入观察期。如果再次违反，该员工将面临解雇。有关这项新政策的任何问题都可以向部门主管提出。

translation.en: Yes.Please get this memo typed up and distributed to all employees before 4 pm .
translation.zh: 是的。请把这份备忘录打好，下午4点前分发给所有员工。

translation.en: It is urgent for us to fill this position now and I would like to stress that English is a must because of the international contacts and most likely traveling abroad very soon . If all these is not problem for you , I recommend you to mention these in your cover letter and send it to me directly .
translation.zh: 我们现在急需填补这个职位，需要强调的英语技能是必须的，因为我们有国际业务，而且很有可能很快就到国外出差。如果这些您都没问题，我建议您在求职信中标明，然后直接寄给我。

translation.en: So that concludes the introduction . Now let's move to the first part of my talk , which is about 2006 fiscal year marketing plan . So first , right off the bat , When looking at the marketing plan , tell me some of the goals that we had set this year to begin with ...
translation.zh: 介绍部分已经结束了。现在我们接下来看一下我要讲的第一部分的内容，有关2006财政年度的销售计划。首先看一下销售计划，马上告诉我我们今年设定的最初几个目标是什么……

translation.en: We wanted to appeal to a younger set of consumers and also , in line with that goal , redo our image ...
translation.zh: 我们想吸引一批年轻的顾客，同时重塑符合这一目标的形象。

translation.en: That's correct . If you remember , we also set a goal to double distribution in overseas markets . Now , when looking at the data to evaluate whether or not we made our goals , there are three things to consider . First , the original condition of the market , second , our marketing numbers from the previous year , and third , our final sales figures for this year . Now I want to describe for you the second and third parts . If you look at the overhead , you'll see a graph ... The blue line represents our sales from the year 2005 , the red line is the sales in 2006 ... As you can see , our sales in 2005 were quite slow to start off with , but managed to make decent performance in the last part of the year . On the other hand , you can see this year's sales took off like a rocket .
translation.zh: 非常正确。不知你们是否记得，我们还设立了一个目标，即把海外市场的销售量增加一倍。现在看一下数据，估算一下我们是否已经达到了这些目标，有三个因素要考虑：第一是原来的市场情况，第二是我们从去年以来的销售数量，第三是我们今年最终的销售额。现在我想向大家介绍一下第二、三部分的情况。抬头向上看，这里有一个图表，蓝色的线代表我们从2005年以来的销售额，红线代表的是2006年的销售额。大家都能看到，我们在2005年的销售额一开始很低，但在后半年却相当好。另一方面，你们也看到今年的销售额像火箭一样急速上升。

translation.en: Good morning , ladies and gentlemen , we are happy you have all come out for our training workshop . Today we have a great line-up of speakers to talk to you . First on our program is a well-renown expert in the field of international economic development , Harvard's own Dr . James Smith . Dr . Smith has been involved in economic research for over twenty years , and has taught at Harvard since 1995 . And now , without further adieu , we'd like to welcome Mr . James Smith .
translation.zh: 女士们先生们，早上好，很高兴你们来参加我们的研讨会。今天我们有很强的的演讲者阵容给大家进行演讲。我们的第一位讲者是国际经济发展领域的知名专家，哈佛大学博士，詹姆斯·史密斯。史密斯博士从事经济研究超过二十年，自1995年起在哈佛任教。那不再耽误时间，让我们欢迎詹姆斯·史密斯先生。

translation.en: Thank you , Mr . Jackson , ladies and gentlemen , colleagues , friends . The subject of my talk is international relations in a morgen world . I plan to say a few words about the current situation in the Middle East and how it affects world economy . I'd like to give you an overview of the way that the economies of seemingly unrelated countries are intertwined . I've divided my talk into three parts , first an overview of international relations , second a discussion of current political situations , and lastly trends for the future . My presentation will take about two hours , but there will be a twenty-minute break in the middle . We'll stop for lunch at 12 .
translation.zh: 杰克逊先生，女士们先生们，同事们，朋友们，非常感谢。我演讲的主题是当今世界的国际关系。我打算就中东的现状和它对世界经济的影响说几句。我想简单论述一下看似不相关的国家的经济是如何交织在一起的。我的演讲分为三个部分，第一部分是国际关系概述，第二部分是当今政治形势的讨论，最后是未来的发展趋势。我的演讲大约要花两个小时，中间会有二十分钟的休息时间。我们十二点停下来吃午饭。

translation.en: What's our target audience for this campaign ?
translation.zh: 我们这次活动的目标受众是哪些？

translation.en: This go-around we're focusing on new moms , families with median income and one or more children under the age of two .
translation.zh: 我们这次促销活动的重点集中在新妈妈身上，中等收入家庭并有一两个两岁以下的孩子。

translation.en: Do you think that's much different from the succor moms we tailored the last campaign for ?
translation.zh: 你认为这次与我们上次的目标中等收入的家庭妇女有很大不同吗?

translation.en: Well , there are some similarities that come up . Because both groups are made up of mothers ... so as before , we can play up on maternal instincts , hygiene , safety , along those lines . But that being said , there are some specific differences that come into play because we are dealing with mothers of infants here .
translation.zh: 是这样，因为两个群体都有妈妈组成，因此存在一些相似之处……所以像以前一样，我们可以强调母亲的本性，在广告中加上卫生、安全等文字。但是虽然如此，一些细小的差别也会起作用，因为我们这次的目标是幼儿的妈妈。

translation.en: Right , that makes sense . What's the average age ?
translation.zh: 你说得对，这是有道理的。那她们的平均年龄是多少?

translation.en: Demographics say an average age of 28.7 , educational background of university or post-grad , annual household income of 40-50 K a year .
translation.zh: 人口统计表明平均年龄是27、8，教育背景是大学或研究生，每家的年收入是4-5万美元。

translation.en: Did you get the position you wanted ?
translation.zh: 你得到你想要的职位了吗？

translation.en: Yes , I'll be promoted to department manager .
translation.zh: 是的，我将被提升为部门经理。

translation.en: Thank you . Actually , I could not believe it at first . You know , there're so many outstanding people in our company . Many of them are qualified to fill that position .
translation.zh: 非常感谢。事实上，一开始我简直不敢相信。你知道的，我们公司有那么多优秀的人。他们中的很多人都有资格填补这个职位。

translation.en: Sure , but you really did great and outperformed the others . You deserved it !
translation.zh: 当然，但你确实做得很好，表现得也比其他人好。你值得！

translation.en: Do you mind I have a look at your computer ?
translation.zh: 你介意我看看你的电脑吗？

translation.en: Let's see . You are importing fifty containers of textiles from China . They should be able to place your order before the end of next week . It will take 2 days for shipping to the port city of Ningpo . The freight will take 3 weeks on the open ocean and will arrive in Los Angeles approximately a month from today . Domestic shipping will be your responsibility , you can make arrangements with the pier in Los Angeles .
translation.zh: 我看看。你们从中国进口了五十箱纺织品。应该在下周末前就能提交订单。通过海运到宁波的港口需要两天时间。然后货物将在公海航行3周，从今天起大约再过一个月就能到达洛杉矶。国内运输将由你们负责，你们可以与洛杉矶码头协商。

translation.en: Fine , we will handle domestic shipping , but what about customs ? Will we have to pay tariff on our imports ? I hope we don't run into any problems with the border control .
translation.zh: 好的，我们会处理好国内运输的问题，但是海关怎么办？我们进口的商品需要付关税吗？我们希望在边境检查时不会遇到任何问题。

translation.en: Have you seen the sales report for last quarter ? Who do you think is our digest threat ?
translation.zh: 你看过上个季度的销售报告了吗？你认为谁是我们的威胁？

translation.en: From the numbers , it seems like Forest Inc . is our digest competitor ... Le'Ban and Markford are also major contenders in our market .
translation.zh: 从数字上看，好像是森林公司。是我们的竞争对手。。。勒班和马克福德也是我们市场的主要竞争者。

translation.en: Le'Ban is the new kid on the block , it's amazing they've had such tremendous success so soon ... With them on the scene , the competition is outthrough .
translation.zh: 勒班是行业新秀，他们这么快就取得了巨大的成功，真是太神奇了……有了他们，竞争都结束了。

translation.en: here's information about our competitor's recent market activities ...
translation.zh: 这是关于我们的竞争对手最近的市场活动信息……

translation.en: Thanks , this will be a big help in putting together next quarter's marketing strategies . With competition this intense , we'll have to step up production even more . We need a price we can compete with .
translation.zh: 谢谢，这将大大有助于制定下一季度的营销策略。既然竞争如此激烈，我们必须要进一步提高产量。我们需要一个能与之竞争的价格。

translation.en: We're in a very competitive environment . It's sink or saimin this market .
translation.zh: 我们处在一个竞争激烈的环境中。在这个市场上要么沉沦要么生存。

translation.en: Better start swimming ! we've got to find a way to outsmart the other guys . I want a preliminarily strategic marketing plan on my desk by next Tuesday ... the competition never sleeps and neither should we .
translation.zh: 最好力争上游！我们得想办法比其他人聪明。我希望能在下周二之前有一份初步的战略营销计划放在我的办公桌上……竞争从不停息，我们也不应该。

translation.en: How did your company's fundraiser go ?
translation.zh: 你们公司的募捐活动进行得怎么样？

translation.en: The fundraiser events went really well . We were able to partner with a few of our competitors , all in fun of course , to sponsor a marathon for the American Cancer Society . All of the people who participated it had a great time , and we were able to raise a lot of money to contribute to cancer research .
translation.zh: 募捐活动进行得非常顺利。我们能够非常高兴地与我们的几家竞争对手合作，赞助美国癌症协会举办的马拉松比赛。所有参加活动的人都玩得非常开心，而且我们也为癌症研究筹集到了很多钱。

translation.en: So how does it work ? How were you able to make money with the marathon ?
translation.zh: 你们是如何操作的？怎么通过马拉松赚钱的？

translation.en: Each of the runners that participated the marathon race paid a ten dollar entrance fee . Also , they went door to door to get sponsors who pledged a dollar per mile that participants ran . All in all we were able to raise several thousand dollars .
translation.zh: 参加马拉松比赛的每个运动员都要交10美元的入场费。此外，他们挨家挨户地寻找赞助商，承诺参与者每跑一英里就有一美元。总而言之，我们就这样筹集到了几千美元。

translation.en: Sounds like a great deal for the American Cancer Society .
translation.zh: 对癌症协会来说数目可不小。

translation.en: In all honesty , it's also a great deal for our company . The exposure that we gained from sponsoring an invent like this was great for our image in the community . We accomplished as much as last year's advertising campaign , plus we were able to do a little fundraising for a good cause .
translation.zh: 老实说，这对我们公司也是一笔大买卖。通过赞助这样的活动我们所得到的出镜率对我们在社区的形象非常重要。我们得到的广告收益跟去年一样多。此外，我们还为慈善事业筹集了一些钱。

translation.en: John , I'd like to see you in my office for a minute .
translation.zh: 约翰，你到我办公室来一下。

translation.en: Yes , sir , I'll be there in just a moment .
translation.zh: 好的，先生，我马上就到。

translation.en: John , I have been watching you . I've been paying attention to you over the last quarter and I'm impressed . You've done a tremendous job in tackling some difficult accounts . I just want to let you to know , after this month's performance reviews , I'm recommending you for promotion .
translation.zh: 约翰，我一直在留意你。上一季度我一直注意你的表现，对你的印象很好。你在处理一些棘手的账目方面做了大量的工作。我只想让你知道，这个月的业绩评议以后，我要推荐你升职。

translation.en: Gosh sir , thank you , sir ! I had no idea there were any positions opening up in our department .
translation.zh: 天哪，先生，谢谢你，先生！我不知道我们部门还有空缺的职位。

translation.en: Well , it's not going to be in our department . I've recommended you for an interdepartmental transfer . There's supervisory spot opening up in financial . I'm turning your name in for it .
translation.zh: 哦，不是我们部门。我已经推荐你跨部门调动，在财务部有个管理岗位空缺，我打算提名你接任。

translation.en: Management ? Wow , I had no idea I could move so quickly from entry level to managerial staff .
translation.zh: 管理层？哇，我真没想到自己能那么快从初级职位升为管理人员。

translation.en: You've earned it .
translation.zh: 这是你应得的。

translation.en: Hello Mr . Jones , please have a seat . Thank you for coming in today . I have read your resume . You completed University in England ?
translation.zh: 你好，琼斯先生，请坐。谢谢你今天能来。我看了你的简历。你在英国完成大学学业了吗？

translation.en: Yes , I went to Cambridge . After graduation , I started right away into the advertising industry . Later , I made a bit of a switch to focus on marketing research .
translation.zh: 是的，我上过剑桥。毕业后，我立刻就进入了广告业。后来，我有了一点（职业）转变，专注于市场调查。

translation.en: So , what experience do you have ?
translation.zh: 那么，你有什么经验？

translation.en: I have ten years marketing experience . This includes both entry level and management positions . In my last position , I worked my way up to being director of the marking department .
translation.zh: 我有十年的市场营销经验。这包括入门级和管理级职位。在我的上一个职位上，我一路努力，成为了市场部的主任。

translation.en: I can see that from your resume.Your last position was marketing director for a pharmaceutical company , is that right ? Later , why did you decide to leave your former post ?
translation.zh: 我从你的简历上可以看出。你上一个职位是一家制药公司的市场总监，对吗？后来，你为什么决定离开原来的岗位？

translation.en: I felt after five years in one place , I was ready for something new . I would like to have a job that is challenging , something that I can see and do new things every day . I loved many things about my former job , and I left with amiable feelings on both sides . I was just ready for something new .
translation.zh: 我觉得在一个地方呆了五年之后，我已经准备好接受新事物了。我想找一份有挑战性的工作，每天都能看到和做新的事情。我喜欢我以前工作的很多东西，离开时我们双方都很和谐。我已经准备好了接受新事物。

translation.en: I see . Do you want to work full-time or part-time ?
translation.zh: 我懂了。你想做全职还是兼职？

translation.en: I would rather work full-time .
translation.zh: 我更倾向于全职工作。

translation.en: I'll make note of that . Now , what are your salary expectations ?
translation.zh: 我会标注一下。那么，你期望的薪水是多少？

translation.en: I am willing to negotiate , but I expect at least $ 40,000 a year .
translation.zh: 我觉得可以谈，但我预计每年至少4万美元。

translation.en: From 11 thirty to 1 o ’ clock .
translation.zh: 从11点半到1点。

translation.en: This is today ’ s schedule . At 8 thirty AM , conference with the department managers . At 9 o ’ clock , live for the workshop where you ’ ll award prizes to the staff for preventatives .
translation.zh: 这是今天的日程安排。早上8点半，和部门经理开会。9点，进行现场直播研讨会，在研讨会上，您将为员工颁发预防措施奖。

translation.en: May I see the manager of your company ?
translation.zh: 我可以见一下贵公司的经理吗？

translation.en: I am.What can I do for you ?
translation.zh: 是的。有什么事吗？

translation.en: Form your company's advertisement in the TWENTY-FIRST CENTURY , I learn that you are a foreign trade company of good service . I am interested in it.Here is my resume , ma'am .
translation.zh: 从贵公司二十一世纪的广告中得知，贵公司是一家服务周到的外贸公司。我很感兴趣。这是我的简历，女士。

translation.en: Very good , you majored in International Trade ?
translation.zh: 很好，你主修国际贸易？

translation.en: Yes , I will graduate from the People's University of China this July majoring in International Trade.Besides , at school , I am a top student.Moreover , both my spoken and written English are pretty good .
translation.zh: 是的，我今年七月毕业于中国人民大学，主修国际贸易。此外，在学校，我是一名尖子生。而且，我的英语口语和书面语都很好。

translation.en: Well , for this position , we prefer experienced employees , Those who have just graduated from university , they are supposed to start by working as an intern for at least half a year .
translation.zh: 嗯，对于这个职位，我们更喜欢有经验的员工，那些刚从大学毕业的人，他们应该开始实习至少半年。

translation.en: I think I ' m qualified for the job if I can be given the chance.While at school , I once worked as part-time translator in a company and salesperson with a textile company for two years.And I don't mind being paid less from the start , I just want to enrich my experience and competence .
translation.zh: 如果有机会的话，我想我能胜任这份工作。在学校的时候，我曾在一家公司做过兼职翻译，在一家纺织公司做过两年的销售员。我不介意从一开始就少拿工资，我只是想丰富我的经验和能力。

translation.en: Good.That is the kind of man we are looking for.By the way , do you like traveling ? Our sales representatives need to travel a lot .
translation.zh: 很好。那就是我们要找的那种人。顺便问一下，你喜欢旅游吗？我们的销售代表需要经常出差。

translation.en: Yes , I do . I like traveling very much .
translation.zh: 是的，我知道。我非常喜欢旅行。

translation.en: Are you willing to work for extra hours ?
translation.zh: 你愿意加班吗？

translation.en: Of course , I'll try my best.When can I start working ?
translation.zh: 当然，我会尽力的。我什么时候可以开始工作？

translation.en: What about next Monday ?
translation.zh: 下周一怎么样？

translation.en: Great.Let ' s start next week.Thank you , ma'am .
translation.zh: 太好了。我们下周开始吧。谢谢你，女士。

translation.en: Well , see you next monday .
translation.zh: 好吧，下周一见。

translation.en: What kind of character do you think you have ?
translation.zh: 你认为你有什么样的性格？

translation.en: Generally speaking , l am an open-minded person .
translation.zh: 一般来说，我是一个思想开放的人。

translation.en: Cheerfulness and friendliness .
translation.zh: 愉快和友好。

translation.en: They say Mr . Sun is a friendly , sensitive , caring and determined person .
translation.zh: 他们说是孙先生是一个友好，敏感，体贴的和坚定的人。

translation.en: What personality do you admire ?
translation.zh: 你欣赏什么样的性格？

translation.en: I admire a person who is honest , flexible and easy-going .
translation.zh: 我钦佩一个诚实、灵活、随和的人。

translation.en: How do you get along with others ?
translation.zh: 你和别人相处得怎么样？

translation.en: I get on well with others .
translation.zh: 我和别人相处得很好。

translation.en: Our advertisement says English competence is a key requirement of this position . Then how do you think of your proficiency in written and spoken English ?
translation.zh: 我们的招聘广告提到英语能力好是这个职位的关键要求。那么你认为你的英语书面语和口语水平如何？

translation.en: I have learned English for 10 years , and I have passed College English Test Band 4 and 6.My spoken English is fairly good enough to express myself fluently .
translation.zh: 我已经学了10年英语，并且通过了大学英语四级和六级考试。我的英语口语相当好，可以流利地表达自己。

translation.en: What other foreign language do you speak ?
translation.zh: 你还会说什么外语？

translation.en: I did self-study of Japanese in college , and I can carry on some simple conversations in Japanese .
translation.zh: 我在大学里自学了日语，我可以用日语进行一些简单的对话。

translation.en: Hello , this is Dunlin . May I speak to Mrs Smith ?
translation.zh: 你好，我是邓林。我可以和史密斯太太通话吗？

translation.en: This is Mrs Smith . Can I help you ?
translation.zh: 我是史密斯太太。有什么我能帮助你的吗？

translation.en: Ok , I will . Do you have any question ?
translation.zh: 好的，我会的。你有什么问题吗？

translation.en: No , thank you . Goodbye .
translation.zh: 没有了，谢谢。再见。

translation.en: This is Dunlin . Is this Mrs Smith speaking ?
translation.zh: 我是邓林。是史密斯太太在说话吗？

translation.en: I just want to call and say thank you for letting me interview yesterday .
translation.zh: 我只想打电话谢谢你昨天让我面试。

translation.en: And I also want to know what the status is of the position .
translation.zh: 我也想知道这个职位的状况。

translation.en: Sorry , we haven't made the decision at all . But we should be making the decision by the end of this week . And we'll get in touch with you once we make it .
translation.zh: 对不起，我们还没有做出决定。但我们应该在本周末做出决定。我们一到就和你联系。

translation.en: Do you have any questions we didn't cover in the interview ?
translation.zh: 你有什么我们在面试中没有涉及的问题吗？

translation.en: Thank you , I am looking forward to hearing from you . Bye-bye .
translation.zh: 谢谢，我很期待你的来信。再见。

translation.en: Thank you for the calling . Bye-bye .
translation.zh: 谢谢你的电话。再见。

translation.en: Yes , I am . I always make a plan before I do anything .
translation.zh: 是的。在做任何事之前我都会制定计划。

translation.en: Where do you want to be in 5 years ?
translation.zh: 你希望五年之后达成什么职场目标？

translation.en: I don't want to have a specific title . I just want to enjoy what I am doing .
translation.zh: 我不想被限制在一个特定的位置。我只想享受我当下做的事情。

translation.en: If you are hired , how long do you plan to stay with us ?
translation.zh: 如果你被录用，你打算在我们这儿呆多久？

translation.en: That obviously depends on how things go - - whether I'm suited to the firm and the firm to me .
translation.zh: 这显然取决于--我是否适合这个公司，以及这个公司是否适合我。

translation.en: Tell me about some of your recent goals and what you do to achieve them .
translation.zh: 告诉我你最近的一些目标，以及你为此付出了什么。

translation.en: I want to put my knowledge and experience to use in a challenging position . In order to achieve this goal , I just want to work step by step .
translation.zh: 我想把我的知识经验运用在一个具有挑战性的职位上。为了实现这个目标，我只想一步一步地踏实工作。

translation.en: What is your long-range objective ?
translation.zh: 你的长期目标是什么？

translation.en: I haven't thought it over at all .
translation.zh: 我根本没想过。

translation.en: What do you think is the most important thing when looking for a job ?
translation.zh: 你认为找工作中最重要的是什么？

translation.en: I think the most important thing is the interest in the job .
translation.zh: 我认为最重要的是对这份工作的兴趣。

translation.en: Could you project what you would like to be doing five years from now ?
translation.zh: 你能未来五年的规划是什么？

translation.en: As I have some administrative experience from my last job , I may use my organizational and planning skills in the future .
translation.zh: 由于我在上一份工作中有一些行政管理经验，我将来可能会运用我的组织和规划技能。

translation.en: By doing everything necessary and for further study .
translation.zh: 通过一切必要的、进一步的学习。

translation.en: How long I will stay with the company depends on whether the company and I are satisfied with each other .
translation.zh: 我将在公司呆多久取决于我和公司是否满意彼此。

translation.en: What do you think of this industry's outlook in five years ?
translation.zh: 你认为这个行业五年后的前景如何？

translation.en: I do believe this industry will be developed rapidly in 5 years time .
translation.zh: 我相信这个行业将在五年内迅速发展。

translation.en: What is your salary at present ?
translation.zh: 你现在的工资是多少？

translation.en: My present pay is 100,000 Yuan per year .
translation.zh: 我现在的工资是每年10万元。

translation.en: What are your salary expectations now ?
translation.zh: 你现在期望的薪水是多少？

translation.en: I like to be paid more than that . Hopefully , 120,000 Yuan per year .
translation.zh: 我想得到更多的薪水。大概是每年12万元。

translation.en: That's a little more than we had planned .
translation.zh: 这比我们预计的要多一些。

translation.en: I think you'll find I'm worth that .
translation.zh: 我想你会觉得我是值得这么多薪水的。

translation.en: I can only offer you 110,000 Yuan a year . Raises will be given after a three-month probation according to your performance . Is that satisfactory ?
translation.zh: 我一年只能给你11万元。根据你的表现，三个鱼试用期过后会加薪。你觉得满意吗？

translation.en: Yes , it is quite reasonable .
translation.zh: 是的，这很合理。

translation.en: How are you doing , Madam ? My name is During . I am coming to your company for an interview as requested .
translation.zh: 夫人，你好吗？我的名字叫杜林。我是按要求来贵公司面试的。

translation.en: Fine , thank you for coming . Mr . Wu , Please take a seat . I am Anne Smith , the assistant manager .
translation.zh: 很好，欢迎你来。吴先生先生，请坐。我是安妮·史密斯，任经理助理。

translation.en: Nice to see you , Mrs . Smith .
translation.zh: 很高兴见到你，史密斯夫人。

translation.en: Hello , Mr . Hammer . Jack Ross here . I'm calling to confirm our appointment on Monday at ten o'clock in your office .
translation.zh: 你好，哈默先生先生。我是杰克·罗斯。我打电话来是想确认我们星期一十点在贵公司会面的约定。

translation.en: Yes . Everything's all set .
translation.zh: 嗯。一切都准备好了。

translation.en: I'd like to bring Mr . Huang and Ms . Sun with me .
translation.zh: 我想和黄先生以及孙女士一起过来。

translation.en: We're supposed to be meeting alone .
translation.zh: 我们应该单独见面。

translation.en: I know , but I think they may add something valuable to the discussion .
translation.zh: 我知道，但我认为他们可能会给讨论增加一些有价值的东西。

translation.en: Fine . But no one else , OK ?
translation.zh: 好的。但是不能再有其他人了，可以吗？

translation.en: Yes , Mr . Hammer .
translation.zh: 好的，哈默先生。

translation.en: Sally , you look so corporate ! What interview do you have today ?
translation.zh: 莎莉，你看起来像个成功人士！你今天去哪儿面试？

translation.en: Amalgamated Trading Company . It's Swiss . Don't you think working at a foreign company would be glamorous ?
translation.zh: 是瑞士的合并贸易公司。你不觉得外企工作很有吸引力吗？

translation.en: Yeah , I guess so . I've never actually heard of this one , but ...
translation.zh: 嗯，我想是的。虽然我从没听说过这个公司，但是……

translation.en: Well , it's small , but it's a young , dynamic , rapidly-growing company with a progressive , humanistic philosophy .
translation.zh: 嗯，虽然规模不大，但它是一家年轻、充满活力、快速发展的公司，有着进步、人文主义的公司理念。

translation.en: You didn't read their brochure or anything , did you ?
translation.zh: 你该不会看过他们的宣传册什么的吧？

translation.en: Four times . I'm totally prepared . Oh , no ! I forgot to take off my nail polish ! And I have to be there in 15 minutes ! That's it . I blew it .
translation.zh: 看了四次。我完全准备好了。哦，不！我忘了卸掉指甲油！我必须在15分钟内赶到那里！就这样吧。我的面试该被搞砸了。

translation.en: Well , they are progressive and humanistic-maybe they don't care about nail polish ... uh ... even blue nail polish . Just keep your confidence up and you'll do great .
translation.zh: 嗯，他们是进步的和人性化的，也许他们不在乎指甲油……呃，甚至蓝色指甲油。只要保持自信，你就会做得很好。

translation.en: But the competition is fierce this year ... and it seems like I'm the only one left who hasn't found a job .
translation.zh: 但是今年的竞争很激烈……看来我是唯一一个找不到工作的人了。

translation.en: Not quite the only one . I really wanted that job at the magazine , but I still haven't heard from them .
translation.zh: 不是唯一一个。我真的很想得到杂志社那份工作，但我也还没有收到他们的结果。

translation.en: It says here that you graduated from Beijing Normal University with a major in English Language and Literature .
translation.zh: 上面写着你毕业于北京师范大学英语语言文学专业。

translation.en: Right . Then you may think that I am not fit for this job according to my educational background .
translation.zh: 是的。也许从我的教育背景来看，你可能会认为我不适合这份工作。

translation.en: But I want to be a tour guide very much because I like traveling and meeting various kinds of people . So I took an evening course at the Tourism School of Beijing after graduation and I have gotten a qualification certificate .
translation.zh: 但是我很想当导游，因为我喜欢旅游，喜欢认识各种各样的人。所以我毕业后在北京旅游学校上了夜校，拿到了资格证书。

translation.en: So you must be an extravert ?
translation.zh: 所以你一定是个外向的人？

translation.en: Yes , I always enjoy being with a group of people and chatting with them .
translation.zh: 是的，我总是喜欢和一群人在一起聊天。

translation.en: What do you think are the responsibilities of a tourist guide ?
translation.zh: 你认为导游的职责是什么？

translation.en: A tourist guide must be responsible for arranging and coordinating tour activities , and offering service of transportation , accommodation , sightseeing , shopping and entertainment .
translation.zh: 导游必须负责安排和协调旅游活动，提供交通、住宿、观光、购物、娱乐等服务。

translation.en: Don't you consider it a hard work ?
translation.zh: 你不认为这是一项艰苦的工作吗？

translation.en: Hard but interesting , I think .
translation.zh: 我觉得很虽然难但也很有趣。

translation.en: Have you any experience as a tourist guide ?
translation.zh: 你有当导游的经验吗？

translation.en: Yes , I usually guided foreign tourists around Beijing when I was in University .
translation.zh: 是的，我在大学的时候经常带领外国游客游览北京。

translation.en: Have you ever learned any other foreign languages other than English ?
translation.zh: 除了英语，你还学过其他外语吗？

translation.en: Yes , I have learned a little French and Japanese as well .
translation.zh: 是的，我也学了一点法语和日语。

translation.en: We have an appointment for this afternoon . Mr . Chen will know why I'm calling .
translation.zh: 我们今天下午有个约会。陈先生会知道我为什么打电话的。

translation.en: The numbers in this table don't seem to be in accord with reality .
translation.zh: 这张表上的数字似乎与实际情况不符。

translation.en: I know , but these are the figures that we came up with .
translation.zh: 我知道，但这些是我们得出的数字。

translation.en: I'm not sure I can't agree , dan
translation.zh: 我恐怕不能同意，丹

translation.en: Are you doing anything right now , Diana ?
translation.zh: 你现在在忙什么，戴安娜？

translation.en: I am typing a report for the moment , Mr . Robbins . Anything I need to do ?
translation.zh: 罗宾斯先生，我正在打报告。有什么事需要我做吗？

translation.en: Will you please cut it for a while and come in here to take a letter ?
translation.zh: 请你先暂停一会儿工作，进来写封信好吗？

translation.en: Yes , this letter can't go into the mail any later than 5 . It's about a contract .
translation.zh: 是的，这封信不能晚于5点寄出。是关于合同的。

translation.en: Ok , I am coming .
translation.zh: 好的，我来了。

translation.en: Please take a seat , Diana . Have you got your spare pens and pencils ?
translation.zh: 请坐，戴安娜。你有多余的钢笔和铅笔吗？

translation.en: Yes , I have this time . But If I don't understand a word or a phrase when you are dictating , can I ask you halfway ?
translation.zh: 是的，这个我有。但是如果你口述的时候，我有某个词或短语听不懂，我可以中途问你吗？

translation.en: No , I ’ d prefer not . I don't want any interruptions every other minute , but you can ask me at the end of the letter .
translation.zh: 不，我想最好不要那样。我不想每隔一分钟就被打断，但你可以在信的最后问我。

translation.en: All right . I understand now . Do you think I should leave a margin on every page wide enough for notes and amendments .
translation.zh: 好吧。我现在明白了。你认为我应该在每一页留一个足够宽的页边空白，以便作注释和修改吗？

translation.en: Of course , Diana . You'd better pay attention to the spelling when you type it .
translation.zh: 当然，戴安娜。你打字时最好注意拼写。

translation.en: Certainly I will , Mr . Robbins . By the way , may I use a window envelope ?
translation.zh: 我当然会的，先生。罗宾斯。顺便问一下，我可以用开窗信封吗？

translation.en: Yes , that's fine . Now when you finish these , I want you to put these cards in alphabetical order , using the last names , and then make a list .
translation.zh: 是的，那很好。当你完成这些后，我需要你把这些卡片按姓氏顺序列一个清单。

translation.en: You want the cards in alphabetical order using the last names ?
translation.zh: 你要按姓氏字母顺序排列卡片吗？

translation.en: Right . And the last thing , we are going to clean the files out tomorrow . Now let's begin .
translation.zh: 是的。还有最后一件事，就是我们明天要清理文件。那么现在让我们开始吧。

translation.en: Come in , Arnold . Have a seat .
translation.zh: 进来，阿诺德。请坐。

translation.en: No , thank you . I just had two cups of coffee at my desk .
translation.zh: 不用了，谢谢。我刚才喝了两杯咖啡。

translation.en: So , you're a serious coffee drinker .
translation.zh: 所以，你是个严重的咖啡爱好者。

translation.en: Yes , it keeps me going . Sometimes I think I'm addicted .
translation.zh: 是的，它让我继续前进。有时候我觉得我上瘾了。

translation.en: Well , coffee isn't such a bad thing.Everyone has to have something.For me , it's cigars . Are you a cigar smoker ?
translation.zh: 嗯，咖啡也不是一个坏事情。每个人都要有所喜好。像我，就是雪茄。你抽烟吗？

translation.en: No , I've tried them . But I'm not really a smoker .
translation.zh: 不，我尝试过。但我并不是一个吸烟爱好者。

translation.en: Well , what would you like to talk to me about ?
translation.zh: 好吧，你想和我谈什么？

translation.en: I wanted to set up this meeting with you to discuss a little proposal .
translation.zh: 我想借着这个会谈跟你讨论一个提案。

translation.en: I'm glad when people have new ideas around here . Tell me about it .
translation.zh: 我很高兴这里能有人提些新计划，告诉我是什么。

translation.en: It is about the staff meetings.You know how we have a staff meeting every Tuesday .
translation.zh: 是关于员工会议的。你知道我们每个星期二都有员工会议。

translation.en: Well , I have been thinking about it.And I believe we could do things more efficiently here .
translation.zh: 嗯，我一直在考虑。我相信我们可以做得更有效率些。

translation.en: What do you suggest ?
translation.zh: 你有什么建议？

translation.en: The way it is now , the staff from all four branches get together once a week.We meet for one hour . But I think a lot of time is wasted in transportation .
translation.zh: 现在的情况是，四个分公司的员工每周都会来这里一次会，我们开会一个小时。但我认为很多时间都浪费在交通上了。

translation.en: You mean because people have to go across town to get here .
translation.zh: 你的意思是因为大家都要横越整个城市到这儿。

translation.en: Yes . Some people spend half of the morning on the road .
translation.zh: 对。有些人花了大半个上午在路上。

translation.en: That's true . But our staff meetings are very important , Arnold . I don't know how we can function without them .
translation.zh: 那是真的。没有错。但我们员工会议是很重要的，阿诺德。我不知道没有员工会议我们如何能运作。

translation.en: I think they are important too.That ' s why I want people to have a better attitude about them .
translation.zh: 我认为他们也很重要，这就是为什么我要大家对员工会议能有更好的态度。

translation.en: I know a lot of people think the meetings aren't too useful . I'm aware of that .
translation.zh: 我知道很多人认为员工会议没什么用。我知道这一点。

translation.en: Here's what I propose . I think we should meet once every two weeks , but meet for ninety minutes or more .
translation.zh: 这是我的建议。我想我们应该每两个星期开一次会，但见面要90分钟以上。

translation.en: I also think the meetings should be more focused.And I would be willing to take responsibility for that .
translation.zh: 我同时也认为议题应更明确。我愿意对这件事负责。

translation.en: You mean you want to run the meetings ?
translation.zh: 你是说你想主持会议？

translation.en: No , not really run them . But I could help organize them . I could discuss meeting topics with you , and then prepare a schedule for each meeting . I could then send an e-mail to all the staff to explain the coming meeting.This way the meetings would become more focused , and people would prepare better .
translation.zh: 不，并不是要主持会议。但我可以帮忙筹组。我可以跟你讨论议题，然后准备每次会议的时程表。我可以寄电子邮件给所有的员工解说下个会议。这样的话会议就能更明确，大家也能准备得更充分。

translation.en: Hmm . But we would meet every two weeks .
translation.zh: 嗯，但我们会每两个星期开一次会。

translation.en: I really think it would work.The meetings could be longer , and better organized .
translation.zh: 我真的认为这样行得通。会议可以更久，更有组织性。

translation.en: I am not against the idea , Arnold.It may really be more efficient , as you say . I'll tell you what we can do.Why don't we try your proposal for a month , and see how it works .
translation.zh: 我不反对这个主意，阿诺德。正如你所说，这也许真的更有效率。我来告诉你我们能做些什么。我们何不试试你的提案一个月，看看效果如何。

translation.en: Excellent . I would be happy to get started on it .
translation.zh: 太好了，我已经迫不及待了。

translation.en: I will call the managers.Then tomorrow I'll tell you when we can schedule our first meeting in this " new style . "
translation.zh: 我会打电话给经理，然后明天我会告诉你我们什么时候可以第一次安排这种“新风格”的会议。

translation.en: Medicine Industry , this is Peter Bush speaking , can I help you ?
translation.zh: 这里是医药工业，我是彼得·布什，有什么事吗？

translation.en: Good afternoon , could you connect this call with Mr Brown , please
translation.zh: 下午好，请把这个电话接给布朗先生好吗

translation.en: This is Li Ping of ABC computer company limited . I'm calling on our Mr Wilson the general manager of our company .
translation.zh: 我是ABC电脑有限公司的李平。我是代表我们公司总经理威尔逊先生打来的。

translation.en: I'm sorry , Mrs Li , Mr Brown is now in a meeting.May I have your number , and ask him to call you back later ?
translation.zh: 对不起，李先生，布朗先生正在开会。请告诉我您的电话号码，让他稍后再打给您好吗？

translation.en: I'm afraid Mr Wilson would like to speak to Mr Brown right now.He ' s got an urgent matter to discuss with Mr Brown without delay .
translation.zh: 恐怕威尔逊先生现在想和布朗先生谈谈，他有急事要和布朗先生立即讨论。

translation.en: Ok , then would you please hold the line ? Mr Li , the line is through , Mr Brown is ready answering the call , go ahead .
translation.zh: 好的，那么请您不要挂断好吗？李先生，电话接通了，布朗先生准备好接电话了，请讲。

translation.en: Thank you for your assistance , Mr Bush .
translation.zh: 谢谢你的帮助，布什先生。

translation.en: Good morning ! I am Anna Lu . I've come for an interview which was arranged .
translation.zh: 早上好！我是安娜卢。我是来面试的，是事先约好的。

translation.en: Oh , I see . I am Jack White , Personnel Manager . Take a seat , please .
translation.zh: 好的，我知道了。我是杰克·怀特，人事经理。请坐。

translation.en: Glad to meet you , Mr . White .
translation.zh: 很高兴见到你，怀特先生。

translation.en: Miss Lu , have you got any experience in restaurant service ?
translation.zh: 陆小姐，你有餐厅服务经验吗？

translation.en: Yes . Since I entered college , I have been working at a fast food restaurant as a part-time waitress .
translation.zh: 有。自从我上大学以来，我一直在一家快餐店做兼职服务员。

translation.en: Our restaurant receives a lot of foreign customers . Can you serve them in English ?
translation.zh: 我们餐厅会接待很多外国顾客。你能用英语招待他们吗？

translation.en: That's why I applied for this job . Now I am studying Hotel English in my college , and I am quite familiar with the western courtesy and restaurant etiquette . I am sure my public relation skills will leave a strong impression on your customers .
translation.zh: 这就是我申请这份工作的原因。现在我正在大学学习酒店英语，我对西方的礼节和餐厅礼仪相当熟悉。我相信我的公关技巧会给你们的顾客留下深刻的印象。

translation.en: You must know our working hours are very long and overtime work is frequent .
translation.zh: 你一定知道我们的工作时间很长而且加班很频繁吧。

translation.en: I don't mind that .
translation.zh: 我不介意。

translation.en: I think I will give you a 3 months ’ trial . The salary for this period is 800 yuan a month with no bonus . After that period if we both feel satisfied , a formal contract would be signed .
translation.zh: 我想我会给你三个月的试用期。这段时间的工资是每月800元，没有奖金。过了这段时间，如果双方都满意的话，我们就会签订正式合同。

translation.en: When am I supposed to start working ?
translation.zh: 我什么时候开始工作？

translation.en: Next monday . Bring your resume and diploma with you .
translation.zh: 下周一。带上你的简历和毕业证书。

translation.en: Yes , I will . Thank you , Mr . White . Goodbye !
translation.zh: 好的，我会的。谢谢你，怀特先生。再见！

translation.en: I'm sorry , he's out at the moment .
translation.zh: 对不起，他现在不在。

translation.en: Can we talk about this bonus plan of yours ? I ’ Ve got a few problems with it .
translation.zh: 我们能讨论一下你定的这个奖金方案吗？我有一些问题。

translation.en: Sure , Richard . What ’ s on your mind ?
translation.zh: 当然，理查德。你怎么想的？

translation.en: Well , to be honest , I just don ’ t think we ’ re going to have enough funds to give the kind of bonuses you have in mind .
translation.zh: 嗯，说实话，我只是觉得我们没有那么多的钱来实现你的方案。

translation.en: Well , why don ’ t we sit down and work out the numbers ? We can always scale down the bonuses if we have to .
translation.zh: 好吧，我们为什么不坐下来算一算钱呢？如果必要的话，我们可以减少奖金额度。

translation.en: Mr . Johnson ’ s office . Cindy speaking .
translation.zh: 这里是约翰逊先生的办公室。我是辛迪。

translation.en: Hi , Cindy . It ’ s Michael Kurt . Is Mr . Johnson in ?
translation.zh: 嗨，辛迪。我是迈克尔·库尔特。约翰逊先生在吗？

translation.en: No , I ’ m sorry , Mr . Kurt . He ’ s stepped out for a bit . Would you like me to have him call you ?
translation.zh: 抱歉，库尔特先生，他不在。他出去有一会儿了。您需要我让他给您打电话吗？

translation.en: Yeah , that ’ ll be great . I ’ m on extension 4283 .
translation.zh: 是的，那太好了。我接4284分机。

translation.en: morning . Rent-A-Car Agency . May I help you ?
translation.zh: 早上好。这里是租车公司。请问您需要帮忙吗？

translation.en: Good morning . This is Paul Alexander calling from the Isis Advertising Firm . We need a car to the airport for Mr . Phillips .
translation.zh: 早上好。我是伊西丝广告公司的保罗·亚历山大。我们需要一辆去机场的车送菲利普斯先生。

translation.en: Certainly , Mr . Alexander . When would Mr . Phillips like to leave ?
translation.zh: 好的，亚历山大先生。请问菲利普斯先生什么时候离开？

translation.en: Let me check ... His flight ’ s at 2:30 p . m . , so he should leave no later than 12 noon .
translation.zh: 让我看一下……他的航班是下午2:30。所以他应该不能晚于中午12点就得离开。

translation.en: Good morning . Could I speak with Mr . Willard please ?
translation.zh: 早上好。请问恨我能和威拉德先生通话吗？

translation.en: This is he . Who ’ s calling , please ?
translation.zh: 我就是。请问你是谁？

translation.en: This is Chris Emerson speaking .
translation.zh: 我是克里斯·爱默生。

translation.en: Hello , Chris . How can I help you ?
translation.zh: 你好，克里斯。有什么事吗？

translation.en: Finance , Angie speaking .
translation.zh: 这里是财务部，我是安吉。

translation.en: Hi Angie , it ’ s Tom Reynolds here . Can you tell me if my tuition fees for this semester have been approved ?
translation.zh: 嗨，安吉，我是汤姆·雷诺兹。你能告诉我这学期的学费是否已经批准了吗？

translation.en: Yes , Mr . Reynolds . They were approved yesterday . You can pick up the check today .
translation.zh: 是的，雷诺兹先生。昨天就批准了。你今天可以去取支票了。

translation.en: Oh wow ! Thanks a million , Angie !
translation.zh: 哦，哇！万分感谢，安吉！

translation.en: Can you come in for an interview tomorrow at 10:00 ?
translation.zh: 你明天10点能来面试吗？

translation.en: I really think if I can get my foot in the door at this company it will do wonders for my career . Do you think you can help me polish my interview style ?
translation.zh: 我想只要我能进入这家公司，就会给我的事业带来奇迹。你能帮我润色一下简历吗？

translation.en: Sure . Doing your homework and preparing for an interview really pays off .
translation.zh: 当然可以。在家做好面试准备工作是值得的。

translation.en: I ’ Ve researched the company and think I ’ m perfect for the job but I ’ m not sure how to get it across to them .
translation.zh: 我已经调查过这家公司，我很适合这份工作，可不知道怎么才能得到他们的赏识。

translation.en: Well first you have to have more confidence.Employers look for people who are interested , enthusiastic and sure of themselves .
translation.zh: 首先，你必须更自信。雇主招的是对工作有兴趣，工作热情和自信的人。

translation.en: I know I have what it takes but Im worried that my work experience won ’ t sufficient . Should I inflate my experience ?
translation.zh: 我知道我有能力，但我担心我的工作经验不够。我应该夸大我的经验吗？

translation.en: No , you should always be upfront and honest about your weaknesses . However by focusing on your strong points and maintaining a positive attitude about your abilities , you can take the attention
translation.zh: 不用，对你的劣势，你必须诚实坦白。不过你可以强调你的强项，对个人能力保持积极态度，雇主就不会注意你工作经验的不足。雇主总是对富有进取心的人印象深刻。

translation.en: Comfort Inn , may I help you ?
translation.zh: 这里是康菲酒店，有什么事吗？

translation.en: I ’ m looking for a hotel near the convention center .
translation.zh: 我想在会议中心附近找一家酒店。

translation.en: You ’ re in luck ! We ’ re just a two-minute drive from there . Would you like to make a reservation ?
translation.zh: 您真幸运！我们离那里只有两分钟的车程。您要预订吗？

translation.en: Not just yet . I have one or two questions . How much for a single ?
translation.zh: 稍等一下。我有一两个问题。单人房多少钱？

translation.en: During the peak season , a single room goes for 50 dollars on a night . But we ’ Ve got a Single Super Saver Special going on right now – only $ 30 a night . And we ’ Ve also extended our checkout time 00 in
translation.zh: 在旺季，一间单人房每晚50美元。但是我们现在有一个巨划算的特别活动——每晚只要30美元。我们还把退房时间延长到了7点。

translation.en: That ’ s a good deal . Since this is a working trip , I wonder if you have meeting rooms where I can get together with some clients .
translation.zh: 那很划算。由于这是一次工作旅行，我想知道你们是否有会议室，我可以在那里与一些客户会面。

translation.en: Yes , we have five meeting rooms , of various sizes . We can accommodate large meetings and small , informal gatherings as well . Of course , if you have many small meeting , you might consider checking
translation.zh: 是的，我们有五间大小不一的会议室。我们还可以容纳大型会议和小型非正式会议。当然，如果你有很多小会议，你可以考虑预订。

translation.en: That sounds great . Do you accept checks ?
translation.zh: 听起来不错。你们收支票吗？

translation.en: I ’ m sorry , sir , we don ’ t . But we do accept all major credit cards .
translation.zh: 对不起，先生，我们不收支票。但我们接受所有主流信用卡。

translation.en: I am a graduate of a technical university and have been employed as a technician with Company or approximately 10 years .
translation.zh: 我毕业于一所科技大学，在公司做技术人员快十年了。

translation.en: I am looking for a growth opportunity , which I feel is not available at my current employer . In terms of skills , I am Microsoft certified in Windows XP and several other operating system
translation.zh: 我在寻找发展机会，但是现在任职的公司不能提供给我这样的机遇。关于技术，我有Windows XP 和其他几个操作系统的微软证书。

translation.en: Good evening , Mr . Lee and thank you for choosing our airline . We have just discovered that this flight is overbooked . Would you like to volunteer to give up your seat ?
translation.zh: 晚上好，先生。谢谢你选择我们的航空公司。我们刚刚发现这趟航班已经超额预定了。你愿意自愿让座吗？

translation.en: Overbooked ? Give up my seat ? I don ’ t understand .
translation.zh: 超额预定？让开我的座位？我不明白。

translation.en: From time to time we have a situation in which there are more passengers than there are seats on the aircraft . That ’ s overbooked .
translation.zh: 我们不时会遇到这样一种情况：飞机上的乘客比座位多。已经超额预定了。

translation.en: I know what overbooked is , I just don ’ t understand how that could happen ?
translation.zh: 我知道什么是超额预定，我只是不明白怎么会发生这种事？

translation.en: Actually it ’ s a common practice to overbook , as passengers often don ’ t take their flight as scheduled . Most of the time there is no problem but today , more passengers arrived than we have seats ,
translation.zh: 事实上，超员预订是一种常见的做法，因为乘客往往没有按计划乘坐航班。大部分时间都没问题，但今天来的乘客比我们的座位还多，

translation.en: So who has to stay behind ?
translation.zh: 那么谁必须留下来？

translation.en: Well , first we ask for volunteers . If someone like yourself volunteers , they receive a free round trip ticket to be used within one year . If no one volunteers we just have to select someone .
translation.zh: 好吧，首先我们请志愿者。如果像你这样的人自愿参加，他们会得到一张免费的往返票，一年内使用。如果没有人自愿，我们只能选择一个人。

translation.en: Ok . I ’ ll volunteer . I could use a free ticket !
translation.zh: 好的。我来做志愿者。我需要一张免费票！

translation.en: Hi . I ’ m here for flight 514 returning to Beijing but the board shows there is a delay.How long of a delay is expected ?
translation.zh: 你好。我是乘坐514次航班返回北京的，但登机牌上显示航班有延误。大概会延误多长时间啊？

translation.en: So far it looks like we will be leaving two hours late , but keep checking the departing flights status board just in case .
translation.zh: 目前看来会延误两小时，不过，请继续检查离港航班状态屏，以防万一。

translation.en: Do you think it ’ s safe to leave to get a quick bite ?
translation.zh: 出去迅速吃一顿饭可以吗？

translation.en: I think you should stay in the airport . Even though the delay is expected to be two hours , the flight departure could be announced any minute . Who knows ?
translation.zh: 我想你应该呆在机场。尽管预计延误两小时，但航班随时可能起飞。谁知道呢？

translation.en: It seems there are some loose bolts on one of the wings . It happens all the time . No need to worry .
translation.zh: 好像有一个机翼上的螺栓松了。这种事经常发生。不用担心。

translation.en: Umm ... You know ... Actually I was thinking of trying another airline . No need to hold my seat .
translation.zh: 呃……嗯……我想换航班，不必要保留我的座位了。

translation.en: hi , Isaiah . How are you ?
translation.zh: 嗨，以赛亚。你好吗？

translation.en: I ’ m well . And you ?
translation.zh: 我很好。你呢？

translation.en: fine . How ’ s your job going ?
translation.zh: 很好。你的工作怎么样？

translation.en: I don ’ t know if I told you or not , but I decided to start my own business .
translation.zh: 我不知道有没有告诉过你，我决定自己创业了。

translation.en: really ? That ’ s fantastic . What kind of business is it ?
translation.zh: 真的吗？太棒了。做什么生意？

translation.en: I ’ Ve started an investment banking firm with some of my old colleagues from Goldman Sachs .
translation.zh: 我和高盛的一些老同事一起创办了一家投资银行公司。

translation.en: how ’ s it going ?
translation.zh: 怎么样了？

translation.en: it started off a bit slow , but now , business is really booming !
translation.zh: 开始进度有点慢，但现在，生意真的很红火！

translation.en: that ’ s such great news . I ’ m really happy for you ! Where is your office located ?
translation.zh: 这真是个好消息。我真为你高兴！你的办公室在哪里？

translation.en: our headoffice is here in Beijing , but we ’ re planning on opening up two more offices soon .
translation.zh: 我们的总部在北京，但我们计划不久再开设两个办事处。

translation.en: where will those be located ?
translation.zh: 它们将在哪里？

translation.en: if all goes well , we ’ ll open one up in Hong Kong in April and another one in Singapore in October .
translation.zh: 如果一切顺利的话，我们将在四月在香港开一家办事处，十月在新加坡开一家办事处。

translation.en: when will you find out ?
translation.zh: 你们什么时候出结果？

translation.en: we ’ re negotiating the final details of the leasing contracts tomorrow .
translation.zh: 我们明天将会谈判租赁合同的最后细节。

translation.en: well , good luck . I hope it all goes well for you tomorrow !
translation.zh: 好吧，祝你好运。我希望你明天一切顺利！

translation.en: We have an hour-long lunch break form 12 to 1 . we can take coffee breaks during the day . My boss doesn ’ t mind , as long as we get out work done on time .
translation.zh: 从12点到1点我们有一个小时的午休时间。我们可以在白天喝咖啡休息。我老板不介意，只要我们按时完成工作。

translation.en: can you squeeze me in sometime today ?
translation.zh: 你今天能给我挤出点时间来吗？

translation.en: That ’ s a big order , Jane . I am really swamped .
translation.zh: 这可够呛，珍妮。我的确忙不开。

translation.en: I know what you ’ re saying , but I have to go over the books with you before I go see our tax guy .
translation.zh: 我明白你的意思。可我必须得在去见收税的之前跟你过一遍账。

translation.en: Right . Okay , let me see what I can do . How about 1:30 right after my lunch meeting ? It won ’ t take more than a half hour , will it ?
translation.zh: 好吧，让我想想怎么办。一点半怎么样, 在我午餐会议之后?不会超过半小时吧？

translation.en: Hello . Excuse me .
translation.zh: 你好。请原谅我。

translation.en: Do you remember me ? I just had lunch here a half hour ago .
translation.zh: 你还记得我吗？我半小时前刚在这里吃过午饭。

translation.en: Of course I remember you .
translation.zh: 我当然记得你。

translation.en: I think I lost my wallet here .
translation.zh: 我想我把钱包丢在这儿了。

translation.en: Oh , no . Really ? I didn't see anything .
translation.zh: 哦，不。真的？我什么也没看到。

translation.en: Really ? You didn't find a wallet ?
translation.zh: 真的？你没找到钱包？

translation.en: No , I didn't . Would you like to go look by the table with me ?
translation.zh: 不，我没有。你愿意和我一起去看看桌子吗？

translation.en: Yes , I would . It's not here . And it's not on the floor.Has anyone sat at this table since we left ?
translation.zh: 是的，我愿意。它不在这里。它不在地板上。我们离开后有人坐在这张桌子旁吗？

translation.en: No . It's been empty the whole time .
translation.zh: 不。一直都是空的。

translation.en: Hmm . I don't know how it could have happened .
translation.zh: 嗯。我不知道怎么会这样。

translation.en: I remember , sir , that your friend took the bill.You didn't pay for the lunch yourself , did you ?
translation.zh: 我记得，先生，你的朋友买了单。这顿午餐不是你付的钱，是吗？

translation.en: No . My friend did .
translation.zh: 不。是我朋友付的。

translation.en: Then are you sure you took your wallet out of your pocket while you were here ?
translation.zh: 那你确定你在这里的时候把钱包从口袋里拿出来了吗？

translation.en: No , I'm not sure . But I usually take out my wallet when I sit down.It ' s uncomfortable to sit on it . So I usually put it next to me on the table .
translation.zh: 不，我不确定。但是我通常在坐下的时候拿出钱包，坐在上面很不舒服。所以我通常把它放在我旁边的桌子上。

translation.en: Maybe you lost it before you came here . Or maybe you left it at home .
translation.zh: 也许你来之前把它弄丢了。或者你把它忘在家里了。

translation.en: I don't think it's at home . I think I had it when I left the house.But what should I do ?
translation.zh: 我觉得不在家。我想我离开家的时候就带了。但是我该怎么办呢？

translation.en: Well , the first thing you should do is make sure it's not at home.Then , if it isn't , you need to call your credit card companies and cancel your cards . Next , you need to replace whatever you lost , your driver's license , things like that .
translation.zh: 嗯，你应该做的第一件事就是确保它不在家里。如果不在家，你需要打电话给你的信用卡公司取消你的信用卡。接下来，你需要换掉你丢失的东西，你的驾照，诸如此类的东西。

translation.en: Should I call the police ?
translation.zh: 我应该报警吗？

translation.en: You can if you want . But the police usually don't do anything about lost wallets .
translation.zh: 如果你愿意，你可以。但警方通常不会对丢失的钱包采取任何行动。

translation.en: Hmm . I'll go home and check . Maybe you're right . Maybe it's at home .
translation.zh: 嗯。我回家看看。也许你是对的。也许在家里。

translation.en: I'm sorry we couldn't find it , sir .
translation.zh: 很抱歉我们找不到，先生。

translation.en: Freeze ! Police ! Put your hands over your head .
translation.zh: 别动！警察！把手放在头上。

translation.en: What crime did I commit ?
translation.zh: 我犯了什么罪？

translation.en: You are suspected of hiding illegal drugs , so we are taking you into custody . We ’ Ve found some heroin in your house . You have the following rights while you are being interviewed . You have the right to remain silent . You don't have to make any statement against your will . You have the right to defense counsel . You have the right to request an investigation of evidence favorable to your case . Do you understand your rights ?
translation.zh: 你涉嫌非法藏匿毒品，所以我们要拘留你。我们在你家发现了一些海洛因。你在接受审讯时有以下权利。你有权保持沉默。你不必违背自己的意愿发表任何声明。你有权请辩护律师。你有权要求调查对你的案件有利的证据。你明白你的权利吗？

translation.en: I am innocent .
translation.zh: 我是无辜的。

translation.en: Would you help me figure out what to do about the office party ?
translation.zh: 你能帮我想想怎么办办公室聚会吗？

translation.en: I would be happy to help . What would you like me to help with , food or entertainment ?
translation.zh: 我很乐意帮忙。你要我帮你哪方面，食物还是娱乐？

translation.en: I would like to help you with both .
translation.zh: 我在这两方面都需要你的帮助。

translation.en: That will work out fine . To make sure everything goes together , do you think this party should be casual or dressy ?
translation.zh: 会办好的。为了确保一切顺利，你认为这个聚会应该是休闲的还是盛装的？

translation.en: A dressy party would be fun !
translation.zh: 盛装的聚会一定很有趣！

translation.en: That will work out fine . Do you think that Chinese or Continental food would be best ?
translation.zh: 会的。你觉得中国菜好还是大陆菜好？

translation.en: We should probably have both .
translation.zh: 我们或许可以两者兼得。

translation.en: Yes , that will work out fine . Should we hire a band or bring in a DJ ?
translation.zh: 是的，那很好。我们是雇个乐队还是请个DJ？

translation.en: Maybe we could do both !
translation.zh: 也许两个都可以！

translation.en: Everything sounds great then ! I'll meet you back here on Friday to discuss the details .
translation.zh: 一切听起来都很棒！星期五我们在这里碰头，讨论细节。

translation.en: I was wondering if you need any help on your new project .
translation.zh: 我想知道你的新项目是否需要帮助。

translation.en: Sure ! That would be great ! Are you good at writing or would you rather do the computer work ?
translation.zh: 当然！那太好了！你擅长写作还是更喜欢做电脑工作？

translation.en: I would like to help with the computer work .
translation.zh: 我想帮忙做电脑工作。

translation.en: Great ! We are going to be working in teams of three . Are you OK working with others ?
translation.zh: 太棒了！我们三人一组工作。你能和别人一起工作吗？

translation.en: Yes , I like working like that .
translation.zh: 是的，我喜欢那样的工作。

translation.en: We will begin next Monday . Would you be available then ?
translation.zh: 我们下星期一开始。你有空吗？

translation.en: Yes , I can be there .
translation.zh: 是的，我有空。

translation.en: Well , if you could send me your basic background information before next Monday , it would be useful .
translation.zh: 嗯，如果你能在下周一之前把你的基本背景资料寄给我，那会很有用的。

translation.en: OK , I will send the information to you .
translation.zh: 好的，我会把信息发给你。

translation.en: Well then , thanks for your help . Have a great day !
translation.zh: 那么，谢谢你的帮助。祝你有美好的一天！

translation.en: What should I do to prepare for a job interview ?
translation.zh: 我应该做些什么来准备面试？

translation.en: An understanding of the basic workings of a company and the services or goods it provides is essential . Do you have that ?
translation.zh: 必须要了解公司的基本运作形式及其提供的服务或商品。你了解吗？

translation.en: Sort of , but I could know more , I guess .
translation.zh: 了解一点吧，但我想我可以再了解多一些。

translation.en: With that understanding , you can figure out what your company is looking for in terms of basic attitude . Right ?
translation.zh: 有了这样的了解，你就可以弄清楚公司的基本目标。对吗？

translation.en: I think that they are a very formal company .
translation.zh: 我认为他们是一家非常正规的公司。

translation.en: What you wear is important . So keep in mind what is suitable for the company and type of work you will be doing . Need help ?
translation.zh: 你穿什么也很重要。所以，记住什么样的衣服适合这个公司以及你将要做的工作。需要帮助吗？

translation.en: I need a lot of help in this area .
translation.zh: 在这方面我需要很多帮助。

translation.en: In addition to clothes we need to think about other basics , OK ?
translation.zh: 除了衣服，我们还需要考虑其他基本问题，对吗？

translation.en: Yes , what else should we think of ?
translation.zh: 是的，还能想到什么？

translation.en: Be prompt . Don't forget to be friendly and interested . Listen carefully and listen to what they are really asking you . You'll be a hit !
translation.zh: 要反应迅速点。别忘了保持友好和兴趣。仔细听听他们真正在问你什么。你会成功的！

translation.en: What is the annual salary for this job ?
translation.zh: 这份工作的年薪是多少？

translation.en: The annual salary is sixty-five thousand dollars per year .
translation.zh: 年薪是每年六万五千美元。

translation.en: What does the benefits package include ?
translation.zh: 福利包括什么？

translation.en: This job pays for half of your medical , dental , and disability .
translation.zh: 这份工作会为你报销一半的医疗费、牙科费和残疾费。

translation.en: Do we get paid time off ?
translation.zh: 我们有带薪休假吗？

translation.en: You have a total of 21 days paid time off which can be used for vacation , personal , or sick leave .
translation.zh: 您总共有21天的带薪休假，可用于休假、事假或病假。

translation.en: How about retirement ?
translation.zh: 退休方面呢？

translation.en: We still offer a traditional retirement plan that pays out if you stay with the company for 5 years or more .
translation.zh: 我们仍然提供一种传统的退休计划，如果你在公司工作5年或5年以上，就可以有退休金。

translation.en: Can I get company provided specialized training ?
translation.zh: 我能得到公司提供的专门培训吗？

translation.en: We offer full tuition reimbursement for job related classes .
translation.zh: 我们提供与工作相关课程的全额学费报销。

translation.en: Where is the benefits office ?
translation.zh: 福利办公室在哪里？

translation.en: It's on the second floor in Suite 201 .
translation.zh: 在二楼201室。

translation.en: Hello , I really appreciate the opportunity to interview for this position .
translation.zh: 你好，我非常感谢您给我机会面试这个职位。

translation.en: I was wondering if you like team projects , or projects that you work on alone .
translation.zh: 我想知道你是喜欢团队合作的项目，还是喜欢独自工作的项目。

translation.en: I like to work on group projects that value and need each individual ’ s contributions .
translation.zh: 我喜欢参与需要每个人的贡献的、有价值的团队合作项目。

translation.en: Are you most interested in a good steady job with benefits or one that will allow you to quickly advance ?
translation.zh: 你最感兴趣的是一份有福利的、稳定的好工作，还是一份能让你快速晋升的工作？

translation.en: I have children so a steady job is important but I would like a chance to advance .
translation.zh: 我有孩子，所以稳定的工作很重要，但我还是希望有一个晋升的机会。

translation.en: How would you feel about relocating to another state ?
translation.zh: 你愿意搬到另一个州工作吗？

translation.en: I could not relocate in the next year , but might be open to it in the future .
translation.zh: 明年之内我可能不会搬到另一个州工作，但未来几年或许可以。

translation.en: Do you know how much this job offers per year ?
translation.zh: 你知道这份工作每年能提供多少薪水吗？

translation.en: A minimum of 75,000 per year .
translation.zh: 每年至少是75000。

translation.en: OK , well , that ’ s all I need to know for now . If something comes up , we ’ ll be contacting you .
translation.zh: 好的，以上我现在想了解的。如果出结果了，我们会通知你的。

translation.en: Hello , thank you for taking the time to interview me .
translation.zh: 你好，谢谢你抽出时间来采访我。

translation.en: Hi there , I ’ m Bill Gotcha , the owner of Gotcha Enterprises . Did you find your way here OK ?
translation.zh: 你好，我是比尔·格查，格查企业的老板。你来的时候路好找吗？

translation.en: Your assistant gave wonderful directions .
translation.zh: 你的助手给我指路指得很好。

translation.en: Why are you switching jobs at this point in your career ?
translation.zh: 你为什么在职业生涯的这个时期换工作呢？

translation.en: Our Company is moving overseas and I wish to stay in the United States .
translation.zh: 我们公司要搬到海外去，但我想留在美国。

translation.en: What are you best at ?
translation.zh: 你最擅长什么？

translation.en: I am good at organizing systems that have been having problems .
translation.zh: 我擅长将问题系统组织化。

translation.en: What is your biggest challenge in terms of skills ?
translation.zh: 你在技能方面最大的挑战是什么？

translation.en: I don ’ t like to sit around and so like to always find things to do to keep myself busy .
translation.zh: 我不喜欢闲坐着，总想找些事情做让自己忙起来。

translation.en: That is good to hear !
translation.zh: 很高兴听到你这么说！

translation.en: After I am accepted for unemployment benefits , what will happen next ?
translation.zh: 在我被认定可以领取失业救济金之后，接下来会怎么样？

translation.en: You will receive a Notice of Unemployment Insurance Award letter .
translation.zh: 您将收到失业保险补助通知。

translation.en: What will that tell me ?
translation.zh: 那会告诉我什么？

translation.en: The Award Letter will tell you how much you will receive weekly .
translation.zh: 补助通知会告诉你每周会收到多少救济金。

translation.en: Are there any other forms that I need to fill out ?
translation.zh: 我还需要填其他表格吗？

translation.en: You will need to fill out a Continued Claim Form every two weeks .
translation.zh: 您需要每两周填写一份连续索赔表。

translation.en: What information will I need to provide on that form ?
translation.zh: 我需要在表格上提供什么信息？

translation.en: They will need to know where you worked and how much money you made .
translation.zh: 他们需要知道你在哪里工作，赚了多少钱。

translation.en: Are there any other questions on the form ?
translation.zh: 表格上还有其他问题吗？

translation.en: Basically , they want to know that you were available for work and not sick .
translation.zh: 基本上，他们就是想知道你能够工作，没有生病。

translation.en: I hate to do this to you , Alice , but I ’ m going to have to ask you to put in some more overtime .
translation.zh: 我不想这样对你，爱丽丝，但我得请你再加班。

translation.en: Does it have to be this afternoon , Mr . Fairbanks ? I ’ Ve already made plans .
translation.zh: 一定是今天下午吗，费尔班克斯先生？我已经订好了计划了。

translation.en: Well , I would have preferred to do it today , but if you ’ Ve already made plans , we can do it tomorrow .
translation.zh: 嗯，我宁愿你今天加班，但如果你已经有计划，我们可以明天做。

translation.en: I ’ d appreciate that , sir . How long do you think you ’ ll need me to stay ?
translation.zh: 我很感激，先生。你认为我需要呆多久？

translation.en: I ’ ll need to meet with you before you go on vacation , Alex . I have a few things to clear up .
translation.zh: 亚历克斯，你去度假前我需要和你见个面。我有几件事要澄清。

translation.en: I ’ ll be glad to . But my schedule is super tight this week . I think the only time I have free is at lunch on Wednesday .
translation.zh: 我很乐意（和你见面）。但我这周的日程安排太紧了。我想我唯一的空闲时间是星期三的午餐时间。

translation.en: That ’ s fine . I can make that .
translation.zh: 那很好。我可以。

translation.en: All right , then . I ’ ll see you at noon on Wednesday .
translation.zh: 那好吧。星期三中午见。

translation.en: Hello . Mr . Othman ? This is Michael in Mr . Emory ’ s office . He ’ d like to set up and appointment with you to talk about buying a new copier .
translation.zh: 你好。奥特曼先生吗？我是埃默里先生办公室的迈克尔。他想和你约个时间谈谈买一台新复印机的事。

translation.en: Sure , I ’ d be glad to . What time frame did he have in mind ?
translation.zh: 当然，我很乐意。他打算什么时间谈？

translation.en: He ’ d like to do it as soon as possible , sir . How about tomorrow at 2:45 ?
translation.zh: 他想尽快谈，先生。明天2:45怎么样？

translation.en: Mm , yeah , that ’ ll be great . Tell him I ’ ll see him then .
translation.zh: 嗯，好的，那挺好的。请转告他我们到时候见。

translation.en: Excuse me . Mr . Emory ?
translation.zh: 打扰一下。埃默里先生？

translation.en: Yes , Ms . Rodriguez ? How can I help you ?
translation.zh: 什么事，罗德里格斯女士？我能帮你什么吗？

translation.en: I wanted to see if I could arrange a meeting with you to discuss recruitment .
translation.zh: 我们是不是可以安排个时间讨论一下招聘的问题？

translation.en: Absolutely . I ’ Ve been wanting to meet with you about that . Let me just get my book .
translation.zh: 当然。我一直想找你谈这个问题。我拿一下笔记本。

translation.en: Well , we could probably get started with a strategy meeting tomorrow morning at 8
translation.zh: 嗯，我们也许可以明天早上8点先开一个战略方针会议。

translation.en: I tell you what , 800 is no good for me , but why don ’ t you guys get started and I ’ ll come by at around 8
translation.zh: 我得告诉你，8点对我不合适。但你们何不先把会开起来？我大约8:45左右过来。

translation.en: That ’ s fine with me . How much time are we going to have to work on this ?
translation.zh: 我没问题。这项工作我们打算要干多久？

translation.en: Excuse me , Bill ?
translation.zh: 打扰一下，比尔？

translation.en: Hi , Christine . How ’ s it going ?
translation.zh: 嗨，克莉丝汀。怎么样了？

translation.en: Fine , thanks . Mr . Emory would like to meet with Mr . Macmillan tomorrow afternoon . Can you take a look at his book ?
translation.zh: 很好，谢谢。明天下午埃莫里先生想见麦克米伦先生。你能看看他的预约安排吗？

translation.en: Sure , just a second . All right , what time ?
translation.zh: 当然，等一下。好的，什么时候？

translation.en: Karen ? I need to go over a few things with you .
translation.zh: 凯伦？我需要和你谈几件事。

translation.en: Certainly . Mr . Graham . When would you like to meet ?
translation.zh: 好的。格雷厄姆先生。你想什么时候见面？

translation.en: I was thinking about this afternoon , after the sales meeting .
translation.zh: 我想在今天下午，销售会议结束之后。

translation.en: Fine . At 3:30 ?
translation.zh: 好的。三点半如何？

translation.en: Hello , may I speak to you for a few minutes ?
translation.zh: 你好，我能和你谈几分钟吗？

translation.en: I want to speak to you about this year ’ s election .
translation.zh: 我想和你谈谈今年的选举。

translation.en: Yes , I am a volunteer for the campaign .
translation.zh: 是的，我是这个运动的志愿者。

translation.en: I am very impressed .
translation.zh: 我真佩服你。

translation.en: I feel that history is about to be made , and I want to be a part of it .
translation.zh: 我觉得历史即将被创造，而我也想成为历史的一部分。

translation.en: That is very nice of you .
translation.zh: 说得太好了。

translation.en: Yes , I am going to vote .
translation.zh: 是的，我会投票的。

translation.en: Make sure you make it to your polling place early on Election Day .
translation.zh: 那你一定要在选举日早些时候赶到投票站。

translation.en: Thank you and good luck .
translation.zh: 谢谢你，祝你好运。

translation.en: Are you going to vote on Tuesday ?
translation.zh: 你星期二要投票吗？

translation.en: Of course . How about you ?
translation.zh: 当然。你呢？

translation.en: I ’ Ve already voted .
translation.zh: 我已经投票了。

translation.en: I sent in an absentee ballot .
translation.zh: 我投了一张缺席选票。

translation.en: I won ’ t be able to vote on Tuesday .
translation.zh: 星期二我不能投票了。

translation.en: I have to work .
translation.zh: 我得工作。

translation.en: Why don ’ t you go to work late ?
translation.zh: 你为什么不晚点去上班呢？

translation.en: I have important business to take care of that morning .
translation.zh: 那天早上我有要事要处理。

translation.en: Right , let me run through your options . You can go ahead and cash your undue Large-Amount Deposit Certificate if you really want to , but I'd recommend a Personal Durable Commodities Loan .
translation.zh: 好的，让我来看看你的期权。如果你实在想的话，你可以去兑现你未到期的大额存单，但我建议你选择个人耐用商品贷款。

translation.en: OK , what does that entail ?
translation.zh: 好吧，这涉及到什么？

translation.en: It's not too much trouble to do it this way and remember , your certificate is due in 2 months . If you can hold on to it , it'll be much better for your finances .
translation.zh: 这样做不太麻烦，记住，你的证书两个月后到期。如果你能继续持有，对你的财务状况会好得多。

translation.en: Yes , it does seem a little silly to cash it now . I'll probably need about 25,000 RIB . Will that be a problem ?
translation.zh: 是的，现在兑现确实有点傻。我大概需要25000RIB。那会有问题吗？

translation.en: Not at all , Mr Zu . As the certificate is due in 2 months , you can get the loan on mortgage of that certificate .
translation.zh: 一点也不，祖先生。等该证书2个月后到期的时候，您可以用该证书抵押贷款。

translation.en: I'm glad you thought of this . I'd have just gone ahead and cashed it ! And I suppose I can use the money from the certificate to pay back this Personal Durable Commodities Loan and I won't lose any interest , right ?
translation.zh: 我很高兴你想到了这点。不然我早就去兑现了！我想我可以用证书上的钱还这个个人耐用商品贷款，而且我不会损失任何利息，对吗？

translation.en: Exactly right . If you'd like to go ahead , I can process that for you now , Mr Zu .
translation.zh: 完全正确。如果你愿意，我现在可以帮你处理，祖先生。

translation.en: Absolutely , Jenny . Thanks very much , I think you've saved me quite a lot of money today .
translation.zh: 当然，珍妮。非常感谢，我想你今天给我省了不少钱。

translation.en: This is Lincoln Bank , Consumer Credit Department . How can I help you ?
translation.zh: 我是林肯银行，消费信贷部。我能帮你什么？

translation.en: Ah , hello . I'm calling to find out how I apply for a car loan .
translation.zh: 啊，你好。我打电话是想知道如何申请汽车贷款。

translation.en: We offer a Personal Automobile Consumer Loan . The application process is pretty straight forward . I trust you have enough funds to cover the 20 % down payment ?
translation.zh: 我们提供个人汽车消费贷款。申请过程非常简单。我相信你有足够的资金支付20%的首付？

translation.en: Yes , I do . It's ready and waiting in my account .
translation.zh: 是的，我有。我的账户已经准备好了。

translation.en: The next step is for us to recommend a dealer to you , who are already contracted to us , so ...
translation.zh: 下一步是我们给你推荐一个已经和我们签约的经销商，所以…

translation.en: Could I just stop you there ? Sorry to interrupt , but I have already been to your appointed dealer and selected the car I want .
translation.zh: 我能打断一下吗?不好意思打扰了，我已经去了你们指定的经销商，选择了我想要的车。

translation.en: That will certainly cut down the processing time . We can move on to the next step . Do you have the purchase price ?
translation.zh: 这肯定会缩短处理时间。我们可以继续下一步。你有购买价格吗？

translation.en: Yes , it's 110,000 RIB . So , with the down payment done , I will need to borrow 70,000 RIB .
translation.zh: 是的，有110000RIB。所以，首付付清后，我需要借7万RIB。

translation.en: What we need you to do next is to come into the branch with a correctly filled in application form , ID card , proof of residency , proof of income , the agreement from the agent and of course the 20 % down payment .
translation.zh: 下一步我们需要您带着正确填写的申请表、身份证、居住证明、收入证明、代理商的协议书，当然还有20%的首付款到分行。

translation.en: Yes , I have everything here . OK , I'll come in and see you later today . Maybe I could have my new car as early as next week ! How exciting !
translation.zh: 是的，这些我什么都有。好的，我今天晚些时候再来。也许我最早下星期就能有我的新车了！多令人兴奋啊！

translation.en: IBA , Jane speaking . How can I help you ?
translation.zh: 我是简。我能帮你什么？

translation.en: Hello . I'd like to speak to someone regarding my card .
translation.zh: 你好。我想和某人谈谈我的卡片。

translation.en: Sorry , I'm not quite sure if I understand . In what way , Sir ? Has your card been stolen ?
translation.zh: 对不起，我不太清楚我是否明白。怎么回事，先生？你的卡被偷了吗？

translation.en: No , no . Nothing at all like that . It's just that I applied for a credit card with you a while ago , my application was accepted , but I'm still waiting for my card .
translation.zh: 不，不。完全不是那样的。只是前一阵子我向你申请了一张信用卡，我的申请被接受了，但我还在等我的卡。

translation.en: Oh , I see , Sir . Well , it does take 5 working days to issue and post the card .
translation.zh: 哦，我明白了，先生。嗯，发卡和寄卡确实需要5个工作日。

translation.en: Yes , my application was accepted last Friday . Now it's Wednesday , that's more than 5 days .
translation.zh: 是的，我的申请上周五被接受了。现在是星期三，已经5天多了。

translation.en: Sorry , Sir , but it's 5 working days . This does not include weekends , so your card should be with you later this week .
translation.zh: 对不起，先生，但是是5个工作日。这不包括周末，所以你的卡应该在本周晚些时候带上。

translation.en: Of course ! How silly of me ! Yes , 5 working days would mean this Friday , at the earliest . I see . I'm sorry to trouble you .
translation.zh: 当然！我真傻！是的，5个工作日意味着最早这个星期五。我懂了。很抱歉打扰你。

translation.en: It's no trouble at all , Sir . Is there anything else I can help you with today ?
translation.zh: 一点也不麻烦，先生。今天还有什么我能帮你的吗？

translation.en: Nothing , thanks . I again apologise for the misunderstanding , bye for now .
translation.zh: 没什么，谢谢。我再次为误会道歉，再见。

translation.en: Hello , this is Lucie Jing calling from Lincoln Bank . May I speak to Mr Was , please ?
translation.zh: 你好，我是林肯银行的李静。请问我可以和瓦斯先生通话吗？

translation.en: Ah , hello , Mr Was . I'm just calling about your new credit card . It has arrived with us , so you can either come to collect it , or we can send it on to you .
translation.zh: 啊，你好，沃斯先生。我打电话过来就是为您的新信用卡的事情。您的卡已经到了我们这里，所以您可以来取，或者我们可以把它寄给您。

translation.en: Sending it won't be necessary . I'm actually coming in for a meeting with my Personal Banker this afternoon .
translation.zh: 没有必要寄。其实今天下午我要来和我的理财顾问会面。

translation.en: What perfect timing !
translation.zh: 时间正合适！

translation.en: Indeed . Is there anything I need to do before I collect it ?
translation.zh: 的确。在来领卡之前还有什么需要我做的吗？

translation.en: Not really . But we do recommend you to read through our terms and conditions again before you sign the card , just in case there is something you aren't happy with .
translation.zh: 没有了。但是，我们强烈建议您，在您签收信用卡之前，再仔细看一遍我们的章程，以防有什么您不满意的地方。

translation.en: I'm sure it'll be fine . How about my PIN number ?
translation.zh: 我相信不会有问题。我的密码怎么办呢？

translation.en: That will be sent on to you within 2 working days . Then , you can start using your new card .
translation.zh: 将在两个工作日内发送给您。然后，你就可以开始使用你的新卡了。

translation.en: Great . I'll be in later today . Thanks for calling . Bye .
translation.zh: 太好了。我今天晚些时候来。谢谢你打电话来告诉我。再见。

translation.en: Good afternoon . This is Michelle Li speaking , calling on behalf of IBA . Is Mr Meng available at all ?
translation.zh: 下午好。这里是米歇尔·李，代表IBA打来电话孟先生有空吗？

translation.en: This is Mr Meng speaking , Michelle .
translation.zh: 我就是孟先生，米歇尔。

translation.en: Oh , hello ! Sorry about that . I'm just calling to say that we've received your new Corporate Credit Card from HQ .
translation.zh: 哦，你好！很抱歉。我打来是想说我们从总部收到了你的新的银行信用卡。

translation.en: That was quick ! I wasn't expecting it until later this week .
translation.zh: 太快了！我原以为要本周晚些才到。

translation.en: Yes , our application procedures have speeded up since we started using the new fast-track system .
translation.zh: 是的，我自从我们开始使用新的快速通道系统以来，我们的申请程序加快了。

translation.en: Shall I come in and collect it ?
translation.zh: 我应该进来取吗？

translation.en: Or we can send it to you . But if you would like to use it at the ATM , you'll need to wait for your PIN number .
translation.zh: 或者我们可以邮寄给你。但是如果你想要在自动取款机上使用的话，你需要等你的密码。

translation.en: Mmmm ... if I come in and collect it this afternoon , is there any way I could use it today ? Petty cash is getting low , so I need to draw some money .
translation.zh: 嗯。。。如果我今天下午过来取的话，有什么方法我可以今天就用到吗？手头的零用钱越来越少了，我需要取一些钱。

translation.en: As long as you bring your ID , etc , we can serve you over the counter . But you won't be able to use the ATM until your new PIN number arrives .
translation.zh: 只要你带上你的身份证等，我们可以在柜台上为你办理。但是要等到你的新密码到了之后，你才能使用自动取款机。

translation.en: I see . Yes , that's fine . I'll be there at around 2:30 pm . See you later , and thanks .
translation.zh: 我明白了。好的，那很好。我会在下午2:30到那里。待会见，谢谢。

translation.en: Good morning . Madam . What can I do for you today ?
translation.zh: 早上好。夫人。今天有什么事吗？

translation.en: Hello . I hope you can help me ; I'm a little worried about my new card .
translation.zh: 你好。我希望你能帮助我，我的新卡给我带来了一些困扰。

translation.en: I received my new card this morning , but I'm unable to use it .
translation.zh: 今天早上我收到了我的新卡，但不能使用。

translation.en: Oh ? You mean , the ATM machine has eaten it ?
translation.zh: 哦？你是说，自动取款机把它吞掉了？

translation.en: No , it's right here , see ? The ATM will not accept it !
translation.zh: 不，就在这里，看到了吗？自动取款机不接受我的新卡！

translation.en: You said you received your card this morning , am I right ?
translation.zh: 你说你今天早上收到你的卡了，对吗？

translation.en: Yes . I was told it would be activated and ready to use right away . So , what's gone wrong ?
translation.zh: 对。我被告知它已经激活了，可以立即使用了。有什么问题吗？

translation.en: Did you receive your PIN number yet , Madam ? You see , unless you have your new PIN number , to match your new card , you cannot use it . We usually send that separately , around one day after the card , for security reasons .
translation.zh: 夫人，您收到密码了吗？你看，除非你有新的密码，否则你不能使用新卡。出于安全考虑，我们通常在信用卡寄出后一天左右再单独寄出密码。

translation.en: Well , that explains it . I've been using my old PIN number ! Thanks for explaining everything to me .
translation.zh: 好吧，这就解释得通了。我一直在用我以前的密码！谢谢你向我解释这一切。

translation.en: I hope you can help . I've got a bit of a problem with your ATM .
translation.zh: 我希望你能帮忙。你的自动取款机有点问题。

translation.en: Of course , that's my job . Oh , dear . What's happened ?
translation.zh: 当然，那是我的工作。哦，亲爱的。发生什么事了？

translation.en: Well , it's eaten my card ! It won't give it back !
translation.zh: 好吧，它吞了我的卡！它不会再吐出来！

translation.en: I see ... calm down , don't worry . May I ask what were you doing when it took your card ?
translation.zh: 我懂了。。。冷静点，别担心。我可以问一下当它拿走你的卡时你在做什么吗？

translation.en: Yes . I was only entering my PIN . I'm terrible at remembering it , I'm so forgetful , you see .
translation.zh: 对。我只是在输入密码。我很难记住，你看，我太健忘了。

translation.en: Mmmm ... and exactly how many times did you enter it , please ?
translation.zh: 嗯。。。你到底进了多少次？

translation.en: Maybe three times . As I said , I always forget it .
translation.zh: 也许三次。就像我说的，我总是忘记它。

translation.en: Ah ! Don't worry ; it's just a security measure . If someone uses a card and cannot get the right PIN after three attempts , the bank keeps the card in case it's stolen . Just contact the bank and we'll get it back to you .
translation.zh: 啊！别担心；这只是一种安全措施。如果有人使用一张卡，三次尝试后仍无法获得正确的密码，银行会保留该卡以防被盗。只要和银行联系，我们会把它还给你的。

translation.en: Oh , I see . So if I call my branch they can sort everything out for me ?
translation.zh: 哦，我明白了。如果我打电话给我的分公司，他们能帮我解决一切问题吗？

translation.en: Yes , they'll be happy to help . Believe me , it happens to many people .
translation.zh: 是的，他们很乐意帮忙。相信我，很多人都会这样。

translation.en: I'd better try harder to memorise my PIN in future . Thanks .
translation.zh: 以后我最好更努力地记住我的密码。谢谢。

translation.en: I can ’ t believe Obama is our President .
translation.zh: 我不敢相信奥巴马是我们的总统。

translation.en: I am proud to know that he is our President .
translation.zh: 我很自豪知道他是我们的总统。

translation.en: Did you vote for him , because I know that I did .
translation.zh: 你投他的票了吗，因为我知道我投了。

translation.en: I did , too .
translation.zh: 我也是。

translation.en: I have nothing but faith in Obama .
translation.zh: 我对奥巴马只有信心。

translation.en: I ’ m sure he will help better America .
translation.zh: 我相信他会帮助美国变得更好。

translation.en: We do need some change in this country .
translation.zh: 我们国家确实需要一些改变。

translation.en: Our country is already changing as it is .
translation.zh: 我们的国家已经在改变了。

translation.en: I trust that he will take good care of our country .
translation.zh: 我相信他会好好照顾我们的国家。

translation.en: I will be voting tomorrow .
translation.zh: 我明天投票。

translation.en: What ’ s your polling place ?
translation.zh: 你的投票站在哪里？

translation.en: My polling place is at the park up the street .
translation.zh: 我的投票站在街对面的公园里。

translation.en: Yeah , where is yours ?
translation.zh: 是的，你的呢？

translation.en: How is it you don ’ t know ?
translation.zh: 你怎么不知道？

translation.en: The location of my polling place never came in the mail .
translation.zh: 我从来没有收到过投票地点的邮件。

translation.en: You can always just check online .
translation.zh: 你可以随时上网查询。

translation.en: Let me go do that .
translation.zh: 那我去看看。

translation.en: I would like to speak to you , if you don ’ t mind .
translation.zh: 如果你不介意的话，我想和你讨论一下。

translation.en: What would you like to speak to me about ?
translation.zh: 你想和我讨论什么？

translation.en: I would like to talk to you about this year ’ s election .
translation.zh: 我想和你讨论一下今年的选举。

translation.en: I am a volunteer for this year ’ s campaign .
translation.zh: 我是今年（这场）选举的志愿者。

translation.en: That ’ s wonderful . I am impressed at someone so young taking a stand .
translation.zh: 真好。一个人如此年轻就能表明自己的（政治）立场，实在让我佩服。

translation.en: I know history is about to be made , and I would like to be a part of it .
translation.zh: 我知道历史即将被创造，（而）我也想成为历史的一部分。

translation.en: That ’ s fantastic .
translation.zh: 说的太好了。

translation.en: I ’ m going to vote .
translation.zh: （是的）我会投票的。

translation.en: Go to your polling place early on Election Day .
translation.zh: （那你记得）在选举日早点去投票站。

translation.en: I will . Good luck with your volunteering .
translation.zh: 我会的。祝你的志愿工作一切顺利。

translation.en: You want to argue your ticket today ?
translation.zh: 你今天想和我争论你的票吗？

translation.en: Yes . That is why I'm here .
translation.zh: 对。这就是我来这里的原因。

translation.en: Tell me your argument .
translation.zh: 告诉我你的论点。

translation.en: I was pulled over for allegedly speeding .
translation.zh: 我被指控超速而被拦下。

translation.en: Are you sure you weren't speeding ?
translation.zh: 你确定你没有超速吗？

translation.en: To be honest , I really wasn't .
translation.zh: 说实话，我真的没有。

translation.en: What speed were you going ?
translation.zh: 你的车速是多少？

translation.en: I was under the speed limit . I was going 35 , when the speed limit was 40 .
translation.zh: 我的速度低于限速。我当时车速低于35，当时车速限制是40。

translation.en: I'm just going to let you go , since the arresting officer isn't here .
translation.zh: 我会放你走，因为逮捕的警官不在。

translation.en: What about my ticket ? Do I still need to pay ?
translation.zh: 我的罚单呢？我还需要付钱吗？

translation.en: I'm so glad for your help .
translation.zh: 我很高兴你的帮助。

translation.en: Are you here about your ticket ?
translation.zh: 你来是为了你的罚单吗？

translation.en: Yes , I am , Your Honor .
translation.zh: 是的，法官大人。

translation.en: What is your argument ?
translation.zh: 你的诉讼理由是什么？

translation.en: Your Honor , the police officer pulled me over for speeding .
translation.zh: 法官大人，警察以我超速为由把我拦了下来。

translation.en: You must've been speeding .
translation.zh: 那你一定是超速了。

translation.en: No , Your Honor , I was not .
translation.zh: 不，法官大人，我没有。

translation.en: Tell me how many miles per hour you were going .
translation.zh: 告诉我你当时的时速多少。

translation.en: I was going 35 in a 40 mph zone .
translation.zh: 我以40英里每小时的速度跑了35英里。

translation.en: That's fine , so I'll let you go with a warning .
