translation.zh: 好吧，我给你算一次警告，你就可以离开了。

translation.en: So , I don't have to pay the ticket ?
translation.zh: 所以，我不用付罚款？

translation.en: You won't have to pay the fine .
translation.zh: 你不用付罚款。

translation.en: What may I help you with ?
translation.zh: 有什么需要我帮忙的吗？

translation.en: I need to file a complaint .
translation.zh: 我需要投诉。

translation.en: What is your complaint about ?
translation.zh: 你抱怨什么？

translation.en: I got robbed .
translation.zh: 我被抢了。

translation.en: My wallet and cell phone .
translation.zh: 我的钱包和手机。

translation.en: Did you get a good look at the person who robbed you ?
translation.zh: 你看清楚抢劫你的人了吗？

translation.en: Would you able to pick him out of a line-up ?
translation.zh: 你能把他从队伍里挑出来吗？

translation.en: What are you doing here today ?
translation.zh: 你今天在这里干什么？

translation.en: I would like to fight my ticket .
translation.zh: 我来为我的罚单提起诉讼。

translation.en: Is the arresting officer in the courtroom today ?
translation.zh: （给你开罚单的）警官今天在法庭上吗？

translation.en: Yes , the officer is here today .
translation.zh: 是的，那个警官今天来了。

translation.en: What's your case ?
translation.zh: 你的案子怎么回事？

translation.en: I was pulled over for running a red light , but I never did .
translation.zh: 我由于闯红灯而被拦下了，但我没有这样做过。

translation.en: Do you believe that the officer lied ?
translation.zh: 你认为那个警官撒谎了吗？

translation.en: There was a camera on the signal . So , he was obviously lying .
translation.zh: 信号仪上有个摄像头。所以，他肯定在撒谎。

translation.en: Your license plate was caught on camera ?
translation.zh: 你的车牌被摄像头拍到了吗？

translation.en: A picture of my license plate was never taken .
translation.zh: 我的车牌没被拍到过。

translation.en: Since there is no picture of your license plate on record , I'm going to let you go .
translation.zh: 既然你的车牌照片没有记录在案，我可以让你走。

translation.en: Thank you . I'm glad that you believe me .
translation.zh: 非常感谢。我很高兴你愿意相信我。

translation.en: Not at all . I ’ m an agnostic . do you ?
translation.zh: 一点也不。我是个不可知论者。你呢？

translation.en: We have hundreds of constituencies and the voters in each one elect a member of parliament . Most people call them mp ’ s .
translation.zh: 我们有数百个选区，每个选区的选民选出一名议员。大多数人都叫他们议员。

translation.en: Almost all of them do . A few are independent . That means that they do not belong to a party . If one party more than half of the mp ’ s . they form a government . That means that they choose a prime Finist
translation.zh: 几乎所有的人都这样。有几个是独立的。这意味着他们不属于一个政党。如果一个政党的议员人数超过半数。他们组成政府。这意味着他们会选择一个质数第一。

translation.en: They produce manifesto . These documents which states their policies . Some people just vote for the same party every time there is an election . Voters who often change the party they vote for are Calle
translation.zh: 他们发表宣言。这些文件阐明了他们的政策。有些人每次选举都投同一政党的票。经常改变他们投票的政党的选民被叫做Calle

translation.en: Good morning . Madam . How can I help ?
translation.zh: 早上好。夫人。我能帮你什么吗？

translation.en: I'd like to take some money from my Fund Account at the Securities Company . Is that possible here ?
translation.zh: 我想从我在证券公司的基金账户里取些钱。这里能取吗？

translation.en: Certainly . We can transfer the money straight into your bank account here and then you can withdraw it right away . Could I have your Passbook for Bank-Securities Account Transfer ?
translation.zh: 当然。我们可以把钱直接转到你的银行账户，然后你马上就可以取款。能给我您的银行证券账户转账存折吗？

translation.en: Here it is . Could I make a balance enquiry , please ?
translation.zh: 给你。我能问一下余额吗？

translation.en: Your balance today is 120,376 RIB .
translation.zh: 你现在的余额是120376元。

translation.en: Fine , I'll take 10,000 RIB , please .
translation.zh: 好的，我要取一万元。

translation.en: OK . Please fill in this form and input you code here ... and again , please . I'll just check and see if the money has been transferred . Yes , transaction successful .
translation.zh: 好的，请填写这张表格，并在这里输入您的密码……请再输入一遍。我看看有没有交易成功。好了，交易成功了。

translation.en: Hello , Sir . You're here to discuss the Network Settlement Service , right ?
translation.zh: 先生，您好。您是来咨询网络结算服务的，对吗？

translation.en: Yes , that's right . We want as much info as possible before we agree to anything .
translation.zh: 是的，没错。在做任何决定之前，我们想要了解尽可能多的信息。

translation.en: Yes , it's important to be all clued up before you enter into any agreement . To make full use of the Network Settlement Service and take advantage of the whole banking system , we provide internal fund transfers , account inquiry , agency clearing to name but a few .
translation.zh: 嗯嗯，在您达成任何协议之前把一切都弄清楚的确很重要。简单举几个例子，我们提供内部资金转账、账户查询、代理清算等服务，来让您通过充分利用网络结算享受银行系统便利。

translation.en: So , do you think our corporation will be eligible for this ?
translation.zh: 那您认为我们公司适合这样做吗？

translation.en: Yes , and it's extremely simple . All you need to do is make a Network Settlement Agreement with us .
translation.zh: 是的，而且非常简单。您只需要和我们签订一份网络结算协议。

translation.en: Hello . It's good to see you again , Ms Harrow , sending more money to your grandson today ?
translation.zh: 您好。很高兴再次见到你，哈罗女士，您今天又给您的孙子汇钱吗？

translation.en: Today I'm here to find out about paying in foreign currency . You do that here , I suppose ?
translation.zh: 今天我来这儿是想知道如何存外币。我想你们这里有这业务，对吗？

translation.en: Yes , of course . What would you like to know ?
translation.zh: 是的，当然。您想知道什么？

translation.en: My nephew has told me about something called a ' timing deposit ' or something like that ?
translation.zh: 我的侄子告诉过我一些关于那个叫“定时存款”或什么类似的业务？

translation.en: A T-I-M-E , Time Deposit . You can chose from 5 different grades
translation.zh: 定期存款。您可以从5档不同的存期中选择。

translation.en: Put me down for 2 years . Here's the money I'd like to pay in ...
translation.zh: 我存两年的，这是我的钱，我想用……付款

translation.en: Hello , how can I be of service ?
translation.zh: 您好，我能为您效劳吗？

translation.en: Hello . I'm not sure who I need to speak to . I got this 50 yuan note today and it seems a little odd to me .
translation.zh: 你好。我不知道该找谁问一下。我今天收到这张50元的钞票，我觉得有点奇怪。

translation.en: The first thing we do is check the feel of the paper ;d oes it feel too thick or too thin ? Then we check the watermark . In my opinion it is counterfeit . I'll just run it through the scanner to double check .
translation.zh: （一般来说）我们要做的第一件事是检查纸张的手感，是厚还是薄，然后还要检查水印。（所以）我认为这是赝品。我会用验钞机再检查一遍。

translation.en: What happens now ?
translation.zh: 怎么样？

translation.en: Well , it's our policy to confiscate all counterfeit notes . So , unfortunately you'll lose this 50 RIB . We'll give you a receipt to show the note has been confiscated .
translation.zh: 我们的政策是没收所有假钞。所以，很不幸你会失去这50RIB。我们会给你一张收据，证明这张纸币被没收了。

translation.en: I'd like to withdraw some money from my account .
translation.zh: 我想从我的账户上取些钱。

translation.en: Please fill out this slip stating how much you wish to withdraw .
translation.zh: 请填好这张单子，说明您要取多少钱。

translation.en: Well , actually , it's quite a substantial amount . Here's my Bank Book . Will that cause a problem ?
translation.zh: 嗯，实际上，这是相当可观的一笔钱。这是我的存折。那会引起问题吗？

translation.en: On your account there is no limit to over the counter withdrawals , it won't cause a problem . Here's your money , 10,000 RIB . Please count it before you leave .
translation.zh: 在您的帐户上，柜台取款没有限制，不会造成问题。这是你的钱，一万RIB。离开前请清点一下。

translation.en: Yes , that seems to be all in order . Thanks very much .
translation.zh: 是的，看来一切正常。非常感谢。

translation.en: Welcome to IBA Bank , how can we be of service ?
translation.zh: 欢迎光临IBA银行，我们有什么可以为您服务呢？

translation.en: I spoke to a girl named Claire on the phone ; it's about losing my card and everything .
translation.zh: 我和一个叫克莱尔的女孩通了电话；是关于我丢了的卡和所有东西。

translation.en: What I need you to do first is fill in these forms , with as much detail as possible . Then we can get you a new card .
translation.zh: 我需要您先尽可能详细地填写这些表格。然后我们可以给你换张新卡。

translation.en: So , I can get my new card today ?
translation.zh: 那我今天能拿到我的新卡吗？

translation.en: I'm sorry , Sir , the full procedure can take up to 7 days to process everything .
translation.zh: 对不起，先生，整个过程可能需要7天才能完成。

translation.en: 7 days ! What am I supposed to do for money until then ?
translation.zh: 7天！在那之前我该怎么付款？

translation.en: If you bring some ID with you , it's possible for you to make a withdrawal over the counter if you need to . But unfortunately , without your new card you cannot use the ATM , so all withdrawals must be made within working hours .
translation.zh: 如果你带着身份证，有需要的话，您可以在柜台取款。但不幸的是，没有您的新卡，您不能使用自动取款机，所以取款都必须在工作时间内进行。

translation.en: You're here to make a deposit , is that correct ?
translation.zh: 您是来存款的，对吗？

translation.en: Right . I'd like to deposit 2,000 RIB into my Current Account .
translation.zh: 正确的。我想在我的活期存款户头上存2000RIB。

translation.en: No problem . Could I have the cash and your Bank Book , please ? Oh dear ... there seems to be some problems here ...
translation.zh: 没问题。请给我您的现金和存折好吗？哦，亲爱的……这里似乎有些问题……

translation.en: What ? What's wrong ?
translation.zh: 什么？怎么了？

translation.en: I'm sorry but 5 of these notes seem to be counterfeit . Look at this watermark , do you see it ?
translation.zh: 对不起，这些钞票中有5张是假钞。看这个水印，你看到了吗？

translation.en: It does look a little strange , I didn't notice that before .
translation.zh: 看起来确实有点奇怪，我以前没注意到。

translation.en: Hello , again . Did you discuss everything with your colleagues ?
translation.zh: 您好，又见面了。您和您的同事商量好了吗？

translation.en: Yes , yes . It seems that everything is settled .
translation.zh: 是啊，是啊。看来，一切都解决了。

translation.en: Have you decided how you would like the salaries paid ?
translation.zh: 您决定如何发工资了吗？

translation.en: We have discussed it and decided that at the moment we would like the salaries to be paid into the employees's accounts , whether they are currently with this bank or not .
translation.zh: 我们已经商量过了，目前决定把工资存入员工的账户，无论他们现在是否在这家银行开户。

translation.en: That's not a problem .
translation.zh: 这没问题。

translation.en: Of course , if we are happy with the service after the initial period we will recommend all employees either transfer their accounts to this bank , or open new accounts with you .
translation.zh: 当然，如果在开始阶段我们对此服务感觉满意的话，我们将建议所有员工把他们自己的账户转到这家银行，或在你们这里开设新账户。

translation.en: Thank you very much . We always welcome new customers .
translation.zh: 非常感谢您。我们总是欢迎新的客户。

translation.en: Hi there . Do you need any help ?
translation.zh: 您好。你需要帮助吗？

translation.en: I've been told about something called Southern Fund . How can I buy it ?
translation.zh: 我听说了有个什么南方基金。我怎么能买到？

translation.en: First of all , you should open a Fund Account with us , just fill in this form . We'll need to see some ID and your Cash Card .
translation.zh: 首先，您应该在我们这儿开一个基金账户，只要填一下这张表就行了。然后我们需要看看您的身份证和现金卡。

translation.en: That sounds simple enough . Do you charge any admin fees for that ?
translation.zh: 听起来很简单。你们要收管理费吗？

translation.en: You'll have to pay 20 RIB , and then you will have your Southern Fund Management company card .
translation.zh: 您需要支付20块钱，然后您就拥有了南方基金管理公司的基金账户卡。

translation.en: Do you need any other documentation from me ?
translation.zh: 你们还需要我提供其他文件吗？

translation.en: Yes , we'll need to fill in this form , for fund trading and this one , for subscribing for and / or applying for purchasing fund units . The minimum is 500 RIB .
translation.zh: 是的，我们需要您填写这张表格，这是申请基金业务的，还有这张表格，这是购买基金时申请认购和/或申购的。最低限额是500元。

translation.en: I want to send some money to Australia . Could you handle it for me ?
translation.zh: 我想寄一些钱到澳大利亚。你能帮我处理一下吗？

translation.en: Yes , madam , how much would you like to remit ?
translation.zh: 可以，夫人，您想汇多少钱？

translation.en: Which would you like to remit , by mail or by cable ?
translation.zh: 您想用邮寄还是电汇？

translation.en: What is the difference between them ?
translation.zh: 它们之间有什么区别？

translation.en: The cable will take less time for your account , in the meantime , the regular service charge is also higher than that of the mail one .
translation.zh: 电汇花的时间会比邮寄的少，同时，正常的服务费也比邮寄的高。

translation.en: Well , I think the cable is better .
translation.zh: 嗯，我觉得电汇更好。

translation.en: OK , please fill in the application form giving the name and address of beneficiary , your name and telephone .
translation.zh: 好的，请填写申请表，注明收款人的姓名和地址，您的姓名和电话。

translation.en: Everything is OK . The commission is 50 yuan .
translation.zh: 好了。佣金是50元。

translation.en: Here you are . Thanks a lot .
translation.zh: 给你。谢谢。

translation.en: The ATM machine outside won't give me back my card .
translation.zh: 外面的自动取款机不推出我的卡了。

translation.en: Let's go take a look at it . Do you have your ID with you ?
translation.zh: 我们去看看吧。你有身份证吗？

translation.en: Okay , I see the problem . You forgot your code , didn't you ?
translation.zh: 好吧，我明白问题所在了。你忘了密码，是吗？

translation.en: The machine gives you three attempts to enter the correct code and after that it assumes that you are not the real owner and confiscates it .
translation.zh: 这台机器会给你三次输入正确密码的机会，然后它会认为你不是真正的主人，并没收你的卡。

translation.en: Oh . But can I have my card back now ?
translation.zh: 哦。那我现在能拿回我的卡吗？

translation.en: Yes , I can get it for you but I need to go back inside the bank .
translation.zh: 是的，我可以帮你拿，但我得回银行去。

translation.en: Good afternoon , Sir . You're here to see about a Temporary Loan , right ? The loans we offer are for purchasing income-generating assets . Is that what you require ?
translation.zh: 下午好，先生。你来这里是想看看临时贷款的事，对吧？我们提供的贷款用于购买创收资产。你需要吗？

translation.en: Yes , that's exactly what I need . How about terms for these ?
translation.zh: 是的，那正是我需要的。这些贷款的有哪些条款？

translation.en: Well , we offer 60 - day or 90 - day loans . The balance of the loan is to be repaid in full by the end of the specified period .
translation.zh: 嗯，我们提供60天或90天的贷款。贷款余额应在规定期限内全部还清。

translation.en: Is there any flexibility on that ?
translation.zh: 有没有什么回旋余地呢？

translation.en: Unfortunately , not .
translation.zh: 对不起，没有。

translation.en: OK . In my position , I think the best way to go would be for the 90 - day loan . That would give us a little more time to sort out the repayment plan .
translation.zh: 好的，就我个人而言，我认为最好的是90天的贷款。那会给我们多一点时间来理清还款计划。

translation.en: Not a problem , Sir . If you'd just fill out these forms , and of course with necessary clearance , we can get you the money right away .
translation.zh: 没问题，先生。你只要填好这些表格，提供必要的证明，我们就可以马上贷款给你。

translation.en: Hi there . Welcome to Lincoln Corporate Services . How can we help ?
translation.zh: 您好。欢迎来到林肯银行公司服务部。有什么我们能帮您的吗？

translation.en: Hi . I was wondering what kind of fixed asset loans you have ? Do you have Fixed Asset Loans ?
translation.zh: 你好。我想知道你们有什么类型的固定资产贷款？你们有固定资产贷款吧？

translation.en: Yes , we do . You'll go through the acceptance application , then a first review , then an evaluation and examination and finally get approval . Why don't you read through this brochure ? It outlines all of the important aspects of the loan , the terms and conditions , etc .
translation.zh: 是的，我们有。您要通过申请受理，然后是初审，再然后是评估和审查，最终会得到批准。您为何不把这本小册子看一遍呢？它概括了有关于贷款的所有重要方面，比如条款和条件等等。

translation.en: That's a good idea , to familiarise myself with it . Then , I'll be back if we decide to go ahead .
translation.zh: 是个好主意，让我自己熟悉一下。那么，如果我们决定继续办理的话，再回来。

translation.en: Yes , please . I'm here for an International Settlement . Our company has to effect payment , and it needs to be done today . Here's the advice slip for the payment .
translation.zh: 好的，谢谢。我来这里是为了国际结算。我们公司必须付款，必须在今天付款。这是付款通知单。

translation.en: Thanks . I'm sorry to say that you need to get this stamped . There is no stamp on this slip and it is essential before I can process it for you .
translation.zh: 谢谢。很抱歉，你得给这个贴上邮票。这张单子上没有邮票，在我为您办理之前，这是很重要的。

translation.en: I see . So , I need to stamp it . And sign it too ?
translation.zh: 我懂了。所以，我需要盖章。还要签吗？

translation.en: Yes , that's right . Down here , at the bottom right hand corner to show that you agree to pay the printed amount .
translation.zh: 是的，没错。在这里，在右下角显示您同意支付打印金额。

translation.en: I'll go back to the office and get it sorted and pop back later . Thanks , bye for now .
translation.zh: 我会回办公室把它整理好，然后再回来。谢谢，再见。

translation.en: Hello , welcome to Lincoln Bank . What can we do for you today ?
translation.zh: 您好，欢迎来到林肯银行。今天我们能为您做些什么？

translation.en: I want to effect payment under an L / C today .
translation.zh: 今天我要办理信用证项下的付汇。

translation.en: No problem . OK ... just checking for you . Ah , I'm afraid there aren't enough funds in your account to cover this transaction . What you can do is buy some US dollars , using local currency and we can credit your account with that amount .
translation.zh: 没问题。好的，正在给您查看。啊，恐怕您帐户里没有足够的资金来支付这笔交易。你所能做的就是用本币买一些美元，我们可以把这笔钱打入你的帐户。

translation.en: That seems alright . What's the exchange rate like today ? Good or bad ?
translation.zh: 我看行。今天的汇率率是多少？高还是低呀？

translation.en: It's not too bad today , actually . 828.23 .
translation.zh: 事实上，今天还不错。828.23 .

translation.en: Hello , can I help ?
translation.zh: 您好，有什么我能帮您的吗？

translation.en: I'm from Lexington Software and I'm here to collect an export L / C .
translation.zh: 我是列克星敦软件公司的，来这里领取出口信用证。

translation.en: Great . Can I take it with me now ? Or do you need me to fill in some forms or something ?
translation.zh: 太好了。我现在能拿走它吗？或者你需要我填些表格什么的吗？

translation.en: No , you can take it away now . I just need you to sign here .
translation.zh: 不用，你现在可以拿走它，只需要在这里签个名。

translation.en: Just one thing before you go , could you please prepare your documents in accordance with the L / C within the validity period ?
translation.zh: 只是在你拿走它之前有个问题，请在有效期内按照信用证的要求准备好你的单据，可以吗？

translation.en: No problem , I'll get on that right away . Thanks , bye .
translation.zh: 没问题，我马上去。谢谢，再见。

translation.en: Good afternoon , Lexington Software . Angelina Dawson , how can I help ?
translation.zh: 下午好，列克星敦软件公司。安吉丽娜·道森，我能帮忙吗？

translation.en: Hello , this is Quinn from IBA .
translation.zh: 你好，我是IBA的奎因。

translation.en: Ah , hello Quinn . Oh dear , you are calling to tell me there is a problem , aren't you ?
translation.zh: 啊，你好，奎因。哦，天哪，你打电话来是想告诉我有问题，是吗？

translation.en: I'm afraid so , yes .
translation.zh: 恐怕是的。

translation.en: Hmm ... well , it was my first attempt ! Is it a very big mistake , or can we just alter it ?
translation.zh: 隐马尔可夫模型。。。嗯，这是我第一次尝试！这是一个很大的错误，还是我们可以改变它吗？

translation.en: Unfortunately it's rather a big mistake .
translation.zh: 不幸的是，这是一个相当大的错误。

translation.en: What do you recommend we do ?
translation.zh: 你建议我们做什么？

translation.en: I would recommend we scrap this one and you bring in another set as soon as possible .
translation.zh: 我建议我们把这一套放弃，你尽快换一套。

translation.en: I trust your judgement . Thank you , Quinn . I'll be back tomorrow with a new set . Bye for now .
translation.zh: 我相信你的判断。谢谢你，奎因。我明天会带着一套新的回来。再见。

translation.en: Hello , this is Steven from Blue Sky Co . May I speak to Mr . James ?
translation.zh: 你好，我是蓝天公司的史蒂文。我可以和李先生讲话吗。詹姆斯？

translation.en: Excuse my troubling you . You purchased our products last year and now I am following up to find out about their workings . Are they still in good condition now ?
translation.zh: 请原谅我打扰你了。你去年购买了我们的产品，现在我正在跟进，了解他们的工作原理。它们现在还完好吗？

translation.en: Yeah , exactly ! I bought them last year . En ... at present , they are still in good state .
translation.zh: 是的，没错！我去年买的。嗯。。目前，他们仍处于良好状态。

translation.en: That's it ! All of them have first-class quality and performance . Besides , we adopt advanced technology . Now we have developed new products . They are much better than what you have bought .
translation.zh: 就这样！产品质量和性能都是一流的。此外，我们采用了先进的技术。现在我们开发了新产品。它们比你买的好多了。

translation.en: Your company is developing so fast . Maybe later on I will plan to buy more .
translation.zh: 你们公司发展很快。也许以后我会买更多的。

translation.en: That's great ! Thanks for your support . If any , please remember to call us . I am afraid I have to say goodbye now ! Bye , Mr . James !
translation.zh: 太棒了！谢谢你的支持。如果有，请记得打电话给我们。恐怕我得说再见了！再见，詹姆斯先生！

translation.en: I ’ Ve come to hear about your offer for bristles .
translation.zh: 我是来听你们的猪鬃报价的。

translation.en: We have the offer ready for you . Let me see ... here it is . 100 cases Houston Bristles , 57 mm , at 10 pounds sterling per kilogram , C . I . F European Main Ports , for shipment in June 2001 . The offer is valid for five days .
translation.zh: 我们已经为你准备好了报盘。我看看……给你。100箱休斯顿猪鬃，57毫米，每公斤10磅，欧洲主要港口到岸，2001年6月装运。报盘有效期五天。

translation.en: Why , your price has soared . It ’ s almost 25 % higher than last year ’ s . It would be impossible for us to push any sales at such a price .
translation.zh: 为什么你们的价格涨了这么多。这比去年几乎高出25%。我们不可能以这样的价格销售。

translation.en: I ’ m a little surprised to hear you say that . You know very well that markets for bristles have gone up a great deal in recent months . The price we offer compares favorably with quotations you can get elsewhere .
translation.zh: 听到你这么说我有点吃惊。你很清楚，近几个月来猪鬃市场上涨了很多。我们所报的价格比你能从别处得到的报价要便宜。

translation.en: I ’ m afraid I can ’ t agree with you there . I must point out your price is higher than some of the quotations we ’ Ve received from other sources .
translation.zh: 恐怕我这么认为。我必须指出你们的价格比我们从其他渠道得到的一些报价要高。

translation.en: But you must take the quality into consideration . Everyone in the trade knows that US ’ s bristles are of superior quality to those from other countries .
translation.zh: 但你必须考虑质量。业内人士都知道，美国的猪鬃质量比其他国家的好。

translation.en: I agree that yours are of better quality . But there ’ s competition from synthetic products , too . You can ’ t very well ignore that . Prices for synthetic bristles haven ’ t changed much over the years .
translation.zh: 我同意你们的质量更好。但合成产品也有竞争力。你不能忽视这一点。这些年来，合成猪鬃的价格变化不大。

translation.en: There ’ s practically no substitute for bristles for certain uses . That ’ s why demand for natural bristles keeps rising in spite of cheaper synthetic ones . To be frank with you , if it were not for the long - standing relationship between us , we would hardly be willing to make you a firm offer at this price .
translation.zh: 在某些用途上，几乎没有什么东西可以代替猪鬃。这就是为什么尽管人造猪鬃价格较低，但是对天然猪鬃的需求仍不断上升。坦率地说，如果不是因为我们之间的长期合作关系，我们很难按这个价格向你方报实盘。

translation.en: Well , we ’ ll have a lot of difficulties in persuading our clients to buy at this price . But I ’ ll have to try , I suppose .
translation.zh: 好吧，我们很难说服客户按这个价格购买。但我想我们得试试。

translation.en: I've come about your wools . According to our market survey , wools are likely to find a ready market in our country .
translation.zh: 我来是为了你的羊毛衫。根据我们的市场调查，羊毛很可能在我国找到销路。

translation.en: Wonderful ! We can meet your requirements and the offer is ready for you . Here it is . The unit price is USD 15.00 per kilogram .
translation.zh: 太好了！我们能满足你方要求，报盘已准备就绪。给你。单价为每公斤15美元。

translation.en: It's FOB Shanghai .
translation.zh: 是在上海的离岸价格。

translation.en: Could you quote the price of CIF Hamburg ?
translation.zh: 你能报汉堡到岸价吗？

translation.en: Certainly , that's easy . We will work out our CIF offer this evening . Could you come again tomorrow , say , at 10 AM ?
translation.zh: 当然，那很容易。今晚我们将计算出到岸价。你能明天上午10点再来吗？

translation.en: Okay , see you tomorrow !
translation.zh: 好的，明天见！

translation.en: Our Afghan customers wanna buy China's tea . I am thinking of placing an order with you .
translation.zh: 我们的阿富汗客户想买中国茶叶。我想和您下个订单。

translation.en: Which tea do you prefer , black or jasmine tea ?
translation.zh: 您想买哪种茶，红茶还是茉莉花茶？

translation.en: I like both . Could you show me some samples ?
translation.zh: 两种都要。能给我看些样品吗？

translation.en: Of course , here you are . These are Black tea from Anti , Oolong tea from Guangdong , Oolong tea from Fujisan and Longing tea from Xinu . The new products are Curls Black tea , Crushed Black tea and so on . They are the best sellers in many countries .
translation.zh: 当然了，给您。这些是安徽的红茶，广东和福建的乌龙茶，还有西湖的龙井茶。新产品有卷茶和碎红茶等等。这些在很多国家都是抢手货。

translation.en: Oh , such a variety . All of them are excellent both in color and flavour . No wonder our people like China ’ s tea better than any other kind . Could you give me some idea of the prices ?
translation.zh: 哦，这么多品种。所有都色纯香浓。难怪我们那边的人最爱中国茶。您能告诉我都卖多少钱吗？

translation.en: Here is our price list . All the prices on the list are subject to our final confirmation . You can see the prices are reasonable .
translation.zh: 这是我们的价格表。所有的价格都以我方最后确认为准。您会看到我们的价格都很合理。

translation.en: I'd like you to quote me CIF Karachi .
translation.zh: 我需要您报给我到卡拉奇的到岸价。

translation.en: Right . Could you tell us the quantity you require so that we can work out the offer ?
translation.zh: 好的。能告诉我您需要的数量吗？这样我们好给您报价。

translation.en: Yes . I want 500 kilograms of Black tea from Anti , 200 kilograms of Jasmine tea from Hangzhou and 100 kilograms of Crushed Black tea , first grade .
translation.zh: 好的，我要500公斤的安徽红茶，200公斤的杭州茉莉花荼，还有100公斤的碎红茶，都要优等货。

translation.en: Good . We will make the offer tomorrow afternoon . Is that all right ?
translation.zh: 好的。我们明天下午报价。这样行吗？

translation.en: Yes . See you tomorrow afternoon .
translation.zh: 好的。明天下午见。

translation.en: Good afternoon , Miss . What can I do for you ?
translation.zh: 下午好，小姐。有什么事吗？

translation.en: Could you tell me my account balance ? My account number is ...
translation.zh: 你能告诉我我的账户余额吗？我的帐号是……

translation.en: Just a moment , please . Your name ?
translation.zh: 请稍等。请问您的名字是？

translation.en: Emily Smith .
translation.zh: 艾米莉·史密斯。

translation.en: Here is your balance .
translation.zh: 这是您的余额。

translation.en: Thank you . I want to make a withdrawal of 150 dollars .
translation.zh: 非常感谢。我想提取150美元。

translation.en: Here you go , Miss .
translation.zh: 给您，小姐。

translation.en: Put on the helmet , please .
translation.zh: 请戴上头盔。

translation.en: Do we need to put on the jackets too ?
translation.zh: 我们也需要穿上罩衣吗？

translation.en: You ’ d better , to protect your clothes . Now please watch your step .
translation.zh: 最好穿上，以免弄脏你的衣服。请留神脚下。

translation.en: Thank you . Is the production line fully automated ?
translation.zh: 非常感谢。生产线是全自动的吗？

translation.en: Well , not fully automated .
translation.zh: 不是全自动的。

translation.en: I see . How do you control the quality ?
translation.zh: 哦。那你们如何控制质量呢？

translation.en: All products have to go through five checks in the whole manufacturing process .
translation.zh: 所有产品在整个制造过程中都要通过五道检查关。

translation.en: What ’ s the monthly output ?
translation.zh: 月产量是多少？

translation.en: One thousand units per month now . But we ’ ll be making 1,200 units beginning with October .
translation.zh: 现在是每月一千台。但从10月份开始，我们将每月生产1200台。

translation.en: What ’ s your usual percentage of rejects ?
translation.zh: 每月不合格率通常是多少？

translation.en: About 2 % in normal operations .
translation.zh: 正常情况下约为2%。

translation.en: That ’ s wonderful . Is that where the finished products come off ?
translation.zh: 那太好了。成品从那边出来吗？

translation.en: Yes . Shall we take a break now ?
translation.zh: 对。我们现在休息一下好吗？

translation.en: It was very kind of you to give me a tour of the place . It gave me a good idea of your product range .
translation.zh: 你能带我参观这个地方真是太好了。这里使我对你们的产品范围有了一个很好的了解。

translation.en: It ’ s a pleasure to show our factory to our customers . What ’ s your general impression , may I ask ?
translation.zh: 我也很高兴带客户参观我们的工厂。请问您的总体印象如何？

translation.en: Very impressive , indeed , especially the speed of your NW Model .
translation.zh: 非常震撼，尤其是你们的NW模型的速度。

translation.en: That ’ s our latest development . A product with high performance . We put it on the market just two months ago .
translation.zh: 这是我们的最新研发的一款高性能产品。我们两个月前才投放市场。

translation.en: The machine gives you an edge over your competitors , I guess .
translation.zh: 我想这台机器可以让你们比竞争对手有优势。

translation.en: Certainly . No one can match us as far as speed is concerned .
translation.zh: 当然。就速度而言，没有人能比得上我们。

translation.en: Could you give me some brochures for that machine ? And the price if possible .
translation.zh: 你能给我一些那台机器的说明书吗？如果可能的话，价格（也一并给我吧）。

translation.en: Right . Here is our sales catalog and literature .
translation.zh: 好的。这是我们的销售目录和资料。

translation.en: Thank you . I think we may be able to work together in the future .
translation.zh: 非常感谢。我想我们将来也许能合作。

translation.en: I think you know already that I want to discuss the represent - ton for your alarm clocks .
translation.zh: 我想你已经知道了，我想和你方商谈闹钟的代理问题。

translation.en: Yes , Mr . Bergeron . You mentioned that in your letter . To tell you the truth , your proposal surprised us .
translation.zh: 是的，先生。伯杰伦。你在信中提到过。说实话，你的提议使我们大吃一惊。

translation.en: Is that so ? Anyhow I want to go over the details with you in person , so you can give my suggestion thorough consideration . Our firm specializes in this line of business . We have six sales representatives , who are on the road all the time , covering the whole of the European market .
translation.zh: 是这样吗？不管怎样，我想亲自和你讨论一下细节，以便你能仔细考虑我的建议。我们公司专门从事这项业务。我们有六个销售代表，他们一直在做这一行，覆盖整个欧洲市场。

translation.en: Do you sell direct to shops ?
translation.zh: 你们直接卖到商店吗？

translation.en: Yes , we specialize in handling clocks and watches of all sorts . We have well established channels of distribution and we canvass the retailers direct , without any middlemen .
translation.zh: 是的，我们专营各种钟表。我们有完善的分销渠道，直接向零售商推销，没有中间商。

translation.en: Do you keep a stock of these things ?
translation.zh: 你有这些东西的存货吗？

translation.en: In some cases , such as the wristwatches , which always have a steady market , we keep a stock in London and act as distributors as well as agents . Generally , however , we pass on the orders of our clients to the manufacturers for supply . We are paid for our service , of course .
translation.zh: 在某些情况下，例如手表，它总是有一个稳定的市场，我们保持在伦敦的股票，并作为分销商和代理商。不过，一般来说，我们把客户的订单转给制造商供货。当然，我们的服务是有报酬的。

translation.en: That is , your commission .
translation.zh: 那就是你的佣金。

translation.en: Yes , our commission is very reasonable . We usually get a 10 % commission of the amount on every deal .
translation.zh: 是的，我们的佣金很合理。每笔交易我们通常得到10%的佣金。

translation.en: Our agents in other areas usually get a 3-5 % commission .
translation.zh: 我们在其他地区的代理商通常会得到3-5%的佣金。

translation.en: The European market is not familiar with your products . You have competitors from Japan and other continental countries . At the beginning of our campaign , there is sales resistance to overcome , we must send out salesmen to do a lot of traveling and spend a considerable amount of money on advertising in news - papers and TV programs . A 10 % commission will not leave us much .
translation.zh: 欧洲市场对你们的产品不熟悉。你们有来自日本和其他大陆国家的竞争对手。在我们的运动开始时，有销售阻力要克服，我们必须派出推销员去大量的地方旅行，并在报纸和电视节目上花大量的钱做广告。10%的佣金不会给我们留下多少。

translation.en: According to your estimate , what is the maximum annual turn - over you can fulfill , in round figures , of course ?
translation.zh: 根据你的估计，你能完成的最大年营业额是多少，当然是整数？

translation.en: We will always do our utmost to enlarge the business , as our remuneration increases with the turnover , but we will not guar - ante anything , at least not to begin with .
translation.zh: 我们将尽最大努力扩大业务，因为我们的报酬会随着营业额的增加而增加，但我们不会保证任何事情，至少一开始不会。

translation.en: We appreciate very much your intention to push the sale of our products . But our suggestion to you , Mr . Bergeron , as a preliminary step , is to do a little research into the market ...
translation.zh: 非常感谢你方推销我方产品的意向。但是我们给你的建议，伯杰伦先生，初始步骤，是对市场做一点调查。。。

translation.en: Do you mean to say you refuse us the agency ?
translation.zh: 你是说你拒绝我们代理吗？

translation.en: Mr . Bergeron , you leave us no alternative . We can not give you an exclusive agency of the whole European market without having the slightest idea of your possible annual marketing turnover . Besides our price is worked out according to the costing . A 10 % commission means an increase in our price . We must have the reaction of the buyers in this respect .
translation.zh: 伯杰伦先生，你让我们别无选择。我们不能连你方每年可能销售多少都不知道就给你方整个欧洲市场的独家代理权。此外，我们的价格是根据成本计算出来的。10%的佣金意味着我们的价格上涨。我们必须了解买方在这方面的反应。

translation.en: Oh , that's just too bad . I intended to make great efforts in selling your products .
translation.zh: 哦，那太糟糕了。我打算努力推销你们的产品。

translation.en: Well , we can still carry on our business relationship without the agreement . To start the ball rolling , we will provide you with price lists , catalogues and some samples . Only when you have a thorough knowledge of the marketing possibilities of our products , can we then discuss further details .
translation.zh: 好吧，没有协议我们还可以继续我们的业务关系。为了开始工作，我们将提供价目表、目录和一些样品。等你们全面了解我们产品销售的可能性之后，我们再进一步细谈。

translation.en: Ah , Mrs . Miller , but in this case am I covered ?
translation.zh: 啊，米勒夫人，但在这种情况下我受保了吗？

translation.en: Oh , yes . We will give you a 5 % commission on every transaction .
translation.zh: 哦，是的。每笔交易我们给你5%的佣金。

translation.en: All right , but I'll be back again for the Autumn Fair . And then I hope we can see eye to eye about our commission and the terms of the agency .
translation.zh: 好吧，不过我会回来参加秋季集市的。然后我希望我们能就佣金和代理条款达成一致意见。

translation.en: Very good . We will discuss the matter again at the next Fair .
translation.zh: 非常好。我们将在下次交易会上再讨论这件事。

translation.en: I have here our price sheet on a F . O . B . basis . The prices are given without engagement .
translation.zh: 这是我们船上交货价的价目单，所报价格没有约束力。

translation.en: Good , if you ’ ll excuse me , I ’ ll go over the sheet right now .
translation.zh: 好的，请允许我现在看一下价格单。

translation.en: I can tell you at a glance that your prices are much too high .
translation.zh: 我一看这份价目单就知道你们的价格太高了。

translation.en: I ’ m surprised to hear you say so . You know that the cost of pro - duction has been skyrocketing in recent years .
translation.zh: 听到你这么说我很惊讶。你知道近年来生产成本涨得很快。

translation.en: We only ask that your prices be comparable to others . That ’ s reasonable , isn ’ t it ?
translation.zh: 我们只要求你们的价格与市场价格相当。这很合理，不是吗？

translation.en: Well , to get the business done , we can consider making some concessions in our price . But first , you ’ ll have to give me an idea of the quantity you wish to order from us , so that we may adjust our prices accordingly .
translation.zh: 好吧，为了做成这笔生意，我们可以考虑在价格上做些让步。但首先，你得告诉我你方希望从我方订购的货物数量，以便我们相应地调整价格。

translation.en: The size of our order depends greatly on the prices . Let ’ s settle that matter first .
translation.zh: 我们订单的大小在很大程度上取决于价格。我们先解决那件事吧。

translation.en: Well , as I ’ Ve said , if your order is large enough , we ’ re ready to reduce our prices by 2 percent .
translation.zh: 好吧，正如我所说，如果你方订货量足够大，我们准备降价2%。

translation.en: When I say your prices are much too high , I don ’ t mean they are higher merely by 2 or 3 percent .
translation.zh: 我说你们的价格太高，并不是说它们仅仅高出百分之二或百分之三。

translation.en: How much do you mean then ? Can you give me a rough idea ?
translation.zh: 那你的意思是多少？你能给我一个大概的价格吗？

translation.en: To have this business concluded , I should say a reduction of least 10 percent would help .
translation.zh: 为了做成这笔生意，我想至少要降价10%。

translation.en: Impossible . How can you expect us to make a reduction to that extent ?
translation.zh: 不可能的。你怎么能指望我们降价那么多？

translation.en: I think you are as well - informed as I am about the market for chemical fertilizers . It ’ s unnecessary for me to point out that sup - ply exceeds demand at present and that this situation is apt to continue for a long time yet . May I suggest that you call your home office and see what they have to say ?
translation.zh: 我想你和我一样了解化肥市场的情况。我没有必要向你指出，目前化肥市场供过于求，而且这种情况还可能持续很长一段时间。我建议你打电话给你的总公司，看看他们怎么说？

translation.en: Very well , I will .
translation.zh: 好，我会的。

translation.en: Mrs . Wang , would you give us an idea of the price you regard as workable ?
translation.zh: 王夫人，你能告诉我们你认为可行的价格吗？

translation.en: As I said before , your price is so high that we find it difficult to make a bid . We hope you will take the initiative and bridge the gap .
translation.zh: 正如我之前所说，你方价格太高，我们很难出价。我们希望你们采取主动，缩小差距。

translation.en: Just to comply , we're ready to reduce the price by 5 percent . I hope this concession of ours will get the ball rolling .
translation.zh: 为了遵守，我们准备降价百分之五。我希望我们的这一让步能取得成功。

translation.en: So do we . Certainly it's a step forward on your side . But the gap is still too wide .
translation.zh: 我们也是。当然这是你的进步。但差距仍然太大。

translation.en: The ball is in your court , Mrs.Wang . What price would you suggest ?
translation.zh: 看你的了，王女士。你建议什么价格？

translation.en: To make your offer workable , I think you should take another step down as big as the one you've just taken .
translation.zh: 为了使你方报盘可行，我认为你方应该再退一步，退得和刚才一样大。

translation.en: That won't do . You see , our profit margin is very narrow . It simply can't stand such a big cut .
translation.zh: 那不行。你看，我们的利润率很低。简直受不了这么大的削减。

translation.en: I hate to disappoint you , Mr . Brown , but if that's the case , we have no alternative but to cover our requirements elsewhere . Do think it over , please . We sincerely hope our discussion will come to a successful conclusion .
translation.zh: 我不想让你失望，先生。布朗，但如果是这样的话，我们别无选择，只能满足其他地方的需求。请仔细考虑一下。我们衷心希望我们的讨论能圆满结束。

translation.en: Well , I'm not authorized to agree to such a big reduction . Would you mind waiting a day or two , until I get a reply from the home office ?
translation.zh: 嗯，我无权同意这么大的降价。你介不介意等一两天，直到我得到内政部的答复？

translation.en: Not at all . Shall we meet again , say , on Friday morning ?
translation.zh: 一点也不。我们星期五早上再见面好吗？

translation.en: Good . Friday morning at 9 .
translation.zh: 很好。星期五上午10点。

translation.en: Yes , I would like to exchange some money .
translation.zh: 是的，我想兑换一些钱。

translation.en: what currency would you like to trade in ?
translation.zh: 您想用什么货币交易？

translation.en: I would like to exchange Chinese RIB for American dollars . Do you accept $ 100 bills ?
translation.zh: 我想把人民币换成美元。你们能收100美元的钞票吗？

translation.en: No problem , we can accept any denomination . How much would you like to exchange today ?
translation.zh: 没问题，我们可以接受任何面额的钞票。您今天想兑换多少钱？

translation.en: Well , that depends on the rate . How much is the RIB trading at today ?
translation.zh: 嗯，那要看价格了。今天人民币的汇率是多少？

translation.en: It's a shame you didn't come a little earlier , the exchange rate was reset yesterday afternoon . The American dollar is now worth 7.45RMB.If you would like to sell RIB , we can give you a rate of 7.35.Will that be all right ?
translation.zh: 很遗憾你没早点来，昨天下午汇率重新调整了。1美元现在可兑换7.45元人民币。如果你想兑换人民币，我们可以给你7.35的兑换率。可以吗？

translation.en: I guess , here , give me 5,000 RIB worth . I might as well exchange a little extra . Who knows what the exchange rate will be tomorrow !
translation.zh: 给我兑换5000元吧。我想我不妨多换一点。谁知道明天的汇率是多少呢！

translation.en: Donna ! How are you ? It's good to hear your voice .
translation.zh: 唐娜！你好吗？很高兴听到你的声音。

translation.en: Thank you . Jack , it's always a pleasure doing business with you .
translation.zh: 非常感谢。杰克，和你做生意总是很愉快。

translation.en: So how are things in the land of the free and the home of brave ?
translation.zh: 那么，在这个自由的国度、勇敢的家园，情况如何呢?

translation.en: Great ! And , how are things in your neck of the woods ?
translation.zh: 好极了！那你的地盘呢？

translation.en: Things are so great here . I almost smiled myself to death last week . One of my coworkers had to give me CPR .
translation.zh: 这里一切都很好。上周我差点高兴得笑死。我的一个同事不得不给我做心肺复苏术。

translation.en: Oh.Jack , I have missed your sense of humor.Ha ha ha ! Nobody else sees things quite like you do.It ' s your gift .
translation.zh: 噢。杰克，我真怀念你的幽默感。哈哈哈！没有人能像你一样看待事物。这是你的天赋。

translation.en: Or a curse .
translation.zh: 或者说诅咒。

translation.en: Nope , it's a gift.Anyway , we need some more of those mid-range speakers you tricked me into buying last time .
translation.zh: 不，这是天赋。另外，我们还需要一些你上次“骗”我买的中音扬声器。

translation.en: That , my dear , was classic sales technique delivered by a professional .
translation.zh: 亲爱的，这是一个专业人士的经典销售技巧。

translation.en: Are you still gouging your customers the same price per unit ?
translation.zh: 你还在以同样的价格欺“骗”你的顾客吗？

translation.en: Heck no , we doubled the price , but because it's you , I'll let you have'em at 50 off .
translation.zh: 哎呀，当然不是，我们已经把价格提高了一倍了，但因为是你，我给你打五折。

translation.en: You silver-tongued devil . Can't you ever just answer a question with a simple yes or no ?
translation.zh: 你这耍嘴皮子的家伙，你回答问题时，难道不能简单地回答“好”或“不好”吗？

translation.en: I could , but where's the fun in that ?
translation.zh: 我可以啊，但那有什么好玩的？

translation.en: Good afternoon Miss , would you be interested in buying more life insurance ? You know , you can never get enough .
translation.zh: 下午好，小姐，您有兴趣多买一些人寿保险吗？你知道的，你从来都不能买够的。

translation.en: I think my husband has some .
translation.zh: 我想我丈夫有一些。

translation.en: Are you sure he ’ s purchased enough insurance for both of you ? If something terrible happened with your husband , and he doesn ’ t have sufficient insurance , my company does have a policy that could cover you and your husband if something happened to either of you .
translation.zh: 你能肯定他为你们两个都买够了保险吗？如果有什么不好的事发生在你丈夫身上，而他又没有足够的保险，我公司正好有一条保险契约能使你和你丈夫免遭损失，如果你们中的任何一个出了什么事。

translation.en: That ’ s true . If something happened to my husband , I might lose everything . Both of us have to work to keep our home , car , and our children ’ s education . I can ’ t afford that by myself .
translation.zh: 那是真的。如果我丈夫出事，我可能会失去一切。我们两个都必须工作保住我们的家、车子，还有我们孩子的教育。我一个人是负担不起这些的。

translation.en: Could we sit and look at the policy I mentioned and see if that ’ s something suitable for you and your husband ?
translation.zh: 我们可以坐下来看看上述我所讲的这个保险条款，看它是否适合你和你丈夫，好吗？

translation.en: Hello , I'd like to open an account .
translation.zh: 你好，我想开一个帐户。

translation.en: Which account would you like to open ?
translation.zh: 您想开立什么帐户？

translation.en: I'd like to open a savings account . What's the interest rate now ?
translation.zh: 我想开一个储蓄账户。现在的利率是多少？

translation.en: It is 3.2 % . You may earn a little interest on money .
translation.zh: 是3.2%。您可以通过存钱赚点利息。

translation.en: Is there any minimum deposit for the first time ?
translation.zh: 第一次有最低存款额吗？

translation.en: Yes , the opening minimum deposit is 1,000 Yuan .
translation.zh: 有的，开户最低存款额是1000元。

translation.en: What about the later deposits ?
translation.zh: 之后的存款呢？

translation.en: For the later deposits , you can deposit any you want . Even one Yuan is OK .
translation.zh: 以后的存款，您想存多少都行。一块钱也行。

translation.en: OK , that's good .
translation.zh: 好的，很好。

translation.en: Your ID , please .
translation.zh: 请出示您的身份证。

translation.en: Here you are , a thousand Yuan and my ID .
translation.zh: 给你，一千元和我的身份证。

translation.en: Wait a moment , please ... Here is your bankbook . Keep it well please .
translation.zh: 请稍等……这是您的存折。请保管好。

translation.en: Good coming . I would like to open a new account . I want to deposit 500 dollars .
translation.zh: 我来是有好事。我想开一个新帐户存500美元。

translation.en: Very good , sir . What kind would you like ?
translation.zh: 很好，先生。你想开什么样的账户？

translation.en: Could you tell me how many kinds there are in your bank ?
translation.zh: 你能告诉我你们银行有多少种账户吗？

translation.en: Besides the checking account , there's a monthly savings account and a daily interest account .
translation.zh: 除了支票账户外，还有月息储蓄账户和一个日息账户。

translation.en: Oh , I think I'd like to take the monthly savings account then .
translation.zh: 噢，那我想开月息储蓄账户。

translation.en: Would you fill out this form ?
translation.zh: 请填一下这张表好吗？

translation.en: All right . And here's your deposit book .
translation.zh: 好的。这是你的存折。

translation.en: I want to open a saving account , sir.What ' s the proper procedure ?
translation.zh: 先生，我想开一个储蓄账户。请问正确的程序是什么？

translation.en: No , Even a dollar is all right.Here ' s your passbook , sir ; just sign your name on it .
translation.zh: 没有，一美元也行。这是您的存折，先生；签上你的名字就行了。

translation.en: It varies from time to time.At present it is 6 % .
translation.zh: 有时会有变化，目前是6%。

translation.en: By all means.But you have to deposit enough money before you can write out your checks .
translation.zh: 当然可以。但是您必须存足够的钱才能开支票。

translation.en: Hi . May I help you ?
translation.zh: 你好。需要帮忙吗？

translation.en: Yes . What's the buying rate for euro ?
translation.zh: 对。欧元的买入价是多少？

translation.en: 1.15 U . S . dollars to the euro .
translation.zh: 1.15美元。S美元兑欧元。

translation.en: Okay . I'd like to change some euro into US dollars , please .
translation.zh: 可以。我想把一些欧元换成美元。

translation.en: Sure . How much would you like to change ?
translation.zh: 当然。您想换多少钱？

translation.en: Six hundred euro .
translation.zh: 六百欧元。

translation.en: Very good . May I see your passport ?
translation.zh: 非常好。我可以看看你的护照吗？

translation.en: How would you like your bills ?
translation.zh: 您的帐单要多少钱？

translation.en: In fifties please .
translation.zh: 请给我五十美元。

translation.en: I'd like to open a current account .
translation.zh: 我想开一个活期账户。

translation.en: Certainly . May I see your social security and your ID , please .
translation.zh: 没问题。请出示您的社保卡和身份证。

translation.en: Here you are . I wonder how much interest can I earn from a current account .
translation.zh: 给。我想问问活期存款能赚多少利息。

translation.en: Oh , current accounts don't pay out interest .
translation.zh: 噢，活期存款不付利息。

translation.en: It's primarily designed for business transactions . That is , writing checks to pay for bills , buying things and sending money . We won't expect a large amount of deposit in a current account .
translation.zh: 它主要是为商业交易而设计的。也就是说，开支票付账，买东西，寄钱。我们没有期望在活期账户上有大笔存款。

translation.en: I see . How do I draw money for my own use then ?
translation.zh: 我懂了。那我怎么取款自用呢？

translation.en: Excuse me , but can I draw on my account for payment of things I buy in China ?
translation.zh: 打扰一下，请问我能从我的帐户上支取现金来支付我在中国买的东西吗？

translation.en: Certainly , sir . How much do you draw ?
translation.zh: 当然可以，先生。请问您想支取多少钱？

translation.en: RIB 8,000 , please . Would you please tell me my balance ?
translation.zh: 请给我8000。你能告诉我账户的余额吗？

translation.en: Yes , sir . Your balance is RIB 34,000 .
translation.zh: 可以，先生。您的余额是34000。

translation.en: Good morning . I'd like to cash this check .
translation.zh: 早上好。我想兑现这张支票。

translation.en: Yes , sir . Can you show you identity ?
translation.zh: 好的，先生。你能证明你的身份吗？

translation.en: What about the driving license ?
translation.zh: 驾驶证可以吗？

translation.en: Don't you have any other identification ?
translation.zh: 您没有其他身份证明吗？

translation.en: I am sorry . I only have my driving license with me .
translation.zh: 我很抱歉。我只有驾驶证。

translation.en: Ok . Would you please sign your name on the back of the check ?
translation.zh: 好的，请您在支票背面签名好吗？

translation.en: Thank you . Here you are .
translation.zh: 非常感谢。给你。

translation.en: How do you want your money ?
translation.zh: 您想兑现多少钱？

translation.en: Would you give me some in twenties and tens ?
translation.zh: 你能给我一些10美元和20美元吗？

translation.en: All right . Please wait for a moment .
translation.zh: 好的。请稍等片刻。

translation.en: Excuse me , is this the Auto Consumer Loan Center ?
translation.zh: 请问，这里是汽车消费贷款中心吗？

translation.en: Yes . Is there anything I can do for you ?
translation.zh: 对。有什么需要我帮忙的吗？

translation.en: Could you tell me something about the terms and interest rates for personal automobile consumer loan ?
translation.zh: 你能告诉我个人汽车消费贷款的条件和利率吗？

translation.en: The deadline is normally no more than 5 years with the interest adopted according to the corresponding lending rates announced by the PBC .
translation.zh: 期限一般不超过5年，利率按照中国人民银行公布的相应贷款利率执行。

translation.en: I plan to take the loan for 3 years .
translation.zh: 我想要贷款三年。

translation.en: Well , the yearly interest rate is 5.49 % for 3 years . I'm sure you are qualified to apply for this loan .
translation.zh: 嗯，三年的年利率是5.49%。我认为你有资格申请这笔贷款。

translation.en: What about the loan repayment ?
translation.zh: 贷款要怎么还？

translation.en: You may choose a repayment pattern by consulting with our bank , for example , payment of equal amount of principal or of principal and interest on monthly installments .
translation.zh: 您可以与我行协商选择还款方式，例如选择按月分期付款或等额支付本息。

translation.en: Does that mean I should deposit sufficient money to my account prior to the monthly payment date so that you can directly deduct the repayment of the principal and interest ?
translation.zh: 这是否意味着我应该在每月还款日之前将足够的钱存入我的账户，以便您可以直接扣除还本付息？

translation.en: Exactly . You are permitted to effect and early payment in part or in full with the consent of our bank .
translation.zh: 确切地。经我行同意，你方可提前支付部分或全部贷款。

translation.en: That's very thoughtful of you . Thank you so much .
translation.zh: 贵行想得真周到。非常感谢。

translation.en: We are willing to participate in the bid which you advertised in China Daily . Would you please tell me the detail of the tender conditions ?
translation.zh: 我们想参加贵公司在《中国日报》上刊登的投标广告。请告诉我投标条件的细节好吗？

translation.en: You will receive the tender notice next month and you'll find the information .
translation.zh: 下个月收到招标通知后，你会知道相关信息的。

translation.en: OK ! Our company is very interested in the tender . I am sure that we will do our best to win the bidding in building the factory .
translation.zh: 好的，我们公司对投标很感兴趣。我相信我们将尽最大努力在建工厂的投标中获胜。

translation.en: I believe your corporation will try your best and I understand fully your feeling , if your tender conditions proved be suitable for our general conditions of tender , we will accept your submission of tender .
translation.zh: 我相信贵公司会尽最大努力，也完全理解您的感受，如果您的投标符合我们的一般投标条件，我们将接受您的投标。

translation.en: Maybe I have asking too many questions today .
translation.zh: 也许我今天问的问题太多了。

translation.en: That's all right . You can contact me later if you have other questions after you read the tender notice .
translation.zh: 没关系。如果您在阅读招标通知后有其他问题，可以再与我联系。

translation.en: Fine , thanks a lot . Bye !
translation.zh: 好的，非常感谢。再见！

translation.en: Excuse me . Something is wrong with my bank card . Can you help me ?
translation.zh: 不好意思。我的银行卡有点问题。你能帮帮我吗？

translation.en: Yes . What's the problem ?
translation.zh: 嗯嗯。它怎么了？

translation.en: Just a mistake with my name . It should be issued as Steven , but the card is under the name ' Steven ' .
translation.zh: 只是名字弄错了。它应该以史蒂文的名字发行，但弄成了卡的名字是“史蒂文”。

translation.en: Oh , I am very sorry about that . It's our fault . I will arrange someone to correct it immediately .
translation.zh: 哦，我很抱歉。这是我们的错误。我会马上安排人改正的。

translation.en: OK , no problem . To err is human .
translation.zh: 好的，没问题。犯错是人之常情。

translation.en: Anyway , we apologize for the inconvenience we have brought you . Please just wait for a moment , and it will be fixed .
translation.zh: 不管怎样，给您带来的不便我们深表歉意。请稍等，马上就弄好。

translation.en: I'm calling today about a bill that I never received .
translation.zh: 我今天打电话来是为了一张我还没收到的账单。

translation.en: Can you tell me which credit card it was for ?
translation.zh: 您能告诉我是用哪张信用卡的吗？

translation.en: It was for my Master Card .
translation.zh: 是我的万事达卡。

translation.en: You should've gotten that bill two weeks ago .
translation.zh: 您应该在两周前就拿到账单的。

translation.en: I haven't got it in the mail yet .
translation.zh: 但是我现在都还没有收到邮件。

translation.en: The computer is showing that all bills have been mailed .
translation.zh: 电脑显示所有的帐单都已寄出。

translation.en: What am I supposed to do about my bill then ?
translation.zh: 那我的账单该怎么办呢？

translation.en: Maybe you should call your post office .
translation.zh: 也许您应该给邮局打个电话。

translation.en: But if it's their mistake , can I get an extension on my bill payment ?
translation.zh: 但如果这是他们的问题，我能延期付款吗？

translation.en: Yes , but you will need to send us proof of their mistake .
translation.zh: 是的，但是您需要给我们寄来他们错误的证明。

translation.en: Not a problem . Enjoy the rest of your day .
translation.zh: 不客气。祝您生活愉快。

translation.en: I need to open a second account .
translation.zh: 我需要开第二个账户。

translation.en: What kind of account would you like to open ?
translation.zh: 您想开立什么样的帐户？

translation.en: I need another savings account .
translation.zh: 我需要开立另一个储蓄账户。

translation.en: Do you have another account with us ?
translation.zh: 你在我们这里还有别的帐户吗？

translation.en: Would you like to transfer money from that account into your new one ?
translation.zh: 你想把那个帐户的钱转到你的新帐户吗？

translation.en: Transfer $ 100 .
translation.zh: 转账100美元。

translation.en: Give me a moment while I complete your transaction .
translation.zh: 请稍等，我来完成你的交易。

translation.en: That ’ s fine . Thank you .
translation.zh: 好的。非常感谢。

translation.en: I need to make a transfer .
translation.zh: 我需要转账。

translation.en: What account would you like to transfer the money from ?
translation.zh: 您想从哪个帐户转帐？

translation.en: I want to transfer money from my savings account .
translation.zh: 我想从我的储蓄账户转帐。

translation.en: Where do you want the money to go to ?
translation.zh: 你想把钱转到哪里？

translation.en: I want the money to be transferred into my checking account .
translation.zh: 我想把钱转到我的支票账户。

translation.en: How much money are you going to transfer today ?
translation.zh: 你今天要转多少钱？

translation.en: $ 200 will be fine .
translation.zh: 200美元就可以了。

translation.en: Is that all I can do for you today ?
translation.zh: 就这些吗？

translation.en: I won ’ t be needing anything else .
translation.zh: 我不需要别的了。

translation.en: I ’ m making a deposit today .
translation.zh: 我今天要存款。

translation.en: I would like to deposit a check .
translation.zh: 我想存一张支票。

translation.en: You need to sign the back .
translation.zh: 您需要在后面签名。

translation.en: Would you like cash back ?
translation.zh: 您要支取现金吗？

translation.en: Let me get $ 150 back .
translation.zh: 请让我支取150美元吧。

translation.en: Thank you . Have a good one .
translation.zh: 非常感谢。祝你过得愉快。

translation.en: Someone else is making charges on my debit card .
translation.zh: 有人从我的借记卡扣款了。

translation.en: I need to see a statement for your debit card .
translation.zh: 我需要看一下你的借记卡账单。

translation.en: Can you show me which charges you ’ re referring to ?
translation.zh: 你能告诉我你指的是哪项扣款吗？

translation.en: The last four charges .
translation.zh: 最后四项扣款。

translation.en: We will need to do an investigation on this .
translation.zh: 我们需要对此进行调查。

translation.en: How long will that take ?
translation.zh: 需要多长时间？

translation.en: We ’ ll have to freeze payment on those charges until the investigation is finished .
translation.zh: 在调查结束之前，我们将不得不冻结这些费用。

translation.en: I need to go to the ATM .
translation.zh: 我要用自动取款机。

translation.en: So , why don ’ t you ?
translation.zh: 啊，那就用啊？

translation.en: I have no idea how to use the ATM .
translation.zh: 我不知道如何使用自动取款机。

translation.en: This will be my first time using an ATM .
translation.zh: 这是我第一次使用自动取款机。

translation.en: Explain to me how to use it .
translation.zh: 告诉我怎么用。

translation.en: Just put your card into the machine .
translation.zh: 把你的卡放进机器里。

translation.en: Now what do I do ?
translation.zh: 接下来我该怎么办？

translation.en: Then you need to type in your PIN .
translation.zh: 然后你需要输入密码。

translation.en: Just click on one of the choices they give you , and that ’ s it .
translation.zh: 只要点击显示出来的某个选项，就可以了。

translation.en: I need to use the ATM .
translation.zh: 我要用自动取款机。

translation.en: What ’ s stopping you ?
translation.zh: 有什么困难吗？

translation.en: I ’ m not sure how .
translation.zh: 我不知道怎么用。

translation.en: I ’ Ve never used one before .
translation.zh: 我以前从没用过。

translation.en: I can help you figure it out .
translation.zh: 我可以帮你。

translation.en: What do I have to do ?
translation.zh: 我该怎么办？

translation.en: Slide your card into the machine .
translation.zh: 把你的卡插进机器。

translation.en: You need to type your PIN in .
translation.zh: 你需要输入密码。

translation.en: What do I have to do next ?
translation.zh: 我下一步要做什么？

translation.en: Click on whichever option you want , and you ’ re done .
translation.zh: 点击任何你想要的选项就完事了。

translation.en: I would like to open an account please .
translation.zh: 我想开一个帐户。

translation.en: Do you have any form of ID ?
translation.zh: 您有身份证吗？

translation.en: I have my Tennis Club card . Is that good enough ?
translation.zh: 我有我的网球俱乐部卡。这样可以吗？

translation.en: I ’ m afraid not . It has to be a passport or a valid driver ’ s license .
translation.zh: 恐怕不行。必须是护照或有效的驾驶执照。

translation.en: Oh ... wait a minute ... here ’ s my driver ’ s license .
translation.zh: 哦……等一下……这是我的驾照。

translation.en: OK , just fill in this application . You can sit over there . This brochure explains our services . We have free checking , and you will be given a debit card and on ATM card . There is no service
translation.zh: 好的，请填写这张申请表。你可以坐在那边。这本小册子上有我们的服务介绍。我们有提供免费支票，您还会得到一张借记卡和一张ATM卡，（并且）不需要服务费

translation.en: OK , I ’ ll fill out the form and come right back .
translation.zh: 好的，我填一下表格，马上回来。

translation.en: So , Jimmy , how does it feel to have your own money ?
translation.zh: 吉米，拥有自己的钱感觉如何？

translation.en: It ’ s great , dad . I don ’ t mind delivering papers , but the real fun is collecting the money .
translation.zh: 太棒了，爸爸。我不介意送文件，但真正的乐趣是收钱。

translation.en: Even though you are only twelve , it ’ s not too early to start saving a little money .
translation.zh: 即使你只有12岁，现在开始存一点钱也不为时尚早。

translation.en: I ’ Ve never had a bank account before . Why don ’ t I just keep my money under the matters like grandpa does ?
translation.zh: 我以前从未有过银行账户。为什么我不能像爷爷那样把钱藏起来呢？

translation.en: You know you would spend it . And also , money in the bank earns interest .
translation.zh: 你知道你会花掉的。而且，银行里的钱也能赚取利息。

translation.en: But what if I need my money suddenly ?
translation.zh: 但是如果我突然需要钱怎么办？

translation.en: The bank will give you a PIN , and you can withdraw money from any ATM .
translation.zh: 银行会给你一个密码，你就可以从自动取款机上取款了。

translation.en: Great ! So it ’ s almost the same as keeping it under the matters !
translation.zh: 太好了！所以这几乎和把它藏起来是一样的!

translation.en: Not quite . You have to maintain a minimum balance of twenty dollars . And sometimes the bank has service charges . But you don ’ t have to worry about that yet . Let ’ s go make your first depot
translation.zh: 不完全是。你必须保持至少20美元的余额。有时银行还要收手续费。但你还不必担心。我们去建造你的第一个存款吧。

translation.en: OK . Guess I have to do that before . I can make money my first withdrawal .
translation.zh: 好的。我想我以前就该这么做。我第一次提款就能赚钱。

translation.en: I ’ d like to open a savings account . Can you tell me how to do it ?
translation.zh: 我想开一个储蓄账户。你能告诉我怎么做吗？

translation.en: Ok , you have to fill out the form . And I let me see three identification cards or documents .
translation.zh: 好的，您得填一下表格。我让我看了三张证件或者证明。

translation.en: I have the driver ’ s license , a membership card and my passport . Would we do ?
translation.zh: 我有驾照、会员卡和护照。接下来该怎么做呢？

translation.en: Let me see them . Yes . There ’ re ok .
translation.zh: 让我看看。对。这些都可以。

translation.en: What ‘ s the minimum amount I can deposit in an account ?
translation.zh: 我能存进帐户的最低金额是多少？

translation.en: You can deposit and ensure amount of ten dollars .
translation.zh: 你可以存十美元保证金。

translation.en: Can you tell me , Ms . Smith , about the training programs you initiated this year ?
translation.zh: 你能告诉我吗，史密斯女士，你能向我介绍一下今年你发起的培训计划的情况吗？

translation.en: We ran a call center training service and language program to ensure that our customer service representatives are well trained .
translation.zh: 我们开办了电话中心服务培训和语言培训,以保证服务人员受到良好的培训。

translation.en: What ’ s the result ?
translation.zh: 成果如何？

translation.en: We directly attribute an increase in our customer service feedback of 50 % to the increase in language skills and training that our employees have received .
translation.zh: 我们认为客户服务反馈增加了百分之五十归功于言语技巧培训和员工培训。

translation.en: That seems very impressive . Good work !
translation.zh: 成果很显著。干得好。

translation.en: Thank you , but I cannot take all the credit . Our employees have all worked very hard to increase their productivity level .
translation.zh: 谢谢，但是功劳不是我一个人的。我们的员工工作都非常勤奋，提高了工作效率。

translation.en: The consignments of chemical instruments have just reached us . We have to lodge a claim against you for inferior quality I am afraid .
translation.zh: 我们刚收到一批化学仪器。恐怕我们得就质量低劣的问题向你方提出索赔。

translation.en: We bought 1,000 sets of chemical instruments from you , but there are 40 not up to the standard .
translation.zh: 我们向你们购买了1000套化学仪器，但有40套不合格。

translation.en: It's hard for us to believe it . Our instruments have been the best quality for years . Have you any reliable evidence ?
translation.zh: 我们觉得难以置信。多年来，我们的仪器质量都是最好的。你们有可靠的证据吗？

translation.en: Here is the survey report from a well-known public surveyor in London . You may inspect the defective instruments personally
translation.zh: 这是伦敦一位著名的公共测量师的测量报告。你们可以亲自检查有缺陷的仪器

translation.en: Well . According to the contract , we are responsible for repairing or replacing those defective instruments . We ’ ll send our technicians to repair them .
translation.zh: 好的。根据合同，我们会负责修理或更换那些有缺陷的仪器。我们将派技术人员去修理。

translation.en: Forty faulty instruments means that 4 % are not up to the standard . You should compensate us for 4 % of the total account on the contract , as well as for the inspection fee .
translation.zh: 40台故障仪器意味着4%（的产品）不合格。你方应赔偿我方合同总额的4%，以及检验费。

translation.en: I am sorry about the quality problem , but I propose we compensate you for 3 % of the total value apart from the inspection fee .
translation.zh: 对于质量问题我很抱歉，但我想除了检验费外，我们只能赔偿合同总额的3%。

translation.en: All right . In that case we are still willing to do business with you .
translation.zh: 好吧。这样的话，我们仍然可以继续合作。
